title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana omassa kodissa, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Seinäjoelle. Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla. Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava tulo on keskimäärin noin 3000 € / kk, kun sinulla on neljä hoitolastaja sinulla kertyy vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpielämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta tai halua opiskella työn ohessa
* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia
* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja
* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Valmiin Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitokonseptin, joka on jo usean yrittäjämme toimesta todettu toimivaksi. Konsepti sisältää kaiken tarvittavan menestyneen perhepäivähoidon pyörittämiseen.
* Kaiken tarvittavan avun yrityksen perustamiseen ja pyörittämiseen. Kaikki on valmiiksi mietitty ja selvitetty puolestasi. Koulutuksemme ja ketjun jatkuva tuki varmistaa, ettet koskaan jää talousasioiden kanssa yksin.
* Ihanan Kultapalat-yhteisön, jossa pääset vaihtamaan ajatuksia muiden Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajien kanssa.




Hae rohkeasti mukaan, tässä porukassa on kivaa sekä aikuisilla että lapsilla!

title: Supervisor - Pharmacy Programs
description:
Join our team as a day shift, full-time, Supervisor in Pharmacy Programs at INTEGRIS Health Cancer Institute in Oklahoma City, OK.

The Supervisor Pharmacy Programs is responsible for managing, educating, marketing, and cultivating potential program participants as well as providing onsite comprehensive benefit and advocacy services for patients enrolled in the Retail Pharmacy programs. Adheres to National Patient Safety Goals as appropriate based on the level of patient contact this position requires. INTEGRIS Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Supervisor Pharmacy Programs is responsible for managing, educating, marketing, and cultivating potential program participants as well as providing onsite comprehensive benefit and advocacy services for patients enrolled in the Retail Pharmacy programs. Adheres to National Patient Safety Goals as appropriate based on the level of patient contact this position requires.

The Supervisor Pharmacy Programs responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Develops and cultivates relationships with targeted referral sources to maximize patient enrollment.
  • Acts as the participants advocate in navigating all aspects of Pharmacy programs. Works with various INTEGRIS departments and providers to assist in coordinating transitions in care programs.
  • Promotes the Pharmacy programs at patient focused group meetings and events.
  • Educates INTEGRIS pharmacy patients about the Pharmacy programs by meeting with them individually and providing informational program materials.
  • Determines patient program eligibility, obtains patient benefit information, and enrolls eligible patients in the program.
  • Educates participants about their specific benefit plan and applicable co pays.
  • Works with interdisciplinary team to refer ineligible patients to other service providers.
  • Maintains documentation of all program participants and follows up on outstanding issues to ensure a smooth and timely plan enrollment.
  • Anticipates changes in an enrolled participants benefit coverage which impacts co pays and works to identify payment options such as payment plans, charity care, and/or assists the participant in identifying new pharmacy benefit plans as applicable.
  • Compiles and analyzes patient data which will be utilized to improve the IntegrisCAREs Pharmacy program for its participants.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field
  • Associates degree, with 2 years additional experience may be substituted for bachelor's degree
  • Greater than or equal to 5 years of pharmacy experience including, but not limited to, the following: knowledge of specialty pharmacy patient management, prior authorizations, benefits investigations, and financial assistance can be substituted for degrees
  • 2 years pharmacy technician experience
  • Strong computer skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Must be able to communicate effectively in English (verbal/written)

INTEGRIS Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will receive consideration regardless of membership in any protected status as defined by applicable state or federal law, including protected veteran or disability status.

title: Airway Transportation Systems Specialist (SOC NOM)
description:
The Airway Transportation Systems Specialists (ATSS) at this level is recognized as the principal expert in their field. All duties of an ATSS are tied to maintaining safe and efficient operating capacity of the vast and complex network of electronics systems required for the world's largest air traffic control and navigation system. ATSS personnel install, evaluate, maintain, modify and certify facilities, services and equipment that support the National Airspace System (NAS).

As an ATSS (SOC NOM), the incumbent is recognized as the principal expert for development of workable solutions for any unanticipated situations adversely affecting operationally critical systems of the NAS. Serves as senior project manager or team leader for large, challenging and complex work activities. Represents the FAA as a senior technical authority for major agency activities, emerging technologies and customer concerns Responsible for establishing and managing program goals and objectives and formulating project plans; develops, interprets, recommends changes, and has broad discretion to insure compliance with organizational objectives and policies; identifies, procures, distributes and tracks resources needed to accomplish large work activities. Works with customers at high internal and external organization levels to the FAA to resolve complex issues to insure the integrity of the NAS. Coordinates with multiple air traffic entities to shut down and restore facilities, systems, and services to prevent activities from disrupting air traffic operations. Quickly resolves restoration problems with minimal impact to the NAS. Performs work providing agency-wide leadership for highly complex and challenging technical activities. This may be accomplished using innovative concepts and approaches for problems that have resisted earlier efforts at resolution. Maintains authority to commit the necessary resources to accomplish the agency's mission. Develops innovative approaches to attain organizational objectives and optimize the use of resources. Works independently, monitors and evaluates trend data on a nationwide basis to develop workable solutions for sustaining the NAS. Keeps abreast of changes in technology and the new systems coming on-line. Provides recommendations to senior level managers for enhancement of systems and air traffic operations. Formulates Standard Operation Procedures (SOP) for local use, dealing with Emergency and Safety situations at assigned facilities. Incumbent has the authoritative responsibility for timely upward reporting of NAS information that could have an impact to operations for purposes of Situation Awareness (i.e. NOT AM, SAL Paging function). Understands the current state and dynamics of local operations and being able to anticipate future changes and developments. Integrates Operational Risk Management (ORM) into restoration, schedule maintenance activities, and all planned projects, ensuring that all customers and users of services are included and involved in ORM implementation and planning. Incumbent is management's representative during non-administrative hours. Formulates and recommends organizational positions on major agency activities to senior managers. Technical decisions are considered authoritative in his/her area of expertise. Is considered a technical expert within the FAA for an assigned system or specialty area. Work directly supports the objectives of the agency and the safe and continual operation of the NAS. Contacts are both internal and external. Formulates and recommends organizational positions on major agency activities to senior managers. Represents the FAA as a senior technical authority for major projects and programs. Works independently. Has broad discretion to ensure alignment with organizational objectives and policies. Develops innovative approaches to attain organizational objectives and optimize the use of resources. Identifies and justifies the resources needed to accomplish large work activities. Provides expert guidance and instruction to address diverse, complex issues that often cross multiple projects, programs, or functional areas. Develops plans, techniques, and policies to address current or anticipated problems and issues. Work is typically reviewed for success in achieving desired results. Performs other duties as assigned. Incumbent must possess a valid driver's license.

We are not accepting applications from noncitizens.

title: Research Associate
location: Edinburgh - Central Area, Midlothian, United Kingdom
description:
Grade UE07: £41,064.00 - £48,822.00 Per Annum

College of Science and Engineering/ School of Informatics

Full Time: 35 hours per week.

Fixed term contract: 12 months, Until 31/12/2027.

The Opportunity:

Together we can do great things. Be part of something bigger.With roles from hospitality to research, there’s a career for everyone at the University of Edinburgh. We can offer opportunities for you to develop in your career and make a real difference in the communities around us while contributing to the world at large.

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We look for the best in the field across all disciplines and provide a working environment where academics can develop their careers and passion for their chosen subject area. We offer the full range of academic roles and have a genuine focus on our student’s performance and wellbeing.

The successful candidate will work on the RubberDUQ project within the Quantum Software Lab, developing mathematical foundations and practical tools for hybrid quantum-classical programming. The project uses categorical semantics to give quantum programs, including their interaction with classical control and measurement, a precise meaning, and turns that meaning into compilers and optimisations that are correct by construction. Depending on the candidate's background, the work may range from category theory and programming language semantics to compiler design and implementation. The Research Associate will collaborate with the project team and with QSL's academic and industrial partners. This post is advertised as full-time.

People have always been at the heart of our work. As part of the University, you are a part of our community. We are looking for people with drive, determination, and a passion for what they do. We are a place where everyone is welcome and offer a range of policies and benefits designed to support you in building the right meaningful/personalised flexibility for you.

Your skills and attributes for success:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics).
  • The following criteria are not strict yes/no requirements; rather, candidates will be assessed on the strength of their experience and evidence across these areas. Recruitment will aim to select the candidates demonstrating the strongest overall profile.
  • Experience conducting research in one or more of: categorical semantics, programming language theory, compilers, or quantum computing.
  • Proven expertise in the mathematical or software techniques required to undertake the proposed research, such as category theory, formal semantics, or compiler implementation.
  • Evidence of high-quality research performance (e.g., publications, technical reports, software contributions, or comparable outputs).
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly, both verbally and in writing.

Contact details for enquiries (name and email address):

Prof. Chris Heunen, chris.heunen@ed.ac.uk

A career with us has a range of other benefits that can be tailored to your lifestyle:

  • Professional development and subject matter expertise
  • Leading-edge research
  • Contributing to the work and purpose of the University.

This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns. We are also open to considering requests for hybrid working (on a non-contractual basis) that combines a mix of remote and regular on-campus working.

title: Senior Information Security Engineer - Security Engineering

title: Data Product Analyst
description:
The Data Product Analyst serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and data engineering for the international data platform. This role combines strong SQL and technical depth with core business analysis skills to ensure that data is trustworthy, accurately specified, and effectively leveraged to inform decision making. The Data Product Analyst owns the path from business request to trusted data in production: eliciting complete requirements, following the work through build and release, and monitoring the data once it is live. Over time, the role becomes the subject matter expert for international data.

  • Act as the Data Subject Matter Expert to stakeholders, building deep knowledge of international data across the end‑to‑end data supply chain through hands-on work on every intake and production incident

  • Make international data trustworthy by working directly with business and marketing stakeholders to resolve data issues and build their confidence in the data.

  • Query, trace, and validate data from multiple sources to investigate anomalies, answer ad hoc requests, and uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

  • Translate analytical findings into clear, business friendly insights that support decision‑making. Go beyond producing numbers: state what they mean in a sentence and anticipate the stakeholder's next question.

  • Elicit, document, and manage business, functional, and nonfunctional requirements through techniques such as interviews, workshops, process analysis, and user story creation. Write complete intakes that capture every requirement in as much detail as possible.

  • Own delivery after handoff: check in regularly with data engineering, confirm that what is built matches what was requested, and drive issues to resolution without waiting for direction.

  • Support prioritization by assessing business value, impacts, complexity, and risk.

  • Ensure traceability of requirements from intake through development, testing, and deployment.

  • Collaborate with data engineering analysts, architects, and engineers to ensure solutions reflect business context and use cases.

  • Define acceptance and UAT criteria that go beyond what the business specifies, including data accuracy, completeness, and edge cases; support user validation and provide structured feedback for continuous improvement.

  • Monitor and enhance data quality through profiling, validation, remediation, and alignment with organizational priorities.

  • Build and maintain business-rule monitors and alerts that catch business logic issues engineering's technical checks may miss, and review past incidents to close monitoring gaps.

  • Participate in PSG and release go/no-go meetings to stay informed on production changes that may affect data quality or reporting.

  • Manage time and availability: decide which meetings need active participation versus a recording and raise calendar overload or availability issues early.

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, analytics engineering, or similar roles, with extensive hands-on SQL experience.

  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross functional environments and support the delivery of data products that serve multiple stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated record of ownership: following requests through delivery and production and resolving issues across business and engineering teams.

  • Advanced SQL and analytical toolkit (with Python proficiency) used to explore, transform, and validate complex datasets across multiple product disciplines, including tracing data lineage and verifying data integrity without engineering dependencies.

  • Solid technical background in data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS), with enough depth to understand how data products are built and to partner credibly with engineers.

    • Skilled at requirements elicitation and translating business needs into technical specifications.

    • Skilled in crafting user stories, acceptance criteria, and high-quality product and data documentation to support scalable, repeatable workflows.

    • Strong understanding of data stewardship principles, including data quality, lineage, metadata management, and responsible data use and the ability to adapt analytical and stewardship skills across a wide range of use cases.

    • Comfortable connecting data across multiple systems and enriching datasets to enable new insights for business stakeholders.

    • Excellent communication, with the ability to tailor messages for both technical teams (engineering, data science) and business stakeholders.

    • Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across cross functional teams.

    • Thrives in ambiguity by asking clarifying questions, exploring new data sources, and uncovering insights that drive team action and improve data quality.

    • Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving, especially when interpreting incomplete, messy, or evolving datasets.

title: Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, englanti
description:
Sasky Mäntän seudun koulutuskeskus on monialainen ammatillinen oppilaitos, joka työllistää yhteensä noin 75 henkilöä. Opiskelijoita on noin 750. Meillä pääset osaksi asiantuntevaa työyhteisöä, jossa tehdään yhteistyötä ja kehitetään ammatillista koulutusta vaikuttavasti ja opiskelijalähtöisesti.


Haemme päätoimista tuntiopettajaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan palvelussuhteeseen opettamaan ammatillisten perustutkintojen yhteisten tutkinnon osien englannin opintoja. Tehtävään voi kuulua myös muiden yhteisten tutkinnon osien opetusta. Työ sisältää sekä lähiopetusta Mäntässä että verkko-opetusta koko Saskyn yhteisellä verkkotarjottimella. Virkasuhteen alkamisajankohta on 7.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Englannin opettajan perustehtäviin kuuluvat
eri alojen perustutkinto-opiskelijoiden opetus
opiskelijoiden ohjaaminen ja oppimisen etenemisen seuranta
osaamisen arviointi
opetuksen ja ohjauksen suunnittelu ja kehittäminen yhdessä opettajatiimin kanssa.


Edellytämme tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä asetuksen 986/1998, 14 § (28.12.2017/1150) mukaista yhteisten tutkinnon osien opettajan kelpoisuutta.

Lisäksi edellytämme
kokemuksesta ja osaamista englannin opetuksesta
kokemusta opetuksesta ammatillisessa ja osaamisperusteisesta koulutuksesta
verkkopedagogista osaamista
kokemusta verkko-opetuksesta ja digitaalisten oppimateriaalien laatimisesta
hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Arvostamme
monipuolisten pedagogisten menetelmien hallintaa
hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja
hyvää ohjauksellista työotetta
kykyä huomioida oppimisen tuen tarpeita ja tukea erilaisia oppijoita
itsenäistä, kehittävää työotetta ja halua kehittyä työssä.



Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn ammatillisen koulutuksen kehittämisen parissa sekä mahdollisuuden työskennellä osaavassa ja kannustavassa työyhteisössä.

Lisäksi käytössäsi ovat
kattavat työterveyspalvelut 6 kk palvelussuhteen alkamisesta lähtien
vuotuinen Epassin liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu
mahdollisuus edulliseen henkilöstöruokailuun.

Virkasuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunta-alan opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (OVTES, osio C) mukaan. Palkka muodostuu valitun henkilön pätevyyden, koulutuksen ja kokemuksen perusteella. Kelpoisen, kokoaikaisen tuntiopettajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3885,98-5007,24 euroa/kk perustuen olennaisen työkokemuksen pituuteen. Peruspalkan lisäksi maksetaan tehtäväkohtaista lisää ja mahdollisia virkaehtosopimuksen mukaisia lisiä.

Tehtävässä sovelletaan OVTES:n mukaista vuosityöaikaa. Päätoimisen tuntiopettajan laskennallinen vuosityöaika on palvelussuhteen alkaessa vähintään 1300 tuntia. Päätoimisen tuntiopettajan vuosityöaika voi vaihdella vuosittain 800-1500 tunnin välillä. Vuosityöaika vahvistetaan kalenterivuosittain.


Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Valitun on ennen työn vastaanottamista esitettävä lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote, joka ei saa olla kuutta (6) kuukautta vanhempi. Valitun on lisäksi esitettävä kuukauden kuluessa palvelussuhteen alkamisesta todistus terveydentilastaan.


Hakemus tulee tehdä 9.11.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä sähköisellä lomakkeella osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Hakuajan jälkeen toimitettuja hakemuksia ei voida ottaa huomioon tehtävää täytettäessä. Hakemusten perusteella soveltuvimmat hakijat haastatteluun heti hakuajan päätyttyä ja haastattelukutsut lähetetään hakuajan päätyttyä viikolla 46. Haastattelut tehtävään järjestetään Mäntän seudun koulutuskeskuksella maanantaina 16.11.2026.


Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää tehtävästä, voit olla yhteydessä koulutuspäällikkö Katri Isomäkeen. Tavoitat hänet puhelimitse numerosta 040 679 1212. Emme valitettavasti pysty vastaamaan sähköpostitiedusteluihin.

title: Turun normaalikoulun alakoulun erityisopettajan määräaikainen tehtävä 1.12.26-31.7.27
description:
Turun normaalikoulu hakee osaavaan ja motivoituneeseen joukkoonsa alakoulun erityisopettajaa ajalle 1.12.2026-31.7.2027. Kyseessä on määräaikainen tuntiopettajuus.

Tehtävänkuvaus

Erityisopettajana toimit työyhteisössämme oppimisen tuen ammattilaisena oppilaiden hyvinvointia tukien. Tehtävääsi kuuluu lähinnä ryhmäkohtaisen tuen suunnittelu ja toteutus luokilla 3-6 tiiviissä yhteistyössä luokanopettajien, aineenopettajien ja muun koulun henkilökunnan kanssa. Lisäksi osallistut tarvittaessa oppilaskohtaisen tuen suunnitteluun.

Yksi osa tehtävää on opetusharjoittelijoiden ohjaus. Toimit turvallisena ja pedagogisesti vahvana ohjaajana, joka tukee harjoittelijoiden ammatillista kasvua ja ohjaa heidän edistymistään yhteistyössä muiden opettajankoulutuksen ammattilaisten kanssa.

Lisäksi osallistut aktiivisesti oppimisen tuen käytänteiden ja oppimisympäristöjen kehittämiseen sekä koulun yhteisölliseen kehittämistyöhön.

Etsimämme henkilö

Odotamme sinulta

- erityisopettajan kelpoisuutta ja hyvää opetustaitoa

- kahden vuoden työkokemusta erityisopettajaksi valmistumisen jälkeen

- kykyä kohdata oppilaat ja heidän huoltajansa yksilöllisesti ja kykyä rakentaa turvallinen oppimisympäristö

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- joustavaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- valmiuksia harjoittelukouluille kuuluvaan tutkimus-, kokeilu tai kehittämistoimintaan

Toivomme sinulta

- kykyä toimia monikielisessä ja monikulttuurisessa ympäristössä

- halua oman työn jatkuvaan kehittämiseen

Lisäansioiksi katsomme kokemuksen alakoulun erityisopettajana toimimisesta ja erityisluokanopettajan pätevyyden. Yliopiston kouluna arvostamme perehtyneisyyttä oman alan tieteelliseen tutkimukseen ja kokemusta tutkimus- ja kehittämistoiminnasta.

Arvostamme yhteisöllisyyttä ja edistämme tasa-arvoa, monimuotoisuutta ja inklusiivisuutta. Kannustammekin erilaisen taustan omaavia päteviä hakijoita hakemaan avoimia tehtäviämme.

Tarjoamme

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja vastuullisen opettajan tehtävän harjoittelukoulussa osana Turun yliopiston kasvatustieteiden tiedekuntaa ja sen opettajankoulutusta. Tehtävässä sinulla on erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi sekä opettajan työssä että opetusharjoittelijoiden ohjaajana. Käytössäsi ovat nykyaikaiset opetustilat ja tarvittavat työvälineet.

Lue lisää meistä [Tervetuloa meille töihin](https://www.utu.fi/fi/yliopisto/tule-meille-toihin) -sivulta, jossa lisää siitä mitä yliopisto tarjoaa työntekijälleen.

Palkkaus ja koeaika

Tehtäväkohtainen palkkaus määräytyy yliopistojen harjoittelukoulujen palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti ja asettuu vaativuustasolle 6 (3909,47 euroa) Lisäksi maksetaan henkilökohtaiseen suoriutumiseen perustuvaa palkanosaa, joka on työsuhteen alussa tyypillisesti 10-20 %.

Tehtävässä on neljän kuukauden koeaika.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työn aloittamista esitettävä työnantajalle nähtäväksi lain 504/2002 edellyttämä hyväksyttävä rikosrekisteriote.

Hakuohjeet

Jätäthän hakemuksesi sähköisen rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 5.11.2026, klo 16.00 mennessä.

Hakijoiden on liitettävä hakemukseensa:

- motivaatiokirje

- ansioluettelo

- tutkintotodistukset

- mahdollisten suosittelijoiden yhteystiedot

- muut mahdolliset tehtävän täyttämiseen vaikuttavat asiakirjat

Rekrytointihaastattelut haastatteluun kutsuttaville järjestetään 11. marraskuuta 2026 klo 9-11.

Lisätietoja antaa

Lisätietoja tehtävästä sekä rekrytointiprosessista antaa Turun normaalikoulun perusopetuksen rehtori Tuija Niemi puh. 050-367 0336, s-posti: tuija.niemi@utu.fi .


Turun normaalikoulu

[Turun normaalikoulu](https://sites.utu.fi/tnk/) (Norssi) on Turun yliopiston harjoittelukoulu. Koulussa suorittavat opetusharjoitteluaan sekä luokan- että aineenopettajaharjoittelijat osana opettajan pedagogisia opintojaan. Näihin opintoihin liittyy myös oppimisen ja opettamisen tutkimus- ja kehitystyö sekä opettajien täydennyskoulutus ja koulutusvienti ulkomaille.

[Kasvatustieteiden tiedekunta](https://www.utu.fi/fi/yliopisto/kasvatustieteiden-tiedekunta) on arvostettu tutkimus- ja koulutusyhteisö sekä kasvatus- ja koulutusalan vahva verkostovaikuttaja. Tiedekuntaan kuuluu kasvatustieteiden laitos Turussa, opettajankoulutuslaitos Turun ja Rauman kampuksilla sekä Turun ja Rauman normaalikoulut.

Turun yliopisto on 25 000 opiskelijan ja työntekijän innostava ja kansainvälinen akateeminen yhteisö. Rakennamme kestävää tulevaisuutta monitieteisellä tutkimuksella, koulutuksella ja yhteistyöllä. Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisia urapolkuja, kannustamme jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja panostamme yhteisömme hyvinvointiin. Tule meille tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitystä muuttuvassa maailmassa!

Tutustu avoimiin tehtäviimme



Sähköposti: No-Reply-eRekry@utu.fi Tietoa hakijalle

Hakulomaketta ei voi tallentaa keskeneräisenä. Voit kuitenkin palata muokkaamaan ja täydentämään hakemustasi sen lähettämisen jälkeen aina hakuajan päättymiseen saakka. Saat linkin hakemuksesi muokkaamista varten sähköpostiisi, kun olet jättänyt hakemuksesi järjestelmään.

Sinulla on 6 tuntia aikaa työhakemuksesi täyttämiseen ennen aikakatkaisua.

title: Client Solutions Manager
description:
Job Description

The Client Solutions Manager collaborates with the Client Solutions Director, UK & Europe to understand the needs of prospective and existing clients, and development of the BGIS solution offering and related value propositions. The Client Solutions Manager collaborates with internal stakeholders in developing and executing the required sales strategy including but is not limited to lead generation, business development, building a long-term sales pipeline, business case development, delivery model development, proposal development & writing. Client Solutions Manager stays abreast of assigned client vertical markets and actively participates in related industry associations supporting BGIS industry awareness.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

Solutioning

  • Supports development of appropriate BGIS delivery solutions that address prospective client’s needs and business strategy/objectives and takes into consideration the client’s business and value drivers, as well as perceived value of the proposed solution(s). Solutions include all aspects of the required delivery model such as organisational design, process design, financials & business case, savings strategies etc.
  • Support development of all aspects of BGIS delivery solution to meet client needs.
  • Collaborate with BGIS Product Lines to develop solutions in support of business development efforts.
  • Brings forward innovative and improved ways of working to enhance the Client Solutions offering to new and existing clients.

Proposals

  • Leads sales opportunities, reviews PQQ & RFP requirements and supports the Client Solutions Director, UK & Europe in understanding factors such as client needs, business strategy/objectives, value perception, business and value drivers.
  • Supports development of appropriate strategy which responds to all tender factors.
  • Leads conceiving, writing and editing of RFP responses, both directly and in collaboration with Operations and SME’s.
  • Monitors portals for opportunities and engages with Salesforce to ensure pipelines and bid trajectory is accurate and up to date.
  • Creates visually compelling presentation material and takes part in presentations to new and existing customers where required.

Industry Awareness

  • Elevates the visibility of the organization and thought leadership with involvement in the application of industry awards and speaking engagements on behalf of BGIS Global Integrated Solutions.
  • Develops and maintains current knowledge of assigned vertical markets, their competitive landscapes and prospective clients.
  • Actively engages in social media in alignment with BGIS’ social media and marketing strategies to champion the brand.

Business Development Existing Clients

  • In collaboration with in place account teams and stakeholders, undertake specific business development assignments with existing clients as assigned.
  • Implement BGIS Way – consultative sales approach for all pursuits. Actively track and report on pursuit process using Salesforce.
  • Support the retention of existing customers through understanding their needs and strategic goals, and reverse engineering bespoke solutions to meet their needs.

Knowledge & Skills

  • University graduate or Professionally qualified with demonstrated progressive, industry knowledge and related experience that usually comes with more than 5 years of FM or similar industry delivery sales experience
  • Specific client vertical market experience and expertise to support BGIS market growth
  • Fully developed presentation, communication, interpersonal & consultative skills.
  • Collaborative and innovative in approach
  • A team player who will enhance and expand upon the positive culture within the Solutions team
  • Excellent writing & presentation development skills
  • Excellent industry knowledge and experience

At BGIS we believe that diversity and inclusion is a key business driver, such that we never lose sight of its importance as it is woven into the fabric of our organisation. We are committed to maintaining a barrier-free recruitment process by providing equal employment opportunities through recruiting and retention of individuals of all backgrounds. We recognise that promoting diversity is an essential component of our continuing pursuit for organisational success! #BGISUK #LI-JC2

title: Global Director, Mid-Market Onboarding
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As Global Director, Mid-Market Onboarding, you will own and scale the onboarding function for Cloudbeds' fastest-growing and most complex customer segment. You'll lead the team responsible for guiding mid-market customers from contract signature through go-live, adoption, and a clean transition to Account Management. You'll build the frameworks, standards, metrics, and team capability that make that experience world-class and repeatable at scale.

You'll inherit a team of dedicated ICs and leads that have been experimenting with new ways to support these customers and improve their experience. Your charter is to get leadership in place and be maniacal about customer experience while building the project-management rigor that complex mid-market deployments demand. You'll be measured on onboarding velocity, deployment quality, customer satisfaction, and the long-term retention impact of a strong start.

Our Onboarding Team:

Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together with a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Every team member is valued and empowered to share feedback, ideas, and insights so we can learn, grow, and improve both as individuals and as a team. Leaders who thrive here are proactive communicators, collaborative problem-solvers, and true customer advocates who enjoy navigating complexity while building the systems and people that scale it.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Mid-Market Onboarding team — including Onboarding Project Managers and senior coaches — setting clear expectations, performance standards, growth paths, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Own end-to-end onboarding outcomes for mid-market customers from sales handoff through go-live, adoption, and transition to Account Management — diagnosing and fixing execution gaps in training quality, error detection, and deployment velocity.

  • Build standardized onboarding frameworks, SOPs, and configuration standards for complex multi-property and 25–100+ room deployments that balance customization with scalability.

  • Establish and own the metrics that matter: onboarding velocity, deployment quality scores, training completion, CSAT/NPS, and early-lifecycle retention — monitoring portfolio health and intervening early on at-risk projects.

  • Own capacity and staffing planning for the division — forecasting demand, balancing workload across the team, and partnering with leadership on headcount decisions.

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex or at-risk mid-market deployments and partner with Account Management on clean, trust-preserving handoffs.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management — bridging what gets sold and what gets delivered, and contributing to the broader strategy for how Cloudbeds serves mid-market and enterprise-adjacent customers.

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 7+ years in hospitality or hospitality technology, including hands-on customer onboarding or implementation experience and team leadership (time at a hotel, hotel group, or a PMS or hospitality-tech company; OTA or travel-distribution experience on its own does not count).

  • Track record of building or significantly improving onboarding and implementation functions and frameworks.

  • Proven people-leadership experience — hiring, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams in a distributed, global environment.

  • Strong project-management foundation: scope, milestones, timelines, and risk mitigation applied to complex multi-stakeholder deployments.

  • Deep understanding of hotel operations and the complexity of serving multi-property, mid-market hospitality customers.

  • Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution — you can design the framework and roll up your sleeves to implement it.

  • Data-driven: comfortable with KPIs, dashboards, and using insights to drive decisions.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

  • Additional language fluency (Spanish, Portuguese) at a business-professional level.

  • Direct experience onboarding or implementing customers at a hospitality SaaS or PMS company.

  • Familiarity with property management systems, payments, or hospitality fintech.

  • Experience building onboarding or implementation functions at a scale-up stage company.

  • Background working with hotel management companies, small chains, or the consultant ecosystem.

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. description:
Bolt.Works hakee nyt viestinnän suunnittelijaa Kainuun jätehuollon kuntayhtymän eli Ekokympin palvelukseen Kajaaniin.

Ekokymppi on kahdeksan Kainuun kunnan ja Vaalan kunnan omistama kuntayhtymä, joka vastaa alueensa kunnallisen jätehuollon järjestämisestä ja viranomaistehtävistä. Ekokympin palveluihin kuuluvat muun muassa jätteiden vastaanotto, lajitteluasemat, jätteenkuljetusten järjestäminen, kierrätysneuvonta sekä jätehuollon kehittäminen. Toiminnallaan Ekokymppi edistää vastuullista jätehuoltoa, materiaalien hyödyntämistä ja kiertotaloutta koko toimialueellaan.

Tehtävänkuvaus:

Viestinnän suunnittelijana vastaat Ekokympin viestinnän suunnittelusta, koordinoinnista ja käytännön toteutuksesta yhdessä viestintätiimin ja johdon kanssa. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät pitkäjänteinen viestinnän kehittäminen, monikanavainen sisällöntuotanto sekä aktiivinen yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien kanssa.

Pääset rakentamaan Ekokympin viestinnästä entistä suunnitelmallisempaa ja vaikuttavampaa kokonaisuutta. Työssäsi viestit jätehuollon palveluista, kiertotaloudesta ja ympäristöalaan liittyvistä ajankohtaisista asioista ymmärrettävästi ja kiinnostavasti erilaisille kohderyhmille.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:
- Viestinnän suunnittelu, koordinointi ja vuosikellon kehittäminen yhdessä johdon ja viestintätiimin kanssa
- Monikanavainen sisällöntuotanto verkkosivuille, sosiaaliseen mediaan, uutiskirjeisiin ja muihin viestintäkanaviin
- Ekokympin verkkosivujen kehittäminen ja sisällönhallinta
- Viestintäkampanjoiden ja vaikuttavien viestintäkokonaisuuksien suunnittelu ja toteutus
- Sisäisen viestinnän ja viestintämateriaalien kehittäminen
- Yhteistyö paikallisten ja valtakunnallisten sidosryhmien sekä median kanssa
- Tapahtumien, asiakastilaisuuksien ja erilaisten tietoiskujen suunnittelu ja järjestäminen
- Viestinnän tulosten seuranta, analysointi ja raportointi
- Osallistuminen ajankohtais- ja kriisiviestintään yhteistyössä johdon kanssa

Tehtävässä työskentelet tiiviisti Ekokympin johdon ja muun henkilöstön kanssa. Rooli on itsenäinen asiantuntijatehtävä, eikä siihen sisälly esihenkilövastuuta.

Odotamme sinulta:

Etsimme viestinnän ammattilaista, jolla on kyky yhdistää suunnitelmallinen tekeminen käytännönläheiseen sisällöntuotantoon. Osaat hallita useita samanaikaisia kokonaisuuksia, reagoida nopeasti muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja mukauttaa viestintää erilaisten kohderyhmien tarpeisiin.

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kokemusta monikanavaisesta viestinnästä, sisällöntuotannosta ja viestintäprojektien hallinnasta
- Kykyä suunnitella, aikatauluttaa ja koordinoida viestintää pitkäjänteisesti
- Erinomaista suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista ilmaisutaitoa
- Hyviä teknisiä valmiuksia ja kokemusta erilaisista sisällöntuotannon ja viestinnän työkaluista
- Itsenäistä, oma-aloitteista ja järjestelmällistä työskentelyotetta
- Hyviä yhteistyö-, esiintymis- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Paineensietokykyä ja valmiutta toimia myös nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa
- Mahdollisuutta käyttää omaa autoa työtehtävissä

Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen esimerkiksi WordPressin, Microsoft 365, Lianan, Adobe InDesignin sekä sosiaalisen median työkalujen käytöstä. Lisäksi arvostamme Kainuun alueen paikallistuntemusta, kokemusta media- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyöstä sekä kiinnostusta kiertotalouteen ja ympäristöalaan.

Aikaisempi kokemus kuntasektorilta tai julkishallinnon viestinnästä on hyödyksi, mutta tärkeintä on käytännönläheinen ote, vahva viestinnällinen osaaminen ja halu kehittää Ekokympin viestintää.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- Vakituisen ja monipuolisen asiantuntijatehtävän yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisellä toimialalla
- Mahdollisuuden kehittää Ekokympin viestintää ja vaikuttaa sen toimintatapoihin
- Kiinnostavan työympäristön kiertotalouden, ympäristöalan ja vastuullisen jätehuollon parissa
- Laajan työterveyshuollon ja muut työsuhde-edut
- Hyvät työskentelytilat ja ergonomiset työvälineet
- Koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuuksia
- Kuntasektorin vuosilomaedut
- Mahdollisuuden hybridimalliseen työskentelyyn perehdytysjakson jälkeen

Tehtävän tasopalkka on noin 3 800 €/kk, jonka lisäksi maksetaan KVTES mukaisia kokemus- ja henkilökohtaisia lisiä.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan kunnallista yleistä virka- ja työehtosopimusta (KVTES). Työaika on toimistotyöaika eli 36,25 h viikossa.

Työskentelypaikka sijaitsee Kajaanissa. Tehtävän ensimmäiset kuusi kuukautta työskennellään kokonaan paikan päällä kattavan perehdytyksen ja organisaation toimintaan tutustumisen varmistamiseksi. Työsuhde on aluksi kolmen vuoden määräaikainen ja sen jälkeen mahdollisuus vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde solmitaan suoraan Kainuun jätehuollon kuntayhtymän kanssa. Bolt.Works toimii rekrytointikumppanina.

title: Principal Cloud Network Engineer
description:
Overview

At Microsoft, our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, with Azure serving as the physical platform that underpins this mission. Azure Global Networking designs, builds and operates the optical, wide-area and edge networks that connect every Azure region to each other and to the world. This network is the lifeline of connectivity for Azure and for the services people use every day. It is also, increasingly, the infrastructure on which artificial intelligence is built. Training frontier models and serving inference at planetary scale are network problems as much as they are compute problems.


We are building the next generation of that network. That means rethinking how the optical, packet and control layers work together, moving more of the network onto open hardware and software we control, and bringing new optical and fiber technologies into production as they mature. It also means changing how the physical network itself is built and maintained, using automation and robotics to make that work faster, safer and more consistent.

As a Principal Cloud Network Engineer, you will help decide what this network becomes and then take it into production. You will own significant parts of the next generation architecture, drive the disaggregation of the hardware the network runs on, and help lead how automation and robotics change the way physical infrastructure is built and operated. This is a role for someone who wants to work across the boundaries between light, packets, software and the physical world, on a network that can never be taken offline.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Next Generation Network Design: Own significant parts of the multi-year architecture for Azure's global network across the optical, packet and control layers. Design so that capacity, topology and protection can each evolve independently, and so that no single change or failure can reach the entire backbone.
  • Hardware Disaggregation: Help move the network from vendor-integrated systems to open, interchangeable building blocks: merchant silicon, open network operating systems such as SONiC, open optical line systems, and pluggable and co-packaged optics. Define requirements, evaluate platforms, and work with silicon vendors, ODMs and optical suppliers to shape their roadmaps years ahead of availability.
  • Programmable Optical Layer: Drive how optical circuit switching, optical protection switching, coherent transport and hollow core fiber become active parts of the network design. Define the interfaces, telemetry and control models that let software see, reason about and act on the physical layer.
  • Physical Automation and Robotics: Find where automation and robotics can make the physical network faster, safer and more consistent to build and repair: inspection, installation quality, fiber and connector handling, hardware qualification, and repetitive lab and technician work. Run focused pilots with clear quality, safety and cost goals, and turn the ones that work into how we build.
  • Simulation and Safe Change: Prove designs before anything physical moves. Use and extend network simulation, digital twins and lab automation so that architectures, capacity plans and changes are validated before they reach production. Help define which physical actions can be automated, which require human approval, and which should always stay human.
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Apply AI and agents to our own engineering, across design, qualification, deployment and operations, so that engineers spend their time on architecture rather than on process.
  • Concept to Production: Take ideas from paper to lab to pilot to fleet. Write the design, build or direct the prototype, define the qualification, and stay with it through deployment at global scale.
  • Technical Leadership and Influence: Lead across Azure engineering, hardware, supply chain, datacenter operations, Microsoft Research and external partners without relying on reporting lines. Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar, and communicate trade-offs clearly to engineers, vendors and senior leaders.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Doctorate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation
    • OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role.
  • These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
    • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Doctorate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation
    • OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 8+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND
  • 12+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years experience delivering network designs into production and experience with live site accountability for a network.
  • 1+ year(s) experience developing quality management programs.
  • 1+ year(s) deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working fluency in at least one other:
    • Optical networking and photonics: DWDM and coherent transmission, optical line systems, optical switching, or fiber and cabling.
    • Large-scale network architecture: routing, traffic engineering, and the design and operation of backbone or datacenter networks.
    • Infrastructure software and systems: controllers, distributed systems, automation, simulation, or robotics for physical systems.
  • 1+ year (s) disaggregated a network or optical system, deployed a software-defined network or optical controller at scale, brought a new optical technology into production, or automated physical infrastructure work.
  • 1+ year(s) experience with optical circuit or protection switching, coherent pluggables such as 400ZR and 800ZR, open line systems, or hollow core and other novel fiber.
    • Merchant silicon, white-box platforms, or open network operating systems such as SONiC.
    • Robotics, machine vision or mechatronics applied to hardware manufacturing, test, datacenter or field operations.
    • Building network simulation, digital twins, or capacity and failure models.
    • Applying AI or agentic systems to infrastructure design, operations or automation.
    • Working with silicon vendors, ODMs, optical suppliers or contract manufacturers on multi-year roadmaps.
    • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, C++ or Rust.

title: Surveyor I or above
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: GENERAL ENGINEER
location: Washington Navy Yard, District of Columbia
description:
You will serve as a GENERAL ENGINEER in the PORTFOLIO ACQUISITION EXECUTIVE STRATEGIC SYSTEMS PROGRAMS of STRATEGIC SYSTEMS PROGRAMS.

You will lead Nuclear Weapons Surety (NWS) Acquisitions and Operations Branch (SP207) efforts for rapid system acquisition and program of record transition in support of urgent and emerging capability needs.

You will be responsible for the formulation and assessment of the branch's advanced planning for and approaches to next generation Integrated Nuclear Weapons Security System (INWSS) programs and initiatives.

You will plan for transition of advanced technologies into the INWSS Program of Record (PoR) by ensuring early and continuous alignment to the SSP Systems Engineering process, particularly including considerations for safety and supportability.

You will manage and execute PAESSP involvement in pre-concept studies and Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) work assessing technology efficacy and performance.

You will work with the other members of the NWS Chief Engineer section (SP207A) to develop and integrate top level technical requirements in support of emerging threats across the INWSS Areas of Responsibility (AoRs).

You will serve as the Division liaison across the SSP enterprise for Research and Development efforts that may drive NWS priorities in related subject areas.

title: Physical Scientist  (Supervisory )
description:
We are the nation's art museum, home to a renowned collection of over 160,000 works of art from antiquity to today. Millions of people come through our doors each year—with even more online—making us one of the most visited art museums in the world. Located on the National Mall, admission to the West and East Buildings, Sculpture Garden, special exhibitions, and public programs is always free.

The Head of the Scientific Research Department reports to the Chief of Conservation within the division of the Chief Curatorial and Conservation Officer. This position serves the National Gallery of Art by ensuring high-quality analytical services and scientific research for the National Gallery in their role of studying and preserving collections. Duties for this position include: Oversees the operation and administration of the Scientific Research Department in all respects, including personnel actions, budgets, and work assignments. Plans and executes a program of scientific research that studies artists' materials, their chemistry, and degradation mechanisms utilizing state-of-the-art analytical methods Plans and executes a program to test and evaluate materials used for conservation. Publishes scientific findings and supports staff research endeavors. Collaborates with conservators and curators on programs and publications that relate to the larger mission and goals of the institution.

Qualification requirements must be met by the closing date of the announcement. For information on qualification requirements, see Qualification Standards Handbook for General Schedule Positions viewable on OPM Website. It is your responsibility to ensure that you submit appropriate documentation prior to the closing date. Your resume serves as the basis for qualification determinations and must highlight your most relevant and significant experience as it relates to this job announcement. Be clear and specific when describing your work history since human resources cannot make assumptions regarding your experience. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Your resume must include the dates of all qualifying experience (from month/year to month/year) and the number of hours worked/volunteered per week.

title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana omassa kodissa, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Ylöjärvelle. Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla.Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava tulo on keskimäärin noin 3000 € / kk, kun sinulla on neljä hoitolasta ja sinulle kertyy vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpielämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta tai halua opiskella työn ohessa
* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia
* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja
* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Valmiin Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitokonseptin, joka on jo usean yrittäjämme toimesta todettu toimivaksi. Konsepti sisältää kaiken tarvittavan menestyneen perhepäivähoidon pyörittämiseen.
* Kaiken tarvittavan avun yrityksen perustamiseen ja pyörittämiseen. Kaikki on valmiiksi mietitty ja selvitetty puolestasi. Koulutuksemme ja ketjun jatkuva tuki varmistaa, ettet koskaan jää talousasioiden kanssa yksin.
* Ihanan Kultapalat-yhteisön, jossa pääset vaihtamaan ajatuksia muiden Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajien kanssa.




Hae rohkeasti mukaan, tässä porukassa on kivaa sekä aikuisilla että lapsilla!

description:

title: Senior Strategy & Planning Lead, Microsoft Surface
description:
Overview

The Surface Business Planning team plays a key role in defining the strategy, growth, and financial performance of Microsoft's Surface portfolio. This role is central to achieving revenue growth, profitability, and volume objectives for the Surface Entry Premium business. As a Senior Strategy & Planning Lead, Microsoft Surface you will lead end-to-end business planning and strategy for the Surface Entry Premium portfolio, owning the business plan from customer value proposition and product strategy through market and competitive strategy, portfolio architecture, pricing, packaging, SKU strategy, volume planning, revenue, profitability, and Marketing Plan of Record (POR) recommendations. The role serves as the single-threaded business owner for the Entry Premium portfolio, partnering closely with Product, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, and Engineering to drive data-backed business decisions that optimize growth, profitability, customer relevance, and execution. This is a high-impact role for a proven business planner with strong analytical depth, strategic thinking, business judgment, and executive communication skills who can translate customer, market, product, and financial insights into actionable business strategies and leadership recommendations.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Lead end-to-end strategy and planning for the Surface Entry Premium portfolio across consumer and commercial channels, owning business outcomes including revenue, profitability, unit volume, and growth.
  • Define customer segments, customer value propositions, and market opportunities, identifying how Surface can attract new customers, expand addressable markets,
  • improve competitiveness, and accelerate portfolio growth.
  • Own product and portfolio strategy, including lineup architecture, feature positioning, portfolio evolution, affordability strategy, SKU design, packaging, and lifecycle management.
  • Own pricing strategy, packaging strategy, SKU strategy, volume plans, and financial recommendations, ensuring a coherent customer-backed and financially optimized portfolio.
  • Own Marketing Plan of Record (POR) recommendations, aligning customer needs, product investments, commercial priorities, competitive positioning, and financial objectives into a unified business strategy.
  • Drive portfolio and business planning decisions through forecasting, demand modeling, business case development, sensitivity analysis, and scenario planning, quantifying opportunities, risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation actions.
  • Own market analytics, competitive intelligence, customer insights, and product analytics, translating findings into actionable recommendations that influence portfolio, product, and commercial decisions.
  • Develop and maintain the long-range business plan for the Entry Premium portfolio, identifying growth opportunities, business risks, investment priorities, and performance improvement opportunities.
  • Serve as the single-threaded business owner for Entry Premium, aligning Product, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Sales stakeholders, enabling high-quality decision making and execution.
  • Create leadership-ready narratives, business reviews, and recommendations that support executive discussions regarding portfolio strategy, pricing, investment decisions, growth opportunities, and overall business performance.


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Computer Science, Economics, Business, or related field AND 4+ years business planning, strategy consulting, finance, business development, corporate strategy, product strategy, analytics, or related experience
    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Computer Science, Economics, Business, or related field AND 8+ years business planning, strategy consulting, finance, business development, corporate strategy, product strategy, analytics, or related experience
    • OR Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), or related field AND 6+ years business planning, strategy consulting, finance, business development, corporate strategy, product strategy, analytics, or related experience
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years business planning, strategy consulting, finance, business development, corporate strategy, product strategy, analytics, or related experience
  • Experience developing business strategy, portfolio strategy, pricing strategy, product strategy, or growth strategies within technology, devices, hardware, or consumer electronics businesses.
  • Experience building forecasting models, financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases used to drive executive decision making.
  • Executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex analytical, customer, market, and financial topics into clear business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment across Product, Marketing, Finance, Sales, Engineering, and Operations organizations.

title: Wilderness Information Assistant and Lead Wilderness Information Assistant (Seasonal)
description:

You work in a Wilderness Information Center providing resource orientation and information about Olympic National Park. Duties at each grade level include: GS-05 Wilderness Information Assistant: You spend about 75% of your working hours in a Wilderness Information Center issuing Wilderness Permits, providing Leave No Trace education, dispensing Preventative Search and Rescue (PSAR) information, and collecting fees. You will also work about 25% of the time conducting uniformed wilderness patrols in Olympic National Park's 876,447 acres of federally designated Wilderness. title: Site Quality Leader
description:
We are looking for a talented Site Quality Leader to join our team specializing in Quality for our CDBS (Cummins Drivetrain and Braking Systems) Facility in York, SC.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Lead Site Quality Strategy - Drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the plant quality system to ensure alignment with business objectives, customer expectations, and operational excellence goals.
  • Champion Product Quality - Ensure products meet established quality standards by overseeing quality assurance processes and taking ownership of product quality performance across the site.
  • Develop High-Performing Teams - Lead, coach, and develop Quality Engineers, Calibration, and Metrology teams to build organizational capability and create a strong culture of quality.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement - Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, IQTM, and structured problem-solving methodologies to improve process performance, reduce defects, and eliminate waste.
  • Ensure Compliance & Audit Readiness - Maintain compliance with IATF standards, customer-specific requirements, APQP, PPAP, and other quality management system requirements through effective assessments and audits.
  • Improve Operational Performance - Lead initiatives focused on Right First Time (RFT), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), and other key quality metrics to enhance plant performance and achieve operational goals.
  • Support New Product & Technology Deployment - Establish quality priorities and requirements for new technologies, manufacturing processes, and product introductions to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.
  • Drive Strategic Change & Sustainability - Act as a change agent by identifying value creation opportunities, adopting innovative quality tools, and supporting greenhouse gas reduction and sustainability initiatives across the site.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Lead Through Influence & Accountability - Partner effectively with plant leadership and cross-functional teams to drive alignment, establish ownership, manage escalations, and ensure timely execution of quality improvement actions.

  • Drive Preventive Quality Systems - Shift the organization from reactive problem-solving to proactive defect prevention by strengthening root cause analysis, corrective actions, layered process audits, effectiveness verification, and quality management processes.

  • Leverage Data for Decision Making - Utilize quality metrics such as reject rates, yield, COPQ, PPM, repeat defects, and customer performance data to identify risks, prioritize improvements, and drive sustainable results.

  • Develop People & Build Capability - Coach leaders, engineers, supervisors, and operators in quality ownership, problem-solving, customer focus, and continuous improvement methodologies to strengthen organizational performance.

  • Champion Continuous Improvement Culture - Foster an environment focused on prevention, accountability, standardization, daily management discipline, and long-term solutions rather than short-term fixes and firefighting.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
Demonstrated role competence is required. College, university, or equivalent degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject or experience equivalent is required.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Significant relevant work experience required. Preferably 5-7 years’ experience in Manufacturing, Engineering or Program Management role in the automotive industry or a similarly regulated industry.
Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience preferred.
