title: UN Women: International Consultant, Expert in Women's Economic Empowerment, Care Economy and Caregiving in Crisis and Recovery Settings (Retainer), Home-Based
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. Placing women’s rights at the centre of all its efforts, the UN Women leads and coordinates the United Nations system efforts to ensure that commitments on gender equality and gender mainstreaming translate into action throughout the world. It provides strong and coherent leadership in support of Member States’ priorities and efforts, building effective partnerships with civil society and other relevant actors.

UN Women’s triple mandate, along with its global network and deep policy and programming expertise, continues to endow the Entity with a unique capacity to: (i) support Member States to strengthen global norms and standards for gender equality and women’s empowerment, and mainstream gender perspectives in other thematic areas; (ii) promote coordination and coherence across the UN system to enhance accountability and results for gender equality and women’s empowerment; and (iii) undertake operational activities to support Member States, upon their request, in translating global norms and standards into legislation, policies and strategies at country level.

UN Women plays an innovative and catalytic role in the State of Palestine since its inception in 1997 (as UNIFEM). In line with the national priorities, the work of UN Women for the period 2023-2025 is aligned with three of the Palestine United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework’s (UNSDCF) outcomes:

• Palestinians have greater access to economic opportunities that are inclusive, resilient, and sustainable, including decent employment and livelihoods opportunities in an empowered private sector.

• Palestinians, including the most vulnerable, have equal access to sustainable, inclusive, gender responsive and quality social services, social protection, and affordable utilities.

• Palestinian governance institutions, processes, and mechanisms at all levels are more democratic, rights-based, inclusive, and accountable.

Its three-year Strategic Note supports the efforts to achieve measurable results in country in terms of four UN Women global Strategic Plan impacts (2022-2025): (SP Impact 1). Governance and participation in public life; (SP Impact 2). Women’s Economic Empowerment; (SP Impact 3). Ending Violence Against Women and Girls; SP Impact 4. Women peace and security, Humanitarian & Disaster Risk Reduction.

In crisis and recovery contexts, women and girls often experience a disproportionate increase in unpaid and underpaid care responsibilities due to displacement, destruction of services, loss of livelihoods, disability, injury, and increased household needs. These care burdens often limit women's ability to engage in education, skills development, employment, entrepreneurship and recovery processes.

Under several recovery initiatives in Gaza, including programmes focused on women's economic recovery, employment generation, enterprise rehabilitation, disability inclusion and livelihood restoration, UN Women is supporting women-headed households, caregivers, women with disabilities and other vulnerable groups to access economic opportunities. These programmes identify unpaid care responsibilities as one of the most significant barriers preventing women's participation and retention in employment, skills development and enterprise recovery pathways.

At the same time, the care economy itself presents important opportunities for employment creation, livelihood generation and resilience-building. Strengthening community-based care systems, supporting paid caregiving services, and integrating care solutions into recovery programming can simultaneously reduce barriers to women's economic participation while creating new jobs and enterprise opportunities.

UN Women seeks a consultant to provide technical expertise on care economy programming, caregiving systems, unpaid care and domestic work, and gender-responsive recovery programming. The consultant will support the design, implementation, evidence generation and institutionalization of care-focused approaches across UN Women's recovery portfolio in Gaza.

The consultant will report to the UN Women Programme Analyst (Humanitarian and Early recovery) and work closely with UN Women programme staff, partners, national stakeholders and Joint Programme partners.

Description of Responsibilities /Scope of Work

1. Strengthen Women's Economic Empowerment and Care-Responsive Programming

  • Lead technical efforts to surge women’s employment during Gaza’s early recovery.
  • Guide the integration of care-responsive approaches across humanitarian, recovery and development programmes.
  • Identify and address care-related barriers affecting women's participation in employment, livelihoods, skills development and entrepreneurship.
  • Develop practical recommendations on childcare, disability care, caregiving support, referral systems and enabling services including community based care models, workplace care, and formal care organizations.
  • Advise on the establishment of informal and formal care structures in crisis settings including: Safeguarding, PSEA and protection systems including child protection and protection for vulnerable groups; SOPs; Decent work standards for care workers; Accountability and complaints mechanisms; Quality assurance, monitoring and supervision; Childcare and care infrastructure investments; transitioning from informal community based care to formal models of care.
  • Guide the design of gender-responsive care interventions for vulnerable groups, including women with disabilities, caregivers and women-headed households.

2. Advance Care Economy Approaches and Evidence

  • Conduct and lead care economy assessments, care needs analyses and labour market assessments related to care services.
  • Identify opportunities for creating decent jobs and enterprise opportunities within the care economy.
  • Develop evidence, policy recommendations and practical guidance on care systems, care services and women's economic empowerment.
  • Guide the collection and analysis of sex-, age- and disability-disaggregated data related to care work and care needs.

3. Strengthen Capacity, Partnerships and Learning

  • Design and deliver capacity-building initiatives on care-responsive programming and care economy approaches.
  • Strengthen engagement with WLOs, service providers, government institutions, private sector actors and development partners.
  • Facilitate dialogue and partnerships around care systems, care needs, and care-related employment.
  • Develop tools, guidance products and learning materials to support scaling up care-responsive and care-focused programmes including transitioning from informal community care models into more formal care structures including work place care and private sector.

Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel

This is a home-based consultancy, without travel.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

  • Strong technical expertise in care economy and caregiving systems.
  • Knowledge of women's economic empowerment and recovery programming.
  • Experience in humanitarian, development and recovery contexts.
  • Ability to conduct care economy analysis and generate evidence-based recommendations.
  • Experience developing policy, programme design and practical guidance tools.
  • Strong facilitation, coordination and partnership-building skills.

Education and Certification:

  • Master's degree in Economics, Social Policy, Gender Studies, Development Studies, Labour Economics, Social Sciences, International Development or a related field is required.
  • A first-level university degree combined with two additional years of relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of an advanced degree.

Experience:

  • At least 5 years progressive experience in care economy, caregiving systems, social protection, women's economic empowerment or related fields is required.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting care economy analysis, assessments or related research is desirable.
  • Experience designing and implementing care-responsive programmes and policies is required.
  • Experience supporting women's employment, livelihood and economic empowerment initiatives is required.
  • Experience working with civil society organizations, women's organizations and government stakeholders is desirable.
  • Experience in humanitarian, crisis-affected or recovery settings is required.
  • Experience in Palestine and/or the Middle East region is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience working with UN agencies and international organizations is desirable.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Knowledge of Arabic is desirable.

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

  • Mahdollisuuden työskennellä vakaassa ja arvostetussa asiakasyrityksessä

  • Hyvän perehdytyksen työtehtäviin

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV meille mahdollisimman pian, sillä täytämme paikat heti sopivien työntekijöiden löydyttyä.

Kerrothan hakemuksessasi aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi, palkkatoiveestasi sekä siitä, milloin voisit aloittaa työt.

Olemme vastuullinen toimija ja noudatamme aina asiakkaan toimialan mukaista yleissitovaa työehtosopimusta ja voimassa olevaa lainsäädäntöä. title: MIG/MAG-hitsaaja, Urjala
description:
MIG/MAG-HITSAAJA URJALAAN

Onko MIG/MAG-hitsaus sinulle tuttua ja jälkesi kestää tarkemmankin katseen? Etsimme asiakkaallemme Urjalaan kokenutta hitsaajaa, jolla on osaamista mustan raudan hitsauksesta ja 6–30 mm ainevahvuuksista.

Tässä työssä pääset tekemään käytännönläheistä hitsaajan työtä osana osaavaa tuotantotiimiä. Työssä tarvitaan hyvää piirustusten lukutaitoa, huolellista työnjälkeä ja kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti.

MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

* MIG/MAG-hitsausta mustalle raudalle

* Hitsauskohteita noin 6–30 mm ainevahvuuksilla

* Osien sovitusta ja kokoonpanoa

* Työskentelyä piirustusten mukaan

* Oman työn laadusta ja siisteydestä huolehtimista

MITÄ TARVITSET TEHTÄVÄSSÄ?

* Aiempi kokemus MIG/MAG-hitsauksesta

* Kokemusta mustan raudan hitsauksesta

* Hyvä piirustusten lukutaito

* Huolellinen ja itsenäinen työote

* Valmius kaksivuorotyöhön, aamu- ja iltavuoroihin

* Oma auto, sillä työpaikalle ei pääse julkisilla

Koulutus ei ratkaise – osaaminen ratkaisee. Jos MIG/MAG-hitsaus on sinulle tuttua tekemistä ja saat aikaan laadukasta jälkeä, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Palkkaus noin 13–20 €/h osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

* Kokoaikaisen työn, 40 h/vko

* Toistaiseksi voimassa olevan vuokratyösuhteen Worknow'lla

* Kaksivuorotyön, aamu- ja iltavuorot

* Osaavan työyhteisön ja hyvän perehdytyksen

* Mahdollisuuden työllistyä työn sujuessa asiakkaamme omille kirjoille

* Worknow'n tuen koko työsuhteen ajan

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos MIG/MAG-hitsaus, musta rauta ja järeämmät ainevahvuudet ovat sinulle tuttua tekemistä, jätä hakemus mahdollisimman pian. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat sähköpostitse osoitteesta hr@worknow.fi [hr@worknow.fi] tai puhelimitse numerosta 0401603159. Puhelimitse tavoitat meidät parhaiten arkisin klo 14–16.


WORKNOW OY TYÖNANTAJANA

* Nopea ja sujuva rekryprosessi

* Pidämme sinut ajan tasalla koko prosessin ajan

* Lakisääteistä kattavampi työterveys alusta alkaen

* Luotettava työnantaja – asiat hoidetaan kuten sovitaan

Meille tärkeintä on, että löydät työn, jossa viihdyt ja onnistut.

description:

Harri Hautamäki

044 517 1027

harri.hautamaki@wirestaff.fi

title: Putkieristäjä / LVI-eristäjä
description:
TYÖTEHTÄVÄ

Etsimme asiakkaallemme LVI-eristäjää / putkieristäjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Kymenlaakson alueelle. Tehtävässä työskentelet monipuolisissa talotekniikan eristystöissä pääasiassa Kouvolan alueen työkohteissa. Työ sisältää käyttövesi-, lämmitys- ja ilmanvaihtojärjestelmien eristämistä erilaisilla materiaaleilla sekä muita alan töitä kokemuksesi mukaan. Työtä tehdään päivävuorossa 40 tuntia viikossa ja tehtävä on kokoaikainen.


LVI-eristäjänä tärkeimpiä työtehtäviäsi ovat:

LVI-putkistojen lämpö- ja kylmäeristystyöt
Solukumi-, kouru- ja verkkomattoeristysten asentaminen
Ilmanvaihtokanavien eristystyöt ja lämpömattojen asennus
PVC-pinnoitukset ja paloeristystyöt
Muut talotekniikan eristysalan työtehtävät

Tehtävässä työskentelet vuokratyösuhteessa, jolloin Adecco/Sihti toimii työnantajanasi. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan ja tehtävässä on mahdollisuus pitkäaikaiseen työllistymiseen.


MITÄ TARJOAMME

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä osaksi ammattitaitoista työyhteisöä, jossa saat tukea kokeneilta kollegoilta ja mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi eristysalan monipuolisissa työtehtävissä.

Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn vakaalla toimialalla
Mahdollisuuden kehittyä alan ammattilaiseksi kokeneiden tekijöiden opastuksella
Monipuoliset työkohteet Kymenlaakson alueella
Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tuen

Tehtävässä menestyt parhaiten, jos sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta LVI-eristystöistä, putkieristyksistä tai muista talotekniikan asennustöistä. Arvostamme kokemusta erityisesti putkistojen eristämisestä,

Huomioimme myös uransa alkuvaiheessa olevat tekijät, joilla on oikea asenne ja halu oppia.

Suomen kielen taito

Työturvallisuuskortti katsotaan eduksi

Eetu Törrönen, Adecco

title: Tekninen kiinteistönhoitaja, liikekiinteistöt
description:
Haemme nyt TEKNISTÄ KIINTEISTÖNHOITAJAA asiakaskohteisiimme TURKUUN!
Tässä tehtävässä vastaat liikekiinteistöjen kiinteistönhoidosta Turun seudulla. Tehtäviisi kuuluu kiinteistöjen teknisten järjestelmien (mm. ilmastointi-, lämmitys-, jäähdytys- ja automaatiolaitteistot) huolto- ja ylläpidon tehtävät sisältäen seurannan, määräaikaistoimenpiteet ja erilaiset pienkorjaukset sekä huoltokirjojen ylläpito.
Työvuorosi ovat pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 7-15. Tämä työsuhde on kokoaikainen (37,5 h / vk) ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työ alkaa 1.12.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.
Tehtävästä maksetaan vähintään Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 7 mukaista palkkaa (15,92 €/h) sekä mahdolliset työaikalisät toteutuneiden työtuntien mukaisesti ja mahdollista koulutuslisää suoritetun tutkinnon perusteella. Tehtävästä voidaan maksaa myös henkilökohtaista lisää osaamiseen perustuen.

ISS on paikka juuri sinulle! Meillä saat
- paikan, jossa voit kasvaa: meillä voit rakentaa oman urapolkusi ja hyödyntää monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksiamme.
- työyhteisön, jossa arvostamme monimuotoisuutta sen kaikissa merkityksissä, meidän tiimissämme voit olla oma itsesi.
- vakaan ja luotettavan työpaikan, jossa voit luottaa siihen, että palkkasi maksetaan oikein ja ajallaan. Erityisiä onnistumisia huomioimme ISS-palkitsemisohjelman mukaisesti.
- laadukkaat työterveyshuollon palvelut ja työhyvinvointiohjelmat.
- turvalliset työolosuhteet: suojavarusteet, työvaatteet, perehdytyksen työtehtäviin, ennakoivaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin ja säännölliset turvavartit.
- liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun vapaa-ajallesi.

Meillä viihdytään, koska täällä voi kasvaa, vaikuttaa ja onnistua. Tutustu taitaviin tekijöihimme: ISS töISSä

Sinulta me odotamme
- kiinteistönhoitajan ammattitutkintoa.
- aiempaa kokemusta teknisen kiinteistönhoidon tehtävistä vähintään 3 vuoden ajalta.
- vähintään B-luokan ajokorttia, joka oikeuttaa manuaalivaihteisen ajoneuvon kuljettamiseen. Liikut kohteissa työautolla.
- työturvallisuus- ja tulityökortteja. Voimassa olevina katsomme ne eduksi, mutta tarvittaessa järjestämme koulutukset.
- sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.
- erinomaista palveluasennetta sekä hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja.
- oma-aloitteisuutta, ongelmanratkaisutaitoa ja kykyä organisoida omaa työtäsi.
- nuhteetonta taustaa; työsopimuksen edellytyksenä on suppean turvallisuusselvityksen läpäiseminen luotettavuuden varmistamiseksi turvallisuusselvityslain (726/2014) mukaisesti.


Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät. Tule meille rakentamaan omaa ISS urapolkuasi ja tekemään kanssamme tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Täytä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 4.11.! Voit kertoa osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi joko liittämällä hakemukseesi cv:n tai kirjoittamalla tiedot hakulomakkeen tekstikenttään. Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.

Me, ISS Suomi, olemme osa maailman johtavaa kiinteistö- ja toimitilapalveluyhtiötä, joka toimii yli 30 maassa. Suomessa meitä ISS:läisiä on yli 7 000 ja toimimme valtakunnallisesti. Toimintamme tarkoituksena on luoda tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla. Luomme näitä tiloja siivous-, kiinteistö-, ravintola- ja työpaikkapalveluillamme. Kiinteistön ylläpidossa työskentelet aina ajankohtaisessa ammatissa ja huolehdit niin työkavereidesi, asiakkaidemme kuin kiinteistöjen turvallisuudesta.
Ilmastotavoitteenamme on olla hiilineutraali vuonna 2040 – ISS:läisenä pääsetkin vaikuttamaan merkittävästi tämän tavoitteen toteutumiseen ja yhteisen ympäristömme hyvinvointiin!
Kurkkaa, mitä ISS:llä tapahtuu:
- Verkkosivut: ISS Palvelut ja ISS työpaikkana
- Instagram: isssuomi
- LinkedIn: ISS Palvelut
- Facebook: Duunissa ISS Suomi
- YouTube: ISS Palvelut

title: Kaivinkoneenkuljettaja, HETI!, TAMPERE
description:
Haemme ammattitaitoista ja omatoimista kaivinkoneenkuljettajaa 2 tonnin telakoneelle Tampereen alueen valokuitutyömaille – tarjolla kokoaikatyötä (40 h/vko) vähintään kuukaudeksi (maan jäätymiseen saakka) sekä Infra-alan TES:n mukainen palkkaus (alk. 16,00 €/h, kerro rohkeasti palkkatoiveesi!).

Tehtävässä työskentelet 2-tonnisella telakoneella valokuitukaivuun parissa. Työmaat sijaitsevat Tampereella ja vaihtuvat päivittäin, joten työpäiviin kuuluu joustavuutta ja koneen siirtoja kohteesta toiseen. Mikäli sinulla on BE-ajokortti, pääset vetämään konetta peräkärryllä itse seuraavalle työmaalle. B-kortti on kuitenkin vähimmäisvaatimus.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Kokemusta pienten kaivinkoneiden (n. 2t) käytöstä ja tarkkuutta vaativista kaivuutöistä

  • Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia ja tieturvakorttia (Tieturva 1)

  • B-ajokorttia (BE-ajokortti ja kokemus yhdistelmän ajamisesta katsotaan suureksi eduksi)

  • Oma-aloitteista työotetta ja valmiutta liikkuvaan työhön Tampereen alueella

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Kokoaikaisen työn (40 h/vko) vähintään kuukaudeksi / aina maan jäätymiseen saakka

  • Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen: alk. 16,00 €/h (Infra-alan TES / kuuntelemme mielellämme palkkatoiveesi ja neuvottelemme palkan kohdalleen)

  • Reilun ja suoran työnantajan tuen koko työsuhteen ajan

Sijainti: Tampere

Työsuhde: Määräaikainen (vähintään 1 kk / maan jäätymiseen saakka)

Työaika: Kokoaikainen (40 h/vko)

Palkkaus: Alk. 16,00 €/h / neuvoteltavissa palkkatoiveen mukaan (Infra-alan TES)

Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan / heti

Asiakkaastamme, työstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.

Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!



---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: IT Specialist
description:
This vacancy is for a IT Specialist in the Office of the Secretary, Office of the Chief Information Officer within the Department of Commerce.

As an IT Specialist, you will perform the following duties: Design and maintain the Configuration Management (CM) plan, configuration item hierarchy, identification practices, baselines, and status accounting. Lead the Change Advisory Boards (CABs); assess change requests for feasibility, impact, risk, priority, and implementation progress. Administer CM tools, verify actual configurations against baselines, correct discrepancies, and use metrics to improve processes. Coordinate stakeholders, guide contractors, support, and communicate changes, procedures, and training to CAB participants. This position is also advertised under OS-OCIO-ST-27-13088482, which is open to Merit Promotion eligible applicants. If you want to be considered for both, you must apply to both announcements. This Job Opportunity Announcement may be used to fill other IT Specialist GS-2210-12, FPL GS-12 positions within the Department of Commerce in the same geographical location or local commuting area with the same qualifications and specialized experience.

You must be a U.S. citizen to apply for this position. This position requires a SECRET CLEARANCE: Any required investigations and clearances must be completed before the selectee can be placed in the position. You must successfully pass a background investigation. This may include a credit check, a review of financial issues, as well as certain criminal offenses and illegal use or possession of drugs. A probationary period may be required. Selective Service: Males born after 12/31/59 must be registered or exempt from Selective Service (see https://www.sss.gov/). If you receive a conditional offer of employment for this position, you will be required to complete an Optional Form 306, Declaration for Federal Employment, and to sign and certify the accuracy of all information in your application. All Federal employees are required to have Federal salary payments made by direct deposit to a financial institution of their choosing. Bargaining Unit Position: No Confidential Financial Disclosure Report (OGE form 450): No Permanent Change of Duty Station (PCS) Expense: Will not be paid License required: No Drug Test Required: Yes - This position is subject to pre-employment drug testing and random drug testing thereafter.

title: Ompelija
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme ompelijaa Nastolaan määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan loppuvuodesta 2026 tai vuodenvaihteessa. Sijaisuuden arvioitu kesto on 8–12 kuukautta, mutta tehtävä voi jatkua pidempäänkin. Myös vakituinen työsuhde on mahdollinen.

Työnkuvaus
Työtehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten ompelutöiden parissa. Työ on pääasiassa koneellista ompelua, ja materiaalit ovat enimmäkseen keinonahkaa sekä jonkin verran erilaisia kankaita. Ompelun lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu materiaalien leikkaamista sähköleikkurilla ja mattopuukolla.

Työskentelet osana pientä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan hyvää yhteistyötä, huolellista työnjälkeä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
- Aiempi kokemus ompelutyöstä ja koneellisesta ompelusta
- Huolellinen ja tarkka työskentelyote
- Hyvät kädentaidot ja kyky käsitellä erilaisia materiaaleja
- Oma-aloitteisuus ja halu oppia uutta
- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Verhoiluosaaminen katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on käytännön kokemus ompelusta ja näppärät kädet.

Mitä tarjoamme?
- Määräaikaisen työn arviolta 8–12 kuukaudeksi, mahdollisesti pidemmäksi aikaa
- Mahdollisuuden vakituiseen työsuhteeseen työtilanteen salliessa
- Säännöllisen päivätyön arkisin, pääsääntöisesti klo 7.00–15.00

title: Mekaanikko
description:
Olemme vahvasti kasvava, mutta työntekijöistämme huolehtiva henkilöstöalan yritys. Missionamme on rakentaa kestävää työelämää sekä työntekijöille että työnantajille. Toimimme usealla alueella Suomessa ja pääkonttorimme sijaitsee Tampereella.

Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme:

Mekaanikkoa sähköosaamisella

Etsimme kehitysmyönteistä, mutta jo kokemusta omaavaa mekaanikkoa, jolta löytyy vahvan mekaanisen osaamisen lisäksi kokemusta tai osaamista sähköpuolelta. Tehtävä sopii käytännönläheiselle tekijälle, joka viihtyy koneiden ja laitteiden parissa ja pystyy ratkomaan vikatilanteita monipuolisesti. Olet jo työskennellyt raskaan kaluston parissa ja sinulla on sähköjärjestelmien tuntemus sekä hydrauliikan ja pneumatiikan osaaminen selkärangassasi. Työssä vaaditaan tarkkuutta ja huolellista työotetta, ongelmaratkaisukykyä sekä toimeen tarttumista ja oma-aloitteisuutta. Suurena etuna katsomme, jos kokemusta löytyy myös liikkuvan kaluston lämmönsäätelyn parista.
Emme siis etsi välttämättä sähköasentajaa, vaan ennen kaikkea hyvää mekaanista tekijää, jolle sähköpuolikaan ei ole vieras. Tarjoamme monipuolisen työtehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään sekä mekaanista että sähköteknistä osaamistasi.
Tarjolla kokoaikainen ja vakituinen työ ammattitaitoisessa ja hyvähenkisessä tiimissä. Työtä tehdään aamu- ja iltavuoroissa, joten valmius vuorotyöskentelyyn ehdotonta. Iltavuoroviikko osuu kohdalle noin 3-4 viikon välein. Työnkuvassa ajoittain myös päivystystä. Työtehtäviin perehdytetään huolellisesti. Palkkaus Teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaan 16-19 €/h osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan.

EDELLYTÄMME:

* Kokemusta mekaanisista huolto-, asennus- tai korjaustöistä
* Sähkötekniikan perusteiden hallintaa
* Kykyä lukea teknisiä kuvia ja ymmärtää koneiden toimintaa
* Oma-aloitteista ja turvallista työskentelyotetta
* Valmiutta itsenäiseen vianhakuun

EDUKSI KATSOMME:

* Sähköalan koulutuksen tai muun sähköteknisen taustan
* Kokemuksen sähkömekaanisten laitteiden kunnossapidosta
* Hydrauliikan ja pneumatiikan tuntemuksen
* Kokemuksen teollisuuden koneista ja laitteista
* Kokemus lämmönsäätelylaitteista

TARJOAMME:

* Pitkäaikaisen työsuhteen
* Vakaan tuen kaikissa työelämäsi asioissa
* Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen
* Armstrongin työterveyspalvelut

title: Junior Sustainability Coordinator
description:
As an on-site Junior Environmental/Sustainability Coordinator, you will support the delivery of sustainability requirements on a live CTS Group data center construction site in Seinäjoki, Finland. You will work with the on-site Sustainability Coordinator, construction management team, package leads, procurement, Dublin based Sustainability Lead and the client team to support the implementation of project sustainability requirements into daily site activity, ensure requirements are met, and maintain audit-ready evidence from mobilization through handover.

The role is hands-on and delivery driven. You will help support the site processes for data capture, sustainable procurement evidence, and compliance tracking, and you will support the coordination of actions across multiple contractors and work packages. You will be responsible for supporting sustainability efforts and requirements across a multitude of disciplines and construction activities. Effective communication with a variety of project stakeholders, including but not limited to designers, engineers, contractors, suppliers, procurement specialists, and the health, safety, and environment (HSE) team will be key to this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Site Sustainability Coordination. Support the site sustainability plan and coordinate implementation across civil, structural, MEP, and fit-out packages, ensuring actions are assigned, scheduled, and closed out.

  • Data Collection and Evidence. Support in the data capture of materials, waste, fuel, energy, water, logistics, and commissioning inputs. Validate submissions; and maintain traceable records aligned to project requirements.

  • Sustainable Procurement Support. Track and record sustainability requirements through submittals and procurement, including EPDs and certifications where applicable; manage supplier follow-up; and document approvals, substitutions, and non-compliances.

  • Specifications and Compliance. Help support the implementation of Employer's Requirements and client standards into site controls; monitor compliance via site walks and audits; raise deviations early; and support in the implementation of corrective actions with package owners.

  • Reporting and Client Meetings. Support in the production of weekly and monthly sustainability updates covering KPIs, risks, issues, and decisions required; prepare meeting packs; present progress; and track actions to completion.

  • Construction-Stage Options. Identify opportunities to reduce impacts during construction (waste prevention, segregation, temporary power efficiency, logistics optimization, and low-impact materials); assess cost and program implications; and coordinate implementation.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Recent graduate with a strong academic record in any discipline, demonstrating intellectual curiosity and a commitment to learning.

  • Ambitious and self-motivated, with the drive to succeed, take ownership and deliver work to a high standard.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand new concepts quickly and apply sound judgement.

  • Proactive and adaptable, comfortable taking initiative, asking thoughtful questions and working through unfamiliar challenges.

  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage priorities and follow through on commitments.

  • Clear and articulate communicator, able to build effective relationships and collaborate with people across different teams and backgrounds.

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

What We Offer

  • A key environmental role on high-profile data center construction projects in Finland

  • Close collaboration with a multidisciplinary HSE and project team

  • Opportunity to influence environmental performance and sustainability outcomes

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Long-term development opportunities within an international organization

About CTS Group

CTS Group is one of the largest design and build contractors in Europe and the market leader in the Nordic region for data center delivery. With a globally diverse team, group companies, and a strong network of experienced partners, we deliver complex, mission-critical projects across Europe. Joining CTS means becoming part of an international organization at the forefront of data center construction, shaping the future of digital infrastructure.

title: Lead Traffic Control Aid (Seasonal)
description:
This position is located in Seasonal Staffing Office-Pacific West Region, in the Visitor and Resource Division. The typical seasonal entry-on-duty period for Seasonal Staffing Office-Pacific West Region is April to October but can be variable during these months due to weather conditions, project needs, or funding.

These positions work in Yosemite National Park performing lead traffic management duties in support of the park wide operations of the Division of Resource and Visitor Protection, law enforcement office. The purpose of the position is to provide guidance and leadership to traffic control aids in the mitigation and management of traffic congestion, facilitation of visitor traffic flow around emergency scenes, controlling parking, and providing information to visitors as necessary.Duties: Serves as shift lead for up to 10 employees. Leads Traffic Control Aids in the monitoring of vehicular traffic levels against pedestrian traffic and leads the control on intersections with regards to safety and the smooth flow of vehicles. Personally observes and monitors parking lots, directs buses and motor homes to appropriate parking stalls, close parking lots when full. Reports information to supervisor. Drives government vehicles on park roads and or state federal highways including outlying areas of the park. Leads staff or personally provides traffic control in and around emergency scenes as directed by park law enforcement personnel. Reports to supervisor or law enforcement dispatchers any public use and or traffic violations or visitor use problems or emergencies via radio communications or in person. Yosemite National Park, California, known worldwide for its spectacular natural beauty is the backdrop for this position. Sitting astride the Sierra Nevada Mountains, the park covers 1,182 square miles of varied wilderness ecosystems, from river valleys to alpine meadows to lofty 13,000-foot-high peaks. Yosemite Valley is located 208 miles from San Francisco, 81 miles from Merced, and 94 miles from Fresno. Shopping, medical, postal and laundry services are available in the park. Elevation at the Valley floor is approximately 4,000 feet and 2,200 feet in El Portal. The park is open year-round with the majority of activities occurring during the busy season March through October. Physical Demands: The work demands long periods of standing at a fixed post and or walking on paved or uneven dirt surfaces. The employee may be exposed to extreme weather conditions, dust, flying debris requiring sureness of balance and knowledge or personal protective equipment. Working Conditions: The work is exclusively outdoors on dirt, gravel or pavement during the spring and summer seasons. The ambient temperature during these periods range from 50-110* Fahrenheit, with some variations dependent on the elevation of the assignment. Work assignment elevation ranges from below 4,000 ft to over 10,000 ft. Work is primarily on foot in roadways and parking lots, sidewalks, trails with some work accomplished on bicycle or while operating a government vehicle.

U.S. Citizenship required. Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication. Meet Selective Service Registration Act requirement for males. Selectee will be required to participate in the Direct Deposit Electronics Funds Transfer Program. You will be required to operate a government (or private) motor vehicle as part of your official duties; a valid driver's license is required. You will be required to submit a Motor Vehicle Operator's License and Driving Record. You must also submit (within a State sealed envelope or submitted directly by the State authorities), and at your own expense, all certified driving records from all States that disclose all valid driver's licenses, whether current or past, possessed by you. You will be required to wear a uniform and comply with the National Park Service uniform standards. A uniform allowance will be provided. You may be required to work on-call, evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime. You must be able to lift traffic control devices weighing up to 25 pounds. Travel, transportation & relocation expenses will not be paid. Relocation expenses will be the employee's responsibility. Applicants must be at least (1)18 years old or (2) at least 16 years old and: (a) Have graduated from high school or been awarded a certificate equivalent to graduating from high school; or (b) Have completed a formal vocational training program; or (c) Have received a statement from school authorities agreeing with their preference for employment rather than continuing their education; or (d) Be currently enrolled in a secondary school and either work only during school vacation periods or work part-time during the school year under a formal student employment program.

title: Medical Instrument Technician (Diagnostic Ultrasound)
description:
The Medical Instrument Technician (MIT) Diagnostic Ultrasound position is located within Diagnostic Imaging service at the Martinsburg West Virginia VA Medical Center. The MIT coordinates a variety of technical procedures that require independent judgment, ingenuity, and initiative in the application of non-ionizing high frequency ultrasonic waves to humans for diagnosis of disease in the clinic or on the inpatient unit.

Duties may include but are not limited to; Controls technical factors on ultrasound unit, which will affect time, gain, amplitude, velocity, frequency, attenuation, absorption, reflection, scattering, refraction, and diffraction. Selects between non-focused, fixed-focus, linear phased array, and annual phased array. Sets up and adjusts all equipment and manually maneuvers the transducer to perform the exam. Receives and identifies patients, explains methods of procedures, assists movement of patients to and from wheelchairs, carts and tables, positions the patient and performs examination requested. Evaluates the nature of critical and emergency procedures and rearranges priorities to accommodate them. Performs ultrasonography studies, records as well as prepares the processed media for interpretation by Staff Radiologist. Maintain records of patients in the Vista radiology package. Schedules and prepares patient for exams and explains procedures to patient white performing the studies. Obtains pertinent diagnostic examinations for the physician, which may be necessary for correlation between the ultrasound scan and the clinical history. Performs diagnostic ultrasound examination on multiple areas of body, including, but not limited to, the abdomen, pelvis, transvaginal, chest, small parts, thyroid, breast, and scrotum. Routinely performs vascular studies carotid duplex, ABI, arterial duplex, venous duplex, renal artery duplex and visceral vascular exams of the abdomen. Regularly performs preoperative upper and lower extremity vein mappings, as well as chronic venous insufficiency studies. Assists radiologist with biopsy procedures determining the location, depth, and required needle angle for the lesion to be sampled. Assists in surgical procedures and fluid aspirations. This requires performance and knowledge of sterile technique and strict enforcement. Recognizes a diagnostic scan and consults with the Staff Radiologist to determine the proper diagnosis. title: US Climate Risk Lead, Climate & Sustainability Advisory
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

Arcadis is seeking a US Technical Lead, Climate Risk to join our U.S.-based Climate and Sustainability Advisory team.

In this role, you will lead climate risk engagements for clients across multiple sectors, helping organizations understand, quantify, and manage climate-related physical and transition risks. You will work with multidisciplinary teams to translate climate science, engineering, financial analysis, and regulatory requirements into actionable business strategies, supporting clients with climate risk assessments, disclosure readiness, transition planning, and enterprise risk management.

This role combines technical leadership, client relationship management, and practice development. You will manage complex projects, mentor junior team members, contribute to the advancement of Arcadis's climate risk methodologies and digital solutions, and support the continued growth of our climate risk services across North America.

This hybrid role can sit in either Washington DC, New York City, or Chicago.

Role accountabilities:

As the US Technical Lead within our Climate and Sustainability Advisory team, you will lead climate risk assessment, reporting, and transition planning engagements across a range of sectors, including real estate, manufacturing, infrastructure, transportation, technology, and consumer products. You will serve as a trusted advisor and primary client contact, helping organizations navigate complex climate risk, resilience, and disclosure challenges.

In this role, you will lead physical and transition risk assessments, vulnerability and criticality assessments, scenario analyses, and climate-related financial impact evaluations to support asset portfolio and enterprise-level decision-making. You will translate technical findings into practical recommendations and executive-ready communications for public officials, senior leaders, boards, and investors, while supporting clients in aligning with leading climate risk and disclosure frameworks, including ISSB, CSRD, TCFD, and California climate disclosure requirements.

You will also lead business development efforts through proposal development, strategic client engagement, and identification of growth opportunities. In addition, you will direct multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality work on schedule and within budget, contribute to the continued development of Arcadis’s Climate Risk Nexus platform, methodologies, and service offerings, and mentor junior consultants to support technical excellence and professional growth across project teams.

Day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Lead climate risk assessment and reporting engagements from planning through delivery, including scenario analysis, quantitative risk assessments, and financial impact modeling.
  • Manage client relationships and facilitate workshops, interviews, and executive-level discussions, while supporting client development, business development, and pursuit activities related to climate risk.
  • Oversee technical analyses and deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency, quality, and alignment with project objectives.
  • Manage project schedules, budgets, staffing, and delivery across multiple engagements, and communicate findings through reports, dashboards, workshops, and executive presentations.
  • Advance climate risk methodologies, tools, and best practices while staying current on climate science, risk modeling approaches, regulatory developments, and disclosure requirements.
  • Collaborate across sustainability, resilience, adaptation, engineering, and digital solutions teams, and contribute to thought leadership through conferences, professional organizations, blogs, videos, and other multimedia.

Qualifications & Experience:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field of study
  • Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in consulting with a focus on climate risk assessment and reporting.
  • Demonstrated expertise in climate physical and transition risk assessments, vulnerability and criticality assessments, scenario analysis and climate-related financial impact modeling
  • Strong consulting, client management, project leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business insights.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary project teams and delivering complex projects across multiple stakeholders and geographies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree and/or additional certifications in relevant sustainability disciplines
  • Strong familiarity with climate scenarios and frameworks including IEA, NGFS, and IPCC.
  • Experience supporting clients with ISSB, CSRD/ESRS, TCFD, SEC, California climate disclosure requirements, or climate transition planning.
  • Experience with climate-related financial analysis, resilience planning, enterprise risk management, or climate disclosure programs.
  • Experience with climate risk and vulnerability assessment for the transportation and energy sectors

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Arcadis offers benefits for full time and part-time positions. These benefits include medical, dental, and vision, EAP, 401K, STD, LTD, AD&D, life insurance, paid parental leave, reward & recognition program and optional benefits including wellbeing benefits, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement. We offer nine paid holidays and 15 days PTO that accrue per year. The salary range for this position is $112,640 - $182,477. Actual salaries will vary and are based on several factors, such as experience, education, budget, internal equity, project and location.

title: Opettaja, talotekniikka, Seinäjoki (KY/283/2026)
description:
Sedu hakee

talotekniikan opettajaa 1.1.2027 alkaen Seinäjoelle (KY/283/2026)

Opettajan tehtäviin kuuluu talotekniikan ja kiinteistöalan koulutukset (perustutkinto, ammattitutkinto ja erikoisammattitutkinto). Opettaja vastaa päätehtävänään nuohoojien, peltienseppien ja teknisten eristäjien koulutuksesta. Työtehtäviin kuuluu olennaisena osana opiskelijahallintajärjestelmän käyttöä ja tutkintoihin liittyvien asioiden ajantasaista dokumentointia.

Mitä saat?
Sedussa pääset työskentelemään innovatiivisessa ympäristössä nuorten ja aikuisten kanssa. Yhteistyö kollegojen kanssa tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Sedu tukee kehittymistäsi koulutuksella ja tarjoaa ison työnantajan monet edut, mm. toimivan työterveyshuollon ja ePassi-Hyvinvointiedun.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on asetuksen 986/1998 13§ mukaisesti soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto ja vähintään kolmen vuoden käytännön työkokemus opetustehtävän sisältöä lähinnä vastaavissa tehtävissä, tai alan erikoisammattitutkinto ja vähintään viiden vuoden käytännön työkokemus opetustehtävän sisältöä lähinnä vastaavissa tehtävissä, sekä opettajan pedagogiset opinnot.

Mitä Sedu edellyttää?
Edellytämme laaja-alaista talotekniikan työkokemusta ja asiantuntijuutta. Talotekniikan osaamisalueista edellytämme erityisesti nuohousalan, peltisepän sekä teknisen eristäjän osaamista. Lisäksi tehtävässä tarvitaan kykyä itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen työskentelyyn.

Sinulle eduksi
Arvostamme opetus- ja ohjauskokemusta sekä hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.

Tehtävän alkusijoituspaikka on Oppimispalvelut, Sedu Seinäjoki, Rastaantaival.

Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät OVTES, C-osion mukaisesti. Opettajan työaika määräytyy opetustarpeen mukaan ja on vuosityöajassa 1500 työtuntia vuodessa. Työaika määritellään työaikasuunnitelman laatimisen yhteydessä työvuosittain. Ennen tehtävän vastaanottoa on esitettävä hyväksyttävä selvitys terveydentilasta sekä lain 504/2002 edellyttämä rikosrekisteriote. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Lisätietoja antavat vararehtori Hellevi Lassila, p. puh. 040 830 4255 ja koulutuspäällikkö Jarmo Huttunen, p. 040 868 0644 ja koulutusvastaava Jarkko Rajala, p. 040 868 0648.

Hakemukset sähköisellä lomakkeella 4.11.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä. Linkki lomakkeeseen löytyy [www.sedu.fi/tyopaikat](http://www.sedu.fi/tyopaikat#_blank). Voit liitää tai nauhoittaa hakulomakkeelle esittelyn itsestäsi.

Seinäjoen koulutuskuntayhtymä Sedu on nikotiiniton työpaikka.

title: Deputy Assistant Inspector General for Investigations (Cooperative Disability Investigations)
description:
Serves as an alter ego for the Assistant Inspector General for Investigations (AIGI), sharing responsibility for carrying out the Office of Investigations' (OI) mission and providing general supervision of the Cooperative Disability Investigations (CDI) Operations. Assumes responsibility for all functions of OI CDI Operations.

Serves as an alter ego for the AIGI directing the development or modification of planning, coordination, and control of the CDI program's national operations and investigative activity. This includes investigations related to complex fraud schemes involving third party facilitators, as well as individuals attempting to obtain disability through fraud or for the continued receipt of disability benefits fraudulently. Organizes and manages the CDI program to align with program needs and the Inspector General's priorities and initiatives. Exercises authority to examine all SSA disability programs and to initiate investigations. Develops plans for CDI investigations, including resource requirements; manages the full scope of CDI investigations, including program evaluation; and presents accomplishments and recommendations based on valid and meaningful reporting criteria to the Inspector General, the Commissioner of Social Security, and Congress. Integrates innovative measures and techniques into the CDI program's investigative approach to fraud detection and abuse prevention in SSA's disability programs. Such measures and techniques could relate to information technology, data analytics, or automation, and inter-component collaboration. Develops statements of CDI program goals containing resource requirements for use as guides for the Inspector General and the Commissioner of Social Security for budgetary hearings and congressional committees. Serves as an expert witness on CDI program objective requirements and accomplishments at budget hearings and before congressional committees.

To be considered minimally qualified for this position, candidates must have had responsible professional experience at a senior level (equivalent to the GS-15 in either the General Schedule (GS) or a comparable pay plan). Must be a U.S. Citizen or National. Subject to a 1-year supervisory probationary period (unless already completed). Complete a Declaration for Federal Employment to determine your suitability for Federal employment, at the time requested by the agency. If you are a male applicant born after December 31, 1959, certify that you have registered with the Selective Service System or are exempt from having to do so. May be subject to pre-employment and random drug tests. Must file a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report OGE-278e within 30 days of appointment and annually from then on. You may be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal. Positions classified in the Criminal Investigation Series (1811) are designated as mobile work positions. You may be required to perform your job duties outside of your assigned official worksite. Age Requirement: This position is covered by the law enforcement officer retirement provisions, 5 U.S.C. 8336 (c) or 5 U.S.C. 8412 (d), and as such is covered by a mandatory age requirement. There is a maximum entry age of the day before your 37th birthday for original appointment into law enforcement officer positions as defined in 5 U.S.C. 8331(20) or 5 U.S.C. 8401(17). This age restriction does not apply to those who have prior Federal service in a covered primary law enforcement position. This position is covered by the special retirement provisions for Federal Law Enforcement Officer (FLEO). Employees subject to special retirement coverage for law enforcement officers must retire at age 57 upon completing 20 years of law enforcement service. If these 20 years of service are not attained at age 57, mandatory retirement is required upon completion of 20 years of service.

title: Cloud & AI Infrastructure Solution Engineer
description:
Overview

Are you curious, enthusiastic about infrastructure, and ready to solve complex challenges in the Frontier AI era? Join us as a Cloud & AI Infrastructure Solution Engineer for commercial customers at Microsoft.

In this technical sales role, you will help customers design secure, scalable, resilient, and sovereign cloud architectures that support their Frontier transformation and modernization goals and guide organizations through modernization, migration, and transformation — translating technical capabilities into significant business outcomes.

You will collaborate across teams to deliver impactful solutions that enhance agility, reduce costs, and unlock value through AI-powered infrastructure.

As a Cloud & AI Infrastructure Solution Engineer, you will play a key role in helping customers modernize their Platform Estate, including hardware, software, applications, databases, security and networking with the full value of Microsoft’s cloud. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design secure, scalable, resilient, compliant, and sovereign architectures that support business-critical applications and Frontier AI transformation. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers and win their technical decisions on Azure solutions and deployment.

You bring deep expertise in migrating core workloads—including Windows, Linux, and Oracle—to Azure. Beyond migration, you lead customers through modernization using the 6R strategy, containerization best practices, and Azure-native services like AKS, while exploring how Agentic AI and Tooling (e.g., Azure Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Agentic Assessment) can accelerate Frontier transformation.

You complement this with strong networking knowledge to design hybrid and cloud-native solutions, including virtual networks, VPNs, secure routing architectures and trusted partner solutions to ensure secure, optimized, and scalable solutions.

As you join the team, you will have the opportunity to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your technical skills, and become adept at solution design and deployment. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their existing platforms to realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform, all while enjoying flexible work opportunities.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Own technical discussions for Azure Migration with customers leveraging processes and tools, demos, and programs; use consultative and/or Challenger method; establish rules of engagement (e.g., role boundaries, handoff strategies) for extended teams.

  • Build strategy: map the agreed customer vision into a strategy, resolve concerns, preventing, and removing technical blockers, and validating a strong business case for investment and translated technology complexity into business impact. Work with the customer, account team, and partners to orchestrate a roadmap for implementation.

  • Drive technical assessments to create a map of the current landscape and to build the technical migration plans, thus building a solid migration business case.

  • Design the solution using your technical knowledge, architectural approach, consultancy skills and our methodology to win a customer’s technical decision and meet the customer’s needs. Ensure technical decision makers agree with proposed architecture and on the migration plan. Drive POCs and MVPs.

  • Scale through partners, acting as liaison between the partner and account team, facilitating partner resources and processes; supporting partner technical capacity by identifying skill and resource gaps and providing feedback to internal teams.

  • Be the Voice of Customer to share insights and best practices, connect with the Engineering team to remove key blockers and drive product improvements.

  • Identify and support the creation of new pipeline within customer engagements in collaboration with the Specialist.



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • 6+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.

  • Deep domain knowledge in Data Center Migration, Windows Server, and SQL Server Migration (including modernization to PaaS), VMware, Networking, Security, Storage, BCDR, Infra as Code, Hybrid and Arc, or hands-on experience working with the respective products at the expert level. Additionally deep knowledge/experience with Azure Migrate and RVTools.

  • Competitive Landscape: Knowledge of competitor cloud migration platforms, infrastructure and services including hybrid cloud technologies.

  • Experience creating cloud migration Proof of Concepts (PoC), Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) for customers that lead to production deployments.

  • Relationship Building: Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior executives. Experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to get consensus on solution/projects. The ability to influence and build relationships across technical and business teams.

  • Excellent Communicator: Demonstrates executive presence, presentation skills, deep technical product demo abilities, written and verbal communication skills.

  • Collaborative: Works cohesively with customers, the Microsoft account team, and Microsoft partners. Helps others succeed by identifying and promoting innovative solutions and strategies.

title: Principal Full Stack Developer
description:
About Oracle LiveLabs

Oracle LiveLabs is Oracle's hands-on learning platform. It enables customers, partners, students, educators, and internal teams to explore Oracle technologies through guided workshops and real cloud environments used in events, roadshows, university programs, and self-service learning.

The LiveLabs team designs, builds, and operates the application and workshop experience behind these labs. The product includes an Oracle APEX application, Oracle Database and PL/SQL services, Markdown-based workshop content, JavaScript interactions, and interfaces used across desktop and mobile devices.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Principal Full Stack Developer to lead the technical direction of the LiveLabs application and workshop experience. This is a hands-on role with responsibility for front-end and back-end architecture, user experience, APIs, data integration, accessibility, and overall application quality.

Current application work and longer-term modernization are both part of the role. The developer will evaluate full-stack technology options, build prototypes, and recommend an approach without assuming a specific framework or server-side platform in advance.

The developer will work closely with product managers, engineers, workshop authors, and users. They will stay involved in research, design, implementation, testing, code reviews, and production problem solving.

Key Responsibilities

•Own the architecture and technical direction of the LiveLabs application across front-end interfaces, back-end services, APIs, data access, and workshop experiences.

•Lead hands-on development of responsive and accessible interfaces using HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript or TypeScript, and appropriate front-end frameworks.

•Design and implement secure back-end services, APIs, integrations, and data access layers that are reliable, maintainable, and easy to operate.

•Evaluate full-stack technologies, build prototypes, and define practical modernization plans with clear technical and product tradeoffs.

•Create reusable user interface components and maintain JavaScript elements that improve the usability of Markdown-based workshops.

•Work with product managers, engineers, workshop authors, and users to turn research and feedback into requirements, priorities, and release plans.

•Set standards for accessibility, security, performance, automated testing, and deployment. Diagnose and resolve complex production issues and prevent recurrence through root cause analysis and corrective action.

•Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and explain technical decisions to senior leaders and partners when needed.

Required Qualifications

•Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

•10+ years of experience in software development, full-stack engineering, web application development, or a closely related technical role.

•7+ years of hands-on front-end experience with modern JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and at least one component-based framework or library such as React, Preact, Angular, Vue, Oracle JET, or a comparable technology.

•5+ years of experience developing back-end services and APIs with one or more server-side technologies such as Java, Node.js or TypeScript, Python, or a comparable language and framework. Experience should include API design, authentication, authorization, input validation, and secure coding.

•5+ years of experience with relational database design, SQL, data access, and performance analysis, including hands-on work with Oracle Database and PL/SQL.

•Experience building accessible interfaces and reusable design systems using semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen readers, responsive design, and WCAG standards.

•Experience with automated front-end and back-end testing, Git and GitHub workflows, build tooling, and continuous integration and delivery.

•Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools or generative AI services in software engineering, including reviewing generated output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and maintainability.

•Proven experience leading complex full-stack work across teams, solving difficult technical problems, setting clear priorities, and explaining technical decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

•Experience developing or extending applications with Oracle APEX, Oracle JET, Oracle Redwood components, or comparable enterprise application platforms.

•Experience with Markdown-based content systems, documentation platforms, static site tooling, or interactive technical content.

•Experience with Figma or comparable design tools, user research, usability testing, and product analytics.

•Experience deploying and operating applications on OCI, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud using containers, infrastructure as code, monitoring, or observability tools.

•Experience building technical workshop, lab, training, developer enablement, or self-service learning experiences.

What We Offer

•Technical ownership of the LiveLabs application and workshop experience across the full stack.

•A senior individual contributor role with hands-on development work and input into product direction.

•The opportunity to guide application modernization without being limited to a predetermined technology stack.

•Work across user experience, APIs, data, cloud services, content delivery, accessibility, and developer experience while mentoring other engineers.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

  • Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

Continuous Learning:

  • Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

  • Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
