title: Digital Solution Engineering
description:
Overview

Do you enjoy working on a high-performing, fast-paced technical sales team? Are you insatiably curious and do you lean into uncertainty, take risks, and learn quickly from your mistakes? If so, we are looking for you!

At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.

SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.

As a Digital Security Engineer, you will take the lead in harnessing the power of AI to achieve customer leadership. Your efforts will be instrumental in executing solution sales strategies by leveraging various programs and offers. Additionally, you will be responsible for selling cloud services and platforms tailored for our managed customers. Furthermore, you will play a significant role in enabling AI and Digital transformation momentum for our customers, partners, and Microsoft.

As a Digital Security Engineer, you will work within a virtual team of sales, technical, partner and consulting resources to enhance the team capabilities for extended detection and response (XDR), zero trust and cloud security as well as Microsoft Purview portfolio empowering our customers to protect, govern, and safeguard their sensitive data while also managing regulatory compliance requirements and maintaining customer & employee privacy. Being part of this team will allow you to strengthen both your consultative selling skills as well as your deep technical expertise across Microsoft and non-Microsoft cloud-based security & compliance solutions, architectures, programs, and technologies. You will make an impact by helping clients secure their organizations. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your solution sales and collaboration skills, and deepening your cloud expertise.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Build Strategy

  • Acts as the voice of the customer (VOC) by driving new feedback, blockers, insights, and resources (e.g., unified action tracker [UAT], technical feedback platform) across territories so they can be added and prioritized. Represents the customer to product teams (e.g., Engineering) to shape products and services by providing insights across the territory.
  • Captures core customer compete knowledge across solution areas and delivers back to product and engineering teams to enhance team capabilities and develop compete strategies.
  • Provides strategic, technical, and partner input based on Microsoft capability to contribute to strategy development, leveraging partner and competitor knowledge.
  • Works with account teams to shape strategic customer win strategy and tailor unique Microsoft value messaging to audience.
  • Monitors and analyzes action plans to promote customer usage of key/prioritized Microsoft solutions/products that support customer’s business outcomes. Identifies opportunities to promote usage.

Scale Customer Engagements

  • Uses knowledge of customer context, cross-solution, or portfolio expertise, and technical and market/industry knowledge to build credibility with customers individually or at scale.
  • Leverages knowledge of programs and investments (e.g., Microsoft Technology Center [MTC], exec briefing center, partner workshops) and proactively engages with engineering, product, and support teams to remediate blockers.
  • Helps ensure consistency and quality of engagements through adherence of standards and practices (e.g., managed service provider [MSP], managed certified professional [MCP]). Utilizes common sales and delivery methodology for the Microsoft sales organization to identify and engage customers in new opportunities. Actively seeks and incorporates feedback on customer impact to increase capabilities.
  • Proactively helps to maximize impact of customer engagements by executing on solutions to blockers.
  • Engages with customer technical and business decision makers, and identifying customer needs and issues proactively through technical discovery.
  • Leads and ensures customer needs are met by showcasing suitable Microsoft solutions anchored in insights and business value, and influences customer technical buy-in. Utilizes rules of engagement (e.g., role boundaries, handoff strategies), and leverages knowledge of processes (e.g., Managed Service Provider [MSP], co-sell partners), tools, and programs (e.g., FastTrack). Searches for customer references to use in engagements.
  • Uses knowledge of customer context, cross-solution or portfolio expertise, and deep technical and market/industry knowledge to build credibility with customers individually or at scale.

Scale Through Partners

  • Engages in partner sell-with scenarios by acting as liaison between the partner and team and shares visibility on partner resources and processes. Supports the development and maintenance of relationships with pre-sale team and partners. Self-identifies and selects top 5 to 10 go-to partners on proactive and early engagement in opportunities.

Solution Design and Proof

  • Presents, applies, and customizes architecture patterns to partners or customers or businesses and drives cross-workload support for Microsoft Solutions.
  • Applies and customizes existing demonstration assets. Demonstrates and oversees demonstrations (e.g., pre-built demos, architectural design sessions [ADS], proof of concept [POC] sessions with partners) of solutions based on multiple Microsoft products through early stage engagements. Leverages partner/customer teams as needed to prove capabilities and integration into customer environment. Reviews partner demonstrations and provides feedback to ensure alignment with Microsoft standards..

Technical Leadership

  • Monitors and responds to internal and external tech community posts, attends community calls, sessions, hackathon, etc., and acts as a mentor for their technology area. Contributes and participates in Customer Executive Briefing Center sessions.
  • Shares practices internally on community calls and drives recognition of Microsoft cloud solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.
  • Conducts group training or one-to-many events (e.g., workshops, Webinars) or leverages existing scale enablement programs to present and educate customers and colleagues on the capabilities and benefits across Microsoft solutions/products.
  • Grows domain knowledge and practices expertise by communicating with customers, partners, and colleagues to expand knowledge of architecture. Builds their own readiness plan and proactively identifies learning gaps.


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field AND 8+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
  • Certification in relevant (Microsoft or industry) technologies or disciplines (e.g., Microsoft Office 365; Power BI; Azure Administrator, Architecture, and Development exams; Cloud Platform Technologies; Information Security; Architecture).

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $137,600 - $222,600 per year.

title: Technical Operations & Project Management (Early Talent)
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Location: Amsterdam, Tel-Aviv
Duration: 3 months
Start date: January 2027
Compensation: Paid
Eligibility: Current University student (Computer Science or related field), Recent Graduate or Early Career specialist
Work authorization: Permitted to work in the job's location

Capacity Management sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, engineering operations, and business priorities. Our team is responsible for ensuring that infrastructure capacity is available for customers, coordinating maintenance activities, and improving operational processes across multiple data centers.

We work closely with hardware infrastructure, platform engineering, networking, and other technical teams to maintain infrastructure availability and ensure that operational issues are identified and resolved efficiently.

We are looking for a student or recent graduate to help us improve and operate several key infrastructure management processes, focusing on GPU node repairs, node acceptance monitoring, and infrastructure maintenance coordination.

This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with real-world cloud infrastructure operations. You will work with engineering teams, analyze operational metrics, track issues, and help improve processes that directly affect infrastructure availability.

You don't need to be an infrastructure expert when you join. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, clear communication, and a willingness to understand how complex technical systems operate.

Your responsibilities will include

GPU Node Repair Process

Help manage and improve the node repair process across Nebius data centers to ensure infrastructure failures are identified, tracked, and resolved within agreed service level objectives.

  • Monitor GPU node availability and repair metrics across different regions and clusters.
  • Track compliance with node repair SLAs and identify cases requiring attention.
  • Analyze repair backlogs, identify nodes stuck in repair, and follow up with responsible teams.
  • Work with Hardware Infrastructure and Platform teams to investigate repair delays and improve issue resolution.
  • Maintain operational dashboards, Jira tickets, and regular status reports.
  • Identify recurring problems, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

Node Acceptance Monitoring

Help establish and maintain an operational monitoring process for node acceptance, ensuring that newly deployed or repaired nodes progress through acceptance testing without unnecessary delays.

  • Monitor node acceptance results across all regions and identify nodes stuck in the process.
  • Track compliance with the Node Acceptance Responsibility Agreement and associated SLAs.
  • Ensure responsible teams are aware of failed acceptance tests and outstanding actions.
  • Follow up on unresolved issues and help coordinate their resolution between engineering teams.
  • Analyze acceptance failures and identify recurring issues or bottlenecks.
  • Contribute to improving acceptance monitoring dashboards and operational procedures.

Infrastructure Maintenance Coordination

Participate in planning and coordinating smaller infrastructure maintenance activities, such as network switch replacements, under the guidance of experienced team members.

  • Help prepare maintenance plans, timelines, and execution checklists.
  • Coordinate with participating engineering teams to ensure readiness for scheduled activities.
  • Track maintenance preparation tasks and follow up on outstanding dependencies.
  • Support maintenance communications and progress reporting.
  • Collect execution results and document outcomes, incidents, and follow-up actions.
  • Help improve existing maintenance procedures and documentation based on practical experience.

Additional projects

Depending on your progress and interests, you may also have the opportunity to work on larger process improvement initiatives.

Extending the Node Repair Process

Help expand the existing GPU node repair process to cover other infrastructure types, including CPU and worker nodes. This would involve understanding differences in their operational lifecycles, identifying relevant stakeholders, and adapting existing monitoring, ticketing, and SLA processes.

Improving Major Maintenance Documentation

Help review and restructure the existing Major Maintenance documentation according to established documentation guidelines. The goal would be to make the process easier to understand and follow, with clear responsibilities, instructions, templates, and references for participating teams.

What we expect

  • You are currently completing, or have recently completed, a degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, operations management, or a related field.
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are comfortable working with data and operational metrics.
  • You can organize information, track multiple activities, and follow up on outstanding tasks.
  • You communicate clearly and are comfortable collaborating with technical specialists and managers.
  • You are proactive in identifying problems and investigating their causes rather than simply reporting them.
  • You can work with established processes while also identifying opportunities to improve them.
  • You pay attention to detail and take responsibility for completing assigned tasks.
  • You are interested in cloud infrastructure, technical operations, and cross-functional project management.

You do not need previous experience operating large-scale cloud infrastructure. Curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn quickly are more important.

It would be an advantage if you have

  • Basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure, servers, networking, or data center operations.
  • Experience working with monitoring or data visualization tools such as Grafana.
  • Familiarity with SQL or other data analysis tools.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration tools.
  • Experience coordinating university, volunteer, or personal projects involving multiple participants.
  • An interest in infrastructure operations, reliability engineering, or technical project management.

What you will gain

This Early Talent program provides hands-on experience with the operational challenges of running large-scale AI cloud infrastructure.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Understand how GPU clusters and cloud infrastructure are operated and maintained.
  • Learn how infrastructure failures are detected, investigated, and resolved.
  • Gain practical experience with operational monitoring, SLA management, and incident prevention.
  • Work with engineers across hardware infrastructure, compute, networking, and platform teams.
  • Participate in infrastructure maintenance planning and execution.
  • Develop analytical, communication, and technical project coordination skills.
  • Contribute to processes that directly impact infrastructure availability and customer experience.

By the end of the Early Talent Program, you should have a practical understanding of how infrastructure operations are coordinated across engineering teams, along with experience identifying operational problems and driving them toward resolution.

What success looks like

A successful Early Talent will result in:

  • Regular monitoring and reporting of GPU node repair performance, with SLA violations and outstanding issues clearly identified.
  • Improved visibility into node repair backlogs and more consistent follow-up on delayed repairs.
  • An established routine for monitoring node acceptance, tracking SLA compliance, and ensuring responsible teams take action on failed tests.
  • Successful coordination of one or more smaller infrastructure maintenance activities under supervision.
  • Improvements to operational dashboards, reporting, or process documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with technical teams, investigate issues, and independently manage assigned operational tasks.

If the Early Talent Program is successful, we will be happy to discuss an opportunity to continue with the team in a full-time position, subject to performance, mutual fit, and business needs.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Xbox Supply Strategist
description:
Overview

Microsoft is looking for a motivated & inspiring leader to join the Xbox Supply Chain team, responsible for driving end to end supply chain strategy & performance to enable achievement of the financial & overall category targets for Xbox Accessories.

The Xbox Supply Strategist will lead development & oversee execution of global supply positioning strategies across all stages of the product lifecycle, ensuring that inventory is positioned to deliver working capital, cost, and service goals. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Finance & various groups within Supply Chain to establish & manage supply plan of record. Every day will bring a new challenge, and you’ll be continually looking for ways to drive business profitability by planning and executing a predictable, reliable & low-cost supply chain.

The ideal candidate must combine exceptional analytical capabilities, have deep supply chain knowledge & a proven track record of improving business performance by driving cross-functional alignment & exerting influence in a matrixed organization.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Communicates with functional stakeholders including Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, Sales, Manufacturing, Engineering, and New Product Introductions (NPI) to create alignment in the overall Sales & Operations Plan and Financial plans. Coordinates with each group individually and synthesizes their needs considering a variety of demands and constraints to drive action efforts across teams that align with business objectives. May contribute to the long-range, integrated operating product plan.
  • Facilitates Sales & Operations meetings for Senior Director-level of all related groups (e.g., Finance, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain) to present relevant analyses, keep everyone informed, facilitate group needs to other members, and drive cross functional decisions as needed. Assists in addressing any requests from stakeholders, issues, or escalations that arise during alignment process of each group. Follows up on action items and conducts additional analyses as necessary.
  • Gathers analyses, reports, and process knowledge to create synthesized set of plans related to operations as directed by senior leadership. Provides insights for the phase in/phase out process of a product or service by orchestrating ramp up/down procedures. Leverages supply and demand analyses to facilitate addressing fulfillment gaps with appropriate stakeholders under guidance from senior leadership.
  • Begins to identify margin increasing improvements to the Integrated Business Plan (IBP) process and advises senior leadership about implementation. Notifies senior leaders of potential improvements to efficiency of the IBP and to incorporate customer needs into the IBP under advisement.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Operations, Finance, or related field AND 6+ years experience in data science/analytics, engineering, industrial engineering, supply chain, operations, or project management with a supply chain or operations field.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Operations, Finance or related field AND 4+ years experience in Data Science/Analytics, Engineering, or Project Management with a Supply Chain or Operations field.
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Ability to think strategically and execute tactically with a hands-on spirit.
  • Advanced conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Leadership of complex cross functional projects, with proven ability to meet challenging organizational objectives.
  • Ability to partner at senior levels to design and implement programs & solutions.
  • Knowledge of business systems and information technology for managing supply chain.
  • Good business judgment, exceptional communication skills and ability to resolve conflicts diplomatically.

title: Lukion ja peruskoulun yhteinen saksan ja ruotsin kielen päätoimisen tuntiopettajan viransijaisuus
description:
Haemme lukion ja perusopetuksen yhteistä saksan ja ruotsin kielen päätoimisen tuntiopettajan viransijaista ainakin 3.11.2026 asti.

Yhdenvertaisuus, osallisuus sekä hyvän näkeminen oppilaissamme ovat keskeisiä toimintaperiaatteitamme. Lukio on saanut OKKA-säätiön sertifikaatin ja yhteiskoulu on Vihreä lippu -koulu, joten ympäristökysymykset ovat osa toimintakulttuuriamme. Kollegiaalisuus, ystävällisyys, yhdessä tekeminen sekä työssä jaksamisen tukeminen ovat työyhteisömme voimavaroja. Yhteiskoulu ja lukio muodostavat yhdessä Unesco-kampuksen. Kampuksellamme tehdään laajaa kansainvälisyystyötä.

Oriveden lukiossa opiskelee 152 oppilasta ja Oriveden yhteiskoulussa 285 oppilasta. Koulukeskuksessa on henkilökuntaa 50. Yhteiskoulussa opiskelee yleisopetuksen oppilaita seitsemännestä yhdeksänteen vuosiluokkaan.

Koulukeskukseen on helppo tulla myös julkisilla liikennevälineillä, sillä se sijaitsee aivan ysitien varrella. Myös junayhteydet niin Tampereen kuin Jämsän suuntaan toimivat hyvin ja juna-asemalta pääsee kätevästi Oriveden keskustaan Nyssykkä-palvelun avulla.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen (986/1998) mukaisesti.

Valitun on ennen palvelussuhteen alkamista toimitettava nähtäväksi lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskenteleviltä.

Hakemukseen tulee liittää kelpoisuuden osoittavat tutkintotodistukset skannattuina.

Jos kiinnostuit, laita hakemus tulemaan jo tänään kuntarekry.fi:n kautta. Viransijaisuus täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Senior Researcher - AI Systems and Infrastructure - Microsoft Research
description:
Overview

Microsoft Research (MSR), a leading industrial research laboratory, comprises over 1,000 computer scientists working across the United States, United Kingdom, China, India, Canada, and the Netherlands.

We are currently seeking a Senior Researcher in the area of AI Systems and Infrastructure located in Vancouver, British Columbia, with a keen interest in developing cutting-edge large foundation models and post-training techniques for different domains and scenarios. This is an opportunity to drive an ambitious research agenda while collaborating with diverse teams to push for novel applications of those areas.

Over the past 30 years, our scientists have not only conducted world-class computer science research but also integrated advanced technologies into our products and services, positively impacting millions of lives and propelling Microsoft to the forefront of digital transformation.

#MSRR #Research
At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.


Responsibilities
  • Conduct research on state-of-the-art AI-driven approaches, methodologies, and technologies to improve the performance, efficiency, scalability, and reliability of AI systems and infrastructure.
  • Design, develop, and evaluate AI-driven methodologies, algorithms, and frameworks for optimizing AI systems and infrastructure performance, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and product managers, to develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for AI systems and infrastructure optimization and automation.
  • Stay current with the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, distributed systems, cloud computing, and system architecture to drive innovation in AI-driven system and infrastructure management.
  • Publish research findings in leading conferences, journals, and other technical venues, and present AI-driven innovations and research outcomes to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Mentor and guide fellow researchers and engineers in AI-driven research methodologies, system optimization techniques, and infrastructure innovation.
  • Collaborate with industry partners, academic institutions, and research communities to advance AI-driven research initiatives and next-generation AI systems and infrastructure technologies


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in relevant field
    • OR Master's Degree in relevant field AND 3+ years related research experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in relevant field AND 4+ years related research experience.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional/Preferred Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in relevant field AND 3+ years related research experience
    • OR Master's Degree in relevant field AND 6+ years related research experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in relevant field AND 8+ years related research experience

title: Supervisory Purchasing Agent
description:
The Supervisory Purchasing Agent is responsible for issuing, reviewing and or procuring prescribed items to Veterans in compliance with VHA guidelines and directives and leading a team of Purchasing Agents. The work requires knowledge of policies and procedures for delivery orders and small purchases. This work also requires knowledge of commercial supply sources and common business practices related to sales, prices, discounts, units of measurement, deliveries, stocks, and shipments.

This position serves as a Supervisory Purchasing Agent for the Prosthetics Service within the VA Health Care System and supported catchment area. The Supervisory Purchasing Agent is responsible for issuing, reviewing and or procuring prescribed items to Veterans in compliance with VHA guidelines and directives. As a purchase card holder, fulfills acquisition requests under the federal micro-purchase threshold, ensuring purchases are procured in accordance with federal and VA regulations, policy and procedures with responsibility for work leading to the purchase of a wide variety of complex and highly specialized services, supplies, equipment, and systems. Duties include, but may not be limited to the following: Supervises three or more Purchasing Agents performing work at or below the GS-6 level; serves as first respondent to any staff concerns related to procurement or purchase orders and is expected to work independently to resolve those issues, only escalating unresolvable issues; distributes and balances the workload among employees; assures timely accomplishment of assignments; and reviews completed work for compliance; instructs Purchasing Agents in specific tasks and job techniques; and, identifies training needs and provides on the job training to new Purchasing Agents. Purchasing and Procurement Support - Conducts purchasing for the VA HCS and supported catchment area under the micro purchase threshold; purchases various equipment, supplies, and services using the government purchase card for micro purchases; utilizes different ordering, reporting procedures, and purchasing methods depending on the type quantity, dollar value, and urgency of the requirement; provides administration and oversight on orders and services; advises approving officials and purchase card holders on purchase card program, procurement procedures and responsibilities. Administrative Support - Serves as the first line of contact for medical staff and customers in regard to procured items; provides clerical support and coordination to approving officials and administrators; utilizes a variety of automated systems to enter, update, revise, sort, and calculate data; develops reports and spreadsheets, obtains, organizes, files and retrieves reports for briefing and presentation purposes. Performs other related duties as assigned. Work Schedule: Monday- Friday 7:45am-4:30pm. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Position Description/PD#: Supervisory Purchasing Agent/PD60564A Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job To be considered for this position, you must complete all required steps in the process. In addition to the application and questionnaire, this position requires an online assessment. The online assessment measures critical general competencies required to perform the job. Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959 Physical Requirements: The work required does not inherently include any physical requirements essential for successful job performance that could not otherwise be performed with accommodation or workplace adjustment. A pre-placement physical examination is not required. Subject to background/security investigation Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued dentification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP) As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period or 2-year trial period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your probationary period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

title: Johtava tutkija, kestävä liiketoiminta
description:
Haluatko vaikuttaa siihen, miten yritykset, kaupungit ja alueet uudistuvat kestävällä tavalla? Innostutko uusien avauksien rakentamisesta, kansainvälisistä verkostoista ja vaikuttavista tutkimus- ja kehittämishankkeista?

Haemme Savonian Kestävä yhteiskunta -tutkimusalalle johtavaa tutkijaa, joka yhdistää tutkimuksellisen osaamisen, työelämälähtöisen kehittämisen sekä kyvyn rakentaa menestyviä tutkimus- ja kehittämiskonsortioita kansallisella ja kansainvälisellä tasolla.

Etsimme henkilöä, joka ymmärtää tutkimuksen lisäksi yritysten liiketoimintaa, investointipäätöksiä ja uudistumisen tarpeita sekä osaa rakentaa näiden ympärille vaikuttavaa tutkimus- ja kehittämistoimintaa. Samalla vahvistat Savonian Kestävä yhteiskunta -tutkimusalan profiilia, laatua ja kansallista sekä kansainvälistä vaikuttavuutta.

Etsimme henkilöä, joka näkee tutkimuksen keinona ratkaista yhteiskunnan ja yritysten käytännön haasteita sekä luoda uutta liiketoimintaa, osaamista ja kilpailukykyä.

Johtavana tutkijana
- johdat ja teet kansallisten ja kansainvälisten tutkimus- ja kehittämisrahoitushakujen valmistelua sekä luot uusia TKI-avauksia
- vahvistat tutkimusalan vaikuttavuutta kestävän liiketoiminnan, ilmastokestävyyden ja kokonaisturvallisuuden teemoissa
- tunnistat yritysten ja yhteiskunnan kehittämistarpeita ja rakennat niiden pohjalta uusia tutkimus- ja kehittämiskokonaisuuksia
- rakennat alueellisia, kansallisia ja kansainvälisiä yhteistyöverkostoja
- teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Savonian muiden tutkimusalojen kanssa sekä edistät TKI:n ja opetuksen integraatiota
- sparraat tutkimusalan asiantuntijoita hankkeiden valmistelussa ja toteutuksessa

Johtavan tutkijan tehtävään edellytämme sinulta
- soveltuvaa tohtorin tutkintoa
- näyttöä menestyksekkäästä tutkimus- ja kehittämisrahoituksen hakemisesta
- vahvaa kokemusta tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiotoiminnan johtamisesta, hankevalmistelusta ja hankkeiden toteuttamisesta
- kokemusta yritysyhteistyöstä sekä kykyä tunnistaa kehittämistarpeita ja rakentaa niiden pohjalta vaikuttavia tutkimus- ja kehittämisavauksia
- näyttöjä kansallisten ja kansainvälisten yhteistyöverkostojen rakentamisesta
- erinomaisia yhteistyö-, verkostoitumis- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
- tutkimusalan tarpeista nousevaa soveltavaa tutkimus julkaisu- ja asiantuntijatoimintaa

Arvostamme
- kokemusta Horizon Europe-, Interreg-, Business Finland- tai Suomen Akatemian rahoituksesta
- kokemusta kestävän liiketoiminnan, ilmastokestävyyden tai kokonaisturvallisuuden teemoista
- vahvoja kansallisia ja kansainvälisiä verkostoja
- näyttöjä yritysten uudistumista tukevasta tutkimus- ja kehittämistoiminnasta
- kykyä yhdistää tutkimus, liiketoiminnan kehittäminen ja yhteiskunnallinen vaikuttavuus

Lopullinen tehtävänkuva muotoutuu valitun henkilön osaamisen ja kiinnostuksen mukaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä ja vaikuttavaa työtä yhdessä Suomen parhaista työpaikoista. Johtavan tutkijan tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, millaisia ratkaisuja rakennetaan tulevaisuuden kestävän liiketoiminnan, vihreän siirtymän, alueellisen kilpailukyvyn ja yhteiskunnan resilienssin vahvistamiseksi.

Pääset osaksi Kestävä yhteiskunta -tutkimusalan asiantuntevaa tiimiä. Tutkimusalamme tuottaa ratkaisuja kestävän liiketoiminnan, vihreän siirtymän, kokonaisturvallisuuden ja alueellisen uudistumisen haasteisiin. Toimintamme perustuu monialaiseen osaamiseen, jota sovelletaan laajasti eri toimialoilla yhteistyössä yritysten, julkisen sektorin ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Tehtävässä voit vaikuttaa merkittävästi tutkimusalan näkyvyyteen, tutkimusrahoituksen kasvuun ja yhteiskunnalliseen vaikuttavuuteen.

Työskentelemme moderneissa toimitiloissa kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä työelämän kanssa. Tehtävän pääpaikkana on Microkadun kampus Kuopiossa, mutta tehtävään voi kuulua työskentelyä myös muilla Savonian kampuksilla. Käytössämme on liukuva työaika, joka tukee työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista.

Työsuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Sivistan ammattikorkeakoulujen työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti. Tehtävässä on sopimuspalkka. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Tehtävään valitulla on kuuden kuukauden koeaika.

Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 8.11.2026. Lähetä sähköinen hakemus Kuntarekryn kautta (www.kuntarekry.fi).

Miksi Savonia?

Arvostamme yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. Vastuullisella johtamisella haluamme mahdollistaa merkityksellisen ja tuloksellisen työn yhdessä Suomen parhaista työpaikoista.

Savoniassa henkilöstön osaamisen kehittäminen ja hyvinvointi ovat meille tärkeitä. Tarjoamme henkilöstölle kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten Epassin, SYKETTÄ-liikuntapalvelut ja työterveyshuollon palvelut. Kampuksilla tarjoamme työpäivän aikana kahvit, teet ja kaakaot. Lisäksi kannustamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan jatkuvasti, ja siksi tarjoamme työntekijöillemme mahdollisuuden opiskella veloituksetta Savonian avoimessa ammattikorkeakoulussa. Olemme ylpeitä yhteisömme tuloksista ja palkitsemme henkilöstöämme onnistumisista säännöllisesti.

Tule rakentamaan kestävää tulevaisuutta kanssamme.

title: Cloud and AI Partner Solution Specialist
description:
Overview

At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.

SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.

As a Partner Solution Sales professional, you will focus on one of Microsoft’s core Solution Areas—AI Business Process, Cloud & AI Platform, or Security within the SMB segment. You will be responsible for driving opportunities from commit to complete (Stages 2–3 of the Microsoft Customer Engagement Methodology, MCEM), operating at scale across a portfolio of high performing CSP (Cloud Solution Providers) partners. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your selling skills, and become adept at deal structuring.

You will develop and execute a Partner Solution Area Sales Plan with assigned partners, driving sales through co-sell strategies to achieve quarterly CSA (Clous Solution Area) FRA across the SMB Business. You will lead your partners' commercial performance and drive sustainable sales impact to customers. A key responsibility will be driving Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) revenue through your partner portfolio. Your role will involve acting as a trusted advisor and business leader, developing the business strategy between Microsoft and your partners. You will also enhance your consultative selling skills through MCEM training and actively pursue additional learning opportunities.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Collaboration & Co-Sell
• Leads partner co-selling efforts with portfolio of assigned partners to drive sales pipeline. Drives the development and execution of co-sell strategies that outline activities to meet and/or exceed Microsoft and partner sales targets. Leads collaboration efforts between internal and external stakeholders to accelerate deal execution, proactively leverage investments, and accelerate sales. Shares innovation in novel sales best practices that drive business forward and influences others across the market.
• Proactively tracks cloud solution area co-sell pipeline performance and addresses low performance through correction of errors (CoE) efforts. Proactively tracks partner sales capabilities and capacities for sales practice acceleration and growth, meanwhile providing insights into future practices. Proactively tracks partner incentive utilization and impact on pipeline velocity, and influences the partner to improve performance. Ensures partner is tracking to target by solution area. Tracks quarterly forecast to ensure it meets and/or exceeds revenue accountability.

Partner Engagement
• Proactively develops and shares best practices for co-selling with partners and global peers through community forums, contributes to listening circles and contributes to and influences worldwide learning initiatives as a subject matter expert. Shares market local solution area business momentum insights and corporate research for customer demand.
• Works with prioritized solution area-aligned partners to identify and cultivate new opportunities with customers. Proactively drives the qualified partner pipeline and progresses it through the sales cycle. Ensures partner adoption of investment levers to create opportunities and accelerate deal velocity
• Drives the acceleration of cloud solution area sales practice with partners, with a focus on pipeline, go-to-market (GTM) sales and co-sell execution. Proactively drives a predictable cloud solution area rhythm of business (RoB) and anticipates and mitigates performance issues with partners to ensure delivery of cloud solution area partner targets. Proactively collaborates with and influences segment sales teams to drive co-sell performance with partners through joint execution.

Partner Solution Area Sales Plan
• Proactively creates joint solution area sales plans in partnership with prioritized partners in the solution area portfolio relevant to customer segment to address complex customer needs and drive quarterly revenue accountability. Owns the identification, understanding, and evaluation of partners' cloud solution area sales practice(s). Leads the strategic alignment with organizational units and overall partner business plans to meet sales objectives.

Sales Process & Sales Management
• Guides partners on solution play and ensures partners have capability and capacity to deliver the value proposition of the solution play. Leads pipeline management meetings and unblocks deals by connecting with Microsoft resources. Drives creative and advanced plans leveraging all of the Microsoft internal resources (e.g., investments, funding) and coaches the partner on how to accelerate their sale process using these tools/resources. Drives business reviews with key partner stakeholders and holds partners accountable for delivery against agreed plan.
• Maintains an in-depth understanding of, and upholds Microsoft's current compliance processes.
• Proactively initiates solution area sales planning with assigned partners and ensures coverage to support targets. Monitors, manages, and provides insights into a predictable sales pipeline rhythm of business (RoB) with assigned solution area partners. Manages and support top partner deals and overall partner revenue aligned to solution area.



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications
Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in core sales, partner sales, industry or solution selling, marketing, or business development OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications
Doctorate AND 5+ years experience in core sales, partner sales, industry or solution selling, marketing, or business development OR Master's Degree AND 8+ years experience in core sales, partner sales, industry or solution selling, marketing, or business development OR Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience in core sales, partner sales, industry or solution selling, marketing, or business development OR equivalent experience.

title: Timpuri
description:
Haemme kokeneita TIMPUREITA monipuolisiin rakennusprojekteihin!

Etsimme ammattitaitoisia ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykeneviä timpureita asiakasyritystemme niin uudis- kuin saneerauskohteisiin. Työkohteet vaihtelevat pienemmistä remonttikohteista laajempiin rakennusprojekteihin, ja työtehtävät määräytyvät osaamisesi mukaan. Työn kesto määräytyy asiakasyritystemme tilauksen ja tarpeiden mukaisesti.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Useamman vuoden kokemusta timpurin töistä
* Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ratkaista ongelmia oma-aloitteisesti
* Piirustusten lukutaitoa ja huolellista työotetta
* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Rakennusalan TES:n mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan aina ajallaan maksettuna. Tässä tehtävässä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 17,12-22 euron välille, ja se määritelläänosaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan
* Monipuolisia ja osaamisesi mukaisia työtehtäviä eri kohteissa
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi eri projekteissa
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka tukee sinua koko työsuhteen ajan
* Luotettavan työnantajan ja jatkuvia työmahdollisuuksia

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Savonlinnaan. Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla. Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava kuukausitulo on keskimäärin noin 3000 € / kk, kun sinulla on neljä hoitolasta ja sinulla on vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpielämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta tai halua opiskella työn ohella(kasvatusalan ammattitutkinto, lähihoitaja, sosionomi, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja)
* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia
* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja
* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Valmiin Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitokonseptin, joka on jo usean yrittäjämme toimesta todettu toimivaksi. Konsepti sisältää kaiken tarvittavan menestyneen perhepäivähoidon pyörittämiseen.
* Kaiken tarvittavan avun yrityksen perustamiseen ja pyörittämiseen. Kaikki on valmiiksi mietitty ja selvitetty puolestasi. Koulutuksemme ja ketjun jatkuva tuki varmistaa, ettet koskaan jää talousasioiden kanssa yksin.
* Ihanan Kultapalat-yhteisön, jossa pääset vaihtamaan ajatuksia muiden Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajien kanssa.



Hae rohkeasti mukaan, tässä porukassa on kivaa sekä aikuisilla että lapsilla!

title: Assistant Manager
description:

To be a successful assistant general manager, you should eagerly participate in educational and training opportunities. title: Assistant Store Director
description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.


Position Summary

The Assistant Store Director supports the overall operation of the store by assisting in leadership, execution, and accountability across all departments. This role helps drive sales, profitability, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and employee development while serving as a key member of the store leadership team. The Assistant Store Director acts as a leader on duty, helping ensure a safe, productive, and customer-focused environment and may assume responsibility for the store in the Store Director's absence.

Key Responsibilities Store Operations
  • Assist in overseeing daily store operations to ensure company standards are achieved.
  • Monitor store conditions, merchandising, inventory levels, and execution of operational programs.
  • Ensure departments maintain cleanliness, organization, food safety, and compliance standards.
  • Support execution of company initiatives, promotions, and sales events.
  • Conduct store walks to identify opportunities and address operational concerns.
Leadership & Team Development
  • Provide leadership and direction to department managers and store associates.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop employees to improve performance and promote career growth.
  • Assist with recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and retention efforts.
  • Help create a culture focused on accountability, teamwork, customer service, and engagement.
  • Support performance management processes, including coaching and corrective action when necessary.
Customer Service
  • Promote exceptional customer service throughout the store.
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and efficiently.
  • Ensure associates maintain a welcoming and customer-focused environment.
  • Support community engagement and customer loyalty initiatives.
Financial Performance
  • Assist with achieving sales, labor, shrink, and profitability goals.
  • Review operational reports and key performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Support labor planning and scheduling to meet business demands.
  • Help manage expenses and maximize department productivity.
Safety & Compliance
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, food safety requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Promote workplace safety and assist with accident prevention programs.
  • Participate in safety inspections and corrective action follow-up.
  • Maintain compliance with cash handling, security, and loss prevention procedures.
Merchandising & Sales
  • Support department managers in executing merchandising plans and maintaining in-stock conditions.
  • Monitor promotional displays and seasonal merchandising opportunities.
  • Drive sales growth through effective execution of company programs and customer-focused selling initiatives.
Qualifications Required
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous retail leadership or grocery management experience.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to analyze business metrics and make operational decisions.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to lead multiple departments in a fast-paced retail environment.
Preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Retail Management, or a related field.
  • Experience managing multiple departments within a grocery or retail setting.
  • Experience with budgeting, labor management, and operational planning.
Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities
  • Strong leadership and people-development skills.
  • Excellent customer service and conflict-resolution abilities.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize, delegate, and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Understanding of merchandising, inventory management, and retail operations.
  • Proficiency with store reporting systems and Microsoft Office applications.
Physical Requirements
  • Frequently stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Lift, push, pull, and carry up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Bend, reach, squat, and climb as needed.
  • Work in varying temperatures, including refrigerated and freezer environments when necessary.

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

  • Competitive wages paid weekly
· Access to up to 50% of your earned wages before payday, via our partnership with Stream
  • Associate discounts
  • Health and financial well-being benefits for eligible associates (Medical, Dental, 401k and more!)
  • Time off (vacation, holidays, sick pay). For eligibility requirements please visit myACI Benefits
  • Leaders invested in your training, career growth and development
  • An inclusive work environment with talented colleagues who reflect the communities we serve

title: Kesäteologi
description:
Vaasan suomalainen seurakunta palkkaa kesäksi 2-3 kesäteologia. Kesäteologien työtehtävät painottuvat leirityöhön (rippileirit ja muut nuorisotyön leirit). Työhön sisältyy myös monipuolisesti muuta seurakuntatyötä, kuten puheita kesäkirkoissa, nuorteniltoja, sometyötä sekä syntymäpäiväonnittelukäyntejä seurakuntalaisten luona. Työkielenä on suomi.

Kesäteologit otetaan määräaikaiseen virkasuhteeseen, ja palkkaus määräytyy KirVESTES:n vaativuusryhmän 303 mukaan (vähimmäispalkka vuonna 2026 2216,52€/kk). Virkasuhteeseen on kelpoinen vain Suomen evankelis-luterilaisen kirkon konfirmoitu jäsen. Valituilta vaaditaan lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain mukainen (504/2022) rikosrekisteriote.

Arvostamme iloista ja ennakkoluulotonta työotetta. Kerro vapaamuotoisessa hakemuksessasi itsestäsi ja siitä, mikä sinua innostaa seurakunta- ja leirityössä.

Työ alkaa 25.5.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Työn kesto on 2-2,5 kk. Leirivuorokausista maksetaan leiripäivärahat. Leirivapaat määräytyvät työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti. Työssä sovelletaan työajattoman hengellisen työn työaikaa.

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisesti 10.11.26 klo 12.00 mennessä KirkkoRekryn kautta. Haastattelut järjestetään Teamsissa keskiviikkona 18.11. Haastatteluun kutsutaan erikseen.

title: Emergency Management Specialist (Preparedness)
description:
The ideal candidate will have experience reviewing and/or developing radiological emergency response plans; and/or conducting and/or evaluating radiological emergency related exercises.

What will I do in this position if hired? In this position, you will serve as an Emergency Management Specialist in the Radiological Emergency Preparedness Program in the FEMA Region 3 office. Typical assignments include: Participating in the execution of preparedness activities and provides assistance with issues involving planning and preparation for crises, disasters, humanitarian emergencies, hazards, or natural and man-made/technological incidents. Serving as a specialist in the functional area of emergency planning and preparedness. Providing, coordinating, and participating in emergency planning and delivery of work that involves the coordination of emergency response and preparedness training, exercises, and local assistance. What else do I need to know? At FEMA, our mission is to help people before, during and after disasters, and every employee at FEMA has a role in emergency management. Every FEMA employee has regular and recurring emergency management responsibilities, though not every position requires routine deployment to disaster sites. All positions are subject to recall around the clock for emergency management operations, which may require irregular work hours, work at locations other than the official duty station, and may include duties other than those specified in the employee's official position description. Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and may require employees to relocate to emergency sites with physically austere and operationally challenging conditions. Promotion Potential: Future promotions will be dependent on your ability to perform the duties at a higher level, the continuing need for an employee assigned to the higher level, and administrative approval.

To ensure the accomplishment of our mission, DHS requires every employee to be reliable and trustworthy. To meet those standards, all selected applicants must undergo, successfully pass, and maintain a background investigation for Moderate Risk as a condition of placement into this position. This may include a credit check after initial job qualifications are determined, a review of financial issues, such as delinquency in the payment of debts, child support and/or tax obligations, as well as certain criminal offenses and illegal use or possession of drugs (please visit: Mythbuster on Federal Hiring Policies for additional information). For more information on background investigations for Federal jobs please visit OPM Investigations. The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C, Non-career SES or Presidential Appointee employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the Human Resources Office. Please ensure you meet the qualification requirements described below. Key Requirements: You must be a U.S. citizen to apply for this position. You must successfully pass a background investigation. Selective Service registration required. Current federal employees must meet time-in-grade requirements. You must be able to obtain and maintain a Government credit card. You must be able to deploy with little or no advance notice to anywhere in the United States and its territories for an extended period of time. Please review the Additional Information section for additional key requirements.

title: Purchasing Agent
description:
This position serves as a Purchasing Agent for the Logistics Service within the VA Health Care System performing work to acquire supplies, services, and construction by purchase, rental, or lease through (a) delivery orders and/or (b) small purchase procedures.

This position utilizes knowledge of policies and procedures for delivery orders and small purchases and knowledge of commercial supply sources and common business practices related to sales, prices, discounts, units of measurement, deliveries, stocks, and shipments. The Purchasing Agent maintains responsibility for work leading to the purchase of a wide variety of complex and highly specialized services, supplies, equipment, and systems that support the full range of programs and activities. Major duties and responsibilities include: Purchasing Support - Conducts purchasing under the micro purchase threshold; reviews and edits purchase requests; resolves issues to ensure requests and bills are processed accurately and in a timely manner; identifies needs or problems and determines corrective action; utilizes federal and agency acquisition regulations to identify possible sources and other pertinent information related to purchases; tracks obligations/commitments and monitors expenditures to support recurring budget forecasts and identify potential fraud, waste and abuse based on procurement history and purchase trends; and, Procurement Support - Procures supplies and services to meet the purchase, rental, or lease needs of the organization; develops unique selection criteria for each purchase; Prepare and issue contract modifications for changes in delivery schedule and sends formal correspondence to a variety of customers such as inventory management specialists, other service line contacts, and contracting officers as appropriate for the purposes of auditing documents, processing receiving reports, and payments.; conducting open market research and sole source small purchases for highly specialized medical items with critical product requirements; and, Administrative Support - Serves as the first line of contact for medical staff and customers in regard to procured items; develops reports and spreadsheets, obtains, organizes, files and retrieves reports for briefing and presentation purposes; performs a variety of receptionist, timekeeping, record keeping and miscellaneous duties in medical facility; and, Performs other related duties as assigned. Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:00am - 4:30 pm Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Position Description/PD#: Purchasing Agent/PD99896S Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not approved Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not authorized

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job To be considered for this position, you must complete all required steps in the process. In addition to the application and questionnaire, this position requires an online assessment. The online assessment measures critical general competencies required to perform the job. Physical Requirements: The work required does not inherently include any physical requirements essential for successful job performance that could not otherwise be performed with accommodation or workplace adjustment. A pre-placement physical examination is not required. Subject to background/security investigation Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP) As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period or 2-year trial period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your probationary period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

title: Inventory Planner - Outlet
description:
Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of home furnishings in the United States, Canada and Australia. Our brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We successfully market them through all three major channels - retail stores, catalogs, and the Internet.

Position Summary

The Inventory Planner, Outlet is responsible for the strategic planning and management of inventory across the Outlet business, including Outlet Stores and Outlet Online, for all Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands. As a member of the Outlet Inventory team (Buying, Planning, and Distribution), this role owns the sales, margin, and inventory plan for the Outlet channel. It manages the flow of brand overstock transfers and customer returns (chip and dent) to deliver the right inventory to the right stores at the right time. The Merchandise Planner partners with Outlet Buyers, Distribution, DC/Supply Chain, brand Merchandising and Planning teams, and field leadership to maximize sales, protect margin, optimize inventory turn, and drive profitable growth. This position reports into the Outlet Inventory Manager and is responsible for meeting Outlet sales, MMU, inventory, and turn goals as outlined in the financial budget.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Financial Planning & Forecasting
    • Own monthly Open to Buy forecasting of Outlet sales, MMU, receipts, and EOP inventory by brand and channel, and recommend near-term actions to achieve sales goals and budgeted inventory EOMs.
    • Partner with Buyers and Finance to build pre-season and annual Outlet plans that align with tops-down financial goals and the overall brand inventory strategy.
    • Plan and manage a favorable mix of allocated brand overstock vs. chip and dent inventory to deliver MMU dollar and rate goals.
    • Perform in-season forecasting and ad-hoc analysis to identify inventory-related risks and opportunities and estimate the impact of inventory shortages and gluts for field and brand leadership.
  • Inventory Flow & Management
    • Plan and manage inventory flow across all brands, incorporating brand overstock transfers, customer returns, and brand store transfers into a single inventory plan to achieve annual turn goals.
    • Partner with Distribution to allocate large cube, clearance, and slow-moving (E/F) product to Outlet Stores to achieve model stock store density and alleviate DC capacity constraints.
    • Consistently review brand inventory positions to identify and facilitate opportunities to reallocate inventory from brand to Outlet to drive sales.
    • Scrutinize returns disposition logic across all DCs and develop creative strategies to add inventory to Outlet Online from sources throughout the network.
    • Support Outlet Online site and assortment strategies, including expanded offerings, filtering and sorting, and improved conditioning categorizations.
  • Pricing, Promotions & Liquidation
    • Recommend targeted promotions and progressive markdown cadence on aging inventory that maximize sales and margin and address inventory gluts.
    • Develop and execute disciplined liquidation strategies for store relocations and closures that minimize margin erosion and support the real estate repositioning plan.
    • Determine end-of-life disposition strategies for aged and non-saleable inventory.
  • Assortment & Milestone PlanningDelete since they are buyer responsibilities
    • Create and maintain a monthly milestone calendar inclusive of seasonal allocation timing and key assortment flow dates, ensuring Buying, Planning, and Distribution are aligned on product flow, transfer cadence, and inventory priorities.
    • Partner with Buyers to develop a channel-right, brand-balanced assortment that prioritizes margin-rich brand overstocks and balances offerings at standalone vs. shared stores.
    • Leverage store profile and market analysis to inform localized store assortment and inventory decisions.
  • Reporting & Analytics
    • Deliver comprehensive, actionable reporting on store and DC inventory position, pending transfers, seasonal ownership, allocation tracking, and category performance.
    • Utilize reporting and planning tools (Qliksense, Microstrategy, etc.) to inform inventory forecasts and follow a data → insight → action approach in every analysis.
    • Leverage historical data to identify key learnings around product, pricing, and inventory and apply learnings to future seasons.
    • Optimize monthly shopping and planning processes for efficiency across all involved cross-functional teams.
  • Leadership & Collaboration
    • Operate as one Outlet Inventory team across Buying, Planning, and Distribution: share information freely, align on priorities, and show up as a collaborative partner to the field and to each other.
    • Bring proactive, clear, and action-oriented communication to stores, DC/Supply Chain, Transportation, and brand partners, flagging risks and surfacing opportunities.
    • Actively participate in creating a people-first culture that is entrepreneurial, accountable to delivering results, and celebrates success.
    • Support new-hire onboarding and provide training and mentorship to assistant planners.
    • Travel within country occasionally.

Qualifications

  • Data driven individual with a curious, entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent professional experience required.
  • Minimum three to five years of experience in Merchandise Planning or Inventory Management required; experience in outlet, off-price, or clearance businesses preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in the retail industry preferred; multi-channel (stores and e-commerce) experience a plus.
  • Proficiency in retail math and experience managing a traditional open-to-buy.
  • Proven ability to objectively interpret data and extract actionable insights that drive the business.
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with reporting and BI tools (e.g., Qlik) and MRP/ERP systems preferred.
  • Understanding of supply chain and distribution processes, including inventory allocation, transfers, and returns.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills; comfortable addressing all levels within an organization.
  • Experience leading others in a project setting, mentoring, and complex problem solving preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload to meet deadlines.
  • Flexible and adaptive to changing priorities; able to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.

Our Culture & Values
We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First
Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits
- A generous discount on all WSI brands
- A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
- Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer
- Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits
- Tax-free commuter benefits
- A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

Continued Learning
- In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University
- Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities
- Resources for self-development
- Advisor (Mentor) program
- Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series


WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

This role requires being onsite in our office in The Colony, TX Monday through Thursday, and remote option on Friday.

title: Planning Local Business Line Leader
description:
This Opportunity

WSP USA, Inc. (WSP) is looking for a Local Business Leader overseeing our Central and Western Pennsylvania Planning Practice, as a Vice President in Transportation Planning working out of our Pittsburgh office. We have an immediate opening for a motivated, highly skilled, and experienced transportation or environmental planner with focus in the transportation industry. This position is expected to organize, plan, and grow our Advisory & Planning services in the western & central portion of Pennsylvania as well as be a client advisor, staff manager, and pursuit and project manager on Pennsylvanian and regional projects and programs. This position will work closely with planning, environmental, civil, and transit/rail staff across WSP to research, analyze, document and present information related to various types of transportation projects across the region.

Your Impact

  • Provide proactive and strategic leadership for the planning discipline and function, offering direction, expertise, and support to ensure project and work site deliverables are successfully achieved within the business sector.
  • Responsible for the contribution and management of multi-disciplinary project teams in all phases of the execution and delivery of siting, impact assessment, approval and permitting for assigned business sector projects, as well as transportation planning and management projects.
  • Lead larger-scale more complex transportation planning projects ensuring contributors know their role and schedule needs, preparing and overseeing relevant project budgets, monitoring external events, tracking hours and expenses, ensuring profitability and satisfactory performance, and supervising subcontractors, contract work, and employees.
  • Leverage professional network to grow a client base for providing high level Transportation Planning services including identifying additional business development opportunities, and cross-selling of other WSP capabilities.
  • Oversee the appropriate use of topographic maps, aerial photographs, GPS data, and other visualization tools to determine exact locations of project areas, associated physical / urban / population / economic / political sensitivities, and to uncover primary, secondary, and tertiary impacts.
  • Actively foster compliance with applicable Federal, State, and Local Agency laws, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support the overall long-term strategy, growth, and pipeline development of Transportation Planning work for WSP in assigned area of responsibility, with a focus on opportunities in all disciplines (planning, design, strategic consulting, and program management).
  • Lead technical aspects of contract negotiation, presentations, and meetings.
  • Assist with the preparation of an annual update to business tactical action plans within the specified area.
  • Ensure that planning discipline certifications, accreditations, and value proposition is developed and continuously improved.
  • Conduct needs analyses and client value surveys to align the planning discipline’s function with business and project strategy, identifying and addressing any skill gaps or risks within the sector business operations.
  • Schedule planning discipline meetings, providing updates and recommendations to ensure that all reasonable and proper measures are taken to inculcate discipline expertise and innovation into project work.
