title: Diagnostic Radiological Technologist - Computed Tomography Angio
description:
This position is eligible for the Education Debt Reduction Program (EDRP), a student loan payment reimbursement program. You must meet specific eligibility requirements per VHA policy and submit your EDRP application within four months of appointment. Program Approval, award amount (up to $200,000) & eligibility period (one to five years) are determined by the VHA Education Loan Repayment Services program office after review of the EDRP application. Former EDRP participants ineligible to apply.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional The Diagnostic Radiologic Technologist (Computed Tomography) performs routine to moderately complex radiographic examination procedures. These exams are achieved by using diagnostic x-ray equipment such as fluoroscopic units and general diagnostic units. Performs computerized tomography of the head, neck spine, chest and body. These exams are performed with and without the use of contrast materials. The purpose of these exams is to achieve diagnostic studies to bring about proper diagnosis and treatment. For this grade level a minimum of 25% (10hrs) is spent working as a CT technologist. The duties associated with this position include but are not limited to the following: Schedules exams in a manner to optimize scanner times while maintaining flexibility for emergency cases. This requires the ability to prioritize scheduled patients as well as the ability to accommodate the emergency patient who may need immediate emergency surgery, etc. Confers with radiologists to determine requirement of non-standard exams. Determines technical factors, positioning, number, and thickness of scans, etc., to produce and satisfy requirements of CT scanning. Schedules patients for examinations. Notifies them of scans requiring their immediate attention. Performs CT angiography; including run-offs and pulmonary embolus studies. These studies require the use of power injectors and reconstruction of images post image acquisition. Performs CT biopsies utilizing surgical sterile techniques. Prepares contrast materials that are used in CT. Performs quality control on the CT scanner as required. Records contrast warmer temperature daily. Checks crash cart at beginning of shift. Performs reconstructions of CT studies when requested or when part of a standard procedure. Maintains records and files of exams performed on patients. This includes the maintenance of patient log registration and editing of patient exams in the computerized information system. Properly identifies patient images. Responsible to explain exams to competent patients so that patients understand what is to be done as well as any adverse reactions, if any, are possible. Responsible for stocking and inventory of all CT supplies and related materials. Must report equipment malfunctions in a timely manner to the supervisor and enter an electronic work order to Biomedical Engineering for repair. Performs irregular hour emergency scans on-call; when necessary. Requires the technologist be available within 45 minutes from receipt of call so that proper and effective emergency care can be given to the patient. May be required to perform diagnostic radiographic examinations. Continually reviews new developments in the field of computerized tomography. Is continually on the alert to improve quality of exams utilizing the new technologies available. The purpose of this review is to provide the patients with the best possible scans for diagnostic purposes. Other duties as assigned Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:00am - 4:30pm Supervisor's discretion. EDRP Authorized: Former EDRP participants ineligible to apply for incentive. Contact Joe.CamarenaContreras@va.gov, the EDRP Coordinator for questions/assistance. Learn more. Pay: Competitive salary and regular salary increases. Paid Time Off: 37-50 days of annual paid time offer per year (13-26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year)Selected applicants may qualify for credit toward annual leave accrual, based on prior [work experience] or military service experience. Parental Leave: After 12 months of employment, up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave in connection with the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of a child. Child Care Subsidy: After 60 days of employment, full time employees with a total family income below $144,000 may be eligible for a childcare subsidy up to 25% of total eligible childcare costs for eligible children up to the monthly maximum of $416.66. Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA. Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement). Telework: Not authorized. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Functional Statement #: 00554F

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job. All applicants tentatively selected for VA employment in a testing designated position are subject to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Applicants who refuse to be tested will be denied employment with VA. Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959. Must be proficient in written and spoken English. Subject to background/security investigation. Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. Must pass pre-employment physical examination. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP). Complete all application requirements detailed in the "Required Documents" section of this announcement. As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1 or 2-year trial period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your trial period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

title: Global Datacenter Engineering Senior Director, Operations Engineering
description:
Overview

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO&I) is the team behind the cloud. Within CO&I, the Datacenter Engineering (DCE) team is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

The Global Datacenter Engineering Senior Director, Operations Engineering is responsible for the leadership, governance, and execution of the TechEx operations engineering team and associated activities across the global portfolio. This leader provides oversight of complex engineering issues impacting operational facilities, drives enterprise-wide reliability initiatives, and leads the planning and execution of major retrofit and infrastructure modernization programs. The successful candidate will possess deep technical expertise across all aspects of data center operations, including construction permitting, building shell and core engineering, and the delivery of power, cooling, telecommunications, and controls infrastructure.

The role serves as the primary authority for operational engineering standards, engineering risk management, and technical remediation efforts. The position partners closely with regional operations teams, design and construction organizations, and executive leadership to ensure safe, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective operations across the portfolio.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Provides strategic leadership, governance, and oversight for all global operational engineering activities, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational excellence, and long-term infrastructure strategy.
  • Serves as the senior technical authority for operational engineering, leveraging deep industry expertise to guide decision-making, resolve complex engineering challenges, and mitigate operational risks across the global portfolio.
  • Leads the development and execution of major retrofit, infrastructure modernization, and asset replacement programs, including portfolio prioritization, business case development, risk management, and delivery governance.
  • Develops emergency operating procedures (EOPs) and governance.
  • Reviews critical technical documents and sequences of operation.
  • Provides training of site operations on new facility designs and sequences of operation.
  • Acts as the primary escalation point for significant engineering incidents, reliability concerns, and infrastructure failures, driving root cause analysis and implementation of sustainable corrective actions.
  • Fosters strong cross-functional partnerships with operational, technical, and business leaders to drive collaboration, stakeholder alignment, and successful program execution in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Leads, develops, and mentors a globally distributed team of engineering leaders and subject matter experts, building organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, accountability, and performance management.
  • Promotes a culture of innovation, ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the engineering organization.
  • Embody our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in datacenter or critical environment mechanical engineering, product/technical program management, OR equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years people management experience.

  • 6+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

Other Requirements
  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 15+ years experience in datacenter or critical environment mechanical engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.

  • 6+ years people management experience.

  • 10+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) registration or equivalent professional certification in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.

  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale retrofit, modernization, or infrastructure renewal programs.

  • Experience supporting global operations and geographically distributed teams.

  • Strong experience with the operation and maintenance of building electrical systems (power distribution, lighting, grounding, fire alarm, security, life safety, and controls systems)

  • Solid understanding of critical datacenter or equivalent high-tech CE equipment

  • Knowledge of construction techniques, terminology, and documentation (ability to interpret blueprints, electrical one-lines, construction drawings etc.)

  • Practical experience with automation and control systems

  • Fundamental understanding of the International Building Codes

title: Environmental Protection Specialist
description:
This position serves as a senior Environmental Protection Specialist who applies experience and comprehensive technical knowledge to accomplish assignments and to develop strategies to improve environmental programs and policies. Incumbent reports to the Technical Operations, Technical Services Organization, Environmental Occupational Safety and Health (EOSH) Support Operations Group (ESOG), EOSH Support Center.

Performs multiple, varying and complex work assignments under the minimal direction of a Manager, Project/Program Manager or more experienced Technical Specialist. Acts as principal technical specialist or as a Project Manager or Team Leader for large work activities. Applies experience and comprehensive technical knowledge applicable to position discipline, as well as an understanding of new technologies and methodologies, to solve complex problems and develop improved technical processes or systems. Considers the objectives of the major subdivision and LOB/SO when developing, integrating, and implementing solutions to diverse, complex problems. Assignments frequently require knowledge and experience working across functional and/or organizational lines. Typical assignments may include: complex system design and integration; extensive research and analyses; investigation and inspection activities; compliance and enforcement actions; and direct responsibility for project/program management. Defines, organizes and assigns resources to accomplish organizational objectives. Allocates resources to accomplish large work-activities within established schedules. Prepares task orders, work statements, and other documents necessary to procure contractual services for environmental programs/compliance projects. Utilizes agency established tool sets to establish, track, and report on schedules, costs, and performance of environmental programs/compliance projects. Translates approved environmental program requirements into project scopes and coordinates project execution with implementing organizations. Plays a lead role in drafting, reviewing, and editing reports or contractual documents for final approval prior to external distribution. Presents briefings to obtain consensus/approval on policies. Coordinates significant technical matters with representatives of external organizations. Broad policies and objectives provide general guidance for addressing issues but allow considerable discretion to develop new and innovative approaches. Draws on experience to solve unusual problems and may create new solutions and policy interpretations as the situation requires. Provides guidance to lower-level staff on how to solve difficult technical issues. Develops plans, techniques, and policies to address current or anticipated problems and issues. Work is reviewed rarely, typically through status reports and at project completion, to ensure technical compliance and alignment with the requirements of the project or other work activity. Work activities typically impact objectives of one or more major subdivisions or LOB's/SO's and may impact on the objectives of the FAA. Acts as a senior technical point of contact on environmental issues. Utilizes skill and judgment in determining the seriousness of potential impacts on the human environment, in analyzing these impacts, in recommending solutions, and negotiating their implementation in a feasible manner will directly influence the environmental programs within the Service Area and the functioning of the EOSH facility security team. Possess a high degree of technical analytic competence in various environmental disciplines and recommends environmental policies for the Service Area. The incumbent is responsible for review and coordination of environmental documents submitted by other federal and state agencies for FAA action and is the Technical Services Senior Technical spokesperson on any joint federal environmental efforts mandated by regulation, either in a lead or cooperating capacity. Provides leadership to maintain an active program to study and ameliorate the impacts of airports on the human environment. The incumbent is expected to exercise multi-disciplinary expertise, innovation, a high degree of judgment, and personal initiative to define airport problems and to resolve them. Performs other duties as assigned.

title: Patient Services Representative III - GVHP GI (Temporary, Day)
description:
At Northbay Health, the Patient Services Representative III is responsible for scheduling surgeries and referrals, in coordination with the care team. They also promptly assist patients with their financial clearance prior to, during, or after their treatment period. This position is responsible for obtaining and updating insurance, financial, and demographic information. Courteously and professionally helps patients and/or their families understand and assist with options to cover their financial obligations including but not limited to: co-pays, deductibles, and co-insurance. Responsible for establishing payment plans and collecting true self-pay and self-pay residual balances as necessary. Responsible for assisting patients with ad-hoc financial issues as needed prior to, during and following their treatment.

Offers financial advice and assistance to patients regarding medical bills. They are the liaison between patients and their insurance companies; often coordinating payments and answering questions from both parties. Their job is to handle financial obligations so that patients and physicians can focus on healthcare.

Primary Job Duties

  1. May provide cost estimates for outpatient and inpatient care.
  2. Educate patients about payment options and financial assistance.
  3. Negotiates and strategize patient payment arrangements.
  4. Update patient accounts and balances.
  5. Review and process patient and insurance company forms.
  6. Communicate with patients, insurance company, Ambulatory Surgery Center Scheduler, and OR
  7. Scheduler on the phone.
  8. Coordinates with surgeons care to in scheduling elective and non-elective surgeries in the Ambulatory Surgery Center & OR.
  9. Informs and/or updates supervisory personnel of any patient billing concerns.
  10. Answers all patient billing questions and works with ambulatory accounting or insurance companies to correct patient billing errors.
  11. Communicates and collaborates with other departments to provide continuity of care across departments and disciplines.
  12. Assists PSRs with their workload, and gives support as needed.
  13. Schedules referrals for orthopedic providers in clinic.
  14. Consistently demonstrates and promotes a sense of team within the immediate and extended work groups, and maintains effective communication with all external and internal customers.
  15. Works on special projects and/or interdisciplinary committees as assigned.
  16. Other duties as assigned.
  1. Education: High School graduate preferred. Associate Degree or Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  2. Experience: Minimum of two year’s of experience in a medical front office setting with experience and knowledge of health insurance/ benefit requirements required. Two years’ experience working with medical insurance plans. Two more years’ experience working with referrals/consult processes in the ambulatory care setting.
  3. Skills: Excellent customer service skills, and comprehensive knowledge & understanding of workflow and processes in the revenue cycle environment. Excellent analytical and project management skills. Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously and manage deadlines. Must possess good organizational skills, work independently, and prioritize multiple projects and objectives in a rapidly changing environment. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, relate cordially with co-workers, members, providers and others. Download and save reports in Excel, and sort reports by name, date or in descending dollar order, when taking calls from patients, providers or payers, the representative needs the ability to determine the necessary action to take, such as the appropriate questions to ask, or determining the research necessary to answer questions. Knowledge of medical terminology, CPT, ICD-10-CM, and Revenue Codes, Medicare guidelines and regulations, billing and follow-up practices, billing requirements for all payer types, managed care terminology (capitation, PPO, stop loss, etc.), Cerner, Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  4. Standards of Performance: Demonstrate performance by adhering to established policies and procedures and exhibiting the defined characteristics associated with attendance and punctuality.
  5. Physical Effort: Attendance is an essential function of the job. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Minimal: Requires prolonged hours of standing and sitting and some walking. Requires extensive use of telephone and computer keyboard. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  6. Hours of Work: Based on business need.

title: Senior Agricultural Liaison Officer
description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

WSP’s Land team is seeking talented Land professionals to join what is already the largest and most successful team in our industry. This is an exciting opportunity to develop or begin a career with a team that enjoys a successful reputation for the successful delivery of major strategic infrastructure projects across the UK and Ireland through the support provided by land referencing, urban and rural landowner engagement, consultation management, land access, formal consents, statutory orders, compensation agreements and land acquisition. Apply and come and discuss the contributions you can make in the delivery of the widest portfolio of projects across all sectors in the UK and Ireland.

In today’s world it’s important to work for a company that has clear purpose, giving back to communities and supporting what is truly important in the world.

When considering a career move it’s vital to work for a business that is aligned to your values and goals, a place where you can belong. See what WSP stands for in 2026 and beyond…

We offer flexible working patterns, competitive salaries and other benefits.

To find out more about our Land business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at WSP: Land referencing and land assembly | WSP

About Land Referencing

We are the largest and most successful Land business supporting infrastructure development in the UK and Ireland, with 300+ specialist professional colleagues consisting of land consultants, property specialists, project managers and utility and topographical surveyors. We have the widest portfolio of projects available in our industry, offering unrivalled opportunities to both develop and diversify careers, working on some of the most exciting and challenging projects across the whole of the UK and Ireland.

Our clients rely on us to deliver the essential land elements of their infrastructure projects and we enjoy a hard-earned reputation of success. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of this success, delivering land referencing, land acquisition, land access, formal consents, statutory orders and landowner engagement across all infrastructure sectors and make a positive impact on economy and communities these projects serve.

Our land referencing professionals, identify land and legal interest in land and use this data to secure powers and/or negotiate land acquisition and land access to support infrastructure development. We provide clients with all the land-related statutory documentation the need to comply with planning processes as they develop, plan, securing and exercise powers to construct, operate and maintain their infrastructure assets. Using the land referencing data, we ensure projects not just comply with legislation but also fulfil their data security obligations, engage meaningfully with landowners and other affected stakeholders, and maximize their benefits of the landed data we provide throughout project lifecycle, ultimately registering the new rights in the name of the client.

Our Energy projects are critical for the deployment of renewable energy and helping the economy to achieve net zero carbon emissions. We support a range of energy generation (nuclear and renewable) and transmission and distribution projects across the UK and Ireland, including distribution and carbon capture.

WSP Land has a 30+ year history of supporting major Rail projects including the Channel Tunnel Rail Link (CTRL or HS1); Central Railway; the Thameslink Programme, the first major Transport & Works Act project; West Coast Mainline Four Tracking; HS2 Phases 1, 2a and 2b; TransPennine Route Upgrade (TRU) and East West Rail (EWR). Our track record also includes successes in light rail and metro schemes including Manchester Metrolink, Nottingham Express Transit, Edinburgh Tram, Luton Translink and the current Dublin MetroLink project, Ireland’s largest ever infrastructure project.

Job Description – Senior Agricultural Liaison Officer

  • Provide expertise and support on agricultural and land management to facilitate access, way leaving and possession of land
  • Advise on agricultural tenancies
  • Secure land rights for high profile, strategic infrastructure projects across the UK and Ireland
  • Utilising statutory powers and other available mechanisms to acquire land (Vesting Order, CPO) on behalf of WSP clients within the electricity sector, but also highway, rail, water, telecoms, gas and renewable energy sectors
  • Negotiate commercial terms, option agreements and other land related agreements
  • Work closely with the Land team and collaborate with engineering, environmental, and planning teams
  • Organise and attend site visit meetings with landowners, their agents, legal teams and other stakeholders and provide meeting records for upload to a landowner and stakeholder communications database
  • Regular communication with landowners and their agents to manage and build positive working relationships for the successful delivery of projects
  • Liaise with landowners, land agents, legal representatives, planning authorities, key stakeholders, contractors and clients
  • Landowner dispute resolution
  • Attend weekly/monthly project meetings and provide updates to project stakeholders
  • Report progress to clients regularly ensuring client satisfaction and expectations are met
  • Prepare and check consenting documentation
  • Experience working on infrastructure, utilities, or energy projects (preferred)
  • Skilled in stakeholder engagement, building trust and maintaining positive relationships
  • Ensuring that WSP H&S procedures are adhered to for all site work
  • Knowledge of land access permissions, land access, s172s licences and site safety experience (preferred)
  • Preparation and quality assurance of technical documents in relation to the identification of land interests and rights, negotiation of access to land for surveys, consents and acquisition of land rights
  • Negotiation of Heads of Terms to secure land for projects.
  • Advise clients on compliance with statutory and industry best practice
  • Support the sharing of knowledge and lessons across regions and projects
  • Lead on quality assurance of deliverables and drive and promote innovation within team to improve working practices
  • Lead on and contribute to business development and client relationship management

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate

  • Degree or equivalent experience in Geography, Land/Estate Management, Agriculture or a relevant discipline
  • Worked to deliver land referencing, land access, landowner engagement services and statutory processes on major infrastructure projects
  • Experience of negotiating with landowners and knowledge of the legal process for the acquisition of wayleaves/easements/servitudes desirable
  • Experience working with multi-disciplinary teams across a range of sectors and locations across the UK and/or Ireland
  • Demonstrable experience of reducing land risk for clients and advising them on land related matters throughout all stages of a project lifecycle
  • Ability to communicate effectively with strong influencing and negotiating skills

  • Strong landowner and public engagement skills

  • Knowledge of the urban and/or rural environment and farming practices would be highly desirable

  • Chartership or membership or a professional body would be advantageous
  • The ability to travel effectively to various sites/locations is a necessary function of this role
  • Ability to travel to site and remote locations

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Location

As part of WSP Land you will enjoy the support of your multi-disciplinary colleagues in our Dublin, Naas, Belfast and wider offices throughout the UK and well as in India

We support high-profile infrastructure projects across the whole of the island of Ireland such as Dublin Metrolink, the largest infrastructure project in the history of Ireland; the North South Interconnector; NM20; M17 and A5, as well as other projects. Many of our Energy projects are critical for the deployment of renewable energy, helping the Ireland economy to achieve net zero carbon emissions, and we support emerging rail, water, highways and other projects that represent investment in Ireland’s future.

The role can be based in one of WSP’s many offices across the UK and Ireland including with the flexibility of hybrid working between one of these locations and from home.


Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.
#L1-JC2

Tehtävä on tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava (0-112,5 h /3vk). Työvuoroja on tarjolla tilanteen ja tarpeen mukaan. Työvuorot painottuvat arkeen klo 6-15 välille, mutta myös muut työajat klo 5-21 välillä sekä viikonloppuvuorot ovat mahdollisia. title: TITLE 32 ELECTRONICS TECHNICIAN (MI CRTC)
description:

title: Hakkuukoneenkuljettaja, vakituinen, SODANKYLÄ
description:
Etsimme ammattitaitoista hakkuukoneenkuljettajaa Sodankylään vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme Epassin.
Työmaat ovat Sodankylä - Kittilä - Savukoski alueella. Työtä tehdään päivä- ja yövuorossa. Voit itse vaikuttaa vuorojen pituuteen.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Hallitset kokonaisvaltaisesti kaikki hakekuskin tehtävät aina ajosta kuormaukseen, purkuun ja kaluston huoltoon.

* CE-ajokorttia, voimassa olevaa ammattipätevyyttä ja kuljettajakorttia.

* Kokemusta yhdistelmäajoneuvon kuljettamisesta vaihtelevissa ja vaativissa olosuhteissa.

* Varmaa otetta kuormaus- ja purkulaitteistojen käyttöön sekä kuorman sitomiseen ja peittämiseen.

* Valmiutta kaluston päivittäisiin tarkastuksiin ja pikkuhuoltoihin.

* Oma-aloitteisuutta, täsmällisyyttä ja hyvää yhteistyökykyä.

Tässä tehtävässä noudatetaan Metsäalan työehtosopimusta. Palkka on tessin mukaan vähintään 12,93 € / h, riippuen kokemuksestasi.

Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!


---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Vesitalousasiantuntija, vesistöhankkeiden edistäminen, eteläinen vesistöyksikkö
description:

Tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti vesitalouden asiantuntijatehtäviä. Tehtävänhaltijan päätehtävät ovat:
- Rakennettuihin vesiin liittyvien kunnostushankkeiden sekä valuma-alueiden vesienhallintahankkeiden edistäminen ja ohjaus yhteistyössä muiden toimijoiden kanssa Kanta-Hämeen ja Pirkanmaan alueilla.
- Valtion vastuulla oleviin vesistörakenteisiin liittyvien vesistökunnostushankkeiden suunnitteluttaminen ja rakennuttaminen Kanta-Hämeen ja Pirkanmaan alueilla.
- Vesitalousasioihin liittyvän luonnonvaratiedon tuottaminen ja siihen liittyvä viestintä.

Työssä on tärkeä yhteensovittaa vesienkäytön intressejä kuten tulvasuojelu, vesivoiman tuotanto, vesienhoito, kalatalous ja virkistyskäyttö sekä ottaa huomioon ilmastonmuutos. Tehtävän hoidossa pääsee verkostoitumaan laajasti muun hallinnon ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

title: Executive - Ocean Import Operations - Freight Forwarding
description:
Ocean Import Operations
- Manage end-to-end ocean import shipments from pre-alert receipt to final delivery.
- Coordinate with overseas agents, shipping lines, customs brokers, transporters, and internal teams.
- Monitor shipment milestones, vessel arrivals, documentation, and delivery timelines.
- Ensure timely filing of Import General Manifest (IGM), Bill of Entry coordination, and other relevant documentation.
- Track and resolve shipment delays, documentation discrepancies, and operational exceptions.


Documentation & Compliance
- Verify shipping documents, including Bills of Lading, invoices, packing lists, and arrival notices.
- Ensure compliance with customs regulations, statutory requirements, and internal SOPs.
- Coordinate customs clearance and ensure timely submission of required documents.
- Monitor detention, demurrage, and other avoidable shipment-related costs.


Customer & Stakeholder Management
- Provide timely shipment updates and proactively address customer queries.
- Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure smooth cargo movement.
- Maintain accurate shipment records and ensure timely closure of operational activities.


Performance & Process Management
- Meet defined operational KPIs, customer SLAs, and productivity targets.
- Ensure accurate and timely system updates, billing inputs, and shipment documentation.
- Identify process gaps and support continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Physical Scientist
description:
You will serve as a Physical Scientist with United States Geological Survey in the Earthquake Science Center for the ShakeAlert Earthquake Early Warning (EEW) system. Participation in 24/7 on-call duty response rotations is required. On call for 7 days at a time, including nights and weekends. Salary Moffett Field, CA: $111,896 (Step 01) to $145,468 (Step 10) Seattle, WA: $100,602 (Step 01) to $130,786 (Step 10) First time hires to the Federal government normally start at the step 1 rate.

As a Physical Scientist your duties will include but are not limited to the following: Serves in a leadership role for the ShakeAlert Communication, Education, Outreach, and Technical Engagement (CEO&TE) community comprised of officials in federal, state, and local agencies and collaborates in developing and implementing long-term, integrated public ShakeAlert CEO&TE protocols and plans to maximize the effectiveness of ShakeAlert's capability. Conveys complex scientific and technical information about earthquake hazards and the ShakeAlert system and its uses to non-technical audiences. Collaborates with the CEO&TE Coordinator to execute long range strategic planning efforts related to CEO&TE scope and overall content relative to the ShakeAlert system goals and those of the USGS Earthquake Hazards Program. Develops and implements new methods and products for dissemination of educational materials in a manner that is multidisciplinary, cost effective, and consistent with existing hazards education efforts. This includes having a direct role in developing and curating the ShakeAlert web and social media presence. Plans, facilitates, and coordinates working groups, meetings, workshops, and other stakeholder interactions as directed by the CEO&TE Coordinator.

title: Ajanvaraaja - tule viemään rekrytoinnin ilosanomaa yrityksille!
description:
AJANVARAAJA - TULE VIEMÄÄN REKRYTOINNIN ILOSANOMAA YRITYKSILLE!

Tykkäätkö jutella ihmisille, uskallat tarttua puhelimeen ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa kasvua? Meillä voisi olla sinulle sopiva paikka!

Rekry Group Oy etsii joukkoonsa tavoitteellista ja reipasta ajanvaraajaa, jonka tehtävänä on avata ovia uusille asiakkuuksille ja sopia tapaamisia asiantuntijoillemme.

Me uskomme, että oikeat ihmiset ovat yritysten tärkein voimavara. Siksi haluamme auttaa yrityksiä löytämään parhaat tekijät niin henkilöstövuokrauksen kuin suorarekrytoinninkin avulla. Meiltä löytyy toimialaosaamista, kokemusta ja ratkaisuja erilaisiin henkilöstötarpeisiin – ja nyt etsimme henkilöä, joka vie tätä ilosanomaa eteenpäin!

Mitä työ käytännössä tarkoittaa?

Työsi keskiössä ovat puhelut yrityspäättäjille ja uusien keskusteluyhteyksien avaaminen. Kerrot lyhyesti Rekry Groupin palveluista ja osaamisesta sekä herätät kiinnostuksen siihen, miten voimme auttaa yrityksiä niiden rekrytointi- ja henkilöstötarpeissa.

Tärkein tavoitteesi on sopia tapaamisia asiantuntijoillemme, jotka pääsevät jatkamaan keskustelua asiakkaan kanssa ja kartoittamaan sopivia ratkaisuja.

* Otat yhteyttä potentiaalisiin yritysasiakkaisiin.

* Kerrot Rekry Groupin henkilöstövuokrauksen ja suorarekrytoinnin palveluista.

* Tunnistat mahdollisuuksia uusien asiakkuuksien avaamiseen.

* Sovit tapaamisia asiantuntijoillemme.

* Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myyntimme kanssa ja autat meitä löytämään uusia asiakkaita.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Sinun ei tarvitse olla rekrytointialan asiantuntija – siihen meiltä löytyy osaamista. Me etsimme ennen kaikkea hyvää tyyppiä, jolla on oikea asenne ja halu onnistua.

* Rohkeutta tarttua puhelimeen ja ottaa yhteyttä uusiin ihmisiin.

* Luontevaa keskustelutaitoa ja kykyä herättää kiinnostusta.

* Tavoitteellista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta.

* Sinnikkyyttä ja positiivista asennetta myös silloin, kun jokainen puhelu ei johda tapaamiseen.

* Halua oppia ja kehittyä.

Aiempi kokemus ajanvarauksesta, puhelintyöstä tai B2B-myynnistä on plussaa, mutta asenne ratkaisee.

Mitä me tarjoamme?

* Merkityksellisen roolin uusasiakashankintamme tukena.

* Mahdollisuuden tutustua rekrytoinnin ja henkilöstöpalveluiden maailmaan.

* Asiantuntijoiden tuen ja perehdytyksen tehtävään.

* Selkeät tavoitteet ja mahdollisuuden nähdä oman työsi tulokset.

* Mahdollisuuden kehittyä myynnin ja asiakastyön osaajana osana kasvavaa liiketoimintaa.

* Hybridi työskentelymallin perehdytyksen jälkeen.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tykkäät keskustella ihmisten kanssa, uskallat avata uusia ovia ja haluat auttaa yrityksiä löytämään oikeat tekijät, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Palkka muodostuu kiinteästä pohjapalkasta ja tuloksiin perustuvasta provisiosta. Tavoitteiden mukaisella tekemisellä kokonaisansio on noin 2 500–3 500 euroa kuukaudessa.

Meillä oma tekemisesi näkyy tuloksissa, ja onnistumiselle on selkeät tavoitteet. Etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa kehittyä, saavuttaa tavoitteensa ja päästä vaikuttamaan omaan ansaintaansa.

Laita hakemusta tulemaan ja kerro meille, miksi juuri sinä olisit oikea henkilö viemään Rekry Groupin ilosanomaa yrityksille!

Jos heräsi kysymyksiä, kilauttele Teemu Takulle, puh. 0449741551

REKRY GROUP OY / EIKÄ TÖISSÄ VIELÄ KAIKKI

Inhimillisyys, tasa-arvo ja toisten kunnioittaminen ovat meille tärkeitä arvoja. Meillä saat olla
juuri se kuka olet.

Rekry Group Oy on henkilöstövuokraukseen ja suorarekrytointeihin sekä rekrymarkkinointiin
keskittynyt palveluyritys. Toimintamme kulmakiviä on paikallisuus, positiivisuus, aktiivisuus,
tavoitettavuus, nopeus, helppous ja luotettavuus.

Keskeistä toiminnassamme on tehokas ja luotettava rekrytointiprosessi sekä vahva osaaminen
markkinoinnista. Olemme sitoutuneet kohtelemaan jokaista työnhakijaa sekä -tekijää
yhdenvertaisesti ja syrjimättä.

title: Administrative Officer
description:
The Administrative Officer is located within the Primary Care Service Line at the Syracuse VA. The primary purpose is to provide direct support to the Primary Care Service Line Chief and the services under Primary Care Service Line umbrella (including Whole Health), the Staff and programs associated with the Primary Care Service Line, in assuring that goals and objectives are being accomplished and performance measures are met.

Major Duties: Responsibilities include budget management, productivity improvement, management controls, and short and long-range planning. The purpose is to provide both effective and efficient delivery of services to patients seen in this health care system. Incumbent develops, maintains, and implements a comprehensive business plan for the Primary Care Line in accordance with the philosophies of the Medical Center and the mission of the Department of Veterans Affairs. Administrative Responsibilities: (65%) The incumbent is integral to all resource allocations decisions involving resources which take into consideration FTE ceiling, hours of duty, salary budget, supply budget, equipment budget, space utilization, maintenance contracts, etc. Paramount to this responsibility is ensuring effective and efficient personnel and position management. This includes analyzing and measuring the resource needs of the patient centered care team organization and making recommendations based upon: non-physician staffing needs, physician staffing needs, approving individual expenditures for all non-recurring items, approving all requests for funding above budgeted levels, preparing funding and staffing requests, and managing capital assets including MCA labor mapping and related reporting requirements. The incumbent is responsible for managing the Emergency Department and attendance in accordance with the Office of Academic (OAA) guidelines. The incumbent is also responsible for ensuring that the on-call information is entered in AMION and that it is kept up to date. The incumbent must have the ability to extract both real time information from Syracuse VA and VISN 2 databases and current and past performance data from local, national and other data sources (e.g., VistA, CPRS, VSSC). Local, VISN and VA National report requirements (e.g., budget, workload, staffing, productivity, person class, etc.) and assignments are completed, and deadlines met in a timely and qualitative manner. Incumbent works to ensure monitoring budgetary activities including contracts. This includes development and maintenance of tracking systems for expenditures and contract concerns. Serves as the technical expert regarding operational problems and personnel administrative issues. This includes responsibility for reviewing and approving organizational changes, position descriptions and performance standards. Staff Assistant Responsibilities: (35%) Conducts periodic administrative reviews of Clinical Privileges for Physicians and professional staff, consistent with VACO and Joint Commission criteria. Ensures maintenance of assignment and attendance records for contract staff, Title 38, Hybrid 38, and Title V staff. Incumbent coordinates the OPPE/FPPE reviews and ensures their timely and accurate completion. The incumbent ensures that the nine dimensions of quality (acceptability, access, appropriateness, continuity, effectiveness, efficiency, safety and timeliness) and High Reliability (HRO) principles are integral in the daily operations and planning efforts. Performs other duties as assigned. Work Schedule: 0730-1600 (M-F) Telework: AD-Hoc only Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Position Description/PD#: Administrative Officer/PD21W14O Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized

Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP) As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your probationary period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

title: Permittivity Standard Reference Instrument Engineer
company: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description:
NIST is seeking an Electronics Engineer to advance precision microwave measurements and develop traceable methods and standards for complex permittivity supporting next-generation electronics and communications. You will design and analyze measurement systems, develop new calibration methods, and collaborate with industry and the scientific community. This notice is issued under direct-hire authority to recruit new talent to occupations for which NIST has a severe shortage of candidates.

NIST is seeking an Electronics Engineer to advance measurement science for next-generation microwave and millimeter-wave technologies. If selected you will: Develop permittivity Standard Reference Materials with limited supervision. Plan, design, and execute complex experiments to establish permittivity traceability using electromagnetic and waveguide circuit theory. Evaluate sources of uncertainty and develop new methods, approaches, and procedures in collaboration with coworkers and technical advisors. Conduct difficult and complex scientific assignments, applying sound judgment to research, interpret, adapt, and apply theoretical principles, technical guidance, and available precedents to microwave calibrations and the integration of commercial and custom analysis software. Contribute to the planning, execution, and direction of major scientific, mathematical, engineering, or information technology projects, and communicate technical concepts, findings, and recommendations clearly and effectively to a variety of audiences.

title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana omassa kodissa, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Lahteen. Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla. Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava tulo on keskimäärin noin 3000 € / kk, kun sinulla on neljä hoitolasta ja sinulle kertyy vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpielämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta (kasvatusalan ammattitutkinto, lähihoitaja, sosionomi, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja)
* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia
* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja
* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Valmiin Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitokonseptin, joka on jo usean yrittäjämme toimesta todettu toimivaksi. Konsepti sisältää kaiken tarvittavan menestyneen perhepäivähoidon pyörittämiseen.
* Kaiken tarvittavan avun yrityksen perustamiseen ja pyörittämiseen. Kaikki on valmiiksi mietitty ja selvitetty puolestasi. Koulutuksemme ja ketjun jatkuva tuki varmistaa, ettet koskaan jää talousasioiden kanssa yksin.
* Ihanan Kultapalat-yhteisön, jossa pääset vaihtamaan ajatuksia muiden Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajien kanssa.




Hae rohkeasti mukaan, tässä porukassa on kivaa sekä aikuisilla että lapsilla!

title: Data Scientist
description:
Location: XenonStack office, Sector 75, STPI, Mohali (Chandigarh Tricity), work from office
Experience: 3–6 years | Employment: Full time, XenonStack Private Limited | Team: AI / Machine Learning / Data Science

ABOUT XENONSTACK

XenonStack is a Data and AI Foundry for Agentic Systems, enabling enterprises to design, deploy, operate, and scale intelligent agents across digital and physical environments. We build enterprise-grade platforms across the agentic stack:

  • Akira AI – Reasoning and agent orchestration.
  • ElixirData – Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes.
  • NexaStack – Agentic infrastructure automation. Secure, compliant AI deployment across cloud, edge, and on-prem.
  • MetaSecure – Trust, compliance and defense. Continuous assurance with AI-BOMs, risk scoring, and agentic security.

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI + Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise-ready.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong expertise in statistical analysis, machine learning, predictive modelling and Python. You will build end-to-end data science solutions on real-world data and turn business problems into measurable, data-driven outcomes, working with data engineers, AI/ML engineers, software developers and business stakeholders to design, evaluate and operationalise machine learning models.

ROLE MISSION

Own data science problems end to end: pick the right approach, prove it against a baseline, ship it into a product or workflow, and show the business value it delivers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyse complex structured and unstructured datasets to find patterns, trends and business opportunities.
  • Build machine learning models for classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection and recommendation.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, data preprocessing and feature selection.
  • Apply statistical techniques: hypothesis testing, probability distributions, regression analysis and experimentation.
  • Select, train, tune, validate and benchmark algorithms against appropriate baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Build reusable Python data science components and reproducible modelling pipelines.
  • Work with engineering teams to integrate models into applications through APIs or batch workflows.
  • Evaluate model accuracy, reliability, interpretability and performance on real-world data; monitor behaviour and contribute to retraining and drift analysis.
  • Research and evaluate emerging ML, deep learning and Generative AI techniques for relevant business problems.
  • Communicate findings, technical trade-offs and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.

HOW WE WORK WITH AI

AI is part of the daily workflow at XenonStack, not an add-on.

  • At our Mohali/Chandigarh office, AI tools are open for use: coding assistance, analysis, experiment design, documentation and research.
  • When working on a client's data or environment, you follow the client's compliance and information security policy: use only client-approved tools, and never put client data, code, credentials or configurations into any tool the client has not approved.
  • Every AI-assisted output is reviewed, tested and understood by you before it is relied on or shipped.
  • Come ready to talk about what is in your AI stack, how you verify its output, and how you keep it compliant.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Models that beat a clear baseline on agreed metrics and hold up on real-world data.
  • Pipelines that are reproducible: anyone on the team can retrain and get the same result.
  • Models integrated into products or workflows, with monitoring for drift and performance.
  • Stakeholders who understand what a model does, how well it works, and what value it delivered.

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

  • Python and data: strong hands-on Python; NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn and visualisation libraries; strong SQL (joins, aggregations, CTEs, analytical queries); handling missing values, outliers, imbalanced and large datasets.
  • Statistics and mathematics: probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimisation; hypothesis testing, significance, confidence intervals and regression analysis.
  • Machine learning: supervised and unsupervised learning; regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting and clustering; time-series forecasting; feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, model selection and cross-validation; overfitting, regularisation, data leakage and generalisation; metrics such as precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, MAE, RMSE and R².
  • Software engineering and production: reusable, maintainable Python; Git and unit testing; model integration through REST APIs; exposure to deploying, maintaining or monitoring models in production.

GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS

  • PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • NLP, transformers, embeddings and Large Language Models
  • Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) or LLM evaluation
  • Recommendation systems or advanced anomaly detection
  • Geospatial and route/location data (GeoPandas, PostGIS, OR-Tools)
  • Optimisation techniques: resource allocation and scheduling
  • MLOps: MLflow, Docker, CI/CD
  • Apache Spark, PySpark, Databricks or distributed data processing
  • Cloud ML platforms on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
  • Model explainability, bias assessment, drift monitoring and responsible AI practices

CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or Applied AI, with proven hands-on model development and validation in Python.
  • End-to-end project experience, from problem definition and data preparation to evaluation and integration; at least one substantial ML project delivered for a real-world use case, preferably in production.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a related quantitative field; a relevant Master's is an advantage. Demonstrated competence and project work count alongside formal qualifications.
  • Strong analytical thinking, clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently and across engineering and business teams.
  • Curiosity, continuous learning, and care for model quality and reproducibility.

We value people who show real ownership of data science problems rather than applying prebuilt algorithms. Be ready to explain why you chose a model, how you evaluated it, what went wrong with the data, and how your solution delivered measurable business value.

HIRING PROCESS

Pre-screening assessment (about 10 minutes, at application) → Technical interview → Face-to-face technical assessment at our Mohali office → HR and Leadership round → Background verification → Offer.

TERMS

  • Location: work from our Mohali (Chandigarh Tricity) office.
  • Full time; immediate joiners or short notice periods preferred.
  • Background verification (BGV) is mandatory.
  • Compensation as per company policy and budget band.

HOW WE WORK

We value deep work, clarity, and execution over activity. You will be expected to clarify, plan, execute, and escalate with options, not wait to be told. Ownership sits with the individual, and outcomes are measured, not effort.

OUR VALUES

Agency – Be self-directed and proactive | Taste – Sweat the details and build with precision | Ownership – Take responsibility for outcomes | Mastery – Commit to continuous learning and growth | Impatience – Move fast and challenge inertia | Customer Obsession – Always put the customer first

WHY JOIN US

  • Work on real enterprise data and ship models into AI platforms used by global clients.
  • AI-first environment: work alongside the agentic platforms we build.
  • Great Place to Work-Certified, 14+ years, headquartered in Mohali.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Overview

Imagine being at the forefront of a transformation powered by Data and AI, helping Marketing at Microsoft become a true “Frontier Organization” by modernizing how data is built, governed, discovered, and consumed. As a Software Engineer II on the Global Marketing Data Engineering team, you will help build the next generation of Marketing data platform capabilities using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Azure, and AI-native engineering patterns.

This role will work on reusable platform capabilities that make data easier to discover, trust, govern, access, operate, and consume across Marketing. You will contribute to modernizing the data estate through Fabric adoption, governed data products, metadata-driven engineering, data quality, observability, self-service capabilities, and AI-assisted development. You will also help evolve shared platform capabilities that enable teams to move away from fragmented and bespoke implementations toward standardized, reusable engineering patterns. This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys building modern data platforms, experimenting with emerging AI capabilities, and translating platform architecture into scalable production solutions.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and operate modern data platform capabilities using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Azure, and related technologies.
  • Build reusable frameworks and services for data ingestion, transformation, publishing, and data-product engineering, reducing bespoke implementations across teams.
  • Help modernize existing workloads and data pipelines onto Microsoft Fabric and governed Lakehouse architecture.
  • Develop platform capabilities that improve data discoverability, metadata management, ownership, lineage, readiness, quality, health, and access experiences.
  • Build and enhance shared platform capabilities supporting the broader Marketing data control-plane strategy.
  • Develop metadata-driven and configuration-driven engineering frameworks that reduce manual development and accelerate onboarding of new data products.
  • Apply AI-assisted and agentic engineering techniques to code generation, migration, testing, documentation, metadata generation, schema mapping, and other data-engineering workflows.
  • Explore and implement patterns for exposing trusted data and metadata to AI agents, MCP-based services, ontology-driven experiences, and other AI applications.
  • Build reusable APIs, microservices, workers, and platform components that can be adopted across multiple Marketing data scenarios.
  • Develop automated capabilities for data quality validation, testing, schema enforcement, monitoring, and operational health.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, DataOps, Security/Governance, and product teams to deliver end-to-end platform solutions.
  • Work with Microsoft Fabric, Purview, Azure, and AI product teams to evaluate emerging capabilities and integrate appropriate technologies into the Marketing data ecosystem.
  • Use telemetry, customer feedback, incidents, and usage data to continuously improve platform capabilities.

Embody Microsoft’s culture and values.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
    • OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, distributed systems concepts, testing, and production-quality software development.
  • Experience developing or operating data platforms, data pipelines, distributed data-processing systems, cloud applications, microservices, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud platforms.
  • Experience with modern data technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Spark, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Cosmos DB, Azure Data Explorer, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience developing data ingestion, transformation, modeling, or publishing solutions, including reusable data-engineering frameworks, APIs, services, or internal platform capabilities.
  • Experience with metadata-driven or configuration-driven data platforms and governance technologies such as Microsoft Purview, data catalogs, data lineage, and data classification.
  • Experience using Git-based development, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software-development practices.
  • Experience with generative AI, agents, MCP, semantic/ontology models, AI-ready data-product patterns, and applying AI and automation to data-engineering workflows.

title: Technical Specialist – Census Cartography, P-4,  Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo
location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
description:
The Position:

The Census Cartography Technical Specialist will provide technical and operational assistance to national counterparts - Institut National de la Statistique/Bureau de Coordination du Recensement - on geospatial and mapping activities across all 26 provinces of DRC. S/he will oversee pre-census mapping, field enumeration area (EA) delineation, mobile GIS integration, and satellite imagery processing. The incumbent will ensure that modern digital cartography, high-resolution satellite imagery, dynamic spatial databases, and mobile Geographic Information Systems (GIS) technologies are effectively integrated into all phases of the census.

The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is undertaking its second General Population and Housing Census (RGPH), a critical national priority aimed at providing reliable, disaggregated demographic and socio-economic data for policy formulation, resource allocation, and development planning.

Executing a census across the DRC’s vast geographical footprint poses unique logistical, infrastructural, and technological challenges, including remote terrains, limited connectivity, and dynamic administrative boundaries.

Under the overall guidance of the UNFPA Representative and the direct supervision of the Census Chief Technical Adviser (CTA), the Cartography Specialist will ensure that any challenges in the cartography processes are quickly identified and brought to the attention of the CTA for the attention of management. S/he will also provide recommendations for measures required to ensure that census Geographic Information Systems /Cartography processes continue to move forward in a timely manner.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results.

Job Purpose:

The Cartography & GIS Specialist ensures that census cartographic processes are designed, executed, monitored, and quality-controlled according to UN international standards and recommendations. The incumbent will oversee pre-census mapping, field enumeration area (EA) delineation, geodatabase modeling, mobile mapping integration, and post-enumeration geospatial data dissemination.

You would be responsible for:

1. Technical Strategy & Operational Planning

  • Lead the formulation and execution of the national Census Cartography & GIS Master Plan and budget, aligned with international standards .
  • Establish technical protocols for digital cartography, including spatial database architecture, baseline coordinate reference systems, enumeration area (EA) size parameters, and layer standards.
  • Manage procurement specifications for high-resolution satellite imagery (HRSI), mobile mapping devices, GNSS/GPS technology, and GIS software/hardware.
  • Design workflows for hybrid/digital mapping combining satellite data, open-source cartographic layers, and ground-truthing in complex field environments.

2. Quality Assurance & Field Mapping Operations

  • Oversee the spatial delineation and digitizing of Enumeration Areas (EAs) and Supervision Areas (SAs) across all 26 provinces of the DRC.
  • Develop robust Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) protocols to ensure the geographical coverage is complete, non-overlapping, and accurate prior to main enumeration.
  • Supervise the deployment and synchronization of mobile GIS mapping tools used by field teams, ensuring offline capabilities and data integrity in remote areas.
  • Conduct frequent field monitoring visits to evaluate cartographic progress, resolve technical bottlenecks, and adjust strategy to local environmental or security contexts.

3. Capacity Building & Technical Transfer

  • Assess capacity gaps in GIS and digital cartography within the Bureau Central du Recensement (BCR) and INS.
  • Design and deliver structured technical training programs for national staff, field cartographers, and digitizers on ESRI/QGIS software, mobile data collection platforms, satellite image interpretation, and spatial analysis.
  • Establish a unsustainable local GIS infrastructure within the national statistical framework to support future inter-censal surveys.

4. Data Integration, Spatial Analysis & Dissemination

  • Integrate EA boundaries and geospatial datasets seamlessly into CAPI (Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing) platforms for automated workload assignment during main enumeration.
  • Manage the post-census geodatabase, performing spatial analyses, population distribution modeling, and thematic mapping.
  • Direct the production of official digital census atlases, interactive web-mapping applications, and georeferenced population portals for open-data access.

5. Technical Coordination & Partnership Building

  • Serve as the UNFPA technical focal point for all cartography and GIS-related technical committees.
  • Coordinate technical inputs with partner UN agencies, international donors, academic institutions, and national mapping agencies to harmonize geospatial datasets.

  • Provide regular strategic progress reports and risk analysis to the Census CTA, UNFPA Country Office Management, and national census steering bodies.

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:

Advanced University degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in Cartography, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geomatics, Geography, Remote Sensing, or related quantitative field.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressively responsible international professional experience in census cartography, GIS design, and spatial database management.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and executing digital mapping strategies for large-scale population censuses, particularly in developing countries (experience in Sub-Saharan Africa / fragile contexts highly desirable).
  • Expertise in using advanced GIS software platforms (ESRI ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, QGIS), spatial DBMS (PostGIS, SQL Server), mobile mapping tools (Survey123, ODK, CSEntry), and high-resolution satellite imagery processing.
  • Proven experience in technical capacity building and conducting technical training for national staff.

Languages:

Fluency in French and working knowledge of English is required.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system
  • Embracing cultural diversity

  • Embracing change

Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results
  • Being accountable
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen
  • Thinking analytically and strategically
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships
  • Communicating for impact

Functional Competencies:

  • Managing Data & Information Systems
  • Technical Leadership & Innovation
  • Understanding of United Nations Principles and Recommendations for Population and Housing Censuses.

Compensation and Benefits:

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: BIM Technician
description:
As a BIM Technician, you will be part of WSP. You will be providing CAD/BIM expertise in developing high quality design drawings. It is expected that you demonstrate clear understanding of various tools within BIM softwares such as REVIT/BIM 360 & Navisworks.

  • Production of high-quality 3D BIM Models in Revit.
  • Perform variety of moderately-difficult to difficult 3D CAD modeling assignments under minimal supervision.
  • Coordinate with Design Engineer for the information required to prepare BIM models and generate drawings as per specifications defined by our Client.
  • Must have strong 3D visualization capabilities.
  • Must possess a strong ability to work independently within a project team. Collaborate with other designers, engineers, architects and clients to convert information into layout designs, drawings and models using REVIT.
  • Decipher information received from various formats (hand sketches, BIM Execution Plans and Architectural drawings).
  • Should be interested and able to work in an international environment.
  • Complete other duties as assigned appropriate for the designated grade level.
  • Degree/Diploma in Engineering.
  • Experience with Architectural / Structural/ Mechanical drawings, developing equipment layout and site plan drawings.
  • Experience in leading the modeling related tasks and coordinating with client to get the deliverables completed on schedule and budget.
  • Must possess a strong working knowledge of core 3D CADD applications (such as Revit, Civil 3D, Plant 3D), as outlined above.
  • Must have proficient knowledge in handling Revit and other BIM application tools and concepts of BIM. Capable of producing Revit plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules etc. must be familiar with all Revit tools and creating and editing view range, drafting views, view templates, system families, materials, project/shared parameters, multi-category schedules, project title blocks, Worksets, Revit category-based profile, annotation families etc., must be capable of linking multiple Revit files and work. Capable of handling Revit projects without any guidance from the superior and managing the tasks with sharing the work with others.
  • Must be capable of performing Clash detection using Navisworks and Revit interference check, export Clash reports, review clash reports etc.
    • Create Dynamic Blocks with parameters
    • Use different 3D representations such as shading, conceptual etc.
    • Export 3D geometry for use by subcontractors and outside agencies.
    • Assist in the production of 2D sheets (plans, sections, 3D clips and details) from 3D/4D multi-discipline models (Transitional 2D techniques)
