title: Doctoral Researcher in Occupational Cancer Epidemiology (NordExCan) / Väitöskirjatutkija NordExCan-tutkimushankkeeseen
description:
Tampere University is a unique, boldly futureoriented and evolving community, and one of Finlands most multidisciplinary universities. At Tampere University, technology, health and society come together in a distinctive way. Our research groups and projects carry out interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral research that transcends organisational boundaries. Our community is international, with members from more than 80 countries. Read more at https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) and [Health Sciences Unit](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/health-sciences#switcher-trigger-overview) (HES) at Tampere University invite applications for the position of

Doctoral Researcher in Occupational Cancer Epidemiology for a fixed-term period of 3 years starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).

The Health Sciences unit provides a collaborative setting with multidisciplinary and multimethodological strengths in population health, supporting rigorous and impactful doctoral research.

Our doctoral programs in [Health Sciences](https://opiskelijanopas.tuni.fi/en/tampere-university/curriculum/degree-programmes/uta-tohjelma-1762?year=2025), [Epidemiology and Public Health (IPPE)](https://opiskelijanopas.tuni.fi/en/tampere-university/curriculum/degree-programmes/uta-tohjelma-1765?year=2025), and [Medicine](https://opiskelijanopas.tuni.fi/en/tampere-university/curriculum/degree-programmes/uta-tohjelma-1763?year=2025) offer a strong methodological and research environment for completing an ongoing doctoral project within established research groups at the Health Sciences Unit. The programs provide advanced training in key areas of population health, supporting high-quality publication-oriented research and researcher training.

Job description

The doctoral researcher will join the research project The Nordic Occupational Exposome and Cancer: Decades of Change, Mixtures, and Inequalities (NordExCan), led by Principal Investigator Dr. Subas Neupane. The project examines how occupational exposures change over working life and how these exposures, individually and in combination, are associated with cancer incidence, mortality, and inequalities in the Nordic countries. The research builds on the Nordic Occupational Cancer (NOCCA) cohort and Nordic job-exposure matrices, using occupational histories and population and cancer registry data from Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Iceland.

The doctoral researcher will mainly work on Work Package 1, focusing on occupational exposure histories and their associations with cancer incidence. The work includes harmonising occupational and registry data, estimating cumulative and time-varying exposures, and examining the effects of exposure mixtures and changes in exposure over working life. The doctoral researcher will use epidemiological and statistical methods to investigate cancer risks, including differences by sex and socioeconomic position. Depending on the research needs, the doctoral researcher may also contribute to other work packages covering rare cancers, cancer survival, and causal pathways.

The doctoral researcher will conduct research leading to a doctoral dissertation and contribute to scientific publications and conference presentations. The position also involves participating in project meetings and working closely with the Nordic research team. The research will be based on registry data analysed in secure environments using reproducible statistical methods.

Qualifications

A Master's degree in epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health sciences, data science, or a related field is required. The selected candidate must also meet the requirements for admission to a relevant doctoral programme at Tampere University. Applicants may be required to provide proof of English proficiency, such as IELTS or TOEFL scores, in accordance with the university's admission requirements.

We are looking for a candidate with an interest in occupational and cancer epidemiology and good skills in quantitative research and statistical analysis. The candidate should be able to work independently and as part of a research team. Good written and spoken English skills are required.

The selected candidate must also meet the requirements for admission to a relevant doctoral programme ([Doctoral Programme in Health Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-health-sciences) or [International Doctoral Programme in Epidemiology and Public Health](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/international-doctoral-programme-epidemiology-and-public-health-ippe)) at Tampere University.

Previous experience in statistical programming, particularly R, and working with large-scale registry or longitudinal data will be considered an advantage. Experience in exposure assessment, survival analysis, or other epidemiological methods is also valuable. Familiarity with job-exposure matrices, time-varying exposures, multilevel models, or causal inference would be beneficial, but is not required. Previous experience with Nordic registry data is not required.

We offer

The position is fixed-term for 3 years starting in January 2027. A trial period of six months applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

The salary will be based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). The salary of a doctoral researcher is at levels 2-4. In addition to the basic salary, a supplementary portion of the salary will be paid based on the appointees qualifications and experience. A typical starting salary is approximately 2 800 € / month.

Most of the research will take place physically in Tampere, Finland. The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by Tampere University. International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.

Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university. We offer a wide range of staff benefits, such as occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent sports facilities on campus. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/working-at-tampere-universities). title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Turkuun. Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla. Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava kuukausitulo on keskimäärin noin 3600 € / kk, kun sinulla on neljä hoitolasta ja sinulle kertyy vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpielämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta tai halua opiskella työn ohessa
* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia
* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja
* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Valmiin Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitokonseptin, joka on jo usean yrittäjämme toimesta todettu toimivaksi. Konsepti sisältää kaiken tarvittavan menestyneen perhepäivähoidon pyörittämiseen.
* Kaiken tarvittavan avun yrityksen perustamiseen ja pyörittämiseen. Kaikki on valmiiksi mietitty ja selvitetty puolestasi. Koulutuksemme ja ketjun jatkuva tuki varmistaa, ettet koskaan jää talousasioiden kanssa yksin.
* Ihanan Kultapalat-yhteisön, jossa pääset vaihtamaan ajatuksia muiden Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajien kanssa.




Hae rohkeasti mukaan, tässä porukassa on kivaa sekä aikuisilla että lapsilla!

Performs surveys of buildings to maintain current overall awareness of facilities and general environmental conditions. Develops and maintains a comprehensive resource library of interior design literature. Supervisory Statement: A one year supervisory probation period may be required for this position. About the job

This position is needed to manage high-volume legal support requests, commercial contracts, and operational processes for Twilio's Legal Center of Excellence.

We are looking for a Legal Services Manager to join Twilio's Center of Excellence within Legal Operations. You will serve as an initial legal point of contact for repeatable, high-volume legal work, support commercial contracting needs, and help improve operational processes that make the Legal Team more efficient, scalable, and responsive.

Responsibilities

In this role, you'll:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for GTM and Telecom Carrier Relations legal inquiries.
  • Review, vet, and respond to high-volume legal requests while following internal processes.
  • Independently review and negotiate NDAs, SOWs, service orders, and related agreements.
  • Support law firm eBilling matter creation, configuration, invoice escalations, and process improvements.
  • Maintain operational expertise across Center of Excellence processes and update playbooks.
  • Support ad-hoc operational projects and repeatable tasks across legal functions.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Legal Operations Analyst or Manager, Contracts Administrator or Manager, or Paralegal.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial contracts and contracting principles.
  • Experience independently drafting and negotiating NDAs, SOWs, assignment and assumption agreements, transition services agreements, and service orders.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Conga, Microsoft Office Suite, Google Suite, Airtable, DocuSign, and Adobe Acrobat Pro.
  • Experience using AI tools and understanding how LLMs can improve day-to-day legal work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach.
  • Process-oriented mindset and ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment with minimal supervision.

Desired:

  • Experience supporting a sales organization at a high-growth technology company.
  • Experience creating and managing process documentation and policies.
  • Experience handling high-volume, repeatable tasks across legal functions.
  • Exposure to law firm billing and eBilling software such as Brightflag, Onit, or Legal Tracker.
  • Good sense of humor, disdain for drama, interest in learning new things, and desire to get things done.

Location

This role will be remote.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to learn from each other. While this role is remote, you may be required to travel occasionally for team offsites, All Hands, and other gatherings.

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

title: Assistant Maintenance - Pembroke Pines, FL
description:
Position Overview

Valiant Residential is seeking an Assistant Maintenance who is responsible for assisting the maintenance supervisor. He/she is also responsible for maintaining the physical integrity of the property and working with the leasing team to maximize renewal and leasing opportunities. The Assistant Maintenance will ensure that all duties are carried out with safety first and according to Valiant Residential policies.


We Are Valiant

With over 37 years of experience, Valiant Residential is a next-generation property management leader, uniquely attuned to the needs of property owners and residents. We are driven by a Valiant Spirit—bold, innovative, and committed to excellence—fostering prosperous partnerships and long-term success. Our team thrives on collaboration, integrity, and strategic thinking, making a meaningful impact in the industry.


Why Work at Valiant?

At Valiant Residential, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers. Consistently ranked as a "Top Place to Work," we are a leader in the property management industry, driven by bold, innovative professionals who make an impact.

We believe in rewarding great work with competitive total compensation and time off with comprehensive benefits, including free health insurance options and 401(k) matching. Growth isn’t just encouraged—it’s expected. With career development opportunities, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to innovation, we empower our employees to thrive.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Service requests made by residents should be completed within 24 hours.
  • Implement and manage the system for handling resident service requests. Whenever possible, all requests should be completed within 24 hours. Schedule the on-call rotation for the staff and assist with service as necessary.
  • The Assistant Maintenance will assist in being responsible for conducting all business in accordance with company policies and procedures and all state and federal laws (such as ADA, Fair Housing, OSHA, etc.).
  • Assist in the distribution of flyers and other materials.
  • Keep all safety materials current and readily accessible. You must be aware of the condition of physical property throughout and immediately correct unsafe conditions.
  • Maintain accurate records of preventive maintenance, service requests, and make-ready status of all vacant apartments.
  • Schedule and perform minor and routine maintenance on all appropriate equipment on a regular basis. Inspect and maintain all tools in excellent condition.
  • Diagnose and perform minor or routine maintenance or repair involving the following on a daily basis: Electrical and plumbing (including water lines), A/C and heating systems, appliances, water irrigation systems, stairs, gates, fences, patios and railings, tile, carpet and flooring, roofing, gutters, fasteners, interior/exterior lights, fireplaces, ceiling fans, gas fixtures and appliances, shutters, doors, cabinets, windows, sliding glass doors, boilers, gas and electric, door locks, P.O. boxes and locks, security systems, ceiling leaks, walls, pool area, tile, hot tub/spa, and pool furniture.
  • Handle “on-call” duties whenever needed.
  • Participate in standby emergency schedules for evening, weekend, and holiday coverage.
  • Assist in preparing the property for various inspections.
  • Perform any additional duties as assigned by the property manager or Regional Community Supervisor.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

title: Logistics Specialist, P3, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo
location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
description:
The Position:

The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is undertaking its second General Population and Housing Census (RGPH). Managing the logistics for a digital census across the DRC—spanning 2.3 million square kilometers and 26 provinces—presents extraordinary operational and supply chain challenges. Hundreds of thousands of items, including mobile devices (tablets), solar chargers, power banks, uniforms, training materials, and IT infrastructure, must be secured, stored, and deployed to thousands of field personnel across urban, riverine, and extremely remote rural areas.

Under the direct supervision of the Census Programme Coordinator and overall guidance of the Census Chief Technical Adviser (CTA), the Logistics Specialist will oversee end-to-end supply chain management, distribution logistics, warehousing, customs clearance, asset tracking, and reverse logistics across all phases of the census (mapping, pilot, and main enumeration).

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results.

Job Purpose:

The Logistics Specialist provides technical and operational support to the Bureau Central du Recensement (BCR) and the Institut National de la Statistique (INS) to ensure the timely, secure, cost-effective, and fully accountable movement of census equipment, materials, and personnel across the DRC. The incumbent will design, execute, and monitor the census logistics operational plan, while building the capacity of the Bureau Central du Recensement (BCR) and the Institut National de la Statistique (INS) to handle large-scale, tech-driven fieldwork operations.

You would be responsible for:

1. Supply Chain Planning & Distribution Strategy

  • Lead the operational development and follow up - in coordination with INS/BCR - of the Census National Logistics Master Plan, including detailed distribution and retrieval schedules for all 26 provinces.
  • Standardize transport workflows across complex multimodal transit routes (air, road, river, and foot) to ensure high-value IT equipment reaches remote field hubs safely and on schedule.

  • Collaborate with the UNFPA Procurement Unit to establish procurement timelines, packaging standards, and delivery terms (INCOTERMS) for all domestic and international census goods.

2. Custom Clearance, Freight & Inventory Management

  • Oversee international shipments, managing customs clearance procedures (exonération/attestation de destination) in coordination with DRC government ministries, port authorities, and airport custom units.
  • Design and oversee central (Kinshasa) and regional/provincial warehouse operations, ensuring security, climate control, fire safety, and strict inventory controls for sensitive electronic devices.
  • Design and implement in collaboration with INS/BCR a robust electronic inventory tracking system (using barcodes/QR codes) to all goods deployed for the census including the tracking of hardware movements from central receiving down to field supervision areas.

3. Asset Control & Reverse Logistics

  • Support INS/BCR to implement strict asset management protocols to secure high-value items, including tens of thousands of mobile CAPI tablets, solar kits, and generators.
  • Formulate and execute the Reverse Logistics Strategy to collect, inspect, reconcile, and re-warehouse all non-consumable technology assets and equipment post-enumeration.
  • Conduct inventory audits, manage damage and loss reporting mechanisms, and oversee proper decommissioning or re-allocation of materials in accordance with UNFPA and government regulations.

4. Operational Coordination & Field Support

  • Coordinate field transport logistics by negotiating agreements and operating frameworks with local transport providers, commercial carriers, UN logistics partners, and government fleets.
  • Conduct risk assessments on fragile supply lines, establishing contingency protocols for difficult-to-reach or security-compromised territory.
  • Provide real-time logistical support during field mapping, pre-tests, pilot census, and main enumeration to immediately resolve local bottlenecks or hardware shortfalls.

5. Capacity Building & Partner Support

  • Provide technical assistance and training to logistics personnel at the INS/BCR and provincial census offices (BPR).
  • Train national logistics teams on modern inventory tools, field asset tracking, warehouse safety standards, and fleet management protocols.

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:

Advanced University degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transport Economics, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in supply chain management, complex field logistics, warehouse management, and freight transportation.
  • Direct experience in executing field logistics for large-scale national operations, population censuses, large surveys, or major humanitarian distribution campaigns in developing countries (Sub-Saharan Africa / DRC context highly preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with automated inventory management databases and asset-tracking technologies.

  • Familiarity with UN system operational policies, customs clearance processes, and multi-agency coordination mechanisms is a strong advantage.

Languages:

Fluency in French and working knowledge of English is required.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system
  • Embracing cultural diversity

  • Embracing change

Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results
  • Being accountable
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen
  • Thinking analytically and strategically
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships
  • Communicating for impact

Functional Competencies:

  • Logistics & Supply Chain Management
  • Asset & Risk Management
  • Operational Innovation

Compensation and Benefits:

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. title: Manager
description:
The role will partner with Business, IT, Finance, and delivery teams to ensure portfolio information is complete, accurate, and timely; identify risks, gaps, and exceptions requiring attention; coordinate resolution of portfolio issues; and identify opportunities to improve reporting, processes, and automation.

  • Support PI Planning by coordinating and collecting required portfolio and program information from Business, IT, Finance, and delivery teams.

  • Review planning inputs for completeness and consistency and follow up with accountable owners to address missing or conflicting information.

  • Continuously monitor portfolio health, including program/project status, milestones, financials, risks, issues, dependencies, KPIs, and commitments.

  • Analyze portfolio information to identify exceptions, emerging risks, trends, and areas requiring management attention.

  • Support PI and portfolio close by coordinating the collection and validation of final program/project information.

  • Review planned commitments against actual outcomes and identify items that are completed, delayed, changed, or require follow-up.

  • Support portfolio governance processes, reviews, planning activities, and change requests.

  • Partner with Business, IT, Finance, and delivery teams to ensure portfolio requirements and governance expectations are understood and followed.

  • Work effectively with teams operating within Agile delivery models and understand sprint, release, backlog, and PI-level information.

  • Interpret Agile delivery information in the context of broader portfolio commitments and outcomes.

  • Maintain the integrity, completeness, and quality of portfolio data used for portfolio reviews and leadership reporting.

  • Perform data-quality checks and investigate discrepancies across portfolio information.

  • Proactively identify manual, repetitive, inefficient, or error-prone activities that could be simplified or automated.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes across planning, portfolio monitoring, governance, close, reporting, and data management.

  • 5-7 years of relevant experience in Portfolio Management, PMO, Program Operations, Agile Delivery, or Portfolio Governance.

  • Hands-on Jira experience is mandatory.

  • Agile delivery experience is mandatory.

  • Experience supporting PI Planning or similar program/portfolio planning cycles.

  • Experience supporting portfolio/program health monitoring and governance.

  • Strong ability to analyze information, identify gaps and exceptions, and drive issues to resolution.

  • Strong experience managing and validating data received from multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Experience working independently with globally distributed/onshore teams.

    Preferred experience

  • Experience within a Value Management Office, Transformation Office, Enterprise PMO, or Portfolio Management function.

  • Exposure to portfolio financials, KPIs, benefits, investment management, and executive portfolio reporting.

  • Experience identifying process improvement, reporting, and automation opportunities.

  • Experience working with Power BI or Power Platform development teams is beneficial.

title: IT Technician
description:
About the role

As an IT Technician, you will play a critical role in maintaining the stability, security, and performance of our customers' IT environments. Working closely with Systems Engineers, customers, and wider technical teams, you will support the installation, maintenance, and optimization of server, network, and desktop infrastructure within data center and server room environments.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with diverse teams, and contributing to reliable IT operations. Your work will directly support business continuity, operational excellence, and a positive customer experience.

How you will contribute

  • Install, configure, and connect customer hardware according to approved technical designs and requirements.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of data center and server room infrastructure, including environmental monitoring, access controls, and related security measures.
  • Create, update, and maintain accurate technical documentation, network records, and asset information.
  • Assist with IT site audits, onboarding and offboarding activities, and the allocation and management of IP addresses.
  • Support routine system administration, including patching, upgrades, maintenance activities, backups, and recovery processes.
  • Collaborate with Systems Engineers to identify and implement solutions that improve performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and respond to server, desktop, and network incidents, supporting containment, recovery, and root cause analysis activities.
  • Provide technical support for network connectivity and infrastructure-related issues, including wireless, switching, and routing environments.
  • Participate in infrastructure upgrades and help implement vendor-recommended improvements and best practices.
  • Work closely with colleagues and customers across different locations and time zones to deliver a consistent and high-quality service.

What you will bring

  • A Bachelor's degree, equivalent work experience, or a comparable level of thinking and working in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting IT infrastructure environments, including Windows Server platforms and enterprise hardware.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A collaborative, customer-focused approach and the ability to prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.

description:

As a Health Insurance Specialist, GS-0107-14, you will you will lead technical reviews of Qualified Health Plan (QHP) submissions, improve certification processes and tools, develop operational guidance, and coordinate with CMS, States, issuers, and contractors to resolve complex issues.

Leads the review and analysis of qualified health plans (QHPs) issuers and plans, particularly QHPs in the Federally-facilitated Marketplaces (FFMs), to ensure compliance with PPACA provisions related to QHP certification.

Works in close partnership with Center and Group leadership and managers across to the Center to evaluate the effectiveness of the QHP submission and review processes, develop solutions, and assess the impact of new initiatives.

Leads the development of and updates to standard operating procedures and other sub-regulatory guidance that instructs issuers on the conduct of benefit review for plans offered in markets under the FFMs.

Oversees the provision of technical assistance to issuers to ensure compliance with QHP Certification Standards, to include conducting benefit and cost sharing reviews.

Serves as a technical expert across the Center on the operational development of new QHP reviews and modification of existing reviews.

Vesitalousasiantuntija osallistuu vesistösuunnittelutehtäviin, jotka liittyvät lähinnä tulvariskien hallintaan ja valtion vesitaloudellisten lupien luvanhaltijan tehtäviin.

Tehtävänä on osallistua valtion vesitaloudellisiin lupiin liittyviin muutosprosesseihin pohjoisen vesistöyksikön alueella (Etelä-Pohjanmaa, Pohjanmaa ja Keski-Pohjanmaa). Tehdä niihin liittyviä projektiluontoisia selvityksiä (mm. lupien ajantasaisuus) sekä valmistella ja esitellä näihin liittyviä lupahakemuksia, lausuntoja ja vastineita.

Tehtävänä on toimia asiantuntijana tulvariskien hallintatyössä ja tulvariskien hallintasuunnitelmien päivittämisessä. Vastata Kyrönjoen tulvaryhmän sihteerinä tulvaryhmän toiminnan järjestämisestä. Osallistua tulvariskien hallinnan toimenpiteiden ja valuma-aluelähtöisen vesienhallinnan edistämiseen.

Tehtävään kuuluu edistää uusien tekniikoiden käyttöä yksikön tehtävissä ja osallistua mm. RPAS-tekniikan (drone) sekä paikkatiedon hyödyntämiseen ja kehittämiseen vesitalousosaston tehtävissä.

Työssä on tärkeä yhteensovittaa vesienkäytön intressejä kuten tulvasuojelu, vesivoiman tuotanto, vesienhoito, kalatalous ja virkistyskäyttö sekä ottaa huomioon ilmastonmuutos. Tehtävän hoidossa pääsee verkostoitumaan laajasti muun hallinnon ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

title: Health Technician
description:
The Health Technician works as a member of the Nursing - Inpatient Medical/Surgical and Critical Care Team. This position is assigned to the Emergency Department (ED) area within Patient Care Services. The Health Technician assists medical and nursing staff through technical, specialized or support services for the diagnosing or treatment of patient illnesses or medical conditions.

Major duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Supports professional, licensed providers, both nurses and physicians in designated clinical area using diagnostic and therapeutic medical instruments and equipment to perform non-invasive Electrocardiograms and Bladder Scans according to established procedures. Applies basic orthopedic splints and performs dressing changes in designated areas. Performs phlebotomy in designated areas. Performs Point of Care (POC) testing using glucometer and I-Stat devices and CLIA-waived testing as authorized, according to established unit procedures. Documents treatments, procedures, and/or telemetry identification conducted by the incumbent in the electronic medical record. Provides non-professional medical and technical support to professional staff during diagnosis and treatment of patients. Recognizes and informs appropriate multidisciplinary health care team of deviations from baseline screening parameters. Prepares and sets up equipment, etc., for procedures performed by licensed providers, including laceration repair, chest tube insertion, lumbar puncture, etc. Assists professional, licensed providers, including nursing staff and physicians, in the care and treatment of the critically ill and those with emergent needs. Observes and reports to the provider changes in patient behavior, attitude, bodily complaints, and appearance. Performs standardized treatment procedures requiring considerable training and experience such as performing pharyngeal (mouth cavity) suctions, setting up pulse oximetry, and observing cardiac waveforms; obtains, reads, measures, and interprets electrocardiogram monitoring. Identifies life-threatening dysrhythmias; activates the appropriate codes and/or steps required to call for definitive help; initiates appropriate action according to established procedures. Performs Basic Life Support, including the operation of the Automated External Defibrillator (or equivalent); applicable protocols are observed. Performs procedures as indicated and pre-authorized, through prior competency assessment. Utilizes the paging system, answers phones and call lights. Provides non-professional nursing care to patients experiencing extremes of behavior on a regular and recurring basis. Intervenes when patients express or display suicidal ideation by utilizing techniques per established procedures to keep the patient safe, and maintain personal safety, while awaiting assistance. Performs constant observation for high-risk patients and follows procedures to ensure safety of room environment, maintaining line-of-sight visual surveillance, and reporting changes in patient behavior to the professional nursing staff member(s). Performs a wide variety of duties aimed at increasing the comfort and spirit of the patient. Transports patients via wheelchair or gurney, accompanying ambulatory patients who need assistance reporting to various areas within the hospital including clinics, diagnostic areas, and treatment areas in the absence of, or non-availability, of medical escort staff. Performs simple personal care duties such as bathing, oral, nail, and hair care. Assists patients with physical limitations such as swallowing disorders with meals. Assists patients with toileting needs, providing incontinent care as necessary. Performs basic personal nursing care that requires knowledge of standardized procedures such as performance of active/passive range-of-motion activities, ensuring that catheters and oxygen cannula, etc., remain intact. Assists with application of protective devices such as soft restraints, padded mitts, side rails, etc. as necessary, per established procedures. Identifies physical, social, psychological, and cultural needs of patients by applying relevant growth and development processes specific to the age of the patient, as well as direct communication as the patient is able. Empowers patients and their families, encouraging them to acknowledge and address personal healthcare issues and embrace recommended follow up and self-care. Performs administrative tasks and manages various support functions such as maintaining control records for specimens, tests, and documenting measurements taken. Initiates work orders, following up to ensure the work is completed. Orders and maintains supplies for the unit. Coordinates with Medical Support Assistants to ensure patient tracking is initiated during check-in, scheduling of appointments for procedures, provider evaluations, etc., from other services. Work Schedule: 11:30am - MN, 11:30am-8:00pm, 3:30pm - MN, 7:30am - 8:00pm, 7:30am - 4:00pm, 8:00am - 11:30pm with rotating weekend/holidays Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Position Description/PD#: Health Technician/PD92902A Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job To be considered for this position, you must complete all required steps in the process. In addition to the application and questionnaire, this position requires an online assessment. The online assessment measures critical general competencies required to perform the job. All applicants tentatively selected for VA employment in a testing designated position are subject to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Applicants who refuse to be tested will be denied employment with VA. Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959 Physical Requirements: The work required does not inherently include any physical requirements essential for successful job performance that could not otherwise be performed with accommodation or workplace adjustment. A pre-placement physical examination is not required. Subject to background/security investigation Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. title: Facility Management Systems Specialist
description:
You will serve as a Facility Management Systems Specialist with the National Park Service at Mesa Verde National Park. Provides technical support for asset management programs, including FMSS, FCAS, and CESS. Assists with facility data management, condition assessments, and cost estimating activities while supporting the development and implementation of long-range facility management strategies for parks.

Some of the major duties you will perform include but are not limited to the following: Serves as the primary FMSS point of contact for network parks, providing data analysis, statistical reports, and program guidance; recommends actions to support asset identification, inventory, condition assessment, cost estimating, lifecycle analysis, and work order management. Implements, coordinates, and evaluates all park FMSS activities, including annual and comprehensive condition assessments; oversees asset evaluation processes, ensures compliance with Director's Order #80 and related asset management policies, and develops schedules supporting Park Asset Management Plan (PAMP) objectives. Develops and maintains essential asset data, including API ratings, Current Replacement Values (CRV), and heritage/unique valuations; reviews, analyzes, and prioritizes asset needs, coordinates PMIS project development, and provides recommendations for facility investment and operational planning. Prepares and presents detailed FMSS reports for operational, fiscal, and strategic planning purposes; ensures data accuracy through QA/QC processes, develops business practices for database management, and trains park personnel on FMSS/FCAS systems and requirements. Provides technical support and oversight for FMSS-related contracts and staff; performs COTR duties, monitors contractor performance, ensures compliance with specifications, manages documentation, and may train or lead personnel conducting asset inspections or FMSS support functions.

Must be a U.S. Citizen or National. Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication. Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service. Direct Deposit participation required. Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more, visit https://www.e-verify.gov/. Driver's License - Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license throughout employment. Government Charge Card: You are required to complete training, obtain and maintain a government credit card with travel and purchase authority. Probationary Period: As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you may be required to serve a 1-year Probationary Period to evaluate your fitness and whether your continuation of employment advances the public interest. This Probationary Period is an extension of the appointment process and therefore requires the agency to determine if continued employment would advance the public interest, meet the organization goals and mission of the agency, and/or otherwise promote the efficiency of the service. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, the agency will consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Under applicable law, the employment of an individual serving a probationary or trial period automatically terminates when that period ends unless the agency affirmatively certifies, in writing, that the individual's employment should continue and that their appointment should be finalized. In the absence of agency action to affirmatively certify continued employment beyond the probationary or trial period, such appointments are terminated. Upon completion of your Probationary Period your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

We Are Valiant

title: Vastaanottovirkailija
description:
Etsimme vastaanottotiimiimme positiivista, palveluhenkistä ja asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta innostuvaa joukkuepelaajaa. Viihdytkö ihmisten parissa, nautit vaihtelevista työpäivistä ja pidät langat käsissäsi myös kiireen keskellä? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö. Meillä pääset työskentelemään ainutlaatuisessa ympäristössä luonnon, liikunnan ja hyvinvoinnin keskellä.

Eerikkilä on olemassa, jotta ihmiset ja yhteisöt voisivat hyvin ja menestyisivät. Uskomme, että todellinen menestys kumpuaa hyvinvoinnista. Meille jokainen on tärkeä, olitpa pelaaja, valmentaja, johtaja tai työntekijä.

Vastaanotto on yksi Eerikkilän tärkeimmistä kohtaamispaikoista. Olemme tunnettuja palveluasenteestamme ja hymystämme. Teemme vastaanotossa työtä suurella sydämellä, annamme kasvot Eerikkilän asiakaspalvelulle sekä varmistamme jokaisen vieraamme viihtyvyyden. Tavoitteenamme on tarjota asiakkaillemme ylivertaisia asiakaskokemuksia, joten odotamme positiivista ja asiakaslähtöistä asennetta myös sinulta.

Haemme vastaanottovirkailijaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen. Vastaanottomme palvelee urheilu-, vapaa-ajan ja yritysasiakkaitamme ympäri vuoden ja vuorokauden.

Tehtävässäsi vastaanottovirkailijana

  • Hoidatmonipuolisia asiakaspalvelutehtäviä: talossa olevien asiakkaiden vastaanottamista, majoittamista ja opastusta, varaustenhallintaa sekä vastaanoton taustatöitä.

  • Tarjoat asiakaspalvelua kasvotusten, puhelimitse, sähköpostilla, chatissa ja muissa sähköisissä kanavissa.

  • Hoidat vastaanottopisteen yhteydessä sijaitsevia kahvilaa ja myymälää.

  • Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kokouspalveluiden kanssa, huolehdit tilojen valmistelusta kokousryhmille sekä avustat tilojen tekniikan käytössä

Tehtävä on kaksivuorotyötä klo 7–21.30 välisenä aikana. Halutessasi voit työskennellä satunnaisesti myös yövuoroissa, esimerkiksi loma- ja sairauspoissaolojen sijaistamiseksi.

Huomioithan, että Eerikkilään ei kulje julkisia kulkuvälineitä, jonka vuoksi oma ajoneuvo on välttämätön.

Odotamme sinulta

  • Kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä. Isoksi eduksi luemme aiemman työkokemuksen hotellin vastaanotosta, tapahtumapalveluista tai alaan liittyvän koulutuksen

  • Erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä työskennellä niin tiimissä kuin itsenäisesti

  • Oma-aloitteista ja joustavaa työotetta sekä valmiutta tarttua ja ratkaista vaihtelevia tehtäviä sekä toimia ripeästi kiireenkin keskellä

  • Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

  • Hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta käyttää erilaisia ohjelmistoja osana päivittäistä työtä

  • Eduksi luemme jo suoritetut anniskelu- ja hygieniapassit.

Tarjoammesinulle työssä onnistumisen tueksi

  • Työtehtävän ainutlaatuisessa ympäristössä ja positiivisessa ilmapiirissä työyhteisössä, jossa tavoitteenamme on toimia ratkaisukeskeisesti ja aidosti asiakkaiden ja kollegoiden parhaaksi

title: Leasing Consultant - Pembroke Pines, FL
description:
Position Overview

Valiant Residential is seeking a Leasing Consultant who is responsible for duties related to leasing, retention, and occupancy for the community while promoting resident satisfaction. Create a lasting influence on visitors, prospects, and residents through a customer service focus.


We Are Valiant

With over 37 years of experience, Valiant Residential is a next-generation property management leader, uniquely attuned to the needs of property owners and residents. We are driven by a Valiant Spirit—bold, innovative, and committed to excellence—fostering prosperous partnerships and long-term success. Our team thrives on collaboration, integrity, and strategic thinking, making a meaningful impact in the industry.


Why Work at Valiant?

At Valiant Residential, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers. Consistently ranked as a "Top Place to Work," we are a leader in the property management industry, driven by bold, innovative professionals who make an impact.

We believe in rewarding great work with competitive total compensation and time off with comprehensive benefits, including free health insurance options and 401(k) matching. Growth isn’t just encouraged—it’s expected. With career development opportunities, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to innovation, we empower our employees to thrive.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Greet prospects and qualify by covering all criteria (ask questions, utilize completed guest cards, etc.)
  • Prepare move-in packages and lease paperwork.
  • Immediately record all telephone and in-person visits on appropriate reports. File your guest cards and maintain them according to established procedures.
  • Inspect models and available “market ready” units; communicate related service needs to the Community Manager.
  • Have the prospect complete the application and secure a deposit in accordance with Valiant Residential procedures and Fair Housing requirements.
  • Update the availability report and process applications for approval (e.g., credit check, rental history, etc.). Submit processed applications to the Community Manager for approval.
  • Assist in monitoring renewals. Distribute and follow up on renewal notices.
  • Monitor advertising effectiveness. Gather information about market competition in the area and file.
  • Professionally represent the company at all times.
  • Accept rental payments and give them immediately to the Assistant Community Manager.
  • Type lease, complete appropriate paperwork, and input information on the Yardi System accurately and on time. Review with the Community Manager before obtaining signatures.
  • Assist the management team with other various tasks as required.
  • Consistently implement policies of the community.

title: Team Leader - Spanish Speaker
description:
About Us

WTW is an award-winning advisory, broking, and solutions company that supports clients worldwide in transforming risk into opportunities for growth. With a rich insurance heritage dating back to 1828, from the Titanic in 1912 to the Moon Buggy in 1971, WTW brings deep industry expertise and longstanding experience. Our WTW Regional Delivery Center, based in the heart of Lisbon, brings together a strong global team of more than 400 colleagues who deliver operational excellence every day through innovation and streamlined, efficient solutions.

The opportunity

Our Health and Benefits business helps large and mid-size clients control health and welfare plan costs, improve health outcomes, and promote employee engagement through broad-based, state-of-the-art interventions. We provide solutions encompassing creative plan design, vendor evaluation and management, pricing and funding strategies, data analytics, valuation support, legal compliance and governance strategies.

As Team Leader for Plan Administration, you will be accountable for stable and effective day-to-day delivery. You will translate business priorities into clear execution, maintain visibility of workload and capacity, and ensure client commitments are met with the required quality and within agreed service levels. You will combine people leadership, operational control and technical coordination, acting as the first escalation point for complex operational matters.

What you will do

  • Lead, coach and develop the Plan Administration team, creating clear expectations, accountability and collaboration.

    • Coordinate workload, priorities, backups and coverage to protect continuity during absences, peak periods and changes in demand.

    • Monitor SLA performance, backlog, productivity, capacity and quality indicators, and follow through on corrective actions.

    • Oversee Plan Administration activities, including enrolment and eligibility data, policy movements, certificates, census renewals and reconciliations.

    • Own the operational response to complex cases, service risks, incidents, errors and urgent client requests, escalating material issues when required.

    • Partner with Client and Account Management, Support teams, Spain Operations and insurance carriers or vendors.

    • Apply risk-based quality controls and ensure errors lead to correction, root-cause understanding and preventative action.

    • Maintain audit-ready SOPs, templates, trackers, handover notes and knowledge repositories.

    • Lead onboarding, knowledge transfer and readiness validation for new joiners, role changes and portfolio transitions.

    • Drive practical continuous improvement by reducing bottlenecks, recurring errors and unnecessary manual effort.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of experience in health and benefits, insurance operations, brokerage, outsourcing or a comparable client-service environment, with strong exposure to Plan Administration.

    • Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating an operational team and managing competing priorities under pressure.

    • Strong knowledge of workload and capacity management, SLA monitoring, quality assurance, operational controls and escalation governance.

    • Practical knowledge of policy movements, enrolment and eligibility data, certificates, census management, renewals and reconciliations.

    • Fluent Spanish for the Spanish market and strong working English, with clear written and verbal communication.

    • Sound judgement, attention to detail and confidence handling urgent, complex or sensitive operational situations.

    • A customer-focused, diplomatic and collaborative approach with internal and external stakeholders.

    • A continuous-improvement mindset and evidence of standardising work, simplifying processes and improving visibility.

Technical capability

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for validation, reconciliation, analysis and operational reporting.

    • Confident use of Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneNote and Planner or equivalent workload-management tools.

    • Experience creating and maintaining SOPs, control evidence, trackers, dashboards and audit-ready documentation.

    • Power BI knowledge is an advantage, especially for service, quality, capacity and productivity reporting.

Why WTW?

At WTW, we offer more than just a job—we offer a career. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy flexible working hours and hybrid working options to suit your lifestyle.

  • Competitive Compensation: Benefit from an attractive, performance-related remuneration system.

  • Global Exposure: Join an international consultancy with the security of a global corporation and renowned clients.

  • Career Development: Experience a steep learning curve and ample opportunities for individual career growth through on-the-job learning and specialist training.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work in a collegial, appreciative, and dynamic environment where decisions are made together.

  • Impactful Work: Quickly take on responsibility and make an impact with direct customer contact.

  • Community and Celebration: Participate in corporate events and celebrate our successes together.

Join Us!

Be part of a team that values innovation, excellence, and collaboration. At WTW, your career is more than just a job—it’s a journey. Apply now and turn your potential into success with WTW!

title: Lead Adjudicator, Provider Claims
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides lead level support for provider claims adjudication activities including responding to providers to address claim issues, and researching, investigating and ensuring appropriate resolution of claims.

Essential Job Duties

• Coordinates workflow and staffing of day-to-day claims adjudication activities, and assigns and monitors work of staff to ensure adherence to productivity and quality standards.
• Manages escalations within the claims department by ensuring appropriate accountability, sense of urgency, communication and follow-through to closure.
• Performs daily claims troubleshooting procedures to support provider claims function as needed.
• Participates in or leads quality improvement efforts to improve claims processes and/or policies.
• Serves as provider claims subject matter expert; provides feedback to team and facilitates training as needed.
• Reviews claims deficiencies and makes recommendations to increase efficiencies and provider satisfaction.
• Sets standard with team for exemplary customer service delivery and ensures the team is meeting established claims metrics and compliance measures.
• Partners with stakeholders and leaders in other functions to coordinate provider claims-related problem-solving in an effective and timely manner.
• Provides technical claims expertise to peers and handles complex provider calls.

• Assists leadership with claims staff development.
• Recognizes trends and patterns in call and claims types and engages leadership with suggested solutions.
• Meets department quality and production standards.
• Supports all claims department initiatives to improve overall efficiency.
• Completes claims projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• At least 4 years of experience in claims, including provider claims investigation/research/resolution/reimbursement methodology analysis experience within a managed care organization, and 3 years experience as a claims adjudicator, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• Experience with claims payments, multiple state billing guidelines and claims processing policies and procedures.
• Research, analysis, data entry, and auditing skills.
• Organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Time-management skills, and ability to manage simultaneous projects and tasks to meet internal deadlines.
• Customer service experience.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills.
• Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

title: Wastewater Engineer / Operations Liaison
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role Description:

We are seeking a motivated and collaborative Wastewater Engineer / Operations Liaison to support a high-profile wastewater treatment program in the San Diego region. This unique role will serve as a critical link between a private wastewater treatment plant operator and the International Boundary and Water Commission (IBWC), helping ensure effective coordination, transparent communication, and successful program delivery.

This position offers an exceptional opportunity for an engineer who wants to expand their experience beyond traditional design work and gain firsthand exposure to wastewater treatment operations, regulatory coordination, stakeholder engagement, capital improvements, and utility management.

The successful candidate will become a trusted advisor and communicator in a highly visible role supporting one of the region's most important wastewater infrastructure programs.

Role Accountabilities:

As the primary operations-owner liaison, you will help facilitate communication, coordination, and problem-solving among a diverse group of stakeholders, including plant operators, government agencies, consultants, contractors, and technical staff.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day liaison between the private facility operator and IBWC representatives.
  • Foster open, transparent, and professional communication among all project stakeholders.
  • Coordinate operational updates, maintenance activities, performance reporting, and technical reviews.
  • Track and communicate key action items, commitments, risks, and decisions.
  • Participate in regular plant meetings and support preparation of agendas, meeting summaries, and executive briefings.
  • Review operational data, compliance reports, performance metrics, and engineering documentation.
  • Support planning and implementation of facility improvements, rehabilitation projects, and optimization initiatives.
  • Assist with plant inspections, field observations, and condition assessments.
  • Identify and elevate operational concerns while helping stakeholders develop practical solutions.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and briefing materials for technical and executive audiences.
  • Support a culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil, Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline.
  • 5 to 10 years of experience in wastewater treatment, utility operations, water/wastewater consulting, or related services.

Key Skills and Attributes

  • Working knowledge of municipal wastewater treatment processes and treatment plant operations.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong facilitation, coordination, and relationship-building abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders and organizations.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to work periodically at treatment plant facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.
  • Experience working with public agencies, utilities, or wastewater treatment operators.
  • Familiarity with regulatory compliance, permitting, and operational reporting requirements.
  • Experience supporting capital improvement projects or treatment plant upgrades.
  • Knowledge of wastewater process optimization and performance monitoring.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish proficiency.
  • Experience working in highly visible or politically sensitive environments.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

title: Associate Client Advocate
description:
The Associate Client Advocate (ACA) client-facing functions utilizing the colleague’s advanced skills in Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance and is responsible for a blend of internal delivery activities. The ACA is responsible for supporting client relationships, strategy development, and execution at the insurance program level.

The Associate Client Advocate (ACA) owns client service activities and client engagement in those activities through daily coordination with an assigned Client Specialist in our Global Service Delivery (GSD) Team. The ACA is the primary point of contact for providing all service, escalation, and placement to meet the client’s insurance and risk management needs. The ACA has a strong connection to the client’s business with a fundamental understanding of its industry and aids in opportunities to maximize the profitability of existing clients by supporting new business efforts.

The primary responsibility of the Associate Client Advocate is to provide an exceptional client experience, with a primary focus on direct client engagement and retention of that business. This includes engaging with sales and broking to understand marketplace changes, design and deliver client presentations/proposals, assist and respond to defensive RFPs, and attend oral presentations where required.

As an ACA you are expected to have:

  • Basic negotiation skills and demonstrated experience
  • Basic account management skills and demonstrated experience
  • Basic project management skills and demonstrated experience
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt to change
  • Solid organization skills
  • Ability to mentor a Client Specialist colleague

As an ACA you have the potential to serve as a mentor to other ACAs, a partner/ team member for others within your IVD, or an ACA Leader.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

  • Retains existing book of business, develops, and strengthens client relationships
  • Identifies, engages, and integrates delivery of all WTW internal resources to deliver an exceptional client experience
  • Provides direct or supporting strategic planning and consulting advice to clients; monitors insurance and risk management needs in collaboration with WTW resource, practice, and industry groups.
  • Recommend appropriate solutions throughout the policy term (including acquisition due diligence)
  • Maximizes the profitability of the client account & drives retention of that business
  • In collaboration with the Client Advocate, actively expands existing client relationships and supports new business prospecting
  • Collaborates with client teams during Internal and External Strategy Meetings
  • Engages with sales and broking to understand marketplace changes
  • Supports the fee/compensation agreement and overall client invoicing processes
  • Supports defensive RFP responses
  • Aids in the design and delivery of full client presentations/proposals, client advocacy reports, client service plans and schedules
  • Coordinates the renewal process to establish and implement the client-specific renewal strategy, collaborates with WTW resources and industry groups to develop and deliver renewal to clients
  • Ensures all policy requirements (legal, regulatory & compliance) are met
  • Client-level coordination & management of all service delivery (GSD)
  • Engage Service Liaisons (Subject Matter Expert or Client Operations Specialist) on escalations
  • Gather and receive all client information working in collaboration with the Client Specialist
  • Responsible for coordination of all service delivery activities such as audits, completing second pair of eyes review on policies, resolving all accounting issues, managing aged receivables and bad debt, surplus lines affidavits, issuance of client invoicing and certificates of insurance and auto identification cards.

-

The Requirements

  • Targeted 5+ years of commercial Property & Casualty insurance knowledge/experience in a client-facing role, or demonstrated capabilities to complete role responsibilities
  • Able to apply knowledge of coverage forms in the analysis of program design, the identification of coverage gaps, and ongoing coverage consultation
  • Depending on the complexity of accountability to understand, interpret, analyze, and/or present analytical models
  • Relationship Management skills: ability to leverage internal and external relationships to bring WTW resources and assets tailored to client needs
  • Negotiation skills – the ability to drive conflict resolution and secure concessions without damaging relationships.
  • Business Acumen; knowledge of strategy, tactics, and solutions for the client, and/or in the marketplace
  • Knowledge of commercial insurance renewal end-to-end process, steps and owners
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; group presentation skills, ability to drive complex/technical conversations
  • Daily management of work assignments, mentoring, and collaboration with a Client Specialist
  • Receptive to feedback; critical thinking and problem-solving skills, high adaptability
  • Supports Client Advocate (CA) in advocating for change. Provides encouragement, takes control of client deliverables, and team projects, leads key delivery areas, collaborates with internal/external stakeholders, and provides clear guidance to ensure others fulfill roles effectively
  • Strong project management skills: Support the CA in end-to-end oversight of large, complex, ambiguous, or multi-dimensional projects
  • Proficient Microsoft Office skills and familiarity with other relevant online tools
  • Must achieve and maintain an active insurance broker’s P&C license, and complete various continuing education activities as needed
  • Insurance industry designations preferred but not required (CPCU, ARM, CIC, CRIS, CRM)

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $90,000-$120,000 USD per year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

Kuusistonkodilla ohjaajan tehtävänä on tukea asiakkaiden hyvinvointia, kuntoutumista, itsenäistä selviytymistä ja sujuvaa arkea asumisyksikössä. Työ perustuu asiakkaan yksilöllisiin tuen tarpeisiin, voimavaroihin ja tavoitteisiin. Sinulla on mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöhön suuntautuneen lähihoitajan tutkinto. Odotamme, että sinulla on koulutuksesi tai aiemman työsi kautta kokemusta mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä sekä neuropsykiatrisista häiriöistä. Omaat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, kommunikoit avoimesti ja luot hyvää työilmapiiriä. Olet työssäsi aktiivinen, pitkäjännitteinen ja innostava. Työssäsi tarvitset tietoteknisiä taitoja. title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
description:
The MongoDB Query Testing Tools Team is hiring Software Engineers who want to join us in building a state-of-the-art distributed query system. Our Team builds tooling that allows us to ship Query Engine features with high confidence in both correctness and performance, making it a great fit if you like seeing your work protect real customers at scale. The team develops advanced testing frameworks (end-to-end testing, fuzzing, property-based testing) as well as performance measurement tools, including high-volume workload generation tools.

The team is part of the Query organization which is responsible for the MongoDB Query Language and the lifecycle of each query, from parsing to optimization to plan selection; our engineers work on maintaining and improving our optimization and execution frameworks and building new query language features to help power our customers' critical workloads. Throughout all our work, our highest priority is always ensuring that customer queries are answered correctly. The successful applicant will be responsible for helping us to maintain the highest standards of quality through rigorous development, testing and automation strategies.

This role can be based out of our Dublin office, or remotely in Ireland.

Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in software development and/or performance engineering
  • Fluency in Python, Javascript or Typescript
  • Enjoys chasing down difficult problems in a distributed environment
  • Able to make complex concepts easy to grasp in written and spoken English
  • Able to decompose and solve complex problems and can rapidly iterate by validating new hypotheses and rethinking current assumptions
  • Demonstrating hands-on experience working with relational or NoSQL databases is a plus
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees of experience in database query engines is a plus
  • Experience in developing automation test frameworks is a plus
  • Experience in query processing engine testing is a strong plus
  • Experience in developing performance test plans and monitoring frameworks is a strong plus
  • Background in database query engines or compilers is a strong plus

Position Expectations

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks, Performance automated tests and internal tooling for the MongoDB query engine
  • Collaborate closely with peers to understand new features and functionalities, ensuring testability, test frameworks, tooling and coverage for automating tests of both happy-path and edge-case scenarios
  • Provide feedback in code reviews, focusing on the robustness and reliability of code changes

Success Measures

  • Within three months, you have gained an understanding of MongoDB's MQL syntax and its semantics, as well as the behavior of our unique query engine. You have contributed to several code bases on Mongodb engine internal tooling
  • By six months, you have established yourself as a key owner of automated test frameworks, and demonstrated improvements in test efficiency and coverage
  • After twelve months, you are instrumental in ensuring quality of major new features, setting an example for new team members in best practices for correctness and performance test automation and internal tooling

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: CBP Officer (Port Officer-In-Charge)
description:
Organizational Location: This position is with the Department of Homeland Security, within U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Office of Field Operations, Portland Field Office, Area Port of Portland located in Longview, WA.

This is a Reassignment Opportunity Bulletin: You must be currently serving or have previously served as a permanent GS-12 with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and are currently serving or have served in the 1895 series within the last five years to qualify under this Bulletin. If you hold or have previously held the GS-1895-13 level or higher and are willing to take a change to lower grade, you will also be considered for this position. Joining the Customs and Border Protection Office of Field Operations will allow you to use your expertise to detect and prevent terrorists and instruments of terror from entering the U.S. Apply for this exciting opportunity to strengthen Homeland Security by performing law enforcement activities such as inspection, intelligence analysis, examination, and interpretation of laws and regulations. This position starts at a salary of $99,111.00 (GS-12, Step 1) to $128,847.00 (GS-12, Step 10). Salary above includes Special Rate for Customs and Border Protection Officer positions in the Portland locality pay area. In this position you will become a key member of a team of homeland security professionals responsible for detecting and preventing terrorists and instruments of terror from entering the U.S. Typical work assignments include: Performing inspections and enforcement of persons, merchandise, and conveyances at ports of entry in the United States to not only ensure the legal entry of persons, merchandise, and conveyances, but also to prevent terrorists and instruments of terror from entering the United States. Interpreting and applying laws, rules, and regulations of over forty Federal agencies. Advising and assisting the public and trade community on CBP policies and procedures, including immigration and document requirements, import/export changes/restrictions, overages/shortages, weight discrepancies, misdirected shipments, or possible seizures of merchandise. Targeting, inspecting, and interviewing low to high risk, self-selected, and randomly selected persons, merchandise, conveyances, and cargo for contraband and compliance with applicable regulations with minimal to no supervision and/or guidance from a supervisor. Processing required documentation for other Federal agencies and serving as a direct liaison with those agencies as needed.

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position Males born after 12/31/1959 must be registered with Selective Service Primary U.S. residency for at least three of the last five years (additional details below) All pre-employment processes will be conducted in English You may be required to pass a background investigation and/or polygraph CBP follows the DHS Drug-Free Workplace Plan for drug testing procedures Firearm Requirement: This position requires that the incumbent meet initial and continuing qualifications in the use of firearms as outlined in the Gun Control Act of 1968, amended by the Lautenberg Amendment of 1996. An applicant whose background includes any of the following will be ineligible for consideration: 1) convicted of a crime punishable by imprisonment exceeding one year; 2) has any outstanding warrants or is a fugitive from justice; 3) unlawful user of or addicted to any controlled substance; 4) adjudicated as a mental defective or has been committed to a mental institution; 5) illegally or unlawfully in the United States; 6) renounced U. S. citizenship; 7) subject to a court-ordered restraining (protection) order from harassing, stalking, or threatening an intimate partner (spouse, former spouse, parent of applicant's child, individual who cohabitates or has cohabitated with the applicant), or child; or 8) convicted under Federal, State, or Tribal Court of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence against an intimate partner or child. Motor Vehicle Operation: You must possess the Ability to operate a Government Owned Vehicle. A valid, non-restricted driver's license is required. DHS uses E-Verify, an Internet-based system, to confirm the eligibility of all newly hired employees to work in the United States. Learn more about E-Verify including your rights and responsibilities. Bargaining Unit: This position is not covered under the bargaining unit. Must be able to obtain and maintain a SECRET national security clearance.

title: Ohjaaja (vakituinen työsuhde) VillaKapteeni
description:
