Ciklum is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our team full-time in Brazil.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Platform Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Our client is building a platform engineering function from the ground up and this role is at the center of it. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will be a founding team member with a clear, three-part mission: fully rearchitect and codify our cloud estate on AWS and Azure, stand up a world-class SRE and observability practice, and build an Internal Developer Platform with golden paths that make shipping software fast, safe, and self-service. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You will work directly with the Platform Engineering Manager to translate strategy into production infrastructure, drive adoption across engineering teams, and set the technical bar for how the platform is built and operated.

Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Modernization — Rearchitect & Codify:
    • Migrate all existing AWS and Azure infrastructure to OpenTofu/Terraform and Ansible; establish module standards, remote state, and GitOps-based plan/apply pipelines — no unmanaged resources
    • Audit the cloud estate against the AWS and Azure Well-Architected Frameworks; produce a remediation backlog and drive it to completion across networking, IAM, landing zones, account structure, and cost governance
    • Implement policy-as-code (OPA/Conftest, AWS SCPs, Azure Policy) to enforce security, tagging, and compliance guardrails at the platform layer — governance embedded, not bolted on
    • Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules for compute (EKS, AKS, EC2), networking, storage, databases, and identity as shared building blocks for all engineering teams
    • Define FinOps standards: tagging taxonomy, cost allocation dashboards, rightsizing recommendations, and reserved capacity planning across both clouds
  • SRE & Observability:
    • Design and implement the full observability stack: metrics (Prometheus/Datadog), logs (Loki/OpenSearch), traces (Tempo/Datadog APM), and dashboards (Grafana) — instrumented end-to-end via OpenTelemetry
    • Define SLIs and SLOs for all platform shared services and critical applications; build error budget dashboards and burn-rate alerting — alert on symptoms, not raw metrics
    • Establish the SRE practice from scratch: incident runbooks, post-incident review templates, and at least one chaos engineering exercise (AWS FIS or equivalent)
    • Partner with engineering teams to instrument their services, define meaningful alerts, and build operational dashboards — reliability is a shared responsibility, not a platform team tax
    • Build capacity planning models for compute and storage so engineering leadership can make data-driven scaling decisions
  • Internal Developer Platform & Golden Paths:
    • Deploy and operate a developer portal (Backstage, GitHub or equivalent) as the single front door: service catalog, scaffolding templates, runbooks, API docs, and on-call ownership all in one place
    • Build and maintain golden paths for the highest-frequency developer workflows: new service creation, Kubernetes deployment, database provisioning, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline setup - opinionated defaults with escape hatches for legitimate edge cases
    • Own the CI/CD platform layer: standardized pipeline templates (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), reusable workflow libraries, container image build and scan pipelines, and environment promotion workflows with security scanning (SAST, Snyk) built in by default
    • Own Kubernetes platform operations: EKS and/or AKS cluster lifecycle, Helm chart standards, admission controllers, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh (Istio or Linkerd)
    • Build the self-service provisioning layer — Backstage scaffolder actions and Terraform automation so developers can provision approved resources without raising a ticket
    • Measure adoption and run regular feedback sessions with engineering teams; iterate on golden paths based on real friction, not assumptions
  • Cross-Cutting Responsibilities:
    • Partner with peer managers and teams to plan and support migration of existing workloads onto the platform; provide hands-on migration support, not just documentation
    • Embed security by default across all platform work: IaC scanning (Checkov, tfsec), secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), RBAC, and container image hardening
    • Write clear technical documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and runbooks; raise the documentation bar for the whole team
    • Mentor and support more junior platform engineers; contribute to architecture reviews and build-vs-buy decisions alongside the Platform Engineering Manager

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering with direct production ownership on AWS and/or Azure
  • IaC: Deep OpenTofu/Terraform proficiency: module authoring, state management, workspace strategy, remote backends, and CI/CD integration; Terramate a plus
  • Kubernetes: Strong Kubernetes operations: EKS and/or AKS cluster lifecycle, Helm, admission controllers, RBAC, network policies, and autoscaling
  • Observability & SRE: Hands-on observability experience with two or more of: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry — including SLI/SLO definition and alert engineering
  • CI/CD: CI/CD platform experience: GitHub Actions pipeline authoring, reusable workflow design, and container build/scan pipeline ownership
  • GitOps: GitOps: ArgoCD or Flux for Kubernetes continuous delivery; progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue-green) a strong plus
  • IDP: IDP experience: Backstage or equivalent developer portal, GitHub, scaffolding templates, service catalog design, or self-service provisioning tooling
  • Security: Security-first mindset: policy-as-code, IaC scanning, secrets management, container hardening, and shift- left security practices
  • Strong communication and documentation skills; comfortable presenting architecture decisions to engineering peers and leadership

Desirable:

  • SRE background: chaos engineering (AWS FIS, Chaos Monkey), error budget management, incident command, and capacity planning
  • Service mesh depth: Istio or Linkerd — mTLS, traffic management, and observability integration
  • FinOps tooling (Kubecost, CloudHealth) and reserved capacity planning experience
  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure basics: LLM API integration or model serving, as the platform will need to support these workloads
  • Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator/Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Terraform Associate
  • Python or Go for platform tooling and CLI development

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year

  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications

  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally

  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays

  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode

  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential

  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients

  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Cardiac Diagnostic Technician
description:
Job Summary: The Cardiac Diagnostic Technician is responsible for providing basic and advanced electrophysiology services to pediatric, adolescent, adult and geriatric patients. The Technician implements standard EKG services and special procedures to include; extended event monitoring, 24/48 hour Holter monitoring, Stress testing, Stress/Nuclear Medicine procedures and Stress/Echo testing. The position also requires extensive scanning, analysis and report generation for Holter monitors received from the CarolinaEast Heart Centers and CIM physician offices. The Technician is also responsible for the day-to-day performance of the departmental duties to include; computerized document and data management systems, and documentation for billing purposes. The individual is required to deliver services to patients in all areas of the hospital and those services are to be performed day/evening/nights and weekends as required to provide continuous, consistent diagnostic testing. On-Call responsibilities are an important part of job requirements. The Cardiac Diagnostic Technician is to perform the duties and responsibilities outlined with minimal supervision and must be capable of making many independent decisions.

About CarolinaEast Health System

CarolinaEast Health System is committed to providing high quality, compassionate care across the Coastal Carolina region. At the heart of our system is a 350-bed, full-service medical center equipped with a comprehensive range of inpatient and outpatient services, utilizing the latest medical technologies. We employ over 3,200 dedicated team members and operate physician practices across various specialties in four counties. Our employees foster a culture of excellence that ensures our patients receive the same high level of care found at larger medical centers, all while maintaining a friendly, community-centered atmosphere throughout our facilities. CarolinaEast offers a robust benefits package to all full-time employees, as well as benefits for part-time plus and part-time staff. We are proud to be the first medical center in North Carolina recognized as a Cardiovascular Center of Excellence by the American College of Cardiology and the American Heart Association. Additionally, we are honored to be named one of America’s Best-In-State Hospitals by Newsweek, among numerous other prestigious accolades.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High School graduate.
  • Typing skills (40+ WPM), grammar/spelling abilities, and medical terminology required.
  • Previous experience and/or formal Cardiac Diagnostic training required.
  • Cardiographic Technician certification preferred.
  • Candidates must obtain CCT credential within one year of employment.
  • BCLS required.
  • Must be able to demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served.
  • The individual must demonstrate knowledge of the principles of growth and development over the life span and posses the ability to assess data reflective of the patient's status and interpret the appropriate information needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his/her age specific needs, and to provide the care needed as described in the department's policies and procedures.
  • Deliver outstanding customer service that upholds CarolinaEast's Standards of Excellence.

The team is also tasked with maintenance of the credit risk rating matrix and assessing compliance with established financial parameters and keeping current on new accounting and regulatory pronouncements that impact member firms.


Your Primary Responsibilities:

  • Analyze financial statements to identify credit risks, mitigants, and trends for financial institutions’ (e.g., banks, broker-dealers, etc.) capital adequacy, profitability, asset quality, and liquidity/funding management.
  • Perform annual reviews and ongoing surveillance of member firms, with guidance from management, to assess the creditworthiness of member firms and identify member firms that need to be subjected to additional surveillance or mitigants.
  • Assist with credit risk monitoring tools, automation, and other risk-related initiatives.
  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Market Risk, Product Management, Relationship Management, Legal, and Compliance, such as to share information on risk exposures to member firms.
  • Apply a basic understanding of DTCC's business, CCR's processes, and the risk environment.
  • Demonstrate values, including adherence to risk-related policies, regulatory awareness, and a risk management mindset.
  • Responsible for a smaller portfolio of less complex counterparties.
  • Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 2 years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

Talents Needed for Success:

  • Collaborates well within and across teams.
  • Communicates openly with team members and others.
  • Works with the team to review deliverables and ensure quality and accuracy.
  • Adheres to established rules and procedures when performing work.

title: Customs Manager - Argos
description:
About the team

The Customs team sits within Finance and helps move goods in a compliant, efficient and well-controlled way. Working across Tax and Treasury, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Logistics and business change, the team protects value through effective risk management, sustainable duty optimisation and reliable customs data. This is a visible leadership role with the opportunity to shape customs governance, improve capability and influence decisions across a complex importing organisation.

More about the role

As Customs Manager, you will lead customs activity and manage two Customs Analysts. You will own customs declaration processes, procedures, systems and data, including duty payments and reconciliations, and ensure compliance with customs legislation across relevant goods movements, including those involving Northern Ireland. You will also maintain registrations, guarantees, authorisations and deferment accounts, including Simplified Customs Declaration Process requirements.

Day to day, you will lead governance for customs valuation, tariff classification and origin, identify sustainable opportunities to optimise duty, and provide practical advice on sourcing, suppliers, logistics and new routes. You will manage relationships with customs authorities, brokers, advisers and auditors, including enquiries, disclosures and remediation. You will also embed customs requirements into business and technology change, improve management information and automation, and build customs capability across the team and wider stakeholder community.

More about you

You will bring demonstrable knowledge of UK customs legislation and practice across classification, valuation, origin, declarations and customs authorisations. You will understand how brokers, supply-chain operations, import data, duty and import VAT accounting connect, and be able to turn complex customs requirements into clear, practical actions for senior and operational stakeholders.

You will combine analytical and commercial judgement with a clear commitment to compliance. You will be able to assess risk, identify sustainable duty opportunities and lead constructive relationships with external authorities and partners. As a people leader, you will set priorities, develop customs capability and provide direction through operational or technology change. A relevant customs or tax qualification, or equivalent substantial experience, is required.

Essential criteria

  • A relevant customs or tax qualification, or equivalent demonstrable experience leading customs activity.

  • Practical knowledge of UK customs legislation and practice covering tariff classification, valuation, origin, declarations and customs authorisations.

  • Proven experience of leading customs compliance and risk management within a large or complex importing organisation.

  • Evidence of managing customs authority audits or enquiries and working with customs brokers, external advisers or logistics partners.

  • Demonstrable experience of leading colleagues and embedding customs requirements into supply-chain, systems or business change.

title: Radiologian erikoislääkäri Akuutti24-päivystykseen, Julkiset palvelut, Päijät-Häme
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt Radiologian erikoislääkäriä akuuttipäivystykseen.

Tarjolla yhdelle tai kahdelle vakituiselle radiologille (mielellään toimenpideradiologi tai päivystysradiologian erityispätevyyden omaava radiologi) paikka päivystysringistä. Toimitamme vuoden jokaisena viikonloppuna ja pyhäpäivänä radiologipäivystäjän Akuuttipäivystykseen. Päivystysviikonloppu sisältää 65,5 h (pe klo 15 - ma klo 08.30). Viikonloppuja on mahdollista jakaa toisen kollegan kanssa.

Työ sisältää normaalin päivystystyön, natiivi- ja leiketutkimusten lausumisen sekä toimenpiteet, pois lukien Angiografiat. Päivystys päättyy maanantain aamumeetingiin. Akuuttipäivystys on hektinen ja vaativia toimipaikka, jossa työskennellään vahvalla osaamisella ja laatu edellä.

Yöpymis- ja lausumismahdollisuus oma omisteisessa rivitaloasunnossa, 400m Akuuttipäivystyksestä.

Terveystalo tarjoaa monipuolisia Henkilöstöpalveluita hyvinvointialueille ja yksityisille yrityksille lyhytaikaiseen sekä pitkäaikaiseen tarpeeseen. Terveystalon Henkilöstöpalveluissa räätälöimme sinulle sopivan työkokonaisuuden, joka voi sisältää esimerkiksi pidemmän työkokonaisuuden yhdessä toimipaikassa, viikoittaisia vakiovuoroja tietyissä toimipisteissä tai satunnaisia keikkavuoroja silloin, kun sinulle sopii. Kauttamme voit tehdä töitä esimerkiksi terveysasemilla, vuodeosastoilla ja päivystyksissä. Tarjoamme sinulle aina omiin ammatillisiin kiinnostuksenkohteisiisi ja omiin kehitystavoitteisiisi sopivia työkokonaisuuksia. Yhteyshenkilömme ovat ammattilaisten keskuudessa todella pidettyjä (lääkärikollegojesi suositteluindeksi-NPS 4,6/5). Et jää missään vaiheessa yksin, ja yhteyshenkilösi huolehtii kaikista käytännön asioista, jotta sinä voit keskittyä olennaiseen.

Lue lisää lääkäreiden kokemuksista Terveystalon Julkisissa palveluissa työskentelystä!

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.
- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kilpailukykyinen palkitseminen ja monipuoliset edut. Meillä palkitseminen ja palkkiomallit ovat kilpailukykyiset, ja tarjoamme työsuhteisille ammattilaisillemme monipuoliset työsuhteen edut, kuten lounas- sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun, kumppanialennukset ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, joka sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja laajasti mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, mm. lyhytpsykoterapian. Ammatinharjoittajille tarjoamme vaihtuvat kumppanietumme ja muun muassa mahdollisuuden sopimushintaiseen työterveyshuoltoon. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. title: Lead Principal Platform Software Engineer
description:
Join the OCI AI team to build and operate cloud platforms and services that power AI workloads at scale. In this IC5 individual contributor role, you will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and implementation through production operations, translating ambiguous customer and business needs into secure, reliable, and efficient solutions.

You will combine deep distributed systems expertise with hands-on software development, guide technical decisions across teams, and mentor engineers. Adhere to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; coach engineers across teams or units to drive improvements. Act as subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develop documents to clarify software. Your work will shape shared platform capabilities, improve service performance and operational excellence, and deliver measurable customer impact.

We take an AI-forward approach to engineering. You will use AI throughout the software development lifecycle and help teams adopt effective AI-assisted workflows for design, coding, testing, review, debugging, and operations. You will pair these capabilities with rigorous validation, sound engineering judgment, and accountability for production outcomes.

  • Own the technical direction and end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives spanning multiple teams, from requirements and architecture through implementation, rollout, and operations.
  • Design and build distributed platforms and services for OCI AI workloads, balancing availability, latency, throughput, scalability, resource utilization, and cost.
  • Write and review critical production code, develop prototypes to resolve technical uncertainty, and lead resolution of complex engineering problems.
  • Establish shared platform capabilities and standards for identity, configuration, APIs, client libraries, interoperability, and lifecycle management.
  • Lead AI-driven engineering practices across design, implementation, testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Build reusable AI-assisted tools and workflows; measure their impact on delivery speed, software quality, developer effort, and operational effectiveness.
  • Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through engineering review, automated testing, and security checks, using approved tools and protecting sensitive information.
  • Define testing and release strategies covering functionality, performance, security, resilience, and compatibility; establish quality evaluations and regression checks for AI capabilities where applicable.
  • Own production readiness and service health through service-level objectives, observability, capacity planning, safe deployments, rollback strategies, and incident response.
  • Partner with customers, product teams, and engineering stakeholders to prioritize needs, resolve issues, and deliver durable improvements.
  • Lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and influence technical decisions and engineering standards across teams.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies through practical experimentation and adopt approaches that demonstrate measurable customer and engineering value.

title: Johtava tutkija, ruokajärjestelmät
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa vaikuttavaa, kansainvälisesti tunnustettua tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiotoimintaa?

Haemme osaavaan joukkoomme ruokajärjestelmät tutkimusalalle vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen tehtävään johtavaa tutkijaa kehittämään yritysten tarpeista lähtevää soveltavaa tutkimusta ja TKI-toimintaa. Tehtävässä vastaat erityisesti kansainvälisen ja Business Finland -rahoituksen hakemisesta sekä yritysverkostojen ja tutkimuskonsortioiden rakentamisesta.

Johtavan tutkijan keskeisiin tehtäviin kuuluu mm.
- Työelämä- ja sidosryhmäverkostojen rakentaminen ja ylläpitäminen
- Tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiotarpeiden tunnistaminen yhdessä yritysten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa
- Hankkeiden etenkin kansainvälisten hankkeiden valmistelu, rahoituksen hakeminen ja kehittämisteemojen edistäminen
- Alueellisen ja etenkin kansainvälisen yhteistyön kehittäminen
- TKI-toiminnan suunnittelu, koordinointi ja tuloksellisuuden edistäminen

Johtavan tutkijan tehtävään edellytämme sinulta:
-Soveltuvaa tohtorin tutkintoa
-Vahvaa alan työelämäkokemusta
-Valmiuksia työskennellä suomen ja englannin kielellä
-Hyviä vuorovaikutus-, yhteistyö- ja verkostoitumistaitoja
-Kokemusta hanketoiminnasta sekä hankerahoituksen, erityisesti kansainvälisen rahoituksen, hakemisesta
-Kiinnostusta ja rohkeutta kehittämistyöhön
-Tuloksellista ja yhteistyöhakuista työotetta


Odotamme sinulta:

Sinulla on vahvat vuorovaikutus- ja verkostoitumistaidot sekä aito kiinnostus kansainväliseen yhteistyöhön. Tunnistat ennakoivasti uusia kehittämismahdollisuuksia ja osaat rakentaa yhteistyötä yritysten, korkeakoulujen, tutkimusorganisaatioiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Toimit luontevasti kansainvälisissä verkostoissa ja näet ulkopuolisen rahoituksen mahdollisuutena vahvistaa alueen yritysten kilpailukykyä sekä Savonian TKI-toimintaa. Arvostamme aktiivista, tavoitteellista ja yhteistyöhakuista työotetta sekä kykyä viedä kehitysideoita kohti rahoitettuja hankkeita ja konkreettisia tuloksia.

Lopullinen tehtävänkuva muotoutuu valitun henkilön osaamisen ja kiinnostuksen mukaan. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä ja mielekästä työtä yhdessä Suomen parhaista ja innostavimmista työpaikoista. Työskentelemme moderneissa toimitiloissa kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja teemme yhteistyötä työelämän kanssa. Tehtävän pääpaikkana on Kuopion kampuksella, mutta tehtävään voi kuulua työskentelyä myös muilla Savonian kampuksilla. Meillä on myös käytössä liukuva työaika, joka auttaa työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista.

Työsuhteen ehdot ja palkkaus määräytyvät Sivistan ammattikorkeakoulujen työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti. Tehtävän sopimuspalkka. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Tehtävään valitulla on kuuden kuukauden koeaika.

Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 8.11.2026. Lähetä sähköinen hakemus Kuntarekryn kautta (www.kuntarekry.fi).

Miksi Savonia?

Arvostamme yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. Vastuullisella johtamisella haluamme mahdollistaa merkityksellisen ja tuloksellisen työn yhdessä Suomen parhaista työpaikoista.

Savoniassa henkilöstön osaamisen kehittäminen ja hyvinvointi ovat meille tärkeitä. Tarjoamme henkilöstölle kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten Epassin, SYKETTÄ-liikuntapalvelut ja työterveyshuollon palvelut. Kampuksilla tarjoamme työpäivän aikana kahvit, teet ja kaakaot. Lisäksi kannustamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan jatkuvasti, ja siksi tarjoamme työntekijöillemme mahdollisuuden opiskella veloituksetta Savonian avoimessa ammattikorkeakoulussa. Olemme ylpeitä yhteisömme tuloksista ja palkitsemme henkilöstöämme onnistumisista säännöllisesti.

title: Materials Handler
description:
This position is located in the Warehouse area of the Logistics Service in a Veteran Affairs Health Care System performing warehouse work that involves receiving, storing, selecting, and shipping general or specialized bulk and bin materials and equipment.

Major duties and responsibilities include: Receives, stores and ships bin and bulk supplies, materials and equipment. Prepares shipping and inventory documents for manual or automated inventory systems. Selects specific storage locations within framework of general warehousing plan. Rotates stock, check for outdated materials and maintains the appropriate safeguards and temperature controls. Handles delivering and warehousing materials including hazardous, flammable and temperature sensitive products. Participates in conducting inventory of stock on hand and communicates discrepancies. Ensures products and shelving are marked with corresponding identification numbers. Load and unload shipments from trucks and other material conveyances. Makes off-site deliveries in motor vehicles typically with a gross weight of less than 4500 pounds. Performs other related duties as assigned. Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 7:00am-3:30pm Recruitment & Relocation Incentives: Not authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959 Pre-employment physical required Subject to background/security investigation Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP) As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your probationary period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

title: Vesitalousasiantuntija, vesistörakenteet, eteläinen vesistöyksikkö
description:
Lounais-Suomen elinvoimakeskuksen vesitalousosaston eteläisessä vesistöyksikössä, jonka toimialueena ovat Varsinais-Suomen, Satakunnan, Pirkanmaan ja Kanta-Hämeen maakunnat, on haettavana vesitalousasiantuntijan määräaikainen virkasuhde ajalle 1.1.2027-31.1.2029. Tehtävä voi mahdollisesti jatkua määräajan jälkeen. Tehtävän sijoituspaikka on Tampereen toimipiste.

Tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti vesitalouden asiantuntijatehtäviä. Tehtävänhaltijan päätehtävät ovat:
- Valtion vastuulla olevien vesistösäännöstelytehtävien toteutus ja muiden säännöstelyn luvanhaltijoiden ohjaus eri vesitilanteissa Kokemäenjoen vesistöalueella.
- Tulva- ja kuivuusriskien vähentämiseen tähtäävien toimenpiteiden ja hankkeiden edistäminen ja ohjaus yhteistyössä sidosryhmien kanssa.
- Tulvatilanteessa ja tulvan uhatessa osallistuminen tilannekuvan tuottamiseen, viranomaisyhteistyön järjestämiseen ja asiantuntijatuen antamiseen muille sidosryhmille.
- Valtion vesioikeudellisten lupien lupavelvoitteista sekä vesistörakenteiden kunnossapidosta, perusparannuksista ja patoturvallisuudesta vastaaminen Pirkanmaan alueella.
- Maa- ja metsätalouden vesienhallinnan osalta kuivatushankkeiden ja -kuivatusyhtiöiden ohjaus ja neuvonta sekä vesienhallintahankkeiden edistäminen.

Työssä on tärkeää yhteensovittaa vesienkäytön erilaisia tarpeita kuten tulvasuojelu, vesivoimatuotanto, vesienhoito ja virkistyskäyttö sekä ottaa huomioon ilmastonmuutos. Tehtävän hoidossa pääsee verkostoitumaan laajasti muun hallinnon, yritysten ja asiakasryhmien kanssa.

title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana omassa kodissa, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Pirkkalaan.P Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla. Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava tulo on keskimäärin noin 3000 € / kk, kun sinulla on neljä hoitolasta ja sinulle kertyy vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpielämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta tai halua opiskella työn ohessa
* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia
* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja
* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Valmiin Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitokonseptin, joka on jo usean yrittäjämme toimesta todettu toimivaksi. Konsepti sisältää kaiken tarvittavan menestyneen perhepäivähoidon pyörittämiseen.
* Kaiken tarvittavan avun yrityksen perustamiseen ja pyörittämiseen. Kaikki on valmiiksi mietitty ja selvitetty puolestasi. Koulutuksemme ja ketjun jatkuva tuki varmistaa, ettet koskaan jää talousasioiden kanssa yksin.
* Ihanan Kultapalat-yhteisön, jossa pääset vaihtamaan ajatuksia muiden Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajien kanssa.




Hae rohkeasti mukaan, tässä porukassa on kivaa sekä aikuisilla että lapsilla!

title: Quality Systems Administrator
description:
Job title: Quality Systems Administrator

Department: New Product Development

Location: The Vision Centre, Adanac Park, Southampton

GLS: P01

Working hours: Full Time, Monday-Friday, 0830-1630. On site 5 days per week.

A brighter future awaits you

CooperVision is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of soft contact lenses with a presence in over 100 countries. Being part of CooperVision means helping improve the way people see each day. It’s more than making contact lenses, it’s about giving lens wearers freedom and confidence to move about their daily lives. We’re all about bright futures – for our people and those who wear our contact lenses.

Job summary – What to expect:

The Quality Systems Administrator will be based in UK R&D site (The Vison Centre – Nursling) as part of the UK R&D QA team and will be reporting to the Principal R&D Quality Systems Manager. This position focuses on supporting the UK R&D QMS and any CooperVision global initiatives in which R&D QA is involved in.

In this role you will work as part of a team monitoring and improving all areas of the Company’s Quality System including supporting and promoting quality assurance and compliance activities.

  • Responsible for the Document Change Control Process and Simple Approvals including conducting Quality review of DCOs, APPs and creation of document numbers within the Quality System.

  • Responsible for the review and approval of the Batch Records to ensure compliance with GMP / GDP requirements.

  • Supports the CAPA and NCR investigation to ensure timely and effective closure in line with the quality objective metrics and assists in reviewing root cause investigations.

title: Senior Integrated Producer
description:
Brandtech+ (formerly known as OLIVER+) is a global team of creative thinkers, tech-savvy trendsetters, and production pros specialising in film, CGI, automation, AI, motion design, and digital/print content. Role: Senior Integrated Producer

A little bit about the role:

Join our dynamic team as a Snr. Integrated Producer, where you'll lead production efforts for one our global brands. Reporting to the Delivery Lead, you'll closely collaborate with global and regional teams, fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders and driving impactful content post-production and global adaptations.

As the Snr. Integrated Producer, you possess expertise in global brand campaign production cycles, emphasizing your passion for crafting engaging creative across various media platforms. Your role requires a deep understanding of the production and delivery processes for broadcast, online and digital media. You'll spearhead project management, assessing campaign volumes, and scoping while reviewing production schedules and providing direction to Project Managers. Your role involves tailoring bespoke timings based on local market lead times and resource availability.

You'll maintain close coordination with the Account manager to ensure adherence to campaign milestones, quality standards, and timely delivery. As a motivating force within the team, you'll inspire your direct reports to excel in their roles, while facilitating effective communication across global and regional teams to align with overarching production objectives. Acting as the central point of contact, you'll relay status updates, risks, and challenges of all campaign deliverables, including budget and resource considerations, while escalating production issues to the Regional and Channel Leads.

What you will be doing:

  • Overall responsible for regional delivery, supporting the Delivery lead to deliver a high volume of localized assets, ensuring alignment with client objectives and brand guidelines.
  • Support Regional Project Manager on project planning, status, risks, and challenges.
  • Client communicator for detailed timeline-specific project queries.
  • Creating production timelines according to SLA’s, building pipeline campaign forecasts to identify production peaks to resource PMs accordingly.
  • Briefing the Design team on campaign specifics, timings and scope.
  • Overseeing and signing off IPMs adapted timings based on local market nuance.
  • Tracking regional pre-production tasks such as translations, Voice over recordings, price validation, global master approvals and market participation.
  • Escalating resource shortfalls to Regional Lead and channel leads.
  • Overseeing and tracking PMs delivery progress, feeding status reports to regional and channel leads.
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders such delivery companies and other suppliers
  • Lead regional production, localisation & delivery, ensuring direction, control, and effective communication throughout the process.
  • Oversee TV, social, digital and print campaigns covering owned and bought media, managing multiple campaigns, languages, and channels.
  • Direct and manage VO recording sessions, manage usage rights.
  • Drive campaign execution, and closure, monitoring progress, controlling deadlines, engaging relevant stakeholders and ensuring successful delivery.
  • Support the Regional Lead to produce data-lead monthly reporting and strategic QBRs, as well as support across invoicing and out-of-scope work.
  • Lead daily stand-up calls with Satellite Studio teams, ensuring production is on track and providing an escalation point to the Global Account director and Delivery Lead.
  • Review global campaigns, familiarise yourself with forecast data, to drive foresight of production.
  • Support the Regional Lead on campaign kick-off calls, assisting on out-of-scope and out-of-guideline conversations as needed.
  • Ensure brand guardianship of local briefs and global guideline changes, while rolling out local campaigns in the sales market and re-iterating local SLAs.
  • Support Regional Lead with cost estimates for additional resource where needed.
  • Champion automation and future-facing ways of working.

What you need to be great in this role:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in broadcast, digital & social video and print, covering owned and bought media.
  • Experience working with multiple campaigns, languages, and channels.
  • Demonstrated production experience on global brands with line management experience.
  • Strong account & project management skills, with experience managing onsite and offshore teams.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
  • Proven ability to drive successful campaign production lifecycles, with an ability to assess risk in real time adapt using agile methodology.
  • Proficiency forecasting, resource management and project burn rate.
  • Keen eye for detail and commitment to innovation and new business growth.

THIS ROLE IS RIGHT FOR YOU IF...

You’re someone who thrives on shared successes, especially as part of a team that’s making waves with innovative processes & high-volume delivery. Unexpected turns energise you, and you take challenges head-on, inspiring your entire team to find solutions and stay the course. Your positive spirit keeps your sleeves rolled up, always ready to seize every opportunity.

You’ll be the kind of person who is driven by producing large volume multi-media campaigns curating timelines and motivating your team ensure high quality creative delivered with maximum efficiency. You’ll be confident with clients and thinks on their feet. You relish adding value throughout the end-to-end creative process, adding your unique touch at every turn.

Ideally, you’ll have experience in large-scale accounts in FMCG industries and experience across multiple channels – because we do the lot, from TV to DOOH to press to 121 to display, social and content.

You’ll already be a Producer looking for bigger challenges on a larger account where you can hone your existing skills and cultivate new ones.

  • Guides implementation of strategic solutions for customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.

  • Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

  • Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.

  • Participates in peer review processes and provides technical leadership with initiatives to ensure quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

  • Demonstrates, contributes to, and shares deep expertise of industry best practices and their application to software development processes.

  • Implements highly complex secure software development practices/solutions requiring modern/emerging innovation to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Continuous Learning:

Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

title: Kuntoutuslääkäri
description:
Lääkäri, kiinnostaako sinua merkityksellinen työ kuntoutuksessa? Tule kuntoutuslääkäriksi Coronarialle!



Etsimme kuntoutuslääkäriä vahvistamaan moniammatillista tiimiämme Tampereella ja Nokialla. Kokonaisvaltainen kuntoutuslääkärin työ on monipuolista ja laaja-alaisesti potilaan fyysisen, psyykkisen ja sosiaalisen hyvinvoinnin tukemista. Tarjoamme ammatillisesti kiinnostavan työn, jossa pääset tukemaan asiakkaidemme työ- ja toimintakykyä sekä rakentamaan heidän kanssaan polkuja kohti parempaa arkea.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu kuntoutujien tapaamisia ja kuntoutussuunnitelmien laatimista Kelan ammatillisen kuntoutusselvityksen (AKSE) palveluissa, KIILA-kursseilla, aikuisten moniammatillisessa yksilökuntoutuksessa sekä omaishoitajien parikursseilla. Lisäksi pääset ohjaamaan ryhmämuotoisia tapaamisia TULES-kursseilla. Työ on ammatillisesti kiinnostavaa, sillä asiakkaamme ovat hyvin monipuolisia diagnooseiltaan sekä taustoiltaan ja pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi laajasti.

Työtä tehdään Coronarian Tampereen Hämeenkadun, Lapinniemenrannan ja Sarvijaakonkadun toimipisteissä sekä Nokian Paratiisikadun toimipisteessä. Monipuolinen toimintaympäristö tuo vaihtelua työpäiviin ja mahdollisuuden tehdä yhteistyötä eri kuntoutuspalveluiden ammattilaisten kanssa.

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja aloitusajankohdasta voidaan sopia joustavasti. Työaika on 80 prosenttia täydestä työajasta. Työaika tasoittuu kalenterikuukausittain, joten työpäivien määrä voi vaihdella viikoittain. Työ ajoittuu arkipäiviin. Meillä saat kattavan perehdytyksen sekä vahvan kollegiaalisen tuen ja pääset osaksi alan johtavaa ja kasvavaa organisaatiota.

Meillä pääset osaksi osaavaa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, jossa moniammatillinen yhteistyö on vahva osa arkea. Tiimissämme työskentelee eri kuntoutusalojen ammattilaisia, ja yhdessä tuotamme laadukkaita kuntoutuspalveluja asiakkaidemme parhaaksi. Olemme savuton työpaikka ja meille on tärkeää, että työympäristömme on turvallinen ja viihtyisä kaikille.

Meille on tärkeää, että työ ja muu elämä ovat tasapainossa. Siksi tarjoamme joustavia työskentelymahdollisuuksia erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin. Voit työskennellä meillä työsuhteisena, ammatinharjoittajana tai oman yrityksesi kautta.

Voit olla etsimämme osaaja, jos olet erikoislääkäri ja erikoisalasi on fysiatria, reumatologia, työterveyshuolto, sisätaudit tai yleislääketiede. Eduksi on laaja-alainen lääketieteellinen osaaminen, hyvät yhteistyötaidot sekä kyky huomioida kuntoutujan elämäntilanne kokonaisuutena.

title: Director, Power Operations (on-site Shackelford County, TX)
description:
>>This position will be full-time on-site at Oracle's data center site in Shackelford County, near Abilene, TX. Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Oracle’s relocation policies.<<

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) powers Oracle’s global cloud services through highly available, large-scale, enterprise-grade data center environments. The Data Center Infrastructure Operations / Facilities team plays a critical role in sustaining OCI’s performance, security, and operational resilience by ensuring infrastructure systems operate reliably at scale. You will join a technically rigorous organization with a culture grounded in operational excellence, disciplined processes, and continuous improvement, where infrastructure reliability, safety, and execution quality are foundational to delivering cloud services worldwide.

Role Overview

The Director of Power Operations is responsible for leading the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of power generation and delivery assets supporting OCI’s energy resilience strategy. This role provides operational leadership across power plants, ensuring high availability, regulatory compliance, and optimized lifecycle performance of generation assets.

The Director will lead plant operations teams while partnering closely with construction, maintenance, engineering, and site operations organizations to ensure generation capacity meets the reliability requirements of OCI’s data center infrastructure. The role also supports fuel procurement strategy, power purchase agreements (PPAs), and coordination with power providers/stakeholders and regulators to ensure long-term operational stability.

Key Responsibilities

Plant Operations Leadership

  • Lead day-to-day operations of power generation facilities to ensure safe, reliable, and continuous power generation.

  • Build, develop, and cultivate relationships that lead to high-performing plant operations teams responsible for power operations, maintenance coordination, and plant reliability.

  • Establish operational standards, procedures, and framework to ensure optimal resiliency and reliability, manage risks, and maintain up-time of data center assets.

  • Drive a culture of operational excellence, compliance, safety, and accountability across all generation sites.

Reliability & Performance

  • Ensure power assets achieve high availability and reliability targets supporting critical infrastructure operations.

  • Monitor plant performance, availability, heat rate, and operational KPIs to drive continuous improvement.

  • Partner with maintenance and engineering teams to optimize preventative maintenance programs and minimize forced outages.

  • Oversee incident investigations and root cause analysis to improve long-term asset performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with operations, construction, and maintenance teams to support commissioning, startup, and integration of new power assets to ensure on time delivery and optimal operational configurations and design.

  • Partner with engineering teams on lifecycle management, upgrades, and plant optimization initiatives.

  • Coordinate with site operations and reliability teams to ensure plant generation aligns with data center load requirements both in construction delivery and day-to-day operations.

Fuel & Commercial Management

  • Support natural gas procurement strategy and coordinate fuel supply agreements to ensure consistent and cost-effective plant operations.

  • Participate in the review and management of power purchase agreements (PPAs) and energy supply contracts.

  • Work with utilities and/or power suppliers to coordinate generation capacity and grid interconnection requirements.

Compliance, Safety & Governance

  • Ensure all plant operations comply with applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain strict adherence to EH&S standards and company safety programs.

  • Ensure compliance with environmental permits, emissions standards, and operational reporting requirements.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with regulatory agencies and utilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 15+ years of experience in power generation operations, preferably in gas power/combined cycle plants or Reciprocating Engine experience.

  • Proven leadership experience managing plant operations teams in mission-critical or utility scale environments.

  • Deep understanding of power operations, plant controls, fuel systems, and generation reliability.

  • Experience supporting gas procurement, fuel supply management, and power purchase agreements (PPAs).

  • Strong experience working across operations, construction, engineering, and maintenance organizations. Strong project management/delivery experience is a plus.

Skills and Competencies

  • Demonstrated leadership managing complex generation operations and plant teams.

  • Strong operational decision-making in high-reliability environments.

  • Ability to balance plant reliability, operational efficiency, and cost management.

  • Strong stakeholder management with utilities, regulators, OEMs, and internal leadership teams.

  • Experience implementing safety programs, operational governance, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

Why Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?

• Global impact at scale: Contribute directly to how mission-critical OCI data centers operate across regions and continents, influencing infrastructure reliability, security, sustainability, and long-term capacity growth.
• Technically rigorous environment: Work alongside experienced engineers, automation specialists, and compliance teams in a rapidly scaling hyperscale cloud infrastructure, where disciplined execution and technical depth matter.
• Culture built on operational excellence: Join an organization that values safety, process rigor, clear accountability, and continuous improvement as foundational to protecting uptime and customer trust.
• Long-term career development: Benefit from internal mobility, role-based technical training, and development opportunities designed for professionals building long-term careers in cloud infrastructure and facilities operations.

Disclaimer:

Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements.

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.

title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
Here's an overview of what it typically involves, along with the qualifications and skills needed

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Data Pipeline Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming ETL pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, Python, and SQL.
  • Lakehouse Implementation: Build and manage data solutions leveraging Delta Lake and medallion architecture principles to support trusted and reusable data products.
  • Data Integration: Integrate data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, files, and cloud platforms to enable unified analytics and reporting.
  • Data Modeling & Transformation: Develop efficient data models and transformation frameworks that support business intelligence, advanced analytics, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Platform Optimization: Monitor and optimize Databricks workloads, cluster configurations, and data processing performance to ensure scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Implement data quality checks, monitoring, lineage, security controls, and governance practices in alignment with enterprise standards.
  • DevOps & Automation: Contribute to CI/CD implementation, automated deployments, testing frameworks, and release management for data engineering solutions.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with business stakeholders, data architects, analytics teams, and AI engineers to deliver data products that support business outcomes.
  • AI & Analytics Enablement: Enable downstream AI, machine learning, and Generative AI initiatives by building reliable, high-quality, and governed data foundations.
  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Stay current with advancements in Databricks, cloud technologies, and modern data engineering practices to continuously enhance platform capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 4 - 6 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in Python, PySpark and SQL

    • Experience in designing and implementing: Medallion Architecture, Data Quality Frameworks, Data Governance Controls, Metadata and Lineage Solutions
    • Experience with orchestration and workflow management tools such as Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
    • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, Git-based source control, automated testing, and deployment automation.
    • Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and modern Lakehouse architectures.
    • Exposure to Databricks Mosaic AI, Vector Search, MLflow, feature engineering, or GenAI data preparation workflows (Preferred).
    • Familiarity with data preparation for RAG, LLM, and AI/ML use cases (Preferred).
    • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and containerization technologies (Preferred).
  • Certifications: Relevant certifications in data engineering, such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional, or similar. (Preferred not mandatory)
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to design scalable data solutions and resolve complex data engineering challenges.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to deliver data and analytics solutions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Experience engaging with business stakeholders to understand data and analytics requirements and translate them into scalable data engineering solutions.

title: General Engineer
description:
This position is part of the Office of Environmental Management - Portsmouth Paducah Project Office, Department of Energy. As a General Engineer, you will serve as an expert advisor providing strategic leadership for major Department of Energy (DOE) scientific and engineering initiatives. You will also develop and implement technical guidance for complex systems, projects, and programs to resolve novel, mission-critical management and operational challenges.

The mission of Portsmouth/Paducah Project Office (PPPO) is to manage the DOE cleanup efforts at two gaseous diffusion plant sites - Portsmouth (Piketon), Ohio, and Paducah, Kentucky. The PPPO conducts environmental remediation, waste management, depleted Uranium Hexafluoride (DUF6) conversion, and decontamination and decommissioning at the plant sites. PPPO's goal is to accelerate cleanup, eliminating potential environmental threats, reducing the DOE footprint, and reducing life-cycle cost. We are truly honored that DOE has been named America's #1 Best Employer for Veterans in 2023 by Forbes-not only among Government agencies, but among employers across the U.S. We are so proud of this ranking which reflects our commitment to the employment of veterans. As so many veterans at DOE renew their service to our Nation, we are deeply committed to their success and advancement. Veterans shape the future of energy As a General Engineer, you will: Direct high-impact scientific and engineering programs lacking technical precedent to to meet key organizational goals and missions. Represent the agency on interagency task forces and before groups such as Congress, state officials, and industry partners to deliver technical briefing or testimony. Evaluates technical maturity and scientific trends across complex technology options to guide decision-making and reduce operational risks. Serve as a technical authority, formulating and implementing key policies while providing strategic counsel to senior leadership and external partners. Develop cross-organizational guidance to resolve complex engineering problems and drive collaborative opportunities with public and private partners.

title: Hydrauliikka-asentaja kasvavaan teollisuusyritykseen
description:
Kiinnostaako sinua työ, jossa pääset rakentamaan ja kokoamaan korkealaatuisia hydrauliikkaratkaisuja vaativiin käyttökohteisiin ympäri maailmaa?

Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme hydrauliikka-asentajaa Tampereen Hervantaan. Kyseessä on kasvun vuoksi avautuva paikka yrityksessä, joka valmistaa erikoisventtiilejä ja hydraulisia kokonaisuuksia muun muassa kallioporalaitteisiin, metsäkoneisiin ja öljynporausympäristöihin.

Tämä tehtävä sopii erinomaisesti uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle asentajalle. Tärkeintä ei ole työkokemus, vaan halu oppia, kehittyä ja ottaa vastuuta omasta työstä.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ TEHDÄÄN?

Työ painottuu hydrauliikkakomponenttien mekaaniseen asennukseen ja kokoonpanoon modernissa tuotantoympäristössä.

Työtehtäviä ovat esimerkiksi:

* Hydrauliikkaventtiilien ja -kokoonpanojen asentaminen

* Mekaaninen kokoonpanotyö piirustusten ja työohjeiden mukaisesti

* Osakokoonpanojen rakentaminen ja viimeistely

* Komponenttien tarkastaminen ja laadunvarmistus

* Yhteistyö tuotannon muiden ammattilaisten kanssa

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

* Perustaidot mekaanisesta asennuksesta tai kokoonpanotyöstä

* Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta

* Halua oppia hydrauliikka-alan erikoisosaamista

* Kykyä käyttää yleisimpiä käsityökaluja

* Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

* Ymmärrys hydrauliikasta katsotaan eduksi.

Hydrauliikkaosaaminen katsotaan suureksi eduksi, mutta tehtävään voidaan perehdyttää myös motivoitunut tekijä.

Kone- ja metallialan koulutus tai kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Kokoaikaisen päivätyön (40 h/vko)

* Palkan alkaen 14 €/h, osaamisen mukaan enemmän

* Modernit tuotantotilat ja hyvät työolosuhteet

* Kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään

MIKSI TÄMÄ PAIKKA KANNATTAA HUOMIOIDA?

Tämä ei ole tavallinen kokoonpanotyö. Työssä pääset erikoistumaan hydrauliikkaan ja oppimaan tuotteita sekä ratkaisuja, joita käytetään maailman vaativimmissa käyttöympäristöissä. Osaaminen, jota tässä tehtävässä kertyy, on arvokasta ja vaikeasti hankittavissa muualla.

title: Crew Lead
description:
SUMMARY

The Crew Lead is responsible for overseeing a team of Technicians in the delivery of preventative and corrective maintenance, routine and on-demand services on facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems for multiple facilities. The Crew Lead is responsible for overseeing the execution of activities performed by Technicians to ensure that work is performed in accordance to established processes and practices and is in compliant with all internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, fire protection. In addition to people leadership responsibilities, the Crew Lead also performs and delivers preventative and corrective maintenance as well as routine and on-demand services.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

People Leadership

  • Leads a team of individual contributors
  • Assigns, prioritizes and monitors work progress to ensure completion and adherence to timeliness, quality standards and all other related requirements
  • Reviews work for completeness and accuracy. Ensures quality adherence is maintained
  • Guides, coaches and trains direct reports
  • Provides input for performance review

Leads the delivery of as well as performs the following subject to legislative licensing requirements:

  • Oversees and monitors the activities and performance of Technicians within assigned facility. Ensures that activities are performed in accordance to established processes as well as internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, fire protection
  • Oversees the proper application and execution of processes and practices to ensure achievement of and adherence to all requirements
  • Oversees and performs regular facility, facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems monitoring and inspection, preventative and corrective maintenance to ensure facility uptime objectives are met, uninterrupted client operation and asset integrity of assigned facility are maintained. Provides observations about facility, facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems conditions and deficiencies and provides recommendations for enhancement and repair
  • Oversees and monitors assigned facility by conducting facility walkthroughs, mechanical and electrical equipment and system monitoring and inspection
  • Oversees and maintains, troubleshoots and repairs mechanical and electrical building systems and equipment
  • Oversees and responds to routine and on-demand service requests and performs preventative and corrective maintenance on facility mechanical and electrical equipment and systems
  • Oversees the maintenance of as well as maintains work order records within service management maintenance database. Initiates documents to obtain formal approval of work required
  • Coordinates and assists in the implementation of preventative maintenance program. Ensures that deficiencies are identified, recorded and escalated, and that related documentations are maintained
  • Coordinates and participates in facility-related projects
  • Oversees and maintains all assigned tools and arranges for repair and replacement where required. Submits all expenditures on a timely basis
  • Provides, participates and supports training, safety meetings, operational meetings, tool box talks, etc.
  • Must be able and willing to work shifts, be available for on-call/standby and emergency call-outs as they arise
  • Assists in enhancing tenant and customer satisfaction and maintaining positive relations through manner in which work is performed and services delivered
  • Other duties as assigned

Work Requirements

  • Must be able to work shifts, be on-call and be available to respond to emergencies
  • Must be willing to wear personal protective equipment

title: Director, Government Affairs
description:
Innovation starts with inclusion at Oracle. We are committed to creating a workplace where all kinds of people can be themselves and do their best work. It’s when everyone’s voice is heard and valued, that we are inspired to go beyond what’s been done before. That’s why we need people with diverse backgrounds, beliefs, and abilities to help us create the future, and are proud to be an affirmative-action equal opportunity employer.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Job Description

Senior Manager, EU Public Affairs

Oracle Corporate Affairs leads Oracle’s engagements with policy makers worldwide seeking to ensure a regulatory environment conducive to the growth of Oracle’s business. The Corporate Affairs team includes representatives in Washington DC, Europe, Asia, Middle East and Latin America. We are creating a new position for a Senior Manager, EU Public Affairs who will be based in Brussels reporting to the Vice President, Government Affairs for Europe. He/She will lead and coordinate Oracle’s engagement with EU institutions, government officials, trade associations and other key policy stakeholders, working closely with Oracle’s senior management in the EU.

The role will also have responsibilities for Oracle public policy outreach in the Netherlands – and to a certain extent – in Belgium and Luxembourg. He/She will work closely with colleagues in Oracle’s legal, compliance, corporate communication, and standards divisions, as well as with business leaders in Oracle’s cloud operations and global business units.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Policy Strategy: Monitor and assess regulatory and legislative initiatives that could significantly impact Oracle’s business or the interests of its customers. Develop and implement strategic advocacy plans—working cross-functionally when needed—to leverage opportunities and address emerging policy challenges. Identify key stakeholders and allies, coordinate engagement strategies, and build coalitions to support favorable policy outcomes.

  • Political Outreach: Strengthen and manage Oracle’s reputation with government officials and policymakers, positioning the company as a trusted and credible voice on technology policy issues. Represent Oracle before public institutions, trade associations, think tanks, and industry coalitions. Develop and maintain strong relationships with policymakers and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Business Risks & Opportunities: Anticipate regulatory developments in France and across Europe and ensure Oracle business leaders are informed of relevant public policy developments. Work with cross-functional teams—including legal, security, privacy, compliance, and sustainability—to develop policy positions on issues relevant to Oracle’s business, including cloud computing, digital regulation, digital sovereignty, cybersecurity, data privacy, artificial intelligence, data centers, and taxation.

Professional Competencies:

Required:

  • 7+ years of relevant work experience in a highly professional environment focused on policy or political work.
  • High-tech industry or related experience. Good understanding of tech policy issues in the EU including Cloud, data privacy, security, AI and trade.
  • Understanding of the political landscape and the policy-making process at EU level.
  • A proven track record of driving multiple initiatives at the same time.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - accuracy and attention to detail.
  • An enquiring mind, eager to continuously learn about the ever-evolving technology landscape.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Other EU languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work with colleagues across departments and organizations across different time zones. Comfortable working in a virtual team environment, as an individual, independently and under tight guidelines.
  • Strong team player, highly motivated and willing to provide help where needed to ensure the success of the team.

title: Myymäläpäällikkö, Hämeenlinna
description:
Partioaitta on vuodesta 1928 asti toiminut maanlaajuinen ulkoilu- ja retkeilyvälineiden vähittäismyyntiin keskittynyt erikoiskauppa, jolla on 24 myymälää ympäri Suomen sekä verkkokauppa. Laadukas tuotevalikoimamme tukee pyrkimystämme kestävään kehitykseen ja ulkoilun kautta saavutettavaan hyvinvointiin.

Vastuullisuusstrategiamme mukaan haluamme myydä tuotteitamme tarpeeseen ja kehittää kiertotaloutta. Partioaitan asiakkaita, henkilökuntaa ja omistajia yhdistää työn ja harrastuksien kautta syntynyt rakkaus luontoa ja siellä liikkumista kohtaan. Siitä syntyy myös se ammattitaito, jolla me Partioaitassa haluamme asiakkaitamme palvella. Kuluttajat ovat valinneet Partioaitan useita kertoja Suomen arvostetuimmaksi urheilukauppabrändiksi sekä alansa vastuullisimmaksi – saavutetut kärkisijat ovat pitkäjänteisen työn tulosta.

Haemme nyt kokenutta, uteliasta, eteenpäin katsovaa ja energistä kehittäjää myymäläpäälliköksi Hämeenlinnan Partioaittaan!

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat myymälän henkilöstön johtaminen, myynnin tuloksellinen ohjaaminen sekä erinomaisen asiakaspalvelun varmistaminen. Vastaat avainlukujen saavuttamisesta ja toimit esihenkilönä myymälähenkilökunnalle. Seuraat ja analysoit niin asiakasvirtoja kuin kuluttajakäyttäytymistä. Rakennat vuosisuunnitelmaa yhdessä ketjuohjaustiimin kanssa, ja vastaat sen toteuttamisesta. Laadit myynti- ja tuntibudjetit ja vastaat niiden seurannasta. Vähittäiskaupan ala koostuu pienistä yksityiskohdista ja tehokkaista myymälärutiineista sekä prosesseista; vastaat niiden kehittämisestä ja toimivuudesta.

Toivomme hakijalta:

* Vahvaa näkemystä vähittäiskaupan esihenkilön työtehtävistä

* Kokemusta tuloksellisesta myynnistä

* Perusosaamista työlainsäädännön ja kaupan työehtosopimuksen tulkitsemisesta

* Ymmärrystä verkkokaupan ja kivijalkamyymälöiden yhteistyön mahdollisuuksista

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

* Hyviä kommunikointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja, sekä inspiroivaa ja kannustavaa johtamistapaa

* Uteliaisuutta ja innovatiivisuutta

* Tavoitehakuista ja analyyttistä työskentelytapaa

* Päätöksentekotaitoja, paineensietokykyä sekä jämäkkää operatiivista otetta

* Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* Tarkoituksenmukaista työtä, sillä inspiroimme ihmisiä ulkoilemaan ja näin voimaan hyvin


* Ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen sekä avoimen työyhteisön, jossa työkaverin kunnioittaminen ja kuunteleminen ovat toimintatapojamme

* Mahdollisuuden kehittää toimintaamme yhteistyössä muiden myymäläpäälliköiden sekä ketjuohjaustiimin kanssa

* Jatkuvaa kouluttamista ja osaamisen kehittämistä

* Henkilökuntaetuina tarjoamme mm. lounasedun, bonusjärjestelmän, henkilökuntaostoedun sekä laajennetun työterveydenhuollon

Mikäli yllä lukemasi herätti kiinnostuksesi ja olet innokas kehittämään Partioaitan toimintaa yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa, haethan paikkaa 1.11.2026 mennessä. Palkka määräytyy työkokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella, ja aloituspalkka tehtävään on 2900€-3300€/kk. Työ alkaa joulukuun alussa tai sopimuksen mukaan. Käymme hakemuksia läpi prosessin aikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan hakijan löydyttyä.
