title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Kangasalle. Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla. Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava tulo on keskimäärin noin 3000 € / kk,kun sinulla on neljä hoitolasta ja sinulle kertyy vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpielämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta tai halua opiskella työn ohessa
* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia
* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja
* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa
* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

title: Director, Client Enablement Manager
description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Director – Head of Americas Client Enablement to join our Global Payments & Trade, Global Client Enablement team. This role is located in Pittsburgh, PA or Lake Mary, FL


In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
• Manage department activities, providing suitable resources (including VP+ level direct staff)
• Provide consultation to Relationship Management/ Sales and Clients on processes and practices
• Strategize, implement, and oversee processes for increased productivity and growth
• Design daily operational programs that achieve organizational objectives
• Establish and grow relationships with relevant internal and external partners
• Establish cost parameters and manage overall P&L for department

title: Supervisory Security Specialist
description:
As a Supervisory Security Specialist, you will serve as the Branch Chief for the Physical Security Branch that performs work pertaining to the administration of Physical Security Standards. Location of position: Fort Worth, TX, Lakewood, CO, Kansas City, MO, Tacoma, WA, Raleigh, NC & Washington, D.C. We are currently filling one vacancy, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

Serves as the principal technical advisor to GSA officials regarding the comprehensive administration of physical and industrial security programs. Co-leads the Government Services and Facility Sector, representing GSA interests and ensuring that national implementation strategies align with policies and directives established by the Chief Security Officer. Manages and provides executive oversight for various Office of Mission Assurance (OMA) programs, specifically focusing on physical security and sector-wide initiatives. Develops and fosters innovative OMA initiatives designed to generate new technical knowledge offerings while coordinating closely with the OMA Emergency Management Office to ensure seamless security integration during natural disasters. Participates in the high-level development of work measurement systems and establishes long-range program goals. Translates industry "best practices" into actionable program improvements and high-performance work team structures. Monitors program measures and results to ensure all security objectives meet federal standards and operational requirements. Manages the strategic allocation of resources by tracking and forecasting utilization across the security program. Develops supporting program data and sophisticated business case rationales to justify staffing levels and budget requests, ensuring the Office of Mission Assurance maintains the necessary fiscal and human capital to fulfill its mission. Provides full technical and administrative supervision to a subordinate staff, including planning work, setting priorities, and evaluating performance. Identifies professional development needs and ensures employees participate in continuing education to maintain technical expertise. Proactively furthers Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) objectives by ensuring equity.

If selected, you must meet the following conditions: Current or Former Political Appointees: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non­Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office. Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service. Serve a one year probationary period, if required. Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 5 investigation level). You must be granted this clearance before you can start the job. Have your identity and work status eligibility verified if you are not a GSA employee. We will use the Department of Homeland Security's e-Verify system for this. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of continued employment. Serve a one year supervisory or managerial probationary period, if required Any applicant tentatively selected for this position will be required to submit to urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Appointment to the position will be contingent upon a negative drug test result. This position requires a Special-Sensitive clearance. Due to the nature of the duties, communities and communications involved the incumbent must be able to obtain and maintain a Special Sensitive security clearance. This position may be required to fulfill duty requirements as needed and may involve performing tasks within a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF).

title: Käsilumityöntekijä talvisesonkiin Kouvolan alueelle
description:
Haemme käsilumityöntekijää talvikaudelle 2026-2027

Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme käsilumityöntekijää talvikaudelle marraskuusta maaliskuuhun. Etsimme ahkeraa ja reipasta tekijää, joka ei säikähdä talvisia olosuhteita ja ymmärtää piha-alueiden turvallisuuden merkityksen.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

* Lumen käsinluontia ja lumitöitä

* Kulkuväylien ja piha-alueiden puhtaanapitoa lumesta

* Liukkauden torjuntaa ja tarvittaessa hiekoitusta

* Kiinteistöjen kulkureittien turvallisuudesta huolehtimista

* Muita talvikunnossapitoon liittyviä tehtäviä

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

* Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa

* Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

* Luotettavuutta ja täsmällisyyttä

* Valmiutta työskennellä ulkona vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa

* Huolellisuutta ja turvallisuuslähtöistä asennetta

Aikaisempi kokemus lumitöistä tai kiinteistönhoidosta katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on hyvä työasenne ja valmius fyysiseen työhön.

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja kestää talvikauden ajan, marraskuusta maaliskuuhun.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos ulkotyö ja käytännön tekeminen sopivat sinulle, jätä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi sekä mahdollisesta aiemmasta kokemuksestasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Delivery Excellence Lead
location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
description:
Overview

Microsoft Frontier Company is Microsoft's outcome-driven AI engineering and delivery business, a global organization of industry experts, world-class architects, forward-deployed engineers, consultants, and delivery professionals who work together to bring Microsoft's mission of empowerment and cutting-edge technology to life for the world's most influential customers. Frontier Company is helping shape how AI, delivery discipline, and deep industry expertise come together to create faster, better, and more measurable customer outcomes, embedding our experts directly with customers to co-design, deploy, operate, and continuously improve AI systems tied to real business impact. We work side by side with customers across the full Frontier Transformation journey and pride ourselves on embracing a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and encouraging everyone to share their unique viewpoints and be their authentic selves. Join us and help create life-changing innovations that impact billions around the world.

As a Delivery Excellence Lead at Microsoft Frontier Company, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution, defining outcomes, aligning stakeholders, and driving measurable results across multiple workstreams. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your growth as a program lead, deepen your business and operational acumen, and expand your influence with executive stakeholders. This role is based in the United States.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Perform program landscape analysis and examine business trends, contributing to programs that impact Microsoft; identify opportunities to develop and improve programs, and drive program strategy definition and project plan creation.

  • Drive strategic alignment among cross-functional stakeholders to design crucial programs from initiation to delivery and use subject-matter expertise to define and track success criteria and performance metrics.

  • Operate with a startup mindset, adapting quickly to evolving priorities and ambiguity while applying situational fluency to sustain delivery, achieve outcomes, and exceed expectations.

  • Lead discovery/current-state assessment and translate findings into an actionable requirements set, prioritized backlog, and sequencing plan.

  • Contribute to portfolio planning and prioritization by surfacing tradeoffs, capacity constraints, and recommendations grounded in data.

  • Define success criteria and create relationships for implementing multiple feature areas across crucial cross-functional projects; coordinate, ensure alignment, and gain buy-in across the business.

  • Deliver on the multi-year roadmap for multiple feature groups, lead tracking of project schedules, oversee development of staging and implementation plans, and oversee governance programs.

  • Set best practices to define and execute a landing and communication plan, leading the rhythm of business during execution and gaining buy-in from stakeholders, partners, and customers.

  • Oversee a portfolio of projects: communicate program status and risk to stakeholders, hold teams accountable to the schedule, and drive collaboration so program processes run efficiently.

  • Provide deep expertise to conduct cost-benefit analyses and evaluate success metrics; optimize the use of data analytics to derive insights, identify risks and opportunities, and drive change-management processes across the organization.

  • Drive continuous improvements by validating use cases and writing test cases; provide the expertise needed for departments to collect performance metrics, and define, lead, and mentor others in direct customer engagements.

  • Own escalated issues and remove barriers or escalate as needed, and flag when existing processes block resolution. Manage field expectations on issue response, keeping Microsoft stakeholders informed on response/resolution status and influencing internally to drive resolution.

  • Embody Microsoft's culture and values.



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 8+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement
    • OR equivalent experience.
Additional or preferred qualifications
  • Master's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 12+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 15+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement
    • OR equivalent experience.

title: Vesitaloussuunnittelija, pohjoinen vesitalousyksikkö
description:
Lounais-Suomen elinvoimakeskuksen vesitalousosaston pohjoisessa vesistöyksikössä, jonka toimialueena ovat Etelä-Pohjanmaan, Pohjanmaan ja Keski-Pohjanmaan maakunnat, on haettavana vesitaloussuunnittelijan määräaikainen virkasuhde ajalle 1.1.2027-31.1.2029 tai sopimuksen mukaan, tehtävä voi mahdollisesti jatkua määräajan jälkeen. Tehtävän sijoituspaikka on Seinäjoen, Vaasan tai Kokkolan toimipiste.

Vesitaloussuunnittelija osallistuu maa- ja metsätalouden vesitalouden hallinnan, maankuivatuksen ja ojitustoimitusten asiantuntijapalvelutehtäviin, mm. koordinoimalla valtakunnallista peruskuivatushankkeiden sähköistämistä sekä laatimalla erilaisia selvityksiä ja ohjeistuksia. Tehtävään kuuluu uusien oppaiden laatiminen ja toimittaminen sekä uusien menetelmien kehittäminen ja käytön neuvonta. Tehtävänä on edistää uusien tekniikoiden käyttöä ja osallistua mm. tekoälyn käytön kehittämiseen vesitalousosaston tehtävissä. Tehtävään kuuluu erilaisten projektiluontoisten selvitysten tekeminen liittyen valtion vastuulla oleviin vesitalouslupiin ja niihin liittyvien rakenteiden kunnossapitoon.

Lisäksi tehtäväkenttään kuuluu muita vesivarojen käyttöön ja hoitoon liittyviä tehtäviä, kuten kiinteistöjen omistajien, vesioikeudellisten yhteisöjen ja kuntia neuvonta, sekä paikkatietoaineistojen tuottamista ja tietojen ylläpitoa erilaisissa tietojärjestelmissä.

Työssä on tärkeä yhteensovittaa vesienkäytön intressejä kuten tulvasuojelu, vesivoiman tuotanto, vesienhoito, kalatalous ja virkistyskäyttö sekä ottaa huomioon ilmastonmuutos. Tehtävän hoidossa pääsee verkostoitumaan laajasti muun hallinnon ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

description:

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Implements performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
Automation & Change Management:
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.


Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
Problem Solving:
–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
Continuous Learning:
–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
Continuous Improvement:
–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

title: Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitaja
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työ perhepäivähoitajana omassa kodissa, mutta et tiedä mistä aloittaa? Haluaisitko olla toteuttamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta pienryhmissä, joissa jokainen lapsi saa ansaitsemansa tuen ja huomion? Jos vastasit kyllä, jatka lukemista!

Etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme uusia ja luotettavia Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajia Raumalle. Etsimämme sydämelliset tekijät avaavat kotinsa ovet lapsille, jotka muodostavat ensimmäisiä suhteitaan oman perheen ulkopuolisiin aikuisiin. Turvallinen ja laadukas varhaiskasvatus on jokaisen lapsen oikeus ja me haluamme mahdollistaa sen sinun avullasi!

Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajilla on ryhmissä maksimissaan neljä lasta. Pieni ryhmäkoko mahdollistaa paljon erilaisia aktiviteetteja ja tekemistä päivän aikana, joista sinä saat päättää itse! Me tarjoamme raamit tekemiselle, mutta vapaus työn tekemisestä säilyy sinulla. Työn vapauden lisäksi, työstä saatava tulo on keskimäärin noin 3400 € / kk, kun sinulla on neljä hoitolasta ja sinulle kertyy vuodessa seitsemän viikkoa lomaa.

Työtä tehdään franchising-yrittäjänä osana Kultapalat-ketjua. Älä säikähdä sanaa yrittäjä, sillä me olemme miettineet sinulle kaiken valmiiksi. Sinun ei tarvitse tietää vielä mitään yritystoiminnasta, kunhan suhtaudut intohimoisesti lasten varhaiskasvatukseen ja tulet hyvin toimeen myös meidän aikuisten kanssa. Kanssamme luot itsellesi korkeamman tulotason, saat vapauden suunnitella hoitopäivien tekemisen itse ja tarjoat pienille kultapaloille läpi elämän mukana kulkevia oppeja ja rakkaita muistoja.



Odotamme sinulta:

* Päiväkotikokemusta

* Soveltuvaa koulutusta tai halua opiskella työn ohessa

* Turvallista ja puhdasta kotia

* Nuhteetonta rikostaustaa ja luottotietoja

* Halua olla uudistamassa varhaiskasvatusalaa

* Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

* Ruoanlaittotaitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Valmiin Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitokonseptin, joka on jo usean yrittäjämme toimesta todettu toimivaksi. Konsepti sisältää kaiken tarvittavan menestyneen perhepäivähoidon pyörittämiseen.

* Kaiken tarvittavan avun yrityksen perustamiseen ja pyörittämiseen. Kaikki on valmiiksi mietitty ja selvitetty puolestasi. Koulutuksemme ja ketjun jatkuva tuki varmistaa, ettet koskaan jää talousasioiden kanssa yksin.

* Ihanan Kultapalat-yhteisön, jossa pääset vaihtamaan ajatuksia muiden Kultapalat-perhepäivähoitajien kanssa.



Hae rohkeasti mukaan, tässä porukassa on kivaa sekä aikuisilla että lapsilla!

title: Product Management Intern
description:
Overview

Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential—and excitement for the journey ahead.

As a Product Manager Intern, you will define product vision and strategy by leveraging a deep understanding of the customer experience and competitive market, while identifying short-and long-term investment opportunities, evaluating tradeoffs, and driving the product roadmap. You will build consensus on product strategy, define features, vision and goals for a specific product(s) or set of features. This opportunity will allow you to develop and execute strategies to enable in-product organic growth and focus on central, cross-functional leadership of a product.

At Microsoft, Interns work on real-world projects in collaboration with teams across the world, while having fun along the way. You’ll be empowered to build community, explore your passions and achieve your goals. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

· Identify customers’ unmet or unknown needs and market opportunities for enhancements or development of a feature (e.g., product, service) via quantitative and qualitative analyses and scope the impact of a problem.
· Drive and track Key Results, success criteria and performance metrics. Partner with Software Engineering and Hardware Engineering to identify needed data and ensure telemetry is developed.
· Determine features or experiences to prioritize in the roadmap that will support achievement of success criteria and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs). Gather input on priorities and resources needed to deliver desired outcomes for a single feature (e.g., product, service).
· Iterate multiple designs with Design, Software Engineering, and Hardware Engineering. Assist in facilitating reviews (e.g., UX, system designs, data designs) with customers (e.g., regulators, engineers, policy makers, business-decision makers) to determine usability and ensure accessibility criteria and updated designs meet customer goals.
· Collaborate with Product Marketing, Business Planning, and Engineering to identify product release criteria, customer acquisition, and usage.
· Monitor and report on progress and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action to improve product/feature development, iteration, and implementation.
· Build trust with customers. Leverage a line of communication with customers to capture feedback and insights through the product development lifecycle.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • You must be legally authorised to work in the UK to be eligible for this role (Legally authorised = has citizenship or has been granted a valid visa or work permit)
  • Currently pursuing either a Bachelor's or Master's Degree
  • Must have at least one semester/term of school remaining following the completion of the internship
  • Experience in product/service/project/program management or software development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

#EiP


This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: EPMO Project Manager-40hr Days
description:
The Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) Project Manager is the lead project management resource for assigned strategic and enterprise-wide initiatives across Connecticut Children’s, including Information Services (IS) projects. The Project Manager is accountable for delivering projects of varying size, cost, complexity, and impact on time, within budget, and within scope. The Project Manager applies standard project management methods and Connecticut Children’s project lifecycle standards to bring structure, consistency, and accountability to each project. The Project Manager works across clinical, operational, and technical areas, bringing internal teams, leaders, vendors, and consultants together around shared project goals. The Project Manager serves as the main point of contact for assigned projects, keeping sponsors and leaders informed so decisions are made at the right time. The Project Manager also helps strengthen project management practices across the organization as part of the EPMO team.

Project Execution and Delivery

  • Leads enterprise-wide cross-functional project teams through all phases of the project lifecycle, from initiation and planning through implementation and closeout.
  • Manages the day-to-day operational aspects of projects; monitors progress, workflow, timeframes, and deliverables, and maintains an organized system for tracking and prioritizing tasks across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Establishes project budgets with project sponsors and leadership; monitors and maintains costs within budget.

  • Communication, Reporting, and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Facilitates internal and external project meetings, including regular status meetings; prepares agendas and minutes and follows up on action items to ensure tasks are completed on time and decisions are addressed.
  • Develops and maintains project documentation, status reports, presentations, and process flow diagrams.
  • Communicates changes in schedule, requirements, and task assignments to team members and stakeholders
  • Develops and maintains strong working relationships with project teams, end users, vendors, and internal and external stakeholders.
  • Takes a proactive approach to resolving project problems and maintains issue and risk logs.
  • Escalates issues when necessary and facilitates decision-making.

Project Planning and Scope

  • Develops detailed project plans, including the work breakdown structure, project timeline/Gantt chart, task lists, milestones, and measurable project goals and objectives.
  • Manages and executes project plans, and revises scope, schedule, and plans as needed to meet changing needs and requirements.
  • Identifies resources needed, assigns individual responsibilities, and tracks resource use.

EPMO Operations and Tools

  • Supports EPMO operations, including the project intake process and business case and charter development.
  • Assists in developing and maintaining project management standards, templates, and tools.
  • Builds and maintains Smartsheet solutions, such as dashboards, reports, forms, and surveys, to support project tracking and reporting.
  • Provides project management consulting, training, and mentoring to project teams and staff
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in technical or business area or equivalent work experience

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years with enterprise-wide project management experience;

  • Knowledge
  • Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK) framework, or other project management methodology, and working within an Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO).
  • Enterprise-wide system implementations, such as Electronic Health Record (EHR), Computerized Physician Order Entry (CPOE), Electronic Medication Administration Record (eMAR), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
  • Process management and process improvement methodologies.
  • Healthcare operations and clinical work environments.
  • Project management and reporting tools, including Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, and Visio.

Skills:

  • Expertise in project management and planning.
  • Critical thinking skills needed to develop project plans and an effective work breakdown structure.
  • Interpersonal and consultative skills needed to support dynamic work teams and communicate effectively with a wide variety of individuals, including patients/families, hospital administrative staff, IS staff, clinicians, and external contacts and vendors.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with an aptitude for technology.
  • Facilitation and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Organization, prioritization, and multitasking skills; detail-oriented, accurate, and thorough in follow-through.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to quickly learn new software and project management tools.

Abilities:

  • Plan large initiatives and projects, managing all tasks required to meet client and business needs within budget and targeted deadlines.
  • Execute and revise project plans to meet changing needs and requirements.
  • Manage and track day-to-day operational aspects of a project, report on project status, escalate issues, and facilitate decision-making.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and adapt to shifting timelines and priorities.
  • Guide and mentor others in project management during planning and execution.
  • Write and present for a variety of audiences.
  • Manage interactions diplomatically with individuals at all levels and job functions.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision and as part of a team.
  • See the big picture and continuously improve processes

title: Technical Implementation Analyst – Automation & Integration (German)
description:
Job Title: Technical Implementation Analyst – Automation & Integration

Location: Lisbon (Hybrid)

Contract: Permanent, Full Time

About Us:

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made.

Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.

Opened in 2025, our Lisbon Regional Operation Center has grown to over 80 employees within less than ten months, with ambitious plans to expand to 300 employees by 2027.

The Role:

  • We are seeking a technically strong Technical Implementation Engineer to support implementations of FeneVision across EMEA.
  • This role combines software implementation, technical configuration, and hands-on development to support customer deployments - particularly in complex, make-to-order manufacturing environments, with focus on automation.
  • In addition to core implementation responsibilities, this role will contribute to custom development, automation, and on-site technical problem solving, including working with manufacturing systems and machinery during implementation and testing phases.
  • You will work closely with Functional SaaS Consultants, Senior Implementation Consultants, and Project Managers to ensure solutions are properly configured, integrated, and optimized for real-world operational environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Configure and customize FeneVision solutions to meet customer technical requirements, including scripting, automation workflows, and integration logic (VBScript, .NET, or similar technologies)
  • Develop and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, data transformations, and support data migration and mapping activities
  • Design and support system integrations between FeneVision, third-party applications, and customer environments
  • Design, develop, and implement automation solutions to improve manufacturing workflows, system integrations, and implementation efficiency
  • Support automation and integration of manufacturing machinery and shop-floor systems during implementation and testing phases
  • Build custom tools, extensions, and automation routines to support customer-specific requirements and EMEA delivery needs
  • Participate in requirements analysis and translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Support rapid prototyping and development for complex or non-standard customer requirements
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Support on-site implementation, testing, and go-live activities, working directly with customer technical teams and production environments
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across application, database, integration, and automation layers, including real-time production scenarios
  • Test configurations, integrations, and automation solutions to ensure they meet customer requirements and production readiness
  • Collaborate closely with Functional SaaS Consultants, Senior Implementation Consultants, and Project Managers to deliver successful implementations
  • Create and maintain technical documentation including configurations, integrations, automation logic, scripts, and API-related details
  • Support knowledge transfer across internal teams

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
    OR equivalent professional experience
  • 2–5 years of software implementation, technical consulting, or development experience
  • Strong experience with SQL databases (SQL Server and/or Oracle)
  • Experience with scripting or customization (VBScript or similar)
  • Experience with .NET development (desktop, web, or backend)
  • Experience with system integrations, data mapping and automation
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within cross-functional teams
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent German
  • Able to travel

Preferred:

  • Experience in make-to-order, custom manufacturing, or configurable product environments such as windows, doors, glass, furniture, cabinetry, millwork, kitchen & bath, flooring, building materials, or similar industries
  • Experience working with manufacturing systems, machinery integration, or shop-floor automation
  • Experience with APIs and integration frameworks
  • Familiarity with Agile development practices
  • Experience with Git, TFS, or similar source control tools

Working for us:

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills — and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone — from every background — to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in — come join us.

title: Levyseppähitsaaja Pirkkalaan
description:
LEVYSEPPÄHITSAAJA VAATIVIEN HITSATTUJEN RAKENTEIDEN VALMISTUKSEEN – PIRKKALA

Oletko kokenut levyseppähitsaaja, joka haluaa tehdä vaativaa metallityötä ja nähdä oman kädenjälkensä teollisuuden ratkaisuissa?

Etsimme asiakkaallemme Pirkkalaan kokenutta levyseppähitsaajaa valmistamaan vaativia hitsattuja rakenteita teollisuuden tarpeisiin. Tässä työssä pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti ja työskentelemään erilaisten teräsrakenteiden parissa.

Etsimme tekijää, joka tarttuu toimeen, haluaa kehittyä ammattilaisena ja suhtautuu työhönsä pitkäjänteisesti.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ TEHDÄÄN?

Tehtävässä valmistat vaativia hitsattuja rakenteita teollisuuteen. Työssä käytetään monipuolisesti eri hitsausmenetelmiä:

* MAG-hitsausta

* TIG-hitsausta

* Jauhekaarihitsausta (SAW)

* Materiaaleina ruostumaton teräs ja hiiliteräs

* Levyseppähitsaajan monipuolisia valmistus- ja kokoonpanotehtäviä

Työssä korostuvat tarkkuus, laadukas työnjälki ja kyky hallita vaativia kokonaisuuksia.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme ammattitaitoista ja motivoitunutta tekijää, jolla on useamman vuoden kokemus vaativista levyseppähitsaajan tehtävistä.

Sinulla on:

* useamman vuoden kokemus vaativista levyseppähitsaajan tehtävistä

* kokemusta MAG- ja TIG-hitsauksesta

* valmiutta työskennellä myös jauhekaarihitsauksen parissa

* kokemusta ruostumattoman ja hiiliteräksen työstämisestä

* sujuva suomen kielen taito

* oma-aloitteinen ja toimeen tarttuva työote

* halua kehittyä ja viedä omaa ammattitaitoasi eteenpäin

* vakaa työhistoria ja halu sitoutua pitkäjänteisesti työhön

Koulutuksesi ei ole tärkeintä, käytännön osaaminen ja asenne ratkaisevat.

TÄSSÄ TYÖSSÄ PÄÄSET TEKEMÄÄN OIKEASTI VAATIVAA METALLITYÖTÄ

Jos olet parhaimmillasi silloin, kun työ vaatii ammattitaitoa, tarkkuutta ja itsenäistä otetta, tässä voi olla sinulle hyvä seuraava askel.

Työskentelet Pirkkalassa sijaitsevalla metallipajalla, arkisin päivätyössä 40 tuntia viikossa. Työ ei sisällä reissutyötä.

Palkkaus määräytyy osaamisesi mukaan, ammattitaitoiselle tekijälle maksetaan ammattilaisen palkka.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos haluat päästä valmistamaan vaativia hitsattuja rakenteita teollisuuteen ja arvostat työtä, jossa oma ammattitaito näkyy konkreettisesti lopputuloksessa, jätä hakemuksesi meille.

Kerro hakemuksessasi erityisesti, millaisissa levyseppähitsaajan tehtävissä olet työskennellyt, mitä hitsausmenetelmiä hallitset ja millaisten materiaalien kanssa olet työskennellyt.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat sähköpostitse osoitteesta hr@worknow.fi [hr@worknow.fi] tai puhelimitse numerosta 0401603159. Puhelimitse tavoitat meidät parhaiten arkisin klo 14–16.


WORKNOW OY TYÖNANTAJANA

* Nopea ja sujuva rekryprosessi

* Pidämme sinut ajan tasalla koko prosessin ajan

* Lakisääteistä kattavampi työterveys alusta alkaen

* Luotettava työnantaja – asiat hoidetaan kuten sovitaan

Meille tärkeintä on, että löydät työn, jossa viihdyt, kehityt ja onnistut.

Tehtävä

Projektipäällikkönä otat kokonaisvastuun ensimmäisistä kaupallisista toimitusprojekteistamme. Johdat projektia sopimuksen allekirjoituksesta käyttöönottoon ja asiakkaalle luovutukseen asti vastaten aikataulusta, budjetista ja projektin kokonaisvaltaisesta etenemisestä.

Työskentelet tiiviisti meidän eri asiantuntijoidemme kanssa ja toimit projektin keskeisenä yhteyshenkilönä asiakkaan, toimittajien, alihankkijoiden ja oman tiimimme suuntaan. Tehtävä sisältää matkustamista Suomessa ja ulkomailla.

Kyse ei ole vain valmiin toimintamallin toteuttamisesta. Ensimmäisten kaupallisten projektien aikana pääset kehittämään TheStoragen projektitoimintaa ja rakentamaan pohjaa skaalautuvalle toimitusmallille.

Vastuualueet

* Toimitusprojektien kokonaisvastuu: aikataulu, budjetti, laatu ja onnistunut toimitus asiakkaalle

* Projektin johtaminen suunnittelusta hankintoihin, valmistukseen, työmaavaiheeseen, asennukseen ja käyttöönottoon

* Projektitiimin ja eri tekniikanalojen koordinointi yhteistyössä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa

* Asiakas-, toimittaja- ja alihankkijayhteistyön johtaminen

* Projektin riskien, muutosten ja kaupallisten asioiden hallinta sekä raportointi

* TheStoragen projektitoiminnan ja skaalautuvan toimitusmallin kehittäminen

Odotamme sinulta

* Vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta teollisuuden investointi- tai toimitusprojektien johtamisesta projektipäällikkönä tai vastaavassa vastuuroolissa

* Kokemusta teollisuuden investointi- ja laitostoimitusprojekteista, esimerkiksi energia- tai prosessiteollisuudesta

* Kykyä johtaa projektin koko elinkaarta suunnittelusta käyttöönottoon ja luovutukseen

* Kykyä hallita samanaikaisesti aikataulua, kustannuksia, teknistä kokonaisuutta ja eri sidosryhmiä

* Kykyä varmistaa toimittajien aikataulujen, laadun ja kustannusten hallinta tehokkaalla toimittajavalvonnalla.

* Hyviä viestintä-, neuvottelu- ja johtamistaitoja

* Valmiutta matkustaa Suomessa ja ulkomailla

* Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Miksi TheStorage?

Pääset mukaan vaiheessa, jossa ensimmäiset kaupalliset toimituksemme ovat ratkaisevassa roolissa yrityksemme tulevaisuuden kannalta. Onnistuminen ensimmäisissä projekteissa luo pohjan uusille asiakkuuksille, tulevalle kasvulle ja seuraaville rahoituskierroksille. Projektipäällikkönä olet keskeisessä roolissa varmistamassa, että nämä projektit onnistuvat.

Samalla rakennamme toimintamalleja tulevia toimituksia varten. Pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan siihen, miten suunnittelemme, valmistamme ja toimitamme laitoksemme asiakkaille.

Tiimimme on tiivis ja päätöksenteko nopeaa. Saat laajan vastuun omista projekteistasi ja pääset rakentamaan toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Roolin vastuu ja mahdollisuudet kasvavat yrityksen ja toimitusmäärien mukana.

Tarjoamme vakituisen työsuhteen, joustavan hybridimallin Tampereen toimistollamme, kattavat henkilöstöedut ja palkan 5 500–6 500 €/kk kokemuksesi mukaan. Tehtävän aloitus joustavasti alkuvuoden 2027 aikana.

title: Software Engineer, Reliability Platform
location: San Francisco, CA; Sunnyvale, CA; Seattle, WA; New York City, NY
description:
About the Team

The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts. Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. When problems are detected earlier, mitigated faster and followed up on rigorously, our engineers can ship rapidly with confidence and we can collectively ensure that the consumers, merchants and Dashers that depend on DoorDash have the best possible experience.

Reliability Platform’s long-term vision is to operationalize a flywheel of reliability data and insights in order to continually raise the bar for our global engineering organization.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Reliability Platform team, you’ll help design, build, and operate software and infrastructure that deliver on the team’s mission and vision described above in collaboration with expert peers across the Infrastructure and Product organizations. You will work on mission-critical back-end services and pipelines, complex orchestration workflows, self-service platform capabilities and agentic intelligence.

We see and believe in the promise of agentic AI to radically reshape and supercharge how we serve our users and stakeholders while remaining pragmatic and committed to delivering positive business-value outcomes as the ultimate goal.

Some examples of what the Reliability Platform team does:

  • Own and drive unification of incident management process and tooling globally across all DoorDash-owned brands
  • Create the framework that measures SLO compliance and quality across tens of thousands of endpoints and derive the programmatic insights that ensure engineering teams are informed and accountable for the quality of their products
  • Build the internal SRE Agent used in incidents which supports team/domain-specific knowledge bases and obviates legacy runbooks
  • Set up MCP for agentic use of Reliability Platform data + tools and enable other Core Infra teams to follow suit

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Deliver Innovative Capabilities: You don’t want to ‘turn the crank’ somewhere, but you want to contribute to strategic thinking and help us drive meaningful continuous improvement.

  • Be Customer Obsessed: We want to learn from our internal customers to ensure we are solving the right challenges, and also share our perspective to influence in areas of expertise

  • Hold a High Quality Bar: We need to lead by example in how we develop, build, test and ship our products to show that we can work at high velocity without sacrificing quality outcomes.

  • Automate Everything: Your first instinct is to ask how toil can be obviated or, failing that, automated away from humans.

  • Shape the Future of Operations: Experiment with agentic AI workflows that can propose, validate, and safely execute production changes — moving DoorDash toward proactive, self-healing systems in step with industry first movers.

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • Platform Engineering Mindset: You think in terms of APIs, abstractions, and workflows — you enjoy building systems that other engineers depend on every day.

  • Proven Experience: You have 2+ years of experience in an infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering role, showing you can deliver and maintain complex systems.

  • Backend Development Skills: You’re fluent in Go (or a similar language) and can design and deliver mission-critical services that are scalable, resilient, performant, and efficient.

  • Cloud/Infra Expertise: You’re comfortable with AWS primitives, security best practices, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

  • SRE Experience: You understand concepts like SLOs, error budgets, and incident response though this is a platform development team, not an SRE/oncall team.

  • AI Alignment: You embrace the use of AI tools to be a more productive and capable engineer. This applies to coding, planning, supporting peers, and everything you do.

  • Curiosity About the Future: You’re excited about automation and agentic, AI-assisted operations and want to help shape how engineers interact with production systems.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$130,600—$192,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only
