title: Cyber Security Strategy Executive Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive

  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location

  • Pension / Retirement benefits

  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact you will have in this role:

The Executive Director, Cybersecurity Strategy and Business Management serves as a strategic advisor to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and a member of the Cybersecurity Leadership Team. This role leads the development and execution of the Cybersecurity strategy and operating plan and provides integrated oversight of the organization's portfolio management, financial management, workforce strategy, executive reporting, and governance activities.

The Executive Director acts as a force multiplier for the CISO and Cybersecurity Leadership Team, translating strategic priorities into measurable execution plans, strengthening organizational accountability, and ensuring leadership has the insights, reporting, and governance needed to effectively manage cyber risk and deliver business outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Strategy and Planning

  • Lead development and ongoing management of the Cybersecurity strategy, multi-year roadmap, operating plan, and investment priorities.

  • Partner with the CISO and Cybersecurity Leadership Team to define strategic objectives and measure organizational performance against those objectives.

  • Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, success metrics, milestones, and management reporting.

  • Maintain an integrated view of strategic commitments, dependencies, risks, and decisions across the Cybersecurity portfolio.

Executive Advisory and Leadership Support

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CISO on strategic, operational, organizational, and governance matters.

  • Assist the CISO in driving organizational alignment, prioritization, decision-making, and execution across the Cybersecurity organization.

  • Ensure effective communication of Cybersecurity priorities, decisions, accomplishments, and risks to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

  • Coordinate leadership operating rhythms, governance forums, strategic planning sessions, and organization-wide initiatives.

Governance, Portfolio Management, and Execution Oversight

  • Lead portfolio governance and execution oversight for strategic Cybersecurity programs and initiatives.

  • Establish and maintain management routines that monitor progress against strategic commitments and organizational objectives.

  • Identify, escalate, and help resolve cross-functional risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints.

  • Drive accountability for execution while enabling collaboration across Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Operations, and Business teams.

Board, Executive, and Regulatory Reporting

  • Lead the preparation and coordination of materials for the Board of Directors, Executive Committee, management committees, regulators, clients, and other governance forums.

  • Ensure leadership reporting is accurate, consistent, decision-oriented, and aligned with organizational priorities.

  • Partner with senior leaders across Cybersecurity to gather, validate, and synthesize information into concise executive-level communications.

  • Coordinate responses to regulatory, audit, and executive information requests as required.

Financial Management and Investment Governance

  • Lead Cybersecurity budget planning, forecasting, financial analysis, and expense management.

  • Partner with Finance to manage annual planning cycles, investment requests, and long-range financial forecasts.

  • Monitor expenditures and workforce investments to ensure alignment with strategic priorities and expected outcomes.

  • Develop executive insights regarding budget performance, investment effectiveness, and resource utilization.

Workforce Strategy and Organizational Planning

  • Lead workforce planning activities, including organizational design, location strategy, headcount planning, hiring priorities, and succession planning.

  • Partner with Human Resources and Cybersecurity leaders to identify future talent needs and organizational capabilities.

  • Develop workforce analytics and operational metrics to support leadership decision-making.

  • Monitor organizational health and capacity to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.

Organizational Effectiveness and Continuous Improvement

  • Drive operating model improvements, management disciplines, and organizational effectiveness initiatives across Cybersecurity.

  • Establish metrics and reporting capabilities that improve transparency, accountability, and decision-making.

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence, continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency across the organization.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build strong partnerships across Technology, Operations, Risk Management, Finance, Human Resources, Corporate Communications, Legal, Compliance, and the business.

  • Facilitate alignment between Cybersecurity priorities and broader enterprise objectives.

  • Support executive engagement with industry groups, clients, regulators, and external stakeholders as appropriate.

Risk and Compliance Oversight

  • Establish governance processes that identify, monitor, and escalate execution risks and organizational issues.

  • Support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance expectations.

  • Reinforce a culture of accountability, ethical conduce and risk awareness throughout the organization.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology, strategy, business management, consulting, financial services, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives and leading cross-functional strategic initiatives.

  • Experience in organizational strategy, portfolio governance, workforce planning, financial management, and executive communications.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity, technology, operational risk, and regulatory environments.

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

Talents Needed for Success:

  • Executive presence and strategic thinking.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actions.

  • Strong organizational leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Financial and operational acumen.

  • Portfolio and program governance expertise.

  • Sound judgment and decision-making abilities.

  • Ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Kassa-myyjä, Aura (vakituinen 35h/vko)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Oletko kokenut kaupan alan ammattilainen ja haluat ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallasi? Oletko asiakaspalveluhenkinen, organisointikykyinen ja kaupallisesti ajatteleva energinen osaaja? Etsimme nyt myymäläämme kassa-myyjää yhdistettynä vuorovastaavan rooliin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

Haemme nyt uuteen rooliin vuorovastaavaksi asiakaspalveluhenkistä, kaupallisesti ajattelevaa ja organisointikykyistä kaupan ammattilaista. Vuorovastaavavuorossa huolehdit, että myymälässä suoritettavat työt sujuvat suunnitellusti ja aikataulussa. Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Vastaat laadukkaan asiakaspalvelun toteutumisesta ja hoidat mahdolliset asiakasreklamaatiot palvelulupauksemme mukaisesti. Tärkeä osa tehtävääsi on huolehtia myymäläkuntoisuudesta, hyllysaatavuudesta sekä hävikistä. Vuoroihisi voi sisältyä myymälän avaamiseen ja sulkemiseen liittyvät toimet sekä esimerkiksi sairaslomituksien hoitaminen. Pääset lisäksi toteuttamaan myymäläkonseptin ja markkinointisuunnitelman mukaisia esillepanoja ja hintanäyttöjä.

Vuorovastaavana toimitaan erikseen määritellyissä vuoroissa silloin, kun vuorossa ei ole palveluvastaavaa tai myymäläpäällikköä. Muissa vuoroissa vuorovastaava toimii normaaleissa kassa-myyjän päivittäisissä myymälätehtävissä. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan ja työaika on 35 h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!


Voisit olla uusi vuorovastaavamme, jos
- Olet aidosti kiinnostunut työyhteisöstä ja asiakkaista - Sinulla on vankka kokemus asiakaspalvelu- ja vähittäiskauppatyöskentelystä - Olet oma-aloitteinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja nautit vastuunkannosta - Innostat ja ohjaat myös muita onnistumaan työssään ja olet yhteistyökykyinen tiimipelaaja - Hallitset perustason tietojärjestelmien käytön, ja sinulla on kyky oppia uusia järjestelmiä ja prosesseja sekä opastaa niitä muille - Olet valmis ottamaan lisää vastuuta ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi eteenpäin, kenties tulevaisuuden palveluvastaavaksi?
Aiempi kokemus esihenkilö- tai vastuutehtävistä on hyödyksi tässä tehtävässä.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Vuorovastaavan tehtävä tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden ottaa lisää vastuuta ja saada uusia haasteita myyjän tehtävän ohelle. Vuorovastaavan vuoroissa työnkuvasi monipuolistuu ja saat vaihtelua työhösi. Pääset vahvistamaan kaupan alan taitojasi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi erityisesti organisoinnin, ohjaamisen ja päätöksenteon saralla. Pääset työskentelemään kannustavassa ja mukavassa työyhteisössä, jossa kehittyminen ja menestyminen tapahtuvat yhdessä. Mikäli osastovastaavan tehtävä kiinnostaa tulevaisuudessa, vuorovastaavana toimiminen voi olla loistava askel osastovastaavaksi kehittymistä!

Vuorovastaavaroolissa tehdyistä tunneista maksetaan korkeampi palkkio. Etuna roolissa on lähiesihenkilötyön ammattitutkinto tai sen osasuoritus, mutta rooli ei edellytä tätä.Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: UN Women: International Consultant, Expert on Gender and Disability in Crisis and Recovery Settings (Retainer), Home-Based
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. Placing women’s rights at the centre of all its efforts, the UN Women leads and coordinates the United Nations system efforts to ensure that commitments on gender equality and gender mainstreaming translate into action throughout the world. It provides strong and coherent leadership in support of Member States’ priorities and efforts, building effective partnerships with civil society and other relevant actors.

UN Women’s triple mandate, along with its global network and deep policy and programming expertise, continues to endow the Entity with a unique capacity to: (i) support Member States to strengthen global norms and standards for gender equality and women’s empowerment, and mainstream gender perspectives in other thematic areas; (ii) promote coordination and coherence across the UN system to enhance accountability and results for gender equality and women’s empowerment; and (iii) undertake operational activities to support Member States, upon their request, in translating global norms and standards into legislation, policies and strategies at country level.

UN Women plays an innovative and catalytic role in the State of Palestine since its inception in 1997 (as UNIFEM). In line with the national priorities, the work of UN Women for the period 2023-2025 is aligned with three of the Palestine United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework’s (UNSDCF) outcomes:

• Palestinians have greater access to economic opportunities that are inclusive, resilient, and sustainable, including decent employment and livelihoods opportunities in an empowered private sector.

• Palestinians, including the most vulnerable, have equal access to sustainable, inclusive, gender responsive and quality social services, social protection, and affordable utilities.

• Palestinian governance institutions, processes, and mechanisms at all levels are more democratic, rights-based, inclusive, and accountable.

Its three-year Strategic Note supports the efforts to achieve measurable results in country in terms of four UN Women global Strategic Plan impacts (2022-2025): (SP Impact 1). Governance and participation in public life; (SP Impact 2). Women’s Economic Empowerment; (SP Impact 3). Ending Violence Against Women and Girls; SP Impact 4. Women peace and security, Humanitarian & Disaster Risk Reduction.

Women and girls with disabilities face multiple and intersecting barriers in accessing protection services, recovery opportunities, justice, information, participation mechanisms and decision-making processes. These barriers have been exacerbated by the ongoing crisis in Gaza. Strengthening collaboration between WLOs and OPDs, improving accessibility of services, generating evidence, and ensuring meaningful participation of women with disabilities are critical components of an inclusive recovery process.

The consultant will provide technical expertise to UN Women and partners across multiple recovery, resilience, protection, livelihoods, women's economic empowerment, governance and social-cohesion initiatives implemented in Gaza. The consultant will ensure that disability inclusion is systematically integrated across programme design, implementation, monitoring, evaluation and knowledge generation, with particular attention to the rights and participation of women and girls with disabilities.

The consultant will support disability-inclusive approaches across a range of sectors including women’s economic empowerment and livelihoods, protection and gender-based violence prevention and response, care economy initiatives, community resilience and social cohesion, recovery planning, institutional capacity strengthening, localization and women's leadership. The consultant will work closely with UN Women programme teams, WLOs, OPDs, UN agencies, civil society organizations, service providers and national stakeholders to promote inclusive recovery and ensure that no one is left behind.

The consultant will report to the UN Women Programme Analyst (Humanitarian and Early recovery) and work closely with UN Women programme staff, WLOs, OPDs, service providers, national stakeholders and Joint Programme partners.

Description of Responsibilities /Scope of Work

1. Disability-Inclusive Programme Design, Recovery and Mainstreaming

  • Provide technical guidance to integrate gender-responsive disability inclusion across UN Women's recovery, protection, livelihoods, economic empowerment, governance and resilience programming.
  • Support disability-inclusive approaches in service delivery, infrastructure, livelihoods, social protection, GBV prevention and response, and recovery planning including technical guidance on disability-inclusive measures and SOPs.
  • Advise on accessibility, universal design, reasonable accommodation and inclusive participation throughout the programme cycle.
  • Support disability mainstreaming across Joint Programmes and recovery initiatives to ensure alignment with LNOB commitments and disability-inclusive recovery standards.

2. Capacity Development, Institutional Strengthening and Partnerships

  • Strengthen the capacities of Women's-Led Organizations (WLOs), Organizations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs), service providers and national institutions on gender-responsive disability inclusion.
  • Support organizational strengthening of OPDs, particularly organizations representing women with disabilities, to enhance their participation, advocacy and leadership in recovery processes.
  • Facilitate partnerships and collaboration between WLOs, OPDs, service providers, UN agencies and national stakeholders.
  • Promote the meaningful participation and leadership of women and girls with disabilities in programme design, implementation, monitoring and recovery decision-making processes.

3. Evidence Generation, Monitoring and Disability Data Systems

  • Advise on gender-responsive and disability-inclusive eligibility criteria, collect sex-, age- and disability-disaggregated data, and monitor equitable access to productive assets, grants, cash, training, paid work, enterprise support and markets.
  • Support the collection, analysis and use of sex-, age- and disability-disaggregated data, including the application of Washington Group Questions where appropriate.
  • Conduct disability and gender analyses, accessibility assessments and inclusion reviews to identify barriers and opportunities.
  • Support strengthening disability-inclusive monitoring, accountability and information management systems.
  • Develop practical guidance, tools, knowledge products and recommendations to inform disability-inclusive recovery planning, programming and policy development.

4. Disability-Inclusive Protection, Economic Empowerment and Access to Services

  • Advise on inclusive approaches to protection, GBV prevention and response, livelihoods, employment, entrepreneurship and women's economic empowerment initiatives including disability-inclusive workplaces, training centres, protection hubs and other services.
  • Support improved accessibility of services, referral pathways, safe spaces, community facilities and economic opportunities for women and girls with disabilities.
  • Promote integrated approaches that strengthen access to rehabilitation, assistive devices, psychosocial support, SRHR, livelihoods and other essential services.
  • Provide technical support to ensure that women and girls with disabilities are effectively reached through recovery interventions and are able to exercise leadership, agency and economic participation.
  • Advise on disability and gender inclusive measures, such as accessible information and registration, childcare or care referrals, flexible and proximate delivery, safe mobility support, reasonable accommodation, suitable PPE, safe working conditions, equal remuneration and accessible feedback mechanisms.
  • Assess and identify barriers to participation for women (and girls) with disabilities including accommodation needs, and accessibility of worksites, training, productive assets and enterprise services. Advise on required support which may include adapted information, assistive technologies, accessible workstations, communication support and flexible delivery.

Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel

This is a home-based consultancy, without travel.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

  • Strong technical expertise in gender-responsive disability inclusion.
  • Knowledge of disability-inclusive humanitarian and recovery programming.
  • Experience strengthening OPDs, WLOs and civil society organizations.
  • Ability to conduct gender and disability analysis and translate evidence into practical recommendations.
  • Experience developing accessibility and inclusion tools and guidance.
  • Strong facilitation, coordination and capacity-development skills.

Education and Certification:

  • Master's degree in Disability Studies, Gender Studies, Human Rights, Social Policy, Social Sciences, International Development, Public Policy or a related field is required.
  • A first-level university degree combined with two additional years of relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of an advanced degree.

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of progressive experience in disability inclusions and gender equality is required.
  • Demonstrated experience mainstreaming disability inclusion across multiple sectors, including livelihoods, economic empowerment, protection, governance or recovery programming is required.
  • Proven experience engaging with OPDs, WLOs, civil society organizations and national institutions is desirable.
  • Experience conducting gender and disability analysis and developing evidence-based recommendations is desirable.
  • Experience conducting accessibility audits and disability inclusion assessments is desirable.
  • Experience designing and delivering capacity-building programmes is desirable.
  • Experience developing disability-inclusive tools, guidance and monitoring frameworks is desirable.
  • Experience in humanitarian or crisis-affected contexts is required.
  • Experience in Palestine and/or the Middle East region is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience working with UN agencies and international organizations is desirable.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Working Knowledge of Arabic is desirable.

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Työyksikkö ja työtehtävät

Vastaanoton lääkärityöpanos, Haapajärven SOTE-asema sekä Nivalan SOTE-keskus, sovittavissa 4kk työjakso molempiin.

Työnkuva; Kiireetön ja kiireellinen lääkärin vastaanotto. Tarvittaessa tilaajan tarpeen mukaan lääkärityövoimaa voidaan käyttää myös lasten- ja nuorten palveluihin tai kuntoutusyksikköön. Työt arkisin ma-pe klo 08-16. Lähityö, ei mahdollisuutta etätyöhön.

Työnkuva; Akuuttiosaston lääkärityö sisältäen osastokierron, uusien potilaiden vastaanottamisen ja loppulausuntojen tekemisen.

Ikäihmisten palveluiden lääkärityöpanos, kotihoito ja asumispalveluyksiköt, Nivala/Haapajärvi/Kärsämäki sekä Pyhäjärvi + Reisjärvi. Tarve on kahdelle kokoaikaiselle lääkärille sekä yhdelle osa-aikaiselle (50% työaika).
Työ kokoaikaista arkisin ma-pe klo 08-16- Työtä voi tehdä hybridimallilla, 60% etätyö onnistuu viikossa. Työ voidaan sopia 6kk.

Työnkuva; ikäihmisten palveluiden omalääkärinä toimiminen sisältäen etäkonsultaatiot ja lähikierrot. Lähikierrot sisältävät ennakoivien hoitosuunnitelmien tekemistä Pohteen mallin mukaisesti.


Edellytämme sinulta
- Yleislääkärin pätevyyttä
- Erikoislääkärin pätevyyttä
- Kokemusta perusterveydenhuollosta lääketieteen lisensiaatilta vähintään kolme vuotta
- Tartuntatautilain 48§ mukaista rokotussuojaa
- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Työaika ja korvaus
Palkkaus määräytyy lääkärin työnkuvan ja sijainnin mukaisesti.

Miksi tämä on loistava tilaisuus?
ePassi etu 400 €/vuosi – Käytettävissä liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointipalveluihin (työsuhteissa, jotka kestävät vähintään 60 työvuoroa)
Työterveys – Hyvinvointiasi tukevat työterveyspalvelut
Vahva tuki ja yhteisö – Et jää yksin! Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, vastuulääkärien tuen sekä kannustavan ja osaavan työyhteisön ympärillesi
Hyvä ja motivoiva palkka – Panostamme reiluun ja motivoivaan palkkaukseen
Mahdollisuus kehittyä – Tarjoamme koulutusrahan, joka kasvaa tehtyjen työtuntiesi myötä
Uusia ovia urallesi – Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia

Mikä on Solo Health?
Olemme suomalainen, mutkattomasti toimiva porukka. Meillä hommat etenevät nopeasti ja ilman turhia välikäsiä – yhteyshenkilösi tuntee sinut nimeltä ja vastaa kysymyksiisi selkeästi. Tunnemme sote-alan arjen ja ymmärrämme, että elämässäsi on muutakin kuin työ: välillä haluat tehdä töitä enemmän, joskus vähemmän. Olemme mukana joustavasti silloin, kun sinulle sopii.

Työllistämme lääkäreitä, hoitajia, psykologeja ja sosiaalityöntekijöitä moninaisiin sosiaali- ja terveysalan tehtäviin ympäri Suomen – myös hiljaisessa haussa oleviin työpaikkoihin, joita et löydä muualta. Vuonna 2019 perustettu Solo Health on Suomen nopeimmin kasvava sote-alan toimija. Vuonna 2025 lähes 800 sote-ammattilaista toimi erilaisissa tehtävissä Solon kautta.

Olemme luotettava ja joustava kumppani julkiselle sektorille sekä pienissä palvelukokonaisuuksissa että laajoissa ulkoistuksissa. Panostamme palveluidemme laatuun, vaikuttavuuteen ja henkilöstömme ammattitaitoon.

Ihmiset ovat toimintamme ydin. Tarjoamme säännöllistä koulutusta ja tukea työhyvinvointiin, mistä kertoo poikkeuksellisen korkea henkilöstötyytyväisyytemme (NPS 70). Meillä ammattilaiset viihtyvät ja voivat työskennellä eettisesti sekä laadukkaasti.

Solo Health on terveydenhuollon paras työkaveri, joka tuntee alan haasteet ja pitää huolta ihmisistä.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae viimeistään 2.11.26. Ole nopea, paikat täytetään sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä.

title: Myyjä taloyhtiömyyntiin / Valokuitunen
description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme Valokuitunen Oy:lle myyjää taloyhtiömyyntiin toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Oulun ja Rovaniemen alueelle. Työ on kokoaikainen ja töitä tehdään pääsääntöisesti maanantaista perjantaihin alkaen kello 12.

Valokuitunen Oy rakentaa valokuituverkkoja ympäri Suomea taajamien. Kasvamme vauhdikkaasti, joten pääset osaksi aitoa kasvutarinaa - sekä meidän että omaasi. Työmme on palkitsevaa: teemme kodeista toimivampia kuin koskaan, sillä tarjoamme ihmisille valokuidun avulla tasokkaimman mahdollisen nettiyhteyden. Meillä väki viihtyy, yhteishenki on vahva ja tukea aina saatavilla.

Pääset tutustumaan Valokuituseen lisää osoitteessa: www.valokuitunen.fi

Valokuitusella taloyhtiömyynnissä

Kohtaat asiakkaita niin puhelimitse kuin sähköpostitse viestien - teet myös kenttätyötä ja osallistut taloyhtiöiden kokouksiin. Taloyhtiömyynnissä korostuu ratkaisukeskeisyys sekä kyky esiintyä ja myydä isollekin porukalle, joten hyvät kommunikointitaidot sekä aktiivinen ja vastuullinen ote ovat avainasemassa.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla aiempaa myyntikokemusta, sillä koulutamme sinulle kaiken työssä tarvittavan. Etsimme tavoitteellisella ja positiivisella asenteella varustettuja tekijöitä, joilla on myös ripaus kunnianhimoa. Liikkuva myyntityö edellyttää B-ajokortin ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuuden.

Kiinnostaako ura myynnissä? Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Kiinteän 13,50 tuntipalkan ja provision, pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan omiin ansioihisi. Keskituntiansio myyjillä taloyhtiömyynnissä on noin 22 e/h.
* Kattavan koulutuksen tehtäviin
* Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myyjänä ja edetä talon sisällä

title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
description:
Overview

Are you an accomplished engineering leader with a proven track record of building high-scale systems and solving complex security challenges? At Microsoft Security, our mission is to create a safer digital world by building an end-to-end security cloud that simplifies and strengthens our customers’ security posture. As organizations navigate growing threats, regulatory demands, and increasingly complex digital environments, they need better ways to understand and secure vast amounts of data across on-premises, multi-cloud, and SaaS environments.

Microsoft Security is seeking an Principal Software Engineering Manager to lead a key subsystem of a groundbreaking, exabyte-scale data platform for security data. In this role, you will drive technical strategy and feature development end-to-end, lead a talented team of engineers, and collaborate across partner teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions.

Our platform is designed to give organizations comprehensive visibility into their digital estates, from devices and users to permissions, data systems, and virtual machines. By integrating and normalizing security data from diverse sources, the platform helps customers manage security data more efficiently and cost-effectively while using advanced AI and machine learning to uncover threats, identify patterns, and answer critical security and governance questions in real time.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Coaches use of engineering health measures (Accelerate, SPACE, ESSP) to improve processes, especially AI. Leads AI experimentation and adoption recommendations.

  • Guides clear test strategy to ensure quality and prevent regressions, including security tests and negative cases. Leads adding tests for gaps, removing/fixing broken tests, and improving suite speed, reliability, and defect localization. Ensures scalable, reliable test frameworks and testable code during design. Maintains knowledge of test types/architectures and applies them; leads redesign of untestable code. Advocates AI for test automation.

  • Guides and leads dependency identification and integration into design documents. Identifies other teams/technologies to leverage and how systems support each other. Ensures security, compliance, performance, and reliability across the stack. Collaborates across teams to resolve dependency ownership/validation conflicts and align delivery schedules.

  • Coaches others to review product and test code for standards, coverage, and fit. Leads insightful, timely code reviews that improve quality and accelerate delivery. Reviews for diagnosability, reliability, testability, maintainability, security, compliance, and best practices. Ensures automated source code analysis is part of the build/development process.

  • Guides team to identify automation requirements and apply automation across production/deployment, targeting zero-touch deployment. Guides validation in simulated/non-production environments. Ensures CICD infrastructure supports developer and operational agility (e.g., low lead-time-to-change).

Qualifications

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 4+ years people management experience

title: Oracle Technology Specialist - II
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role Purpose:

The Oracle Technology Specialist – II supports the availability, reliability, performance, and secure operation of Oracle technology services across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). The role provides hands-on administration and operational support for OCI infrastructure, Oracle Database, and Oracle Fusion Middleware, including provisioning, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, automation, and release support.

The role works closely with business users, project teams, system integrators, and service providers to maintain stable and effective Oracle services.


Key Responsibilities:

Infrastructure Administration and Operations

  • Administer and support Oracle Database 19c and 26ai, Oracle Fusion Middleware 12c and 14c, and associated OCI services.
    Provision and configure OCI infrastructure in accordance with approved architecture, security standards, and operational procedures.
  • Perform routine maintenance, including patching, backup and recovery, configuration changes, and service health checks.
  • Configure and maintain OCI Observability and Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) for monitoring, alerting, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
  • Proactively monitor infrastructure health, performance, capacity, and resource utilization, investigating alerts and taking appropriate corrective action.
  • Diagnose database, middleware, and cloud infrastructure issues and contribute to root cause analysis and problem resolution.
  • Identify availability, capacity, performance, and operational risks and take appropriate remediation or escalation action.

Service Management and Release Coordination

  • Manage incidents and service requests within agreed service expectations, ensuring effective investigation, communication, documentation, and resolution.
  • Contribute to problem management, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for recurring service issues.
  • Coordinate infrastructure maintenance and release activities with the Release Manager, application teams, business stakeholders, and service providers.
  • Support Oracle quarterly updates, patching, change implementation, and post-change validation.
  • Identify technical dependencies and scheduling conflicts and help minimize disruption to business services.
  • Support application capacity and infrastructure requirements while maintaining security, privacy, and operational standards.

Automation and Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with GSI and project teams to establish effective monitoring and operational support for new and changed services.
    Automate repeatable infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, health checks, and administrative activities using Terraform, OCI CLI, SQL, PL/SQL, and Unix/Linux shell scripting.
  • Maintain and enhance Infrastructure as Code (IaC) configurations for OCI using Terraform, following established standards and change-control processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, monitoring, operational efficiency, and support processes.
  • Support the transition of new and changed services from project delivery into operational support.

Collaboration and Knowledge Management

  • Work with Key Business Users, system integration leads, infrastructure teams, application teams, project teams, and external service providers to maintain service availability and performance.
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand service concerns, operational requirements, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide clear technical updates during incidents, maintenance, releases, and service-impacting events.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and training materials.
  • Document technical resolutions and lessons learned to improve knowledge sharing and reduce recurring operational issues.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of infrastructure, platform, or technology support experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on OCI experience.
  • Experience administering or supporting Oracle Database, Oracle Fusion Middleware, and OCI services in production or business-critical environments.
  • Experience provisioning, configuring, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience working in a global, multinational, and multi-vendor environment.
  • Experience working within structured incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
  • Experience coordinating activities across internal technical teams, business stakeholders, and external service providers.Strong track record of service delivery, technical problem solving, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

Technical Skills:

Core:

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration and support.
  • Oracle Database 19c and 26ai administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, backup, recovery, and performance management.
  • Oracle Fusion Middleware 12c and 14c administration and support.
  • Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM). OCI Observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and diagnostics.
  • OCI compute, storage, networking, IAM, backup, and availability concepts.

Automation and Infrastructure as Code

  • Terraform for OCI Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • OCI CLI scripting and automation.
  • SQL and PL/SQL.
  • Unix/Linux shell scripting.
  • Automation of infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, reporting, and operational health checks.

Supporting Knowledge:

  • Oracle database backup and recovery.
  • Cloud networking and connectivity.
  • Identity and access management and least-privilege principles.
  • Infrastructure security and operational controls.
  • Performance, capacity, and availability management.
  • Incident, problem, change, and release management practices.

Professional Skills:

  • Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to prioritize operational activities and respond effectively to service incidents.
  • Clear written and verbal communication across technical and business audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed and multi-vendor teams.
  • Strong attention to security, operational quality, documentation, and compliance.
  • Proactive approach to automation, service improvement, and operational risk reduction.Ability to work independently within established technical and governance standards.

Comerțul este vital pentru economia globală, creând oportunități și îmbunătățind calitatea vieții oamenilor din întreaga lume. DP World există pentru a face ca schimburile comerciale globale să funcționeze mai bine, schimbând ceea ce este posibil pentru clienții și comunitățile pe care le deservim la nivel global.

Cu o echipă dedicată, diversă și profesionistă formată din peste 115.000 de angajați, reprezentând 160 de naționalități din 78 de țări de pe șase continente, DP World împinge limitele comerțului spre lanțuri de aprovizionare mai fluide, pregătite pentru viitor.

Transformăm rapid și integrăm afacerile noastre – Porturi și Terminale, Servicii Marine, Logistică și Tehnologie – unind infrastructura globală cu expertiza locală pentru a crea soluții de lanț de aprovizionare mai puternice și mai eficiente, schimbând modul în care lumea face comerț.

Mai mult decât atât, remodelăm viitorul prin investiții în inovație. De la sisteme inteligente de livrare până la stivuirea automată în depozite, ne aflăm în fruntea tehnologiilor disruptive, conducând sectorul către modalități mai bune de a face comerț, minimizând întreruperile de la linia de producție până la ușa clientului.

Misiunea DP World este de a transcende granițele și de a construi punți între toate națiunile și culturile – nu doar prin ceea ce facem, ci și prin modul în care acționăm.

Suntem dedicați creării unei culturi în care fiecare persoană să se simtă respectată, sprijinită și împuternicită să-și atingă potențialul maxim. Credem că acceptarea diversității și incluziunii stimulează inovația și creșterea, ajutându-ne să conectăm oameni, afaceri și societăți. Mințile libere și perspectivele diferite schimbă lumea, iar împreună putem schimba ceea ce este posibil.

title: Senior Analytics Manager
description:
🚀 Why Headout?

We’re a rocketship: 9-figure revenue, record growth, and profitable

With $200M+ in revenue, guests in 700+ cities, and 18 months of profitability, Headout is the fastest-growing marketplace in the travel industry, and we’re just getting started. We've raised $60M+ from top-tier investors and are building a durable company for the long term — because that's what our mission needs and deserves. We’re growing, profitable and nowhere near done.

What we do is important

In an increasingly digital world, there is a desperate need to augment our human experience by getting us to interact with the real world around us and the people in it. At Headout, our mission is to be the easiest, fastest, and most delightful way to head out to a real-life experience — from immersive tours to museums to live events and everything in between.

Why now?

The foundation is strong. The opportunity ahead is even bigger. We’ve hit profitability, built momentum, and proven the model — but there’s so much more to build. If you’re looking to join a company where the trajectory is steep and your impact is real, this is the moment.

Our culture

Reinventing the travel industry isn't easy, but that's the fun part.
We care deeply about ownership, craft, and impact, and we’re here to do the best work of our careers. We won’t pretend like it’s for everyone but if you’re a builder who loves solving tough problems, you’ll feel right at home.

👩‍💻 The role

As Manager, Product Analytics, you'll lead the analytics function for Headout's Product org. This isn't about dashboards and reports; it's about building product intelligence that compounds into competitive advantage.

You'll define the metrics that matter, build the experimentation muscle, and ensure product decisions are grounded in customer understanding. You'll partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to shape what we build, not just measure what we shipped.

You'll also build and lead a team of product analysts who operate like owners: sharp on metrics, strong on problem framing, and measured by the outcomes they enable, not the analyses they deliver.

🤩 What makes this role special?

  • Build Product Intelligence, Not Just Measurement: You'll define the metrics, frameworks, and experimentation systems that make Headout's product smarter over time. Your work shapes the intelligence layer, not just the reporting layer.
  • Thought Partner, Not Report Generator: You'll work directly with Product leadership to answer "what should we build next?" not just "what happened?" You'll bring clarity on customer behaviour, funnel bottlenecks, and where the highest-leverage opportunities are. When the product roadmap is debated, your perspective will be in the room.
  • Shape the Experimentation Engine: You'll raise the bar on how we run experiments; hypothesis quality, statistical rigor, guardrails, and decision-making. You'll help teams move fast without making noisy or misleading calls. Experimentation becomes a capability, not a bottleneck.
  • Build a Team of Owners: You'll hire, mentor, and develop product analysts who own problem domains, not task queues. Analysts who can frame problems, define success, and drive adoption, not just write SQL and hand off slides.
  • Drive Outcomes That Compound: Your work will directly improve conversion, retention, and LTV. But more importantly, it will build systems that keep improving: ranking models that learn, retention frameworks that clarify priorities, recommendations that get smarter. The advantage compounds.

💝 What skills & experience do you need?

  • 6-10 years in product analytics, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring analysts. Track record of defining metrics that teams actually use to make decisions.
  • Strong problem framing: you can translate ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses and clear measurement plans.
  • Experimentation expertise: you've run A/B tests end-to-end, understand statistical pitfalls, and know when experiments are needed and when they're not
  • Full-funnel fluency: acquisition → activation → conversion → retention. You can diagnose drop-offs, interpret cohort behaviour, and identify segmentation insights
  • Advanced SQL; comfortable with Python/R for analysis and statistics

EEO statement

At Headout, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our partners, and the community at large. Headout provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. During the interview process, if you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact the recruiter assigned to your application or email us at life@headout.com.

Privacy policy

Please note that once you apply for this job profile your personal data will be retained for a period of one (1) year. Headout shall process this data for recruitment purposes only. Once the relevant job profile is filled or once the time period of one (1) year from the date of the job application has passed, whichever is later, Headout shall either delete your data or inform you that it shall keep it in its database for future roles. In compliance with the relevant privacy laws, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that the processing of your personal data be restricted. If you have any concerns or questions about the way Headout handle your data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer for more information.

title: Manager - Sourcing
description:
1. Product Development & Commercialization: Manage product development from concept and design brief through sampling, prototyping, validation, pilot production and commercialization, ensuring approved samples, completed milestones and timely product launches.
  2. Vendor Development & Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, onboard and develop domestic and international suppliers based on their technical capabilities, capacity, quality, commercial competitiveness and ability to meet business requirements.
  3. Costing, Negotiation & Value Engineering: Prepare and finalize product and raw material costing, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, identify alternate sourcing opportunities and drive cost optimization through material changes and value engineering.
  4. BOM & Pricing Management: Prepare, finalize, and maintain accurate Bills of Material (BOMs), pricing records and cost documentation for finished goods, raw materials and components, ensuring data accuracy and availability for business decisions.
  5. Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with Design, Marketing, Quality, Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain teams to finalize requirements, secure approvals, resolve development issues and ensure timely product launches.
  6. Supplier Quality, Performance & Compliance: Monitor supplier adherence to quality standards and company requirements, support audits and compliance reviews, resolve development and consumer quality issues, and drive corrective actions and periodic supplier performance evaluations.
  7. Market Intelligence & Continuous Improvement: Monitor supplier and material trends, identify alternate sources, develop supplier capacity, improve sourcing processes and support strategic sourcing initiatives and special projects.
  8. Project, MIS & Documentation Management: Maintain product development trackers, sourcing databases, supplier agreements, NDAs, costing records, MIS reports and supporting documentation to ensure effective project monitoring, reporting and record control.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Textile Engineering, or equivalent.

MBA/PGDM in Operations, Supply Chain, or Materials Management will be an added advantage.

12–15 years of experience in Product Development, Vendor Development, Sourcing, or Manufacturing within the luggage, backpacks, bags, footwear, consumer goods, plastics, or related manufacturing industries.

Experience in managing end-to-end New Product Development (NPD), vendor management, costing, BOM preparation, and cross-functional project execution.

Exposure to ERP systems (preferably LN ERP) is desirable.

title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
description:

  • Mentor engineers, review designs and code, and establish operational best practices and runbooks.

  • 6–8 years of Oracle Database Engineering, Administration, SRE experience.

  • Deep expertise with Oracle 19c, including RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, ASM, SQL optimization, performance diagnostics, and HA/DR design.

  • Strong Python and/or Shell scripting experience for automation, diagnostics, monitoring, and operational tooling.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex database changes, upgrades, and reliability initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of database security, observability, capacity planning, and cloud-scale operations.

  • Proven technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, critical thinking, and ability to operate effectively in a demanding environment.
    Leads platform projects crossing multiple teams, evolving runtimes or middleware patterns for interoperability and multi-tenant scale. Diagnoses and resolves complex cross-service issues; enforces versioning, compatibility, and safe rollout practices. Drives observability standards, capacity planning, and resilience patterns across several workloads. Produces migration guides and adoption playbooks that raise ecosystem consistency and developer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

  • Lead cross-team evolution of middleware patterns or runtimes to standardize interoperability at scale.

  • Define and enforce versioning, deprecation, and rollout strategies that minimize downstream breaks.

  • Drive shared observability baselines (SLOs, error budgets) and resilience patterns across several services.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

  • Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion.

  • Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements.

  • Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.

  • Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements.

  • Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues.

  • Develops fixes for identified issues.

  • Implements comprehensive software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion.

  • Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes.

  • Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.

  • Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

  • Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope.

  • Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture.

  • Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.

  • Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture.

  • Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

  • Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

  • Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions.

  • May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues.

  • Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.

  • Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

  • Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.

  • Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad-reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

  • Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.

  • Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently.

  • Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

  • Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

  • Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion.

  • Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

  • Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

Continuous Learning:

  • Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

title: Engineering Tech (Draft)
description:
The incumbent performs a variety of duties including Contract Officer Representative for complex construction projects of various disciplines in an extremely complex medical facility. The duties require the application of professional knowledge of the principles, methods, and techniques of engineering concerned in the practical working knowledge of heating and air conditioning, structural, and building performance of the work assignments.

The Engineering Tech (Draft) serves as the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for all construction projects and leases as assigned. They are required to possess and maintain relevant VA certifications as a condition of employment, i.e. COR, FAC-FEC, etc. Projects include architectural remodeling, mechanical, plumbing, and electrical system upgrades or replacements, hazardous material abatement, installation of complex systems such as elevators and security/access control systems, and new construction of buildings, structures, and other infrastructure. Prepares and oversees the production of plans, specifications, estimates, and schedules for complex projects. Reviews the needs of the medical center and makes recommendations as to the scope of the work (SOW). Duties Include: Plan, develop and oversee complex projects involving highly sophisticated medical equipment installation requiring methods and procedures not usually found in written procedures. Develop and draw preliminary sketches, plot utility plans, maps, architectural plans, electrical schematics, electrical circuit plans, plumbing schematics, plumbing plans (piping layout), heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system layouts, etc. with an optimal level of drafting techniques and use of the CAD system. Coordinates all assigned projects, including at times leases, from conception through completion. Review designs for technical soundness and inspecting all work completed by contractors and VAMC staff to ensure compliance. Responsible for resolving problems with the contractors should they arise. They maintain and update JAHVA record drawings as required. Prepares project documents for submission to the VISN and VACO requesting authorization and funding. Serves as a project team leader in planning and coordinating projects with facility services and staff, consultants, and contractors. Administers architectural/engineering (A/E) design contracts to ensure A/E conformance to project scope and design criteria, while ensuring accuracy. Plans for minimizing disruption to healthcare operations due to construction projects. Evaluates various alternatives and weighs cost versus time versus impacts to ongoing operations to select best alternatives Administers construction contracts for compliance with project documents and other applicable standards, evaluates submittals, and processes payment applications and invoices within the required time frames. Prepares reports required for VISN, VACO, and NCA tracking of project progress and funding allocation. Inspects construction progress on a regular basis to ensure compliance with drawings, specifications, schedule, and all applicable codes. Identifies deviations from contract documents and ensures proper corrective action is taken by the contractor in a timely manner. Ensures schedule milestones are met during design and construction project execution. Ensures all closeout documentation is received and filed. Conducts the final inspection(s) of the project area with JAHVA staff, NE, and contractor, ensuing completion of all items within the construction scope. Generates punch lists as necessary and tracks completion of all items noted as incomplete or requiring correction. Upon completion of punch list items, accepts the work on behalf of the government. Develops new specifications from templates provided on the Technical Information Library (TIL) as needed for in-house design projects. Performs other duties as assigned related to project management. Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Position Description/PD#: Engineering Tech (Draft)/PD04363A Physical Requirements: Most of the work is performed indoors in a well-lit, temperature and sound controlled office setting. However, incumbent may be exposed to the hazards of weather, dirt, dust etc. associated with construction settings while making "on-site" inspections of assigned projects. Incumbent must be physically able to climb, crawl, walk, stoop, sit and stand to perform assigned duties. Incumbent is also expected to comply with all safety codes and other practices described in the Engineering and Medical Center Safety Manuals.

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959 Subject to background/security investigation Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment. Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP) As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period or 2-year trial period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Upon completion of your probationary period or trial period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

title: Embedded Risk Associate Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

Pay and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact you will have in this role:

Being a member of Clearing & Security Services team, the Embedded Risk Manager strengthens the role of the first line of defense by challenging product management and general management of risks, including its effort to identify, assess, respond to, and report and monitor risks. In this role, the Risk Manager challenges management's assessment of internal control effectiveness by ensuring management's adherence to Control testing framework, Issue management framework (including self-identified issues), and Identified issues resulting from audits or regulatory exams, and partners with management on risk response strategies (mitigate, control, accept, remediate, etc.) to ensure the strategies sufficiently address identified risks, whether internal or external.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a strategic first-line risk partner to Business and Product Management, providing independent-minded review and challenge while helping management identify, assess, monitor, mitigate and communicate risks across the business.
  • Lead and coordinate Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) for assigned businesses, partnering with Risk Family SMEs and Aligned Risk Management to assess risk applicability, inherent risk, control effectiveness and residual risk; challenge ratings and supporting rationale and drive assessments through business-owner review and approval.
  • Lead Comprehensive Program Risk Assessments (CPRAs) and other change-risk assessments for strategic initiatives, modernization programs, new products/services and significant business or technology changes, ensuring emerging and changing risks are appropriately identified and incorporated into the business risk profile.
  • Monitor and assess the business risk profile, integrating information from risk incidents, issues and actions, control performance, audits, regulatory matters, risk assessments, business changes and strategic initiatives to identify emerging risks, concentrations and trends requiring management attention.
  • Provide effective review and challenge of risk incidents and control breakdowns, including assessment of root cause, business/client impact, control alignment, recurring themes and potential implications to the broader risk and control environment.
  • Oversee the Issue and Action lifecycle, including identification and development of self-identified issues, remediation-plan adequacy, milestone monitoring, escalation of at-risk items, closure-package review and sustainability considerations.
  • Review and challenge the Process, Risk and Control framework, including control design, control mappings, control testing results and other GRC data to ensure risks and controls remain appropriately represented and supported.
  • Lead ERM engagement for internal and external audits, coordinating business readiness and information requests, identifying potential risk or control concerns, supporting development of Management Self-Identified Issues where appropriate, and monitoring remediation of resulting findings.
  • Coordinate business risk governance and senior-management reporting, including quarterly risk meetings, risk-tolerance assessments, executive risk reporting and other governance forums; synthesize complex risk information into clear themes, decisions and areas requiring management attention.
  • Provide risk oversight and coordination across enterprise risk programs and regulatory obligations, including regulatory reporting, business continuity/resiliency, third-party risk, model risk, EUCAs, clearing agency/link risk reviews and other applicable enterprise risk frameworks.
  • Partner across the first, second and third lines of defense, acting as the primary risk liaison among Business Management, Risk Family SMEs, Aligned Risk Management, Compliance, Audit and other control functions to resolve risk matters and ensure appropriate escalation and accountability.
  • Drive continuous improvement and consistency across ERM practices, identifying opportunities to standardize risk processes, improve reporting and governance, strengthen documentation and make ERM activities more efficient and scalable.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8 years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

Talents Needed for Success:

  • AI & Digital Mindset (Key Differentiator)
  • Familiar with Risk and Control Self‑Assessments (RCSAs), including risk identification, inherent and residual risk assessment, control design evaluation, and challenge of risk ratings
  • Inclination toward AI-driven risk insights, automation, and data-led decision-making
  • Ability to leverage data for trend analysis, predictive risk identification, and reporting optimization
  • Prior experience in Risk Management & Incident Management
  • Experience with stakeholder management and influencing senior leadership
  • Knowledge of issue lifecycle management, audits, and control frameworks
  • Be a change ambassador and drive forward improvements
  • Proactive and laser focused on cultivating a risk mentality
  • Execution and delivery focused in a fast-paced environment
  • Financial services business acumen, with the ability to understand supported business areas, critical services, and client impacts, and to align risk assessments to business
