title: Senior Director, Data Center Facilities Development
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Center Development organization leads the planning, design, and delivery of the next generation of Oracle’s global data center portfolio. We are seeking a Senior Director of Data Center Development to provide strategic leadership and organizational oversight for the design of mission-critical infrastructure across OCI’s rapidly expanding global footprint.

This role is responsible for establishing and executing OCI’s data center design strategy across a portfolio of large-scale, highly complex developments. The Senior Director will lead a team of design management professionals and provide executive-level oversight of multidisciplinary design activities spanning architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and mission-critical infrastructure systems.

The position requires a combination of organizational leadership, technical depth, design governance, and portfolio management. The successful candidate will establish clear design requirements, drive consistency across projects and delivery partners, manage technical risk, and ensure that OCI’s facilities meet established requirements for performance, reliability, resiliency, scalability, constructability, and operational readiness.

The Senior Director will serve as a senior technical and organizational leader within OCI Data Center Development, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other internal organizations. The role will also provide senior-level direction to colocation partners, architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other external stakeholders responsible for delivering OCI

Responsibilities:

• Lead the Data Center Design Management function for an assigned global or multi-region portfolio of hyperscale and mission-critical infrastructure projects.

• Establish organizational priorities, expectations, governance processes, and performance standards for the design management team.

• Lead, develop, and mentor design managers and design leadership personnel, establishing clear accountability for project execution, technical quality, and professional development.

• Provide portfolio-level oversight of multidisciplinary data center design across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.

• Establish and maintain design governance throughout the project lifecycle, from early planning and Basis of Design development through schematic design, design development, construction documentation, construction support, commissioning, and record documentation.

• Ensure projects maintain alignment with OCI technical requirements, design standards, operational requirements, reliability objectives, and infrastructure strategies.

• Provide senior technical leadership for high-density compute environments, including mechanical systems, liquid cooling, electrical infrastructure, controls, and other mission-critical systems supporting next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure.

• Drive consistent implementation and continuous improvement of OCI global data center design standards, specifications, design criteria, and best practices.

• Establish effective design review, technical approval, change management, and decision-making processes across the portfolio.

• Identify systemic and project-specific design risks and ensure appropriate mitigation, escalation, and resolution before those risks impact construction, schedule, cost, reliability, or operations.

• Lead resolution of complex multidisciplinary technical issues requiring coordination across internal organizations, design consultants, construction teams, operators, and external delivery partners.

• Partner with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other OCI organizations to ensure infrastructure requirements are coordinated and incorporated into project designs.

• Provide senior-level oversight of architects, engineers, consultants, colocation providers, and other design partners responsible for delivering OCI infrastructure.

• Establish expectations for consultant scope, performance, technical quality, schedule adherence, and design deliverables.

• Ensure Basis of Design, SD, DD, permit, IFC, and record design packages meet OCI requirements and are appropriately reviewed and approved.

• Drive standardization and repeatability while maintaining the flexibility necessary to address regional requirements, site conditions, utility constraints, code requirements, and evolving technology.

• Evaluate proposed design changes and deviations to determine portfolio-level impacts to reliability, operations, schedule, cost, standards, and future scalability.

• Develop and monitor design performance metrics, portfolio risks, technical issues, and organizational priorities, providing clear reporting and recommendations to executive leadership.

• Support strategic planning for future data center capacity, emerging technologies, new infrastructure architectures, and evolving cloud and AI requirements.

• Represent OCI Data Center Design Management in executive reviews, technical workshops, partner engagements, design reviews, and other internal and external forums.

• Build a culture of technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined design governance across the organization.

Required Qualifications:

• Professional licensure required as a Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE).

• Accredited degree in Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in data center, mission-critical, industrial, or large-scale infrastructure design and development.

• Significant leadership experience managing design professionals, multidisciplinary technical teams, and external architecture and engineering organizations.

• Demonstrated experience leading large-scale hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or mission-critical infrastructure programs.

• Strong multidisciplinary understanding of data center architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.

• Demonstrated ability to establish and manage design governance, standards, technical requirements, and change control across multiple concurrent projects.

• Experience managing complex project portfolios involving multiple sites, delivery partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of data center mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with experience in high-density and liquid-cooled environments strongly preferred.

• Strong understanding of data center electrical distribution, resiliency strategies, controls, commissioning, and operational requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to identify, communicate, and resolve complex technical and organizational risks.

• Experience working within accelerated design and construction programs where schedule, scalability, repeatability, and technical quality are critical.

• Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to both executive and technical audiences.

• Working knowledge of applicable data center codes, standards, and industry guidance, including NFPA, ASHRAE, IBC, and other applicable international, national, and local requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 15+ years of experience in mission-critical or large-scale infrastructure design and development.

• Experience leading design organizations supporting hyperscale cloud or AI infrastructure.

• Experience managing global or multi-region data center portfolios.

• Experience developing and implementing enterprise-level data center design standards, specifications, and governance programs.

• Experience with high-density compute environments, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, advanced thermal management, and next-generation data center infrastructure.

• Experience with colocation and developer-led delivery models, including oversight of third-party design and construction partners.

• Experience implementing formal design review, technical deviation, change management, and lessons-learned processes.

• Working knowledge of BIM, digital design coordination, document management, and design collaboration platforms.

• LEED AP, Uptime ATD, or other relevant mission-critical industry certifications.

• Demonstrated experience developing high-performing technical teams and future organizational leaders.

Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Delta Live Tables (DLT) — pipeline development, expectations, and monitoring.

title: Senior Cloud Architect Financial Services Industry (FSI)
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Architect – Financial Services to help customers define and execute their cloud modernization and technology transformation strategies.

This role combines deep technical expertise, strategic consulting, and strong customer engagement capabilities. The successful candidate will work closely with financial institutions to understand their business priorities, assess existing technology environments, and design innovative cloud, data, and AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

As a trusted technical advisor, you will engage with senior business and technology stakeholders, providing architectural guidance, developing modernization roadmaps, and supporting customers throughout their cloud adoption journey.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in enterprise cloud architecture, database technologies, and infrastructure modernization, along with a strong consulting mindset and an understanding of the challenges facing the financial services industry.

Key Responsibilities 1. Cloud Architecture & Technology Modernization
  • Design and recommend scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with customer business and technical requirements.
  • Assess existing enterprise infrastructure, databases, and application environments to identify modernization opportunities.
  • Develop cloud migration and modernization strategies, including hybrid and multicloud architectures.
  • Provide architectural guidance on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), enterprise databases, data platforms, and related cloud technologies.
  • Support technical discovery, architecture design, proof of concepts (POCs), and implementation planning.
2. Strategic Consulting & Customer Advisory
  • Act as a trusted technology advisor to financial services customers, helping them navigate complex technology decisions.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customers' business models, technology landscapes, and strategic priorities.
  • Lead consultative discussions with CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Translate business challenges into actionable technology strategies, architectural recommendations, and transformation roadmaps.
  • Independently develop and present technical proposals, solution recommendations, and business-oriented architecture presentations.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and recommend solutions based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, and operational requirements.
3. Financial Services Industry Expertise
  • Understand the technology and business challenges of banks, insurance companies, fintech organizations, and other financial institutions.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize mission-critical platforms and improve operational efficiency, scalability, security, and resilience.
  • Provide architectural recommendations that consider regulatory requirements, data protection, business continuity, and industry-specific technology standards.
  • Support customer initiatives involving digital banking, core systems modernization, enterprise data platforms, and cloud transformation.
  • Stay informed about emerging technology trends and their potential impact on the financial services industry.
4. Customer Engagement & Solution Development
  • Partner with Sales and technical teams to support strategic customer engagements and cloud opportunities.
  • Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, solution demonstrations, and proof-of-concept initiatives.
  • Develop compelling technical and business value propositions tailored to customer needs.
  • Guide customers through the solution lifecycle, from initial discovery and architectural assessment to adoption planning.
  • Build long-term relationships with technical and executive stakeholders, establishing credibility through technical expertise and business understanding.
5. Data, AI & Emerging Technologies
  • Identify opportunities to leverage enterprise data platforms, analytics, and artificial intelligence to address business challenges.
  • Collaborate with customers to define data-driven and AI use cases that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Recommend architectural approaches for integrating cloud, data, and AI capabilities with existing enterprise environments.
  • Support customers in evaluating emerging technologies and their applicability to financial services use cases.
6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Leadership
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and other technical teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Coordinate with internal specialists to address complex architectural and customer requirements.
  • Contribute to the development of reference architectures, technical presentations, solution guides, and best practices.
  • Share technical knowledge and industry insights with internal teams and customers.
  • Continuously develop expertise in cloud infrastructure, enterprise databases, data platforms, AI, and emerging technologies.

Required Qualifications

title: Tool and Die Maker
description:
Summary:

Sets up and operates conventional and CNC machines. Performs the layout and fabrication of tools, dies, special machines, machine modifications, and K-Fast tooling. Develop new products using exotic and composite materials while meeting established quality standards. Has moderate control to make process adjustments after tasks are assigned.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Tooling Fabrication: Determines the layout, fabrication, and assembly of complex tools, dies, special machines, machine modifications, fixtures, and K-Fast tooling using prints, drawings, sketches, and verbal instructions.
  • Machine Setup & Operation: Sets up and operates conventional and CNC lathes, mills, grinders, honing machines, center laps, and other specialized equipment.
  • Precision Machining: Performs complex machining operations to produce tooling and components to exact dimensional and tolerance requirements.
  • Tooling Layout & Development: Performs detailed layouts for tooling and components and develops sketches for tooling designs, part development, and progressions.
  • Specialized Materials & Processes: Works with exotic and composite materials and applies specialized processes, including EDM, grinding, jig boring, welding, and heat treatment, as required.
  • Tooling Prove-Out & Troubleshooting: Proves, tests, debugs, and reworks tooling and special equipment. Make process adjustments and resolves tooling and machining issues.
  • Design & Process Improvement: Recommends tooling design revisions, material substitutions, and alternative fabrication methods. Constructs temporary tooling for short production runs as required.
  • Inspection & Quality Control: Uses precision measuring instruments and inspection equipment to verify tooling and components meet dimensional and quality requirements.
  • Training & Knowledge Sharing: Trains and provides guidance to Tool & Die apprentices and employees with less experience or skill.
  • Equipment Maintenance: Performs routine maintenance on machines and equipment, including changing grinding wheels.
  • Material Handling: Safely lifts and transports materials, tooling, and parts weighing up to 30 pounds.
  • Safety & Housekeeping: Maintains a clean, safe, and organized work area and equipment while following all applicable safety procedures.
  • Other Duties: Performs other duties of equal or lesser skill as assigned.

Benefits/Salary:

The position includes competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package available day one of hire, including health insurance (medical, dental, vision), excellent 401k matching program, paid holidays and vacation. Howmet Aerospace curates a strong working environment through opportunities for career progression, community engagement activities, and flexible schedules contingent upon role and location. The salary range for this position ___$24.70____ - ___$41.99____.

Education, Experience, and Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred.
  • 5-7 years of experience in a tool room environment or equivalent previous experience with a fastener manufacturing company. Ability to trouble-shoot and solve problems of the most advanced level. Must possess a working knowledge of ferrous and non-ferrous metals and their alloys.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a working knowledge of ferrous and non-ferrous metals.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical documents, safety procedures, and work instructions.
  • Proficient in basic math, precision measurements, and completing production documentation.
  • Effective verbal communication and computer skills, including experience with Syteline Manufacturing software preferred.

  • Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: ICT Risk Assessment Manager
description:
About the opportunity

We are looking for a ICT Risk Assessment Manager to join the Information Risk Management (IRM) Segment and work at the heart of ICT Compliance at N26. As part of our team, you’ll be at the forefront of building a compliance culture that’s innovative, scalable, and seamlessly integrated into our operations, making compliance a key driver of N26’s competitive advantage.


In this role, you will:

  • Manage the full lifecycle of ICT risk assessments, from initial risk identification to final remediation monitoring.
  • Assist in task prioritization, workload coordination, and ensuring timely delivery of risk assessments.
  • Foster a collaborative and open team environment, encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a point of contact for team-related topics and support escalation handling when needed.
  • Support the implementation and execution of the key pillars of Risk Management & Reporting in the field of Information Security.

  • Execute ICT Risk Assessments and ICT Audits for third-party provided tools and services in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Proactively coordinate activities with Third Party Vendors, Product Owners, Security Engineers and within the IRM Segment to perform the aforementioned assessments.
  • Provide technical and quality oversight regarding ICT risks, controls and technologies, including ongoing risk assessments, risk decisions, control implementation, evaluation of segregation of duties, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute to perform Protection Requirement Analysis to determine the criticality of N26’s information assets and their needs for protection.
  • Identify gaps in current frameworks and lead improvement efforts that streamline the team's efficiency.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, distilling complex technical risks into clear, actionable essence for leadership.
  • Participate in the coaching and training of new hires and junior colleagues, ensuring quality of deliverables.
  • Develop KPIs and KRIs that support monitoring of ICT third party risks and reporting to 2nd line.

What you need to be successful:

  • Strong understanding of Information & Communication Technologies (ICT) and the ICT Risk Management domain, as well as audit/compliance frameworks, methodologies and related processes.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with peers, as well as stakeholders of all levels from the partner companies.
  • Previous experience working in a dynamic environment of a technology-driven business (as e.g. a scaled startup).
  • Hands-on experience with cross-functional teams, business operations analysts, security engineers, software engineers, product managers, data analysts, IT audit functions, among other relevant stakeholders, in assessing processes, risks and controls.
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience on SOC reports, ISO 27001 certification and other standards or frameworks as a plus (as e.g., PCI DSS).
  • Previous experience in the banking sector is a plus, especially understanding of MaRisk and DORA requirements. Experience with Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms.
  • Strong Sense of Ownership: You are able to inherit a workflow, identify its weaknesses, and independently implement improvements and optimizations on your own initiative.
  • Experience with AI tools to improve workflows and efficiency

Skills:

  • Proficiency with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) tools
  • Detail-oriented approach to analyzing technical evidence and documenting findings.
  • Fluency in English is strictly required. German language knowledge is a plus.
  • A hands-on mentality, eager to suggest and implement process improvements.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: UN Women: International Consultant, Gender and Private Sector Engagement Expert in Crisis and Recovery Settings (Retainer), Home-Based
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. Placing women’s rights at the centre of all its efforts, the UN Women leads and coordinates the United Nations system efforts to ensure that commitments on gender equality and gender mainstreaming translate into action throughout the world. It provides strong and coherent leadership in support of Member States’ priorities and efforts, building effective partnerships with civil society and other relevant actors.

UN Women’s triple mandate, along with its global network and deep policy and programming expertise, continues to endow the Entity with a unique capacity to: (i) support Member States to strengthen global norms and standards for gender equality and women’s empowerment, and mainstream gender perspectives in other thematic areas; (ii) promote coordination and coherence across the UN system to enhance accountability and results for gender equality and women’s empowerment; and (iii) undertake operational activities to support Member States, upon their request, in translating global norms and standards into legislation, policies and strategies at country level.

UN Women plays an innovative and catalytic role in the State of Palestine since its inception in 1997 (as UNIFEM). In line with the national priorities, the work of UN Women for the period 2023-2025 is aligned with three of the Palestine United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework’s (UNSDCF) outcomes:

• Palestinians have greater access to economic opportunities that are inclusive, resilient, and sustainable, including decent employment and livelihoods opportunities in an empowered private sector.

• Palestinians, including the most vulnerable, have equal access to sustainable, inclusive, gender responsive and quality social services, social protection, and affordable utilities.

• Palestinian governance institutions, processes, and mechanisms at all levels are more democratic, rights-based, inclusive, and accountable.

Its three-year Strategic Note supports the efforts to achieve measurable results in country in terms of four UN Women global Strategic Plan impacts (2022-2025): (SP Impact 1). Governance and participation in public life; (SP Impact 2). Women’s Economic Empowerment; (SP Impact 3). Ending Violence Against Women and Girls; SP Impact 4. Women peace and security, Humanitarian & Disaster Risk Reduction.

UN Women is planning to implement early recovery programming which aims to support enterprise recovery, restore livelihoods, create employment opportunities, and strengthen economic resilience, with a strong focus on ensuring that women benefit equitably from economic recovery efforts. Emphasis for this assignment will be on private sector recovery including in light industries, and in the textiles and garment industries, as well as in the care industry and food production and processing, among others.

Women-owned businesses, SMEs and women workers face multiple barriers to participation in economic recovery initiatives, including limited access to productive resources, workplace discrimination, care responsibilities, mobility restrictions, and reduced opportunities for advancement. In fragile and crisis-affected contexts, these challenges are often exacerbated. Consequently, there is a need to engage private sector actors in adopting gender-responsive business practices that promote women's participation, retention, leadership, and economic empowerment.

The consultant will provide strategic and technical expertise to strengthen gender-sensitive private sector engagement across the programme and ensure that women's economic empowerment objectives are systematically integrated into enterprise recovery interventions, workplace practices, and business development support. The consultant will provide advice through the framework of the Women's Empowerment Principles.

Demand side (women workers): The consultant will support UN Women in Gaza and partners (including UN agencies and women-led organisations and enterprises) with outreach and identification of women workers, followed by developing a tailored case management to address barriers to employment. This could include identifying childcare and other care services, transportation, protection referrals, and other support needed for women to access and retain work. The consultant may also advise on facilitating TVET certification, skills development, mentoring, and coaching.

Supply side (enterprises): The consultant will focus on supporting enterprises through expertise on the Women's Empowerment Principles (WEPs) and private sector engagement to create safer, more inclusive, and gender-responsive and disability inclusive workplaces. The consultant will support enterprises on a progressive pathway towards WEPs adoption by applying and operationalizing key WEPs principles.

The consultant will report to the Programme Analyst (Humanitarian and Early Recovery) and will work closely with the UN Women Gaza team, relevant ministries, project partners, participating enterprises, light industries/factories employing women, chambers of commerce, women-led and owned businesses, women's organizations, and other relevant stakeholders.

Description of Responsibilities /Scope of Work

1. Gender Analysis and Private Sector Engagement Strategy

  • Conduct gender-responsive assessments of target enterprises and economic sectors.
  • Identify barriers and opportunities affecting women's access to employment, entrepreneurship, leadership, and decent work.
  • Analyze enterprise practices from a gender equality and inclusion perspective.
  • Develop recommendations to strengthen gender-responsive private sector engagement throughout project implementation.
  • Prepare a practical gender-sensitive private sector engagement framework.

2. Support Gender-Responsive Enterprise Recovery

  • Provide technical guidance on integrating gender considerations into enterprise recovery and workforce development interventions.
  • Advise on strategies to increase women's participation in employment opportunities created under the programme including in light industries.
  • Ensure inclusion of women-led enterprises, cooperatives, and home-based producers.
  • Develop recommendations to improve retention and advancement of women workers.

3. Workplace Inclusion and Responsible Business Practices

  • Support participating enterprises in adopting gender-responsive workplace policies and procedures.
  • Develop guidance on gender-responsive recruitment, retention, promotion, and leadership pathways.
  • Strengthen enterprise capacities on prevention of workplace discrimination, sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse ensuring safe and protective workplaces for women workers.
  • Advise on grievance, referral, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Support implementation of workplace inclusion and safety standards.

4. Capacity Building and Coaching

  • Design and facilitate training sessions for enterprises, business associations, and project partners.
  • Deliver coaching and technical advisory support to participating businesses.
  • Build awareness of the business case for gender equality and women's economic empowerment.
  • Support companies in developing practical workplace improvement plans.

5. Data, Knowledge Products and Learning

  • Advise on collecting and analysing data on women’s employment in the private sector.
  • Develop practical guidance materials, tools, SOPs, and checklists related to gender-sensitive private sector engagement.
  • Produce case studies highlighting successful practices and lessons learned.
  • Document innovative approaches to women's economic participation and enterprise recovery.
  • Contribute recommendations for future economic recovery and private sector programming.

Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel

This is a home-based consultancy, without travel.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

  • Technical expertise in women's economic empowerment and private sector development.
  • Strong understanding of gender-responsive business practices and workplace inclusion including WEPs.
  • Ability to engage effectively with private sector stakeholders and employers.
  • Capacity to translate gender analysis into practical business solutions.
  • Experience designing tools, frameworks, and guidance materials.
  • Strong analytical, facilitation, and advisory skills.

Education and Certification:

  • Master's degree or equivalent in Gender Studies, Economics, Business Administration, Social Sciences, Development Studies, International Development, Human Rights, or a related field is required.
  • A first-level university degree combined with two additional years of relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of an advanced degree.

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in women's economic empowerment, private sector engagement, inclusive economic development, or related fields is required. At least 2 years of those must be experience working in Crisis and Recovery settings.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing gender-responsive employment, entrepreneurship, and private sector programmes is desirable.
  • Proven experience engaging with private sector actors and promoting inclusive workplace practices including familiarity with the Women’s Empowerment Principles is required.
  • Experience conducting gender analyses and developing gender mainstreaming frameworks is desirable.
  • Experience delivering training, coaching, and technical advisory services is desirable.
  • Experience in humanitarian, recovery, or fragile contexts is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in Palestine or the Middle East is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with UN agencies and international organizations is highly desirable.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Working knowledge of Arabic is desirable.

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

title: Vaihteistojen kokoonpanoasentaja, Katsa Oy
description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme Katsa Oy:lle kokoonpanoasentajaa vahvistamaan kasvavaa tuotantotiimiä. Katsa Oy on vakiinnuttanut asemansa laadukkaiden hammaspyörien ja erikoisvaihteiden toimittajana, jonka tuotteita käytetään ympäri maailmaa esimerkiksi laivamoottoreissa, voimalaitoksissa, paperikoneissa ja monissa muissa kohteissa.

Työssä pääset osaksi teollisuusympäristöä, jossa panostetaan laatuun, turvallisuuteen ja jatkuvaan kehittämiseen.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ PÄÄSET TEKEMÄÄN?

Kokoonpanoasentajana työskentelet vaihteistojen kokoonpanon parissa. Kyse ei ole pelkästä yksittäisten osien sarjakokoonpanosta, vaan rakennat suurempia kokonaisuuksia asiakastilausten ja teknisten piirustusten mukaisesti.

Työssä tarvitaan hyvää mekaanista hahmotuskykyä, tarkkuutta sekä ymmärrystä metallista materiaalina. Osaat lukea teknisiä kuvia ja käyttää sujuvasti tavallisia käsityökaluja. Työ sopii tekijälle, joka nauttii konkreettisesta tekemisestä ja haluaa nähdä oman työnsä jäljen valmiissa tuotteessa.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää aiempaa kokemusta metallialan kokoonpanotyöstä. Toivomme sinulta soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta, kuten kone- ja tuotantotekniikan perustutkintoa, ajoneuvoalan koulutusta tai muuta vastaavaa teknistä taustaa.

Olennaista tehtävässä on:

* kokemus mekaanisesta kokoonpanosta metallialalla

* hyvä teknisten piirustusten lukutaito

* käsityökalujen sujuva ja turvallinen käyttö

* ymmärrys metallien ominaisuuksista ja käyttäytymisestä eri lämpötiloissa

* riittävä suomen kielen taito työohjeiden ja teknisten piirustusten ymmärtämiseen

* huolellinen ja vastuullinen työskentelyote sekä rohkeus kysyä, jos jokin työohjeessa on epäselvää.

MILLAINEN TYÖPAIKKA KATSA ON?

Katsalla pääset työskentelemään siistissä ja toimivassa teollisessa työympäristössä, jossa työpisteiden, työkalujen ja työpöytien suunnittelussa on kiinnitetty huomiota ergonomiaan ja työn sujuvuuteen. Työyhteisö on hyvähenkinen ja henkilöstö viihtyy työpaikalla.

Katsa on kasvava ja arvostettu teollisuusyritys. Kasvusta kertoo myös Pirkkalaan valmistuva uusi tehdas, jonka on määrä valmistua kesällä 2027. Tässä tehtävässä pääset siis mukaan yrityksen kasvuvaiheeseen ja saat mahdollisuuden rakentaa pidempää työuraa Katsalla.

TYÖSUHDE

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työ on kokoaikainen, 40 h/vk, ja työaika on klo 7.00–15.30 (vuorotyömahdollisuus).

Palkkaus on osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta riippuen noin 15–16 €/h. Noudatamme teknologiateollisuuden tes:iä.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan marraskuussa 2026.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos sinulla on kokemusta metallialan kokoonpanosta, tekniset piirustukset ovat sinulle tuttuja ja etsit pitkäaikaista työtä laadukkaassa teollisuusympäristössä, tässä voi olla seuraava työpaikkasi.

title: Field Construction Supervisor
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

Arcadis is seeking an experienced Field Construction Supervisor to join the Arcadis Construction Services (ACS) Team. The Field Construction Supervisor will support Construction Administration and Owner’s Representative services for construction projects at industrial facilities, with an emphasis on AFFF foam-transition and fire suppression system experience. The successful candidate will provide field leadership and oversee subcontractors performing civil, mechanical, electrical, and other construction work. AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam) transition projects may include demolition, decontamination, waste handling, fire protection system modifications, replacement system installation, testing, commissioning, and project closeout. This role follows industry practices for construction oversight and administration on AFFF conversion projects.

This role will his role will require extensive travel to project sites throughout the United States.

Role accountabilities:

The Field Construction Supervisor will act as the owner's on-site representative, ensuring work is completed safely, in accordance with contract documents, project schedules, quality requirements, regulatory requirements, and facility operational constraints. The ideal candidate will effectively manage multiple subcontractors in an active industrial environment and communicate professionally with facility personnel, contractors, engineers, and project managers.

Construction Oversight:

  • Serve as the primary field representative for the owner during construction activities.
  • Monitor subcontractor performance, staffing, productivity, workmanship, and compliance with project requirements.
  • Verify construction is performed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, permits, and applicable codes.
  • Conduct routine site inspections and document progress and deficiencies.
  • Coordinate daily field activities with facility operations personnel and project stakeholders.

Fire Protection and AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam) Transition Projects:

  • Oversee removal and decommissioning of existing AFFF foam suppression systems.
  • Monitor PFAS-related decontamination, flushing, waste handling, transportation, and disposal activities.
  • Oversee installation of replacement fire suppression systems, including water-based, fluorine-free foam, sprinkler, deluge, detection, alarm, and releasing systems.
  • Coordinate impairment management, temporary fire protection measures, fire watches, shutdowns, and system cutovers.
  • Support acceptance testing, commissioning, and turnover activities.

Contract Administration:

  • Review field reports, schedules, daily logs, testing documentation, and quality records.
  • Participate in progress meetings and subcontractor coordination meetings.
  • Track RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, punch-list items, and corrective actions.
  • Review contractor progress against schedule and report potential impacts.
  • Assist with change-order evaluations and documentation.
  • Review contractor payment applications and verify completed work quantities.

Health, Safety, and Compliance:

  • Promote and enforce project health and safety requirements.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with OSHA, site-specific safety plans, and environmental requirements.
  • Verify proper handling of hazardous and non-hazardous wastes associated with system removal and decontamination activities.
  • Support incident investigations and corrective-action implementation.
  • Ensure work is performed with minimal impact to ongoing facility operations.

Quality Assurance:

  • Verify materials, equipment, and installations meet project requirements.
  • Witness pressure tests, flushing, acceptance testing, integrated system testing, and commissioning events.
  • Maintain deficiency logs and oversee punch-list completion.
  • Verify as-built documentation and closeout deliverables are complete and accurate.

Qualifications & Experience:

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of construction supervision or construction management experience with 3+ years of experience with industrial facility construction projects preferred.
• Demonstrated experience overseeing subcontractors in active industrial facilities.
• Working knowledge of fire protection systems, including sprinkler, foam, deluge, detection, and alarm systems preferred.
• Experience with contractor scheduling, safety oversight, and quality control.
• Strong skills in problem-solving, team communications, and documentation/reporting.
• Strong working knowledge of construction drawings and specifications, with the ability to identify deviations, resolve field conflicts, and ensure subcontractor compliance with the design intent.
• Ability to travel extensively to project sites.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with AFFF transition, PFAS-related remediation, or fire suppression system replacement projects.
• Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Fire Protection, or related discipline is desirable, not required.
• Knowledge of NFPA standards, including NFPA 11, NFPA 13, NFPA 15, NFPA 16, NFPA 30, and related fire protection codes.
• OSHA 30-Hour certification.
• NICET certification, Certified Construction Manager (CCM), Project Management Professional (PMP), or similar credentials.
• Experience within chemical manufacturing, petroleum, aerospace, industrial manufacturing, or distribution facilities.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Arcadis offers benefits for full time and part time positions. These benefits include medical, dental, and vision, EAP, 401K, STD, LTD, AD&D, life insurance, paid parental leave, reward & recognition program and optional benefits including wellbeing benefits, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement. We offer nine paid holidays and 15 days PTO that accrue per year. The salary range for this position is $58,320- $97,200. Actual salaries will vary and are based on several factors, such as experience, education, budget, internal equity, project and location.

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience
    • OR equivalent experience

  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Pearl, Shell or other related technologies is a plus.
  • Knowledgable in IP, Subsystem, and/or full chip verification workflows or ASIC/FPGAs.

title: Director, GMP Operations
description:
About Century Therapeutics:
Century Therapeutics (NASDAQ: IPSC) is a biotechnology company advancing a pipeline of induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived cell therapies with the potential to meaningfully address autoimmune diseases, including type 1 diabetes, and cancer. The company’s therapies are derived from its iPSC cell foundry and leverage its novel immune evasion engineering technology, Allo-Evasion™. Century believes its approach to developing off-the-shelf cell therapies will expand patient access and provide advantages over existing cell therapies which will ultimately advance the course of care.


Role:

The Director, GMP Operations will provide strategic and operational leadership in the areas of GMP operations, including validation, warehouse operations, and overall facility readiness for Century’s cell therapy GMP clinical manufacturing facility. The candidate will develop and maintain site specific manufacturing infrastructure, policies, and systems and will provide operational oversight for the manufacture and supply of cellular therapy clinical products. This position will play a critical role in the Manufacturing facility and has responsibility for leading all site-level manufacturing, inventory, and Commissioning, Qualification, Validation (CQV) processes and procedures.


The work expectation for this role is 5 days per-week on-site.


The expected annual salary range for this role is approximately $195,000 - $218,000 depending on experience. Additional benefits offered include but are not limited to an annual performance-based bonus (prorated by start date), medical, dental, and vision insurance, matching 401K plan, and 20+ days per-year of PTO (prorated by start date). Additionally, employees not requiring sponsorship are preferred.

title: Engineer I, Grad Rotation Program
description:
Propel your career with Seaspan Shipyards! We are currently recruiting 6 engineering graduates to join our Graduate Rotation Program commencing in September 2027. In this two-year program you will gain meaningful work experience, mentorship, and targeted training across a range of business areas within the company, working in a diverse and collaborative environment.

The Seaspan Graduate Rotation Program is open to recent graduates who can demonstrate the following:

  • Recently completed (within 2 years) an Undergraduate or Graduate Degree in Naval Architecture, Marine, Electrical, Mechanical, Systems Engineering or other relevant engineering subject. Graduation date must be by August 31, 2027.
  • Registration as an Engineer-In-Training with EGBC, or ability to attain.
  • Proven track record of both strong academic and extracurricular achievements.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications, specifically Word, Excel, PowerPoint and experience with computer aided drawing/modelling tools.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and timelines.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including written, verbal, listening and presentation.
  • Strong research, problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability to take initiative, ownership and drive tasks to completion.
  • Committed to our Core Values of Safety, Care, Efficiency and Accountability.

How it works

Participants will rotate through the following discipline areas within our Vancouver Shipyard operations:

  • Engineering
  • Program Management
  • Planning and Estimating
  • Production Support
  • Coast Guard Office (Ottawa, ON)

In each discipline area, you will spend 3 – 6 months training and developing new skills, while contributing to state-of-the-art shipbuilding projects. At the end of the program, you will be offered a permanent position based on availability, suitability, and performance. You will be able to confidently take this next step knowing that you have a solid foundation of demonstrable skills and experience to build from, complimented by an exceptional understanding of how Seaspan builds ships.

Why you'll love working here

  • With multiple operations and long-term projects, Seaspan employees enjoy job stability as we look ahead to build ships for decades to come.
  • In addition to an annual bonus and pension plan matching, this role provides you a very competitive salary in line with the successful candidate’s experience.
  • We also provide the best-in-class health and wellness benefits package for this position, including things such as extended health care (i.e. paramedical services for massage therapy, speech therapy, mental health coverage, physiotherapy, and more), dental care, vision care, life insurance, medical leave coverage, parental leave coverage, childcare benefit partnership, $500 personal spending account, and an Employee Family Assistance Program (EFAP).

Due to the nature of this position, and requirements of the Government of Canada, this position requires the successful candidate to obtain and maintain a Canada Controlled Goods Program approval, Reliability Status (or higher depending on position) security clearance issued by the Government of Canada. All required approvals and clearances must be obtained prior to commencement of employment in any position.


To successfully apply, please submit your Academic Transcript, Resume and Cover Letter as one PDF document.

Application Closing Date: Wednesday, November 18, 2027, at 11:59pm PST.

Note: Due to business needs, this position is required to be fully on-site based mainly at our North Vancouver office with potential short-term relocation across our Canada-wide offices.

The estimated salary for this position is $78,300 - $95,700. In determining final salary, Seaspan considers many factors including the successful Candidate’s skillset and experience as well as position location and internal equity. The final base salary offer will be at the Company’s sole discretion and presented as part of a competitive total compensation package.

title: Sähköautomaatioasentaja Algol Technics Oy:lle
description:
Haluatko Lahden ykköspaikalle töihin? Etsitkö kunnossapidon töitä monipuolisen laitekannan parista?

Etsimme asiakkaallemme Algol Technics Oy:lle motivoitunutta ja osaavaa sähköautomaatioasentajaa kokopäiväiseen ja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työpiste sijaitsee Hartwallin tehtaalla Lahdessa.

Algol Technics toimittaa moderneja teollisuuden automaatioratkaisuja, joiden tavoitteena on asiakkaan tuotanto- ja logistiikkaprosessien tehostuminen. Tavoitteena on asiakkaan toiveet ylittävä ratkaisu, joka tuottaa selkeitä hyötyjä, lisäarvoa ja lisää tätä kautta asiakkaan kilpailukykyä. Kaikkiin toimittamiinsa ratkaisuihin Algol Technics tarjoaa kattavat huolto- ja kunnossapitopalvelut. Yhtiö kuuluu Algol-konserniin. Lue lisää:<http://www.algoltechnics.fi/> .

Algol on suomalainen kaupan monialakonserni, joka toimii laajassa kansainvälisessä kumppaniverkostossa vastuullisesti ja yli 130 vuoden kokemuksella. Algol työllistää noin 500 alan ammattilaista kymmenessä maassa. Lue lisää: <http://www.algol.fi/> . Algol Technicsin toimintaa on kiteytetty videoksi tänne <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dRlEivTm7wM&t=1s> .

Työpäiväsi

Työpäiväsi kuluvat Hartwallin tehtaan logistiikkapuolella erilaisten sähkö- ja automaatiokunnossapidon tehtävien parissa. Vastaat erilaisten laitteistojen toimintavarmuuden ylläpitämisestä ja pääset hyödyntämään teknistä osaamistasi niin ennakoivissa huolloissa, kuin haastavampien vikatilanteiden ratkaisemisessa. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa laitteistojen määräaikaishuollot, käynnissäpito, häiriönpoistot, vikakorjaukset sekä erilaiset tilaustyöt ja asiakaspalvelutehtävät. Kunnossapidettävä laitekanta koostuu esimerkiksi korkeatavarahisseistä ja kuljettimista, joten päivittäinen työsi onkin vaihtelevaa ja monipuolista.

Viikoittainen työaikasi on 40 tuntia maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7.00–15.30. Työhön sisältyy lisäksi satunnaisia lauantaivuoroja (noin 6 kertaa vuodessa). Työsuhteessa noudatetaan Teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimusta, ja palkkauksesta sovitaan ammattitaitosi sekä kokemuksesi perusteella.

Arvostamme
* Sähköalan tutkintoa
* Kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta tai muista teollisuuden sähkö- ja automaatioasennuksista
* Oma-aloitteista työasennetta sekä ongelmanratkaisukykyä
* Osaamista tai halua oppia PLC- ja väylätekniikasta

Tarjoamme sinulle <https://drive.google.com/file/d/1F8j-lbav67JU8mlh-hDaOPZFvBZ1QNTQ/view>

Työllistyt vakituiseen työsuhteeseen suoraan Algol Technics Oy:lle, joka tarjoaa sinulle loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittyä edelleen alallasi monipuolisten sähkö- ja huoltoasennusten parissa. Mukavan ja reilun työnantajan ohella tukenasi on tiivis ja yhteen hiileen puhaltava työporukka. Algol Technics Oy tarjoaa myös kattavasti erilaisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka edesauttavat työtäsi ja ovat ilonasi myös vapaa-ajalla, kuten kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedun sekä laajan työterveyshuollon. Lisäksi jokaisessa yksikössä on bonuspalkkiojärjestelmä, johon voit vaikuttaa tiimisi kanssa päivittäisessä työssäsi.

Hakuprosessi

Olisiko Algol Technics Oy juuri sinun tuleva työpaikkasi? Lähetäthän hakemuksesi suoraan kotisivujemme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuajalla, ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

Kyseessä on rekrytointitoimeksianto, joten asiakkaamme pyynnöstä toivommekin, että hakemukset lähetetään WorkPowerin kautta ja käännyt puoleemme, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää tehtävään liittyen.

title: Physical Scientist
description:
This position is part of the Office of Environmental Management - Portsmouth Paducah Project Office, Department of Energy. As a Physical Scientist, you will serve as an expert advisor providing strategic leadership for major Department of Energy (DOE) scientific and engineering initiatives. You will also develop and implement technical guidance for complex systems, projects, and programs to resolve novel, mission-critical management and operational challenges.

The mission of Portsmouth/Paducah Project Office (PPPO) is to manage the DOE cleanup efforts at two gaseous diffusion plant sites - Portsmouth (Piketon), Ohio, and Paducah, Kentucky. The PPPO conducts environmental remediation, waste management, depleted Uranium Hexafluoride (DUF6) conversion, and decontamination and decommissioning at the plant sites. PPPO's goal is to accelerate cleanup, eliminating potential environmental threats, reducing the DOE footprint, and reducing life-cycle cost. We are truly honored that DOE has been named America's #1 Best Employer for Veterans in 2023 by Forbes-not only among Government agencies, but among employers across the U.S. We are so proud of this ranking which reflects our commitment to the employment of veterans. As so many veterans at DOE renew their service to our Nation, we are deeply committed to their success and advancement. Veterans shape the future of energy As a Physical Scientist, you will: Direct high-impact scientific and engineering programs lacking technical precedent to to meet key organizational goals and missions. Represent the agency on interagency task forces and before groups such as Congress, state officials, and industry partners to deliver technical briefing or testimony. Evaluates technical maturity and scientific trends across complex technology options to guide decision-making and reduce operational risks. Serve as a technical authority, formulating and implementing key policies while providing strategic counsel to senior leadership and external partners. Develop cross-organizational guidance to resolve complex engineering problems and drive collaborative opportunities with public and private partners.

title: Assistant Vice President
description:
This role is designed for a senior resource who will set up new accounts and projects, establish delivery frameworks, and ensure a smooth transition to steady-state operations. The role also carries P&L governance responsibilities including utilization management, revenue forecasting, and margin simulations.

Key Responsibilities:

Delivery Setup & Transition

  • Lead the initial setup of analytics engagements across verticals.
  • Define solution components, delivery models, governance structures, and execution plans tailored to client needs.
  • Build and onboard cross-functional teams, establish delivery KPIs, and ensure operational readiness.
  • Hands on techno-functional expertise from solution to delivery
  • Act as the primary delivery lead during the incubation phase, transitioning projects to steady-state teams post-stabilization.
  • Drive client engagement and ensure alignment with business objectives during early phases.

Functional Expertise in Analytics:

  • Data Management: Expertise in data architecture, data governance, ETL, and data quality frameworks.
  • Descriptive & Diagnostic Analysis: Strong foundation in BI, reporting, and root cause analysis.
  • Predictive Analytics: Experience with statistical modeling, machine learning, and forecasting techniques.
  • Customer Experience (CX) Analytics: Ability to design and deliver solutions that enhance customer journeys, segmentation, and personalization.
  • Operational Analytics: Proven success in optimizing business processes, supply chain, and workforce efficiency through data-driven insights.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in analytics delivery and financial management.
  • Proven success in setting up and scaling delivery operations across multiple clients and verticals.
  • Strong understanding of analytics platforms, tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, R), and exposure to cloud ecosystems (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Deep expertise in P\&L ownership, budgeting, and forecasting.
  • Excellent client-facing skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Data Science, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in consulting or IT services industry.
  • Exposure to global delivery models and multi-region operations.
